verses.en: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.fr: Prophétie d''Esaïe, fils d''Amots, sur Juda et Jérusalem, au temps d''Ozias, de Jotham, d''Achaz, d''Ezéchias, rois de Juda.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ነገሥታት በዖዝያንና በኢዮአታም በአካዝና በሕዝቅያስ ዘመን ስለ ይሁዳና ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ያየው የአሞጽ ልጅ የኢሳይያስ ራእይ።

verses.en: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the Lord hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
verses.fr: Cieux, écoutez! terre, prête l''oreille! Car l''Eternel parle. J''ai nourri et élevé des enfants, Mais ils se sont révoltés contre moi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና ሰማያት ስሙ፥ ምድርም አድምጪ፤ ልጆችን ወለድሁ አሳደግሁም፥ እነርሱም አመጹብኝ።

verses.en: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
verses.fr: Le boeuf connaît son possesseur, Et l''âne la crèche de son maître: Israël ne connaît rien, Mon peuple n''a point d''intelligence.
verses.am: በሬ የገዢውን አህያም የጌታውን ጋጣ አወቀ፤ እስራኤል ግን አላወቀም፥ ሕዝቤም አላስተዋለም።

verses.en: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
verses.fr: Malheur à la nation pécheresse, au peuple chargé d''iniquités, A la race des méchants, aux enfants corrompus! Ils ont abandonné l''Eternel, ils ont méprisé le Saint d''Israël. Ils se sont retirés en arrière...
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ ወገንና በደል የተሞላበት ሕዝብ፥ የክፉዎች ዘር፥ ርኵሰትን የምታደርጉ ልጆች ሆይ፥ ወዮላችሁ! እግዚአብሔርን ትተዋል የእስራኤልንም ቅዱስ አቃልለዋል ወደ ኋላቸውም እየሄዱ ተለይተዋል።

verses.en: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
verses.fr: Quels châtiments nouveaux vous infliger, Quand vous multipliez vos révoltes? La tête entière est malade, Et tout le coeur est souffrant.
verses.am: ደግሞስ ዓመፃ እየጨመራችሁ ለምን ገና ትቀሰፋላችሁ? ራስ ሁሉ ለሕመም ልብም ሁሉ ለድካም ሆኗል።

verses.en: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
verses.fr: De la plante du pied jusqu''à la tête, rien n''est en bon état: Ce ne sont que blessures, contusions et plaies vives, Qui n''ont été ni pansées, ni bandées, Ni adoucies par l''huile.
verses.am: ከእግር ጫማ አንስቶ እስከ ራስ ድረስ ጤና የለውም፤ ቍስልና እበጥ የሚመግልም ነው፤ አልፈረጠም፥ አልተጠገነም፥ በዘይትም አልለዘበም።

verses.en: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.fr: Votre pays est dévasté, Vos villes sont consumées par le feu, Des étrangers dévorent vos campagnes sous vos yeux, Ils ravagent et détruisent, comme des barbares.
verses.am: ምድራችሁ ባድማ ናት፤ ከተሞቻችሁ በእሳት ተቃጠሉ፤ እርሻችሁንም በፊታችሁ ሌሎች ይበሉታል፤ ባዕድ እንዳፈረሳት ምድር ባድማ ሆነች።

verses.en: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
verses.fr: Et la fille de Sion est restée Comme une cabane dans une vigne, Comme une hutte dans un champ de concombres, Comme une ville épargnée.
verses.am: የጽዮንም ሴት ልጅ በወይን ቦታ እንዳለ ዳስ፥ በዱባ አትክልትም እንዳለ ጎጆ፥ እንደተከበበችም ከተማ ሆና ቀረች።

verses.en: Except the Lord of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
verses.fr: Si l''Eternel des armées Ne nous eût conservé un faible reste, Nous serions comme Sodome, Nous ressemblerions à Gomorrhe.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ዘርን ባያስቀርልን ኖሮ፥ እንደ ሰዶም በሆንነ እንደ ገሞራም በመሰልነ ነበር።

verses.en: Hear the word of the Lord, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
verses.fr: Ecoutez la parole de l''Eternel, chefs de Sodome! Prête l''oreille à la loi de notre Dieu, peuple de Gomorrhe!
verses.am: እናንተ የሰዶም አለቆች ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ እናንተ የገሞራ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ የአምላካችንን ሕግ አድምጡ።

verses.en: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the Lord: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
verses.fr: Qu''ai-je affaire de la multitude de vos sacrifices? dit l''Eternel. Je suis rassasié des holocaustes de béliers et de la graisse des veaux; Je ne prends point plaisir au sang des taureaux, des brebis et des boucs.
verses.am: የመሥዋዕታችሁ ብዛት ለእኔ ምን ይጠቅመኛል? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ የሚቃጠለውን የአውራ በግ መሥዋዕትንና የፍሪዳን ስብ ጠግቤያለሁ፤ የበሬና የበግ ጠቦት የአውራ ፍየልም ደም ደስ አያሰኘኝም።

verses.en: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
verses.fr: Quand vous venez vous présenter devant moi, Qui vous demande de souiller mes parvis?
verses.am: በእኔ ፊት ልትታዩ ብትመጡ ይህን የመቅደሴን አደባባይ መርገጣችሁን ከእጃችሁ የሚሻ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
verses.fr: Cessez d''apporter de vaines offrandes: J''ai en horreur l''encens, Les nouvelles lunes, les sabbats et les assemblées; Je ne puis voir le crime s''associer aux solennités.
verses.am: ምናምንቴውን ቍርባን ጨምራችሁ አታምጡ፤ ዕጣን በእኔ ዘንድ አጸያፊ ነው፤ መባቻችሁንና ሰንበታችሁን በጉባኤ መሰብሰባችሁን አልወድድም፤ በደልንም የተቀደሰውንም ጉባኤ አልታገሥም።

verses.en: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
verses.fr: Mon âme hait vos nouvelles lunes et vos fêtes; Elles me sont à charge; Je suis las de les supporter.
verses.am: መባቻችሁንና በዓላቶቻችሁን ነፍሴ ጠልታለች፤ ሸክም ሆነውብኛል፥ ልታገሣቸውም ደክሜያለሁ።

verses.en: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
verses.fr: Quand vous étendez vos mains, je détourne de vous mes yeux; Quand vous multipliez les prières, je n''écoute pas: Vos mains sont pleines de sang.
verses.am: እጃችሁንም ወደ እኔ ብትዘረጉ ዓይኔን ከእናንተ እሰውራለሁ፥ ልመናንም ብታበዙ አልሰማችሁም፤ እጆቻችሁ ደም ተሞልተዋል።

verses.en: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
verses.fr: Lavez-vous, purifiez-vous, Otez de devant mes yeux la méchanceté de vos actions; Cessez de faire le mal.
verses.am: ታጠቡ ሰውነታችሁንም አንጹ፤ የሥራችሁን ክፋት ከዓይኔ ፊት አስወግዱ፤ ክፉ ማድረግን ተዉ፥

verses.en: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
verses.fr: Apprenez à faire le bien, recherchez la justice, Protégez l''opprimé; Faites droit à l''orphelin, Défendez la veuve.
verses.am: መልካም መሥራትን ተማሩ፥ ፍርድን ፈልጉ፥ የተገፋውን አድኑ፥ ለድሀ አደጉ ፍረዱለት ስለ መበለቲቱም ተምዋገቱ።

verses.en: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.fr: Venez et plaidons! dit l''Eternel. Si vos péchés sont comme le cramoisi, ils deviendront blancs comme la neige; S''ils sont rouges comme la pourpre, ils deviendront comme la laine.
verses.am: ኑና እንዋቀስ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ኃጢአታችሁ እንደ አለላ ብትሆን እንደ አመዳይ ትነጻለች፤ እንደ ደምም ብትቀላ እንደ ባዘቶ ትጠራለች።

verses.en: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
verses.fr: Si vous avez de la bonne volonté et si vous êtes dociles, Vous mangerez les meilleures productions du pays;
verses.am: እሺ ብትሉ ለእኔም ብትታዘዙ፥ የምድርን በረከት ትበላላችሁ፤

verses.en: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.fr: Mais si vous résistez et si vous êtes rebelles, Vous serez dévorés par le glaive, Car la bouche de l''Eternel a parlé.
verses.am: እምቢ ብትሉ ግን ብታምፁም፥ ሰይፍ ይበላችኋል፤ የእግዚአብሔር አፍ ይህን ተናግሮአልና።

verses.en: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
verses.fr: Quoi donc! la cité fidèle est devenue une prostituée! Elle était remplie d''équité, la justice y habitait, Et maintenant il y a des assassins!
verses.am: ፍርድ ሞልቶባት የነበረው የታመነችይቱ ከተማ እንዴት ጋለሞታ ሆነች! ጽድቅ አድሮባት ነበር፥ አሁን ግን ገዳዮች አሉባት።

verses.en: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
verses.fr: Ton argent s''est changé en scories, Ton vin a été coupé d''eau.
verses.am: ብርሽ ወደ ዝገት ተለወጠ፤ የወይን ጠጅሽ ከውሃ ጋር ተደባለቀ።

verses.en: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
verses.fr: Tes chefs sont rebelles et complices des voleurs, Tous aiment les présents et courent après les récompenses; Ils ne font pas droit à l''orphelin, Et la cause de la veuve ne vient pas jusqu''à eux.
verses.am: አለቆችሽ አመጸኞችና የሌቦች ባልንጀሮች ሆኑ፤ ሁሉ ጉቦ ይወድዳሉ፥ ዋጋም ለማግኘት ይሮጣሉ፤ ለድሀ አደጉ አይፈርዱም፥ የመበለቲቱም ሙግት ወደ እነርሱ አይደርስም።

verses.en: Therefore saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici ce que dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées, Le Fort d''Israël: Ah! je tirerai satisfaction de mes adversaires, Et je me vengerai de mes ennemis.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል ኃያል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በጠላቶቼ ላይ ቍጣዬን እፈጽማለሁ፥ የሚቋቋሙኝንም እበቀላለሁ።

verses.en: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
verses.fr: Je porterai ma main sur toi, Je fondrai tes scories, comme avec de la potasse, Et j''enlèverai toutes tes parcelles de plomb.
verses.am: እጄንም በአንቺ ላይ አመጣለሁ፥ ዝገትሽንም በጣም አነጻለሁ፥ ቆርቆሮሽንም ሁሉ አወጣለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
verses.fr: Je rétablirai tes juges tels qu''ils étaient autrefois, Et tes conseillers tels qu''ils étaient au commencement. Après cela, on t''appellera ville de la justice, Cité fidèle.
verses.am: ፈራጆችሽንም እንደ ቀድሞ አማካሪዎችሽንም እንደ መጀመሪያው ጊዜ መልሼ አስነሣለሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ የጽድቅ ከተማ የታመነችም ከተማ ተብለሽ ትጠሪያለሽ።

verses.en: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
verses.fr: Sion sera sauvée par la droiture, Et ceux qui s''y convertiront seront sauvés par la justice.
verses.am: ጽዮን በፍርድ ከእርሷም የሚመለሱ በጽድቅ ይድናሉ።

verses.en: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the Lord shall be consumed.
verses.fr: Mais la ruine atteindra tous les rebelles et les pécheurs, Et ceux qui abandonnent l''Eternel périront.
verses.am: በደለኞችና ኃጢአተኞች ግን በአንድነት ይሰበራሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚተዉ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
verses.fr: On aura honte à cause des térébinthes auxquels vous prenez plaisir, Et vous rougirez à cause des jardins dont vous faites vos délices;
verses.am: በወደዳችኋት የአድባር ዛፍ ታፍራላችሁና፥ ስለ መረጣችኋትም አትክልት እፍረት ይይዛችኋልና፤

verses.en: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
verses.fr: Car vous serez comme un térébinthe au feuillage flétri, Comme un jardin qui n''a pas d''eau.
verses.am: ቅጠልዋ እንደ ረገፈ ዛፍ፥ ውሃም እንደሌለባት አትክልት ትሆናላችሁና።

verses.en: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
verses.fr: L''homme fort sera comme de l''étoupe, Et son oeuvre comme une étincelle; Ils brûleront l''un et l''autre ensemble, Et il n''y aura personne pour éteindre.
verses.am: ኃይለኛውም እንደ ተልባ ጭረት፥ ሥራውም እንደ ጠለሸት ይሆናል፤ አብረውም ይቃጠላሉ እነርሱንም የሚያጠፋ የለም።

verses.en: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Prophétie d''Esaïe, fils d''Amots, sur Juda et Jérusalem.
verses.am: የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ ስለ ይሁዳና ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ያየው ቃል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
verses.fr: Il arrivera, dans la suite des temps, Que la montagne de la maison de l''Eternel Sera fondée sur le sommet des montagnes, Qu''elle s''élèvera par-dessus les collines, Et que toutes les nations y afflueront.
verses.am: በዘመኑም ፍጻሜ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተራራ በተራሮች ራስ ላይ ጸንቶ ይቆማል፥ ከኮረብቶችም በላይ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፥ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ይሰበሰባሉ።

verses.en: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Des peuples s''y rendront en foule, et diront: Venez, et montons à la montagne de l''Eternel, A la maison du Dieu de Jacob, Afin qu''il nous enseigne ses voies, Et que nous marchions dans ses sentiers. Car de Sion sortira la loi, Et de Jérusalem la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሕግ ከጽዮን የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ከኢየሩሳሌም ይወጣልና ብዙዎች አሕዛብ ሄደው። ኑ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተራራ፥ ወደ ያዕቆብ አምላክ ቤት እንውጣ፤ እርሱም መንገዱን ያስተምረናል፥ በጎዳናውም እንሄዳለን ይላሉ።

verses.en: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.fr: Il sera le juge des nations, L''arbitre d''un grand nombre de peuples. De leurs glaives ils forgeront des hoyaux, Et de leurs lances des serpes: Une nation ne tirera plus l''épée contre une autre, Et l''on n''apprendra plus la guerre.
verses.am: በአሕዛብም መካከል ይፈርዳል፥ በብዙ አሕዛብም ላይ ይበይናል፤ ሰይፋቸውንም ማረሻ ጦራቸውንም ማጭድ ለማድረግ ይቀጠቅጣሉ፤ ሕዝብም በሕዝብ ላይ ሰይፍ አያነሣም፥ ሰልፍም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይማሩም።

verses.en: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the Lord.
verses.fr: Maison de Jacob, Venez, et marchons à la lumière de l''Eternel!
verses.am: እናንተ የያዕቆብ ቤት ሆይ፥ ኑ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ብርሃን እንሂድ።

verses.en: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
verses.fr: Car tu as abandonné ton peuple, la maison de Jacob, Parce qu''ils sont pleins de l''Orient, Et adonnés à la magie comme les Philistins, Et parce qu''ils s''allient aux fils des étrangers.
verses.am: ሕዝብህን የያዕቆብን ቤት ትተሃልና፤ ይኸውም የምሥራቅን ሰዎች አመል ስለ ተሞሉ፥ እንደ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ምዋርተኞች ስለ ሆኑ፥ ከባዕድ ልጆችም ጋር ስለ ተባበሩ ነው።

verses.en: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
verses.fr: Le pays est rempli d''argent et d''or, Et il y a des trésors sans fin; Le pays est rempli de chevaux, Et il y a des chars sans nombre.
verses.am: ምድራቸው በብርና በወርቅ ተሞልታለች፥ ለመዛግብቶቻቸውም ፍጻሜ የለውም፤ ምድራቸውም ደግሞ በፈረሶች ተሞልታለች፥ ለሠረገሎቻቸውም ፍጻሜ የለውም።

verses.en: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
verses.fr: Le pays est rempli d''idoles; Ils se prosternent devant l''ouvrage de leurs mains, Devant ce que leurs doigts ont fabriqué.
verses.am: ምድራቸው ደግሞ በጣዖታት ተሞልታለች፤ ጣቶቻቸውም ላደረጉት ለእጃቸው ሥራ ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.en: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
verses.fr: Les petits seront abattus, et les grands seront abaissés: Tu ne leur pardonneras point.
verses.am: ታናሹም ሰው ዝቅ ብሎአል፥ ጨዋውም ተዋርዶአል፤ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቅር አትበላቸው።

verses.en: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty.
verses.fr: Entre dans les rochers, Et cache-toi dans la poussière, Pour éviter la terreur de l''Eternel Et l''éclat de sa majesté.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ማስደንገጥና ከግርማው ክብር የተነሣ ወደ ድንጋይ ዋሻ ግባ፥ በመሬትም ውስጥ ተሸሸግ።

verses.en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.fr: L''homme au regard hautain sera abaissé, Et l''orgueilleux sera humilié: L''Eternel seul sera élevé ce jour-là.
verses.am: ከፍ ያለችውም የሰው ዓይን ትዋረዳለች፥ የሰዎችም ኵራት ትወድቃለች፥ በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ብቻውን ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: For the day of the Lord of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
verses.fr: Car il y a un jour pour l''Eternel des armées Contre tout homme orgueilleux et hautain, Contre quiconque s''élève, afin qu''il soit abaissé;
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን በትዕቢተኛውና በኵራተኛው ሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ባለውም ላይ ይሆናል፥ እርሱም ይዋረዳል፤

verses.en: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.fr: Contre tous les cèdres du Liban, hauts et élevés, Et contre tous les chênes de Basan;
verses.am: ደግሞም በረጅሙ ከፍ ባለው በሊባኖስ ዝግባ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በባሳንም ዛፍ ሁሉ ላይ፥

verses.en: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
verses.fr: Contre toutes les hautes montagnes, Et contre toutes les collines élevées;
verses.am: በረጅሙም ተራራ ሁሉ ላይ፥ ከፍ ባለውም ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ፥

verses.en: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
verses.fr: Contre toutes les hautes tours, Et contre toutes les murailles fortifiées;
verses.am: በረጅሙም ግንብ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በተመሸገውም ቅጥር ሁሉ ላይ፥

verses.en: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
verses.fr: Contre tous les navires de Tarsis, Et contre tout ce qui plaît à la vue.
verses.am: በተርሴስም መርከብ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በሚያማምሩ ጣዖታትም ሁሉ ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.fr: L''homme orgueilleux sera humilié, Et le hautain sera abaissé: L''Eternel seul sera élevé ce jour-là.
verses.am: ሰውም ሁሉ ይዋረዳል፥ የሰውም ኵራት ይወድቃል፥ በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ብቻ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
verses.fr: Toutes les idoles disparaîtront.
verses.am: ጣዖቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ፈጽመው ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.fr: On entrera dans les cavernes des rochers Et dans les profondeurs de la poussière, Pour éviter la terreur de l''Eternel et l''éclat de sa majesté, Quand il se lèvera pour effrayer la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ምድርን ያናውጥ ዘንድ በተነሣ ጊዜ ሰዎች ከማስደንገጡና ከግርማው ክብሩ የተነሣ ወደ ድንጋይ ዋሻና ወደ ምድር ንቃቃት ውስጥ ይገባሉ።

verses.en: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
verses.fr: En ce jour, les hommes jetteront Leurs idoles d''argent et leurs idoles d''or, Qu''ils s''étaient faites pour les adorer, Aux rats et aux chauves-souris;
verses.am: በዚያን ቀን ሰው ይሰግድላቸው ዘንድ ያበጁአቸውን የብሩንና የወርቁን ጣዖቶቹን ለፍልፈልና ለሌሊት ወፍ ይጥላል።

verses.en: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.fr: Et ils entreront dans les fentes des rochers Et dans les creux des pierres, Pour éviter la terreur de l''Eternel et l''éclat de sa majesté, Quand il se lèvera pour effrayer la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ምድርን ያናውጥ ዘንድ በተነሣ ጊዜ ከማስደንገጡና ከግርማው ክብር የተነሣ ወደ ድንጋይ ዋሻና ወደ ተሰነጠቁ ዓለቶች ውስጥ ይገባሉ።

verses.en: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of ?
verses.fr: Cessez de vous confier en l''homme, Dans les narines duquel il n''y a qu''un souffle: Car de quelle valeur est-il?
verses.am: እስትንፋሱ በአፍንጫው ውስጥ ያለበትን ሰው ተዉት፤ እርሱ ስለ ምን ይቈጠራል?

verses.en: For, behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées, Va ôter de Jérusalem et de Juda Tout appui et toute ressource, Toute ressource de pain Et toute ressource d''eau,
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ከኢየሩሳሌምና ከይሁዳ ድጋፍንና ብርታትን፥ የእንጀራን ድጋፍ ሁሉ የውኃውንም ድጋፍ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
verses.fr: Le héros et l''homme de guerre, Le juge et le prophète, le devin et l''ancien,
verses.am: ኃያሉንም፥ ተዋጊውንም፥ ፈራጁንም፥ ነቢዩንም፥ ምዋርተኛውንም፥

verses.en: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
verses.fr: Le chef de cinquante et le magistrat, Le conseiller, l''artisan distingué et l''habile enchanteur.
verses.am: ሽማግሌውንም፥ የአምሳ አለቃውንም፥ ከበርቴውንም፥ አማካሪውንም፥ ብልሁንም ሠራተኛ፥ አስማት አዋቂውንም ይነቅላል።

verses.en: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
verses.fr: Je leur donnerai des jeunes gens pour chefs, Et des enfants domineront sur eux.
verses.am: አለቆቻቸው እንዲሆኑ ብላቴኖችን አስነሣባቸዋለሁ፥ ሕፃናቶችም ይገዙአቸዋል።

verses.en: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
verses.fr: Il y aura réciprocité d''oppression parmi le peuple; L''un opprimera l''autre, chacun son prochain; Le jeune homme attaquera le vieillard, Et l''homme de rien celui qui est honoré.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም፥ ሰው በሰው ላይ ሰውም በባልንጀራው ላይ፥ ይገፋፋል፤ ብላቴናውም በሽማግሌው ላይ የተጠቃውም በከበርቴው ላይ ይኰራል።

verses.en: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:
verses.fr: On ira jusqu''à saisir son frère dans la maison paternelle: Tu as un habit, sois notre chef! Prends ces ruines sous ta main! -
verses.am: ሰውም በአባቱ ቤት ውስጥ ወንድሙን ይዞ። አንተ ልብስ አለህ አለቃም ሁንልን ይህችም ባድማ ከእጅህ በታች ትሁን ሲለው፥

verses.en: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
verses.fr: Ce jour-là même il répondra: Je ne saurais être un médecin, Et dans ma maison il n''y a ni pain ni vêtement; Ne m''établissez pas chef du peuple!
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ድምፁን ከፍ አድርጎ። እኔ በቤቴ ውስጥ እንጀራ ወይም ልብስ የለኝምና ባለ መድኃኒት አልሆንም፤ በሕዝቡም ላይ አለቃ አታደርጉኝም ይላል።

verses.en: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the Lord, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
verses.fr: Jérusalem chancelle, Et Juda s''écroule, Parce que leurs paroles et leurs oeuvres sont contre l''Eternel, Bravant les regards de sa majesté.
verses.am: የክብሩን ዓይን ያስቈጡ ዘንድ ምላሳቸውና ሥራቸው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ነውና ኢየሩሳሌም ተፈታች ይሁዳም ወደቀ።

verses.en: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
verses.fr: L''aspect de leur visage témoigne contre eux, Et, comme Sodome, ils publient leur crime, sans dissimuler. Malheur à leur âme! Car ils se préparent des maux.
verses.am: የፊታቸውም እፍረት ይመሰክርባቸዋል፤ እንደ ሰዶምም ኃጢአታቸውን ያወራሉ፥ አይሠውሩአትም። በራሳቸው ላይ ክፉ ነገርን ሠርተዋልና ለነፍሳቸው ወዮ!

verses.en: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
verses.fr: Dites que le juste prospérera, Car il jouira du fruit de ses oeuvres.
verses.am: የሥራቸውን ፍሬ ይበላሉና ጻድቁን። መልካም ይሆንልሃል በሉት።

verses.en: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
verses.fr: Malheur au méchant! il sera dans l''infortune, Car il recueillera le produit de ses mains.
verses.am: እንደ እጁ ሥራ ፍዳው ይደረግበታልና ለበደለኛ ወዮ! ክፉም ደርሶበታል።

verses.en: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
verses.fr: Mon peuple a pour oppresseurs des enfants, Et des femmes dominent sur lui; Mon peuple, ceux qui te conduisent t''égarent, Et ils corrompent la voie dans laquelle tu marches.
verses.am: ሕዝቤንስ አስገባሪዎቻቸው ይገፉአቸዋል፥ አስጨናቂዎችም ይሠለጥኑባቸዋል። ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ የመሩአችሁ ያስቱአችኋል የምትሄዱበትንም መንገድ ያጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The Lord standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
verses.fr: L''Eternel se présente pour plaider, Il est debout pour juger les peuples.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለፍርድ ተነሥቶአል በሕዝቡም ላይ ሊፈርድ ቆሞአል።

verses.en: The Lord will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
verses.fr: L''Eternel entre en jugement Avec les anciens de son peuple et avec ses chefs: Vous avez brouté la vigne! La dépouille du pauvre est dans vos maisons!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎችና ከአለቆቻቸው ጋር ይፋረዳል፤ የወይኑን ቦታ የጨረሳችሁ እናንተ ናችሁ፤ ከድሆች የበዘበዛችሁት በቤታችሁ አለ፤

verses.en: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord God of hosts.
verses.fr: De quel droit foulez-vous mon peuple, Et écrasez-vous la face des pauvres? Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: ሕዝቤንም ለምን ታደቅቁአቸዋላችሁ? የድሆችንስ ፊት ለምን ትፈጫላችሁ? ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Moreover the Lord saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit: Parce que les filles de Sion sont orgueilleuses, Et qu''elles marchent le cou tendu Et les regards effrontés, Parce qu''elles vont à petits pas, Et qu''elles font résonner les boucles de leurs pieds,
verses.am: ደግሞም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለ። የጽዮን ቈነጃጅት ኰርተዋልና፥ አንገታቸውንም እያሰገጉ በዓይናቸውም እያጣቀሱ፥ ፈንጠርም እያሉ፥ በእግራቸውም እያቃጨሉ ይሄዳሉና

verses.en: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will discover their secret parts.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur rendra chauve le sommet de la tête des filles de Sion, L''Eternel découvrira leur nudité.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ የጽዮንን ቈነጃጅት አናት በቡሀነት ይመታል፥ እግዚአብሔርም ኀፍረተ ሥጋቸውን ይገልጣል።

verses.en: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
verses.fr: En ce jour, le Seigneur ôtera les boucles qui servent d''ornement à leurs pieds, Et les filets et les croissants;
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ጌታ የእግር አልቦውን ክብር፥ መርበብንም፥ ጨረቃ የሚመስለውንም ጌጥ፥ የጆሮ እንጥልጥሉንም፥

verses.en: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
verses.fr: Les pendants d''oreilles, les bracelets et les voiles;
verses.am: አንባሩንም፥ መሸፈኛውንም፥ ቀጸላውንም፥

verses.en: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
verses.fr: Les diadèmes, les chaînettes des pieds et les ceintures, Les boîtes de senteur et les amulettes;
verses.am: ሰንሰለቱንም፥ መቀነቱንም፥ የሽቱውንም ዕቃ፥

verses.en: The rings, and nose jewels,
verses.fr: Les bagues et les anneaux du nez;
verses.am: አሸንክታቡንም፥ የእጅና የአፍንጫ ቀለበቱንም፥

verses.en: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
verses.fr: Les vêtements précieux et les larges tuniques, Les manteaux et les gibecières;
verses.am: የዓመት በዓልንም ልብስ፥ መጐናጸፊያውንም፥ ልግምበገላውንም፥ ከረጢቱንም፥

verses.en: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
verses.fr: Les miroirs et les chemises fines, Les turbans et les surtouts légers.
verses.am: መስተዋቱንም፥ ከጥሩ በፍታ የተሰራውንም ልብስ፥ ራስ ማሰሪያውንም፥ ዓይነ ርግቡንም ያስወግዳል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
verses.fr: Au lieu de parfum, il y aura de l''infection; Au lieu de ceinture, une corde; Au lieu de cheveux bouclés, une tête chauve; Au lieu d''un large manteau, un sac étroit; Une marque flétrissante, au lieu de beauté.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በሽቱ ፋንታ ግማት፥ በመታጠቂያውም ፋንታ ገመድ፥ ጠጕርንም በመንቀስ ፋንታ ቡሀነት፥ በመጐናጸፊያ ፋንታ ማቅ፥ በውበትም ፋንታ ጠባሳ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
verses.fr: Tes hommes tomberont sous le glaive, Et tes héros dans le combat.
verses.am: ጕልማሶችሽ በሰይፍ፥ ኃያላንሽም በውጊያ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
verses.fr: Les portes de Sion gémiront et seront dans le deuil; Dépouillée, elle s''assiéra par terre.
verses.am: በሮችዋ ያዝናሉ ያለቅሱማል፤ እርስዋም ብቻዋን በምድር ላይ ትቀመጣለች።

verses.en: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.
verses.fr: Et sept femmes saisiront en ce jour un seul homme, et diront: Nous mangerons notre pain, Et nous nous vêtirons de nos habits; Fais-nous seulement porter ton nom! Enlève notre opprobre!
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ሰባት ሴቶች። የገዛ እንጀራችንን እንበላለን የገዛ ልብሳችንንም እንለብሳለን፤ ስምህ ብቻ በእኛ ላይ ይጠራ፥ መሰደባችንንም አርቅ ብለው አንዱን ወንድ ይይዙታል።

verses.en: In that day shall the branch of the Lord be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, le germe de l''Eternel Aura de la magnificence et de la gloire, Et le fruit du pays aura de l''éclat et de la beauté Pour les réchappés d''Israël.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቍጥቋጥ ለጌጥና ለክብር ይሆናል፥ ከእስራኤልም ወገን ላመለጡ ሰዎች የምድሪቱን ፍሬ ለትምክሕትና ለውበት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:
verses.fr: Et les restes de Sion, les restes de Jérusalem, Seront appelés saints, Quiconque à Jérusalem sera inscrit parmi les vivants,
verses.am: ጌታም የጽዮንን ቈነጃጅት እድፍ ባጠበ ጊዜ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ደም በፍርድ መንፈስና በሚያቃጥል መንፈስ ከመካከልዋ ባነጻ ጊዜ፥ በጽዮን የቀረ በኢየሩሳሌምም የተረፈ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ለሕይወት የተጻፈ ሁሉ፥ ቅዱስ ይባላል።

verses.en: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
verses.fr: Après que le Seigneur aura lavé les ordures des filles de Sion, Et purifié Jérusalem du sang qui est au milieu d''elle, Par le souffle de la justice et par le souffle de la destruction.
verses.am: ጌታም የጽዮንን ቈነጃጅት እድፍ ባጠበ ጊዜ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ደም በፍርድ መንፈስና በሚያቃጥል መንፈስ ከመካከልዋ ባነጻ ጊዜ፥ በጽዮን የቀረ በኢየሩሳሌምም የተረፈ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ለሕይወት የተጻፈ ሁሉ፥ ቅዱስ ይባላል።

verses.en: And the Lord will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.
verses.fr: L''Eternel établira, sur toute l''étendue de la montagne de Sion Et sur ses lieux d''assemblées, Une nuée fumante pendant le jour, Et un feu de flammes éclatantes pendant la nuit; Car tout ce qui est glorieux sera mis à couvert.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በጽዮን ተራራ ላይ ባለ ማደሪያ ሁሉ በጉባኤአቸውም ላይ በቀን ዳመናንና ጢስን በሌሊትም የሚቃጠለውን የእሳት ብርሃን ይፈጥራል፤ በክብርም ሁሉ ላይ መጋረጃ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the day time from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
verses.fr: Il y aura un abri pour donner de l''ombre contre la chaleur du jour, Pour servir de refuge et d''asile contre l''orage et la pluie.
verses.am: በቀን ከሙቀት ለጥላ፥ ከዐውሎ ነፋስና ከዝናብም ለመጠጊያና ለመሸሸጊያ ጎጆ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
verses.fr: Je chanterai à mon bien-aimé Le cantique de mon bien-aimé sur sa vigne. Mon bien-aimé avait une vigne, Sur un coteau fertile.
verses.am: አሁን ስለ ወዳጄና ስለ ወይን ቦታው ለወዳጄ ቅኔ እቀኛለሁ። ለወዳጄ በፍሬያማው ኮረብታ ላይ የወይን ቦታ ነበረው።

verses.en: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
verses.fr: Il en remua le sol, ôta les pierres, et y mit un plant délicieux; Il bâtit une tour au milieu d''elle, Et il y creusa aussi une cuve. Puis il espéra qu''elle produirait de bons raisins, Mais elle en a produit de mauvais.
verses.am: በዙሪያው ቈፈረ፥ ድንጋዮችንም ለቅሞ አወጣ፥ ምርጥ የሆነውንም አረግ ተከለበት፥ በመካከሉም ግንብ ሠራ፥ ደግሞም የመጥመቂያ ጕድጓድ ማሰበት፤ ወይንንም ያፈራ ዘንድ ተማመነ፥ ዳሩ ግን ሆምጣጣ ፍሬ አፈራ።

verses.en: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
verses.fr: Maintenant donc, habitants de Jérusalem et hommes de Juda, Soyez juges entre moi et ma vigne!
verses.am: አሁንም እናንተ በኢየሩሳሌም የምትኖሩ የይሁዳ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ በእኔና በወይኑ ቦታዬ መካከል እስኪ ፍረዱ።

verses.en: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
verses.fr: Qu''y avait-il encore à faire à ma vigne, Que je n''aie pas fait pour elle? Pourquoi, quand j''ai espéré qu''elle produirait de bons raisins, En a-t-elle produit de mauvais?
verses.am: ለወይኔ ያላደረግሁለት፥ ከዚህ ሌላ አደርግለት ዘንድ የሚገባኝ ምንድር ነው? ወይንን ያፈራል ብዬ ስትማመን ስለ ምን ሆምጣጣ ፍሬ አፈራ?

verses.en: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
verses.fr: Je vous dirai maintenant Ce que je vais faire à ma vigne. J''en arracherai la haie, pour qu''elle soit broutée; J''en abattrai la clôture, pour qu''elle soit foulée aux pieds.
verses.am: አሁንም በወይኔ ላይ የማደርገውን እነግራችኋለሁ፤ አጥሩን እነቅላለሁ፥ ለማሰማርያም ይሆናል፤ ቅጥሩንም አፈርሳለሁ፥ ለመራገጫም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
verses.fr: Je la réduirai en ruine; elle ne sera plus taillée, ni cultivée; Les ronces et les épines y croîtront; Et je donnerai mes ordres aux nuées, Afin qu''elles ne laissent plus tomber la pluie sur elle.
verses.am: ባድማ አደርገዋለሁ፤ አይቈረጥም፥ አይኰተኰትም፤ ኵርንችትና እሾህ ይበቅልበታል፤ ዝናብንም እንዳያዘንቡበት ዳመናዎችን አዝዛለሁ።

verses.en: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
verses.fr: La vigne de l''Eternel des armées, c''est la maison d''Israël, Et les hommes de Juda, c''est le plant qu''il chérissait. Il avait espéré de la droiture, et voici du sang versé! De la justice, et voici des cris de détresse!
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ወይን ቦታ እርሱ የእስራኤል ቤት ነው፥ የደስታውም አትክልት የይሁዳ ሰዎች ናቸው፤ ፍርድን ተስፋ ያደርግ ነበር፥ እነሆም ደም ማፍሰስ ሆነ፤ ጽድቅንም ይተማመን ነበር፥ እነሆም፥ ጩኸት ሆነ።

verses.en: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui ajoutent maison à maison, Et qui joignent champ à champ, Jusqu''à ce qu''il n''y ait plus d''espace, Et qu''ils habitent seuls au milieu du pays!
verses.am: ስፍራ እስከማይቀር ድረስ እናንተም በምድር ላይ ብቻችሁን እስክትቀመጡ ድረስ፥ ቤትን ከቤት ጋር ለሚያያይዙ እርሻንም ከእርሻ ጋር ለሚያቀራርቡ ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: In mine ears said the Lord of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
verses.fr: Voici ce que m''a révélé l''Eternel des armées: Certainement, ces maisons nombreuses seront dévastées, Ces grandes et belles maisons n''auront plus d''habitants.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በጆሮዬ እንዲህ አለ። በእውነት ብዙ ታላቅና መልካም ቤት ባድማ ይሆናል፥ የሚቀመጥበትም አይገኝም።

verses.en: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
verses.fr: Même dix arpents de vigne ne produiront qu''un bath, Et un homer de semence ne produira qu''un épha.
verses.am: ከወይኑ ቦታ አሥር ጥማድ በሬ ካረሰው አንድ የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ብቻ ይወጣል፤ አንድ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ዘር አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ብቻ ይሰጣል።

verses.en: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui de bon matin Courent après les boissons enivrantes, Et qui bien avant dans la nuit Sont échauffés par le vin!
verses.am: ስካርን ለመከተል በጥዋት ለሚማልዱ፥ የወይን ጠጅም እስኪያቃጥላቸው እስከ ሌሊት ድረስ ለሚዘገዩ ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the Lord, neither consider the operation of his hands.
verses.fr: La harpe et le luth, le tambourin, la flûte et le vin, animent leurs festins; Mais ils ne prennent point garde à l''oeuvre de l''Eternel, Et ils ne voient point le travail de ses mains.
verses.am: መሰንቆና በገና ከበሮና እምቢልታም የወይን ጠጅም በግብዣቸው አለ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ ግን አልተመለከቱም፥ እጁም ያደረገችውን አላስተዋሉም።

verses.en: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi mon peuple sera soudain emmené captif; Sa noblesse mourra de faim, Et sa multitude sera desséchée par la soif.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሕዝቤ ወደ ምርኮ ሄዱ፥ ጌታን አላወቁትምና፤ ከበርቴዎቻቸውም ተራቡ፥ ሕዝባቸውም ተጠሙ።

verses.en: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi le séjour des morts ouvre sa bouche, Elargit sa gueule outre mesure; Alors descendent la magnificence et la richesse de Sion, Et sa foule bruyante et joyeuse.
verses.am: ሲኦልም ሆድዋን አስፍታለች፥ አፍዋንም ያለ ልክ ከፍታለች፤ ከበርቴዎቻቸውና አዛውንቶቻቸው ባለጠጎቻቸውም ደስተኞቻቸውም ወደ እርስዋ ይወርዳሉ።

verses.en: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
verses.fr: Les petits seront abattus, les grands seront humiliés, Et les regards des hautains seront abaissés.
verses.am: ሰውም ይጐሰቍላል፥ ሰውም ይዋረዳል፥ የትዕቢተኞችም ዓይን ትዋረዳለች፤

verses.en: But the Lord of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées sera élevé par le jugement, Et le Dieu saint sera sanctifié par la justice.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ግን በፍርድ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአል፥ ቅዱሱም አምላክ በጽድቅ ተቀድሶአል።

verses.en: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
verses.fr: Des brebis paîtront comme sur leur pâturage, Et des étrangers dévoreront les possessions ruinées des riches.
verses.am: የበግ ጠቦቶች በማሰማርያቸው ውስጥ ይሰማራሉ፥ እንግዶችም የሰቡትን ባድማ ይበላሉ።

verses.en: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui tirent l''iniquité avec les cordes du vice, Et le péché comme avec les traits d''un char,
verses.am: በደልን በምናምንቴ ገመድ፥ ኃጢአትንም በሰረገላ ማሰሪያ ወደ ራሳቸው ለሚስቡ። እናይ ዘንድ ይቸኵል፥

verses.en: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
verses.fr: Et qui disent: Qu''il hâte, qu''il accélère son oeuvre, Afin que nous la voyions! Que le décret du Saint d''Israël arrive et s''exécute, Afin que nous le connaissions!
verses.am: ሥራውንም ያፋጥን፤ እናውቃትም ዘንድ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ምክር ትቅረብ፥ ትምጣ ለሚሉ ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui appellent le mal bien, et le bien mal, Qui changent les ténèbres en lumière, et la lumière en ténèbres, Qui changent l''amertume en douceur, et la douceur en amertume!
verses.am: ክፉውን መልካም መልካሙን ክፉ ለሚሉ፥ ጨለማውን ብርሃን ብርሃኑንም ጨለማ ለሚያደርጉ፥ ጣፋጩን መራራ መራራውንም ጣፋጭ ለሚያደርጉ ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui sont sages à leurs yeux, Et qui se croient intelligents!
verses.am: በዓይናቸው ጥበበኞች በነፍሳቸውም አስተዋዮች ለሆኑ ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui ont de la bravoure pour boire du vin, Et de la vaillance pour mêler des liqueurs fortes;
verses.am: የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጣት ኃያላን የሚያሰክረውንም ለማደባለቅ ጨካኞች ለሆኑ፤

verses.en: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
verses.fr: Qui justifient le coupable pour un présent, Et enlèvent aux innocents leurs droits!
verses.am: በደለኛውን ስለ ጉቦ ጻድቅ ለሚያደርጉ፥ የጻድቁንም ጽድቅ ለሚያስወግዱበት ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the Lord of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, comme une langue de feu dévore le chaume, Et comme la flamme consume l''herbe sèche, Ainsi leur racine sera comme de la pourriture, Et leur fleur se dissipera comme de la poussière; Car ils ont dédaigné la loi de l''Eternel des armées, Et ils ont méprisé la parole du Saint d''Israël.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእሳት ወላፈን ቃርሚያን እንደሚበላ፥ እብቅም በነበልባል ውስጥ እንደሚጠፋ፥ እንዲሁ የእነርሱ ሥር የበሰበሰ ይሆናል ቡቃያቸውም እንደ ትቢያ ይበንናል፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ጥለዋልና፥ የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ የተናገረውን ቃል አቃልለዋልና።

verses.en: Therefore is the anger of the Lord kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi la colère de l''Eternel s''enflamme contre son peuple, Il étend sa main sur lui, et il le frappe; Les montagnes s''ébranlent; Et les cadavres sont comme des balayures au milieu des rues. Malgré tout cela, sa colère ne s''apaise point, Et sa main est encore étendue.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በሕዝቡ ላይ ነድዶአል እጁንም በላያቸው ዘርግቶ መትቶአቸዋል፤ ተራሮችም ተንቀጠቀጡ፥ ሬሳቸውም በአደባባይ መካከል እንደ ጕድፍ ሆኖአል። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፥ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።

verses.en: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
verses.fr: Il élève une bannière pour les peuples lointains, Et il en siffle un des extrémités de la terre: Et voici, il arrive avec promptitude et légèreté.
verses.am: ለአሕዛብም በሩቅ ምልክትን ያቆማል፥ ከምድርም ዳርቻ በፉጨት ይጠራቸዋል፤ እነሆም፥ እየተጣደፉ ፈጥነው ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
verses.fr: Nul n''est fatigué, nul ne chancelle de lassitude, Personne ne sommeille, ni ne dort; Aucun n''a la ceinture de ses reins détachée, Ni la courroie de ses souliers rompue.
verses.am: ደካማና ስንኵል የለባቸውም፥ የሚያንቀላፋና የሚተኛም የለም፤ የወገባቸውም መቀነት አይፈታም፥ የጫማቸውም ማዘቢያ አይበጠስም።

verses.en: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
verses.fr: Ses flèches sont aiguës, Et tous ses arcs tendus; Les sabots de ses chevaux ressemblent à des cailloux, Et les roues de ses chars à un tourbillon.
verses.am: ፍላጾቻቸው ተስለዋል፥ ቀስቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ተለጥጠዋል፤ የፈረሶቻቸውም ኮቴ እንደ ቡላድ የሰረገሎቻቸውም መንኰራኵር እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይቈጠራል።

verses.en: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.
verses.fr: Son rugissement est comme celui d''une lionne; Il rugit comme des lionceaux, il gronde, et saisit la proie, Il l''emporte, et personne ne vient au secours.
verses.am: ጩኸታቸው እንደ አንበሳ ነው፥ እንደ አንበሳ ደቦሎችም ያገሣሉ፤ ንጥቂያንም ይዘው ያገሣሉ፥ ይወስዱትማል፥ የሚያድንም የለም።

verses.en: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
verses.fr: En ce jour, il y aura près de lui un mugissement, Comme celui d''une tempête sur mer; En regardant la terre, on ne verra que ténèbres, Avec des alternatives d''angoisse et d''espérance; Au ciel, l''obscurité régnera.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንደ ባሕር መትመም ይተምሙባቸዋል፤ ወደ ምድርም ቢመለከቱ፥ እነሆ፥ ጨለማና መከራ አለ፤ ብርሃንም በደመናዎችዋ ውስጥ ጨልሞአል።

verses.en: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
verses.fr: L''année de la mort du roi Ozias, je vis le Seigneur assis sur un trône très élevé, et les pans de sa robe remplissaient le temple.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ዖዝያን በሞተበት ዓመት እግዚአብሔርን በረጅምና ከፍ ባለ ዙፋን ላይ ተቀምጦ አየሁት፥ የልብሱም ዘርፍ መቅደሱን ሞልቶት ነበር።

verses.en: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
verses.fr: Des séraphins se tenaient au-dessus de lui; ils avaient chacun six ailes; deux dont ils se couvraient la face, deux dont ils se couvraient les pieds, et deux dont ils se servaient pour voler.
verses.am: ሱራፌልም ከእርሱ በላይ ቆመው ነበር፥ ለእያንዳንዱም ስድስት ክንፍ ነበረው፤ በሁለት ክንፍ ፊቱን ይሸፍን ነበር፥ በሁለቱም ክንፍ እግሮቹን ይሸፍን ነበር፥ በሁለቱም ክንፍ ይበር ነበር።

verses.en: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
verses.fr: Ils criaient l''un à l''autre, et disaient: Saint, saint, saint est l''Eternel des armées! toute la terre est pleine de sa gloire!
verses.am: አንዱም ለአንዱ። ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ምድር ሁሉ ከክብሩ ተሞልታለች እያለ ይጮኽ ነበር።

verses.en: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.fr: Les portes furent ébranlées dans leurs fondements par la voix qui retentissait, et la maison se remplit de fumée.
verses.am: የመድረኩም መሠረት ከጭዋኺው ድምፅ የተነሣ ተናወጠ፥ ቤቱንም ጢስ ሞላበት።

verses.en: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: Alors je dis: Malheur à moi! je suis perdu, car je suis un homme dont les lèvres sont impures, j''habite au milieu d''un peuple dont les lèvres sont impures, et mes yeux ont vu le Roi, l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: እኔም። ከንፈሮቼ የረከሱብኝ ሰው በመሆኔ፥ ከንፈሮቻቸውም በረከሱባቸው ሕዝብ መካከል በመቀመጤ ዓይኖቼ የሠራዊትን ጌታ ንጉሡን እግዚአብሔርን ስለ አዩ ጠፍቻለሁና ወዮልኝ! አልሁ።

verses.en: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
verses.fr: Mais l''un des séraphins vola vers moi, tenant à la main une pierre ardente, qu''il avait prise sur l''autel avec des pincettes.
verses.am: ከሱራፌልም አንዱ እየበረረ ወደ እኔ መጣ፥ በእጁም ከመሠዊያው በጕጠት የወሰደው ፍም ነበረ።

verses.en: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.
verses.fr: Il en toucha ma bouche, et dit: Ceci a touché tes lèvres; ton iniquité est enlevée, et ton péché est expié.
verses.am: አፌንም ዳሰሰበትና። እነሆ፥ ይህ ከንፈሮችህን ነክቶአል፤ በደልህም ከአንተ ተወገደ፥ ኃጢአትህም ተሰረየልህ አለኝ።

verses.en: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
verses.fr: J''entendis la voix du Seigneur, disant: Qui enverrai-je, et qui marchera pour nous? Je répondis: Me voici, envoie-moi.
verses.am: የጌታንም ድምፅ። ማንን እልካለሁ? ማንስ ይሄድልናል? ሲል ሰማሁ። እኔም። እነሆኝ፥ እኔን ላከኝ አልሁ።

verses.en: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
verses.fr: Il dit alors: Va, et dis à ce peuple: Vous entendrez, et vous ne comprendrez point; Vous verrez, et vous ne saisirez point.
verses.am: እርሱም። ሂድ፥ ይህን ሕዝብ። መስማትን ትሰማላችሁ አታስተውሉምም፤ ማየትንም ታያላችሁ አትመለከቱምም በላቸው።

verses.en: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
verses.fr: Rends insensible le coeur de ce peuple, Endurcis ses oreilles, et bouche-lui les yeux, Pour qu''il ne voie point de ses yeux, n''entende point de ses oreilles, Ne comprenne point de son coeur, Ne se convertisse point et ne soit point guéri.
verses.am: በዓይናቸው እንዳያዩ፥ በጆሮአቸውም እንዳይሰሙ፥ በልባቸውም እንዳያስተውሉ፥ ተመልሰውም እንዳይፈወሱ፥ የዚህን ሕዝብ ልብ አደንድን፥ ጆሮአቸውንም አደንቍር፥ ዓይናቸውንም ጨፍን አለኝ።

verses.en: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
verses.fr: Je dis: Jusqu''à quand, Seigneur? Et il répondit: Jusqu''à ce que les villes soient dévastées Et privées d''habitants; Jusqu''à ce qu''il n''y ait personne dans les maisons, Et que le pays soit ravagé par la solitude;
verses.am: እኔም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ነው? አልሁ። እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። ከተሞች የሚኖርባቸውን አጥተው እስኪፈርሱ ድረስ፥ ቤቶችም ሰው አልቦ እስኪሆኑ ምድርም ፈጽሞ ባድማ ሆና እስክትቀር ድረስ፥

verses.en: And the Lord have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à ce que l''Eternel ait éloigné les hommes, Et que le pays devienne un immense désert,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰዎችን እስኪያርቅ፥ በምድርም መካከል ውድማው መሬት እስኪበዛ ድረስ ነው።

verses.en: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.
verses.fr: Et s''il y reste encore un dixième des habitants, Ils seront à leur tour anéantis. Mais, comme le térébinthe et le chêne Conservent leur tronc quand ils sont abattus, Une sainte postérité renaîtra de ce peuple.
verses.am: በእርስዋም ዘንድ አሥረኛ እጅ ቀርቶ እንደ ሆነ እርሱ ደግሞ ይቃጠላል፤ በተቈረጡ ጊዜ ጉቶቻቸው እንደ ቀሩ እንደ ግራርና እንደ ኮምበል ዛፍ ሆኖ፥ ጉቶው የተቀደሰ ዘር ይሆናል።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.fr: Il arriva, du temps d''Achaz, fils de Jotham, fils d''Ozias, roi de Juda, que Retsin, roi de Syrie, monta avec Pékach, fils de Remalia, roi d''Israël, contre Jérusalem, pour l''assiéger; mais il ne put l''assiéger.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በዖዝያን ልጅ በኢዮአታም ልጅ በአካዝ ዘመን የሶርያ ንጉሥ ረአሶን የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ፋቁሔ ኢየሩሳሌምን ሊወጉ ወጡ፥ ሊያሸንፉአትም አልቻሉም።

verses.en: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
verses.fr: On vint dire à la maison de David: Les Syriens sont campés en Ephraïm. Et le coeur d''Achaz et le coeur de son peuple furent agités, comme les arbres de la forêt sont agités par le vent.
verses.am: ለዳዊትም ቤት። ሶርያ ከኤፍሬም ጋር ተባብረዋል የሚል ወሬ ተነገረ፤ የእርሱም ልብ የሕዝቡም ልብ የዱር ዛፍ በነፋስ እንድትናወጥ ተናወጠ።

verses.en: Then said the Lord unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shearjashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field;
verses.fr: Alors l''Eternel dit à Esaïe: Va à la rencontre d''Achaz, toi et Schear-Jaschub, ton fils, vers l''extrémité de l''aqueduc de l''étang supérieur, sur la route du champ du foulon.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኢሳይያስን አለው። አንተና ልጅህ ያሱብ አካዝን ትገናኙት ዘንድ በልብስ አጣቢው እርሻ መንገድ ወዳለው ወደ ላይኛው የኵሬ መስኖ ጫፍ ውጡ፤

verses.en: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.fr: Et dis-lui: Sois tranquille, ne crains rien, Et que ton coeur ne s''alarme pas, Devant ces deux bouts de tisons fumants, Devant la colère de Retsin et de la Syrie, et du fils de Remalia,
verses.am: እንዲህም በለው። ተጠበቅ፥ ዝምም በል፤ ስለ እነዚህ ስለሚጤሱ ስለ ሁለት የእንጨት ጠለሸቶች፥ ስለ ሶርያና ስለ ረአሶን ስለ ሮሜልዩም ልጅ ቍጣ አትፍራ፥ ልብህም አይድከም።

verses.en: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
verses.fr: De ce que la Syrie médite du mal contre toi, De ce qu''Ephraïm et le fils de Remalia disent:
verses.am: ሶርያና ኤፍሬም የሮሜልዩም ልጅ። ወደ ይሁዳ እንውጣ እናስጨንቀውም፥ እንስበረውም፥ የጣብኤልንም ልጅ እናንግሥበት ብለው ክፋት ስለ መከሩብህ፤

verses.en: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:
verses.fr: Montons contre Juda, assiégeons la ville, Et battons-la en brèche, Et proclamons-y pour roi le fils de Tabeel.
verses.am: ሶርያና ኤፍሬም የሮሜልዩም ልጅ። ወደ ይሁዳ እንውጣ እናስጨንቀውም፥ እንስበረውም፥ የጣብኤልንም ልጅ እናንግሥበት ብለው ክፋት ስለ መከሩብህ፤

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Cela n''arrivera pas, cela n''aura pas lieu.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ ምክር አይጸናምና አይሆንም።

verses.en: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
verses.fr: Car Damas est la tête de la Syrie, Et Retsin est la tête de Damas. Encore soixante-cinq ans, Ephraïm ne sera plus un peuple.
verses.am: የሶርያ ራስ ደማስቆ ነው፥ የደማስቆም ራስ ረአሶን ነው፤ በስድሳ አምስት ዓመት ውስጥ ኤፍሬም ይሰባበራልና ሕዝብ አይሆንም፤

verses.en: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
verses.fr: La Samarie est la tête d''Ephraïm, Et le fils de Remalia est la tête de la Samarie. Si vous ne croyez pas, Vous ne subsisterez pas.
verses.am: የኤፍሬምም ራስ ሰማርያ ነው፥ የሰማርያም ራስ የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ነው። ባታምኑ አትጸኑም።

verses.en: Moreover the Lord spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla de nouveau à Achaz, et lui dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ አካዝን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Ask thee a sign of the Lord thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
verses.fr: Demande en ta faveur un signe à l''Eternel, ton Dieu; demande-le, soit dans les lieux bas, soit dans les lieux élevés.
verses.am: ከጥልቁ ወይም ከከፍታው ቢሆን ከአምላክህ ከእግዚአብሔር ምልክትን ለምን።

verses.en: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the Lord.
verses.fr: Achaz répondit: Je ne demanderai rien, je ne tenterai pas l''Eternel.
verses.am: አካዝም። አልለምንም፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አልፈታተንም አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
verses.fr: Esaïe dit alors: Ecoutez donc, maison de David! Est-ce trop peu pour vous de lasser la patience des hommes, Que vous lassiez encore celle de mon Dieu?
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። እናንተ የዳዊት ቤት ሆይ፥ ስሙ፤ በውኑ ሰውን ማድከማችሁ ቀላል ነውን? አምላኬን ደግሞ የምታደክሙ፤

verses.en: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi le Seigneur lui-même vous donnera un signe, Voici, la jeune fille deviendra enceinte, elle enfantera un fils, Et elle lui donnera le nom d''Emmanuel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ ራሱ ምልክት ይሰጣችኋል፤ እነሆ፥ ድንግል ትፀንሳለች፥ ወንድ ልጅም ትወልዳለች፥ ስሙንም አማኑኤል ብላ ትጠራዋለች።

verses.en: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
verses.fr: Il mangera de la crème et du miel, Jusqu''à ce qu''il sache rejeter le mal et choisir le bien.
verses.am: ክፉን ለመጥላት መልካሙንም ለመምረጥ ሲያውቅ ቅቤና ማር ይበላል።

verses.en: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
verses.fr: Mais avant que l''enfant sache rejeter le mal et choisir le bien, Le pays dont tu crains les deux rois sera abandonné.
verses.am: ሕፃኑ ክፉን ለመጥላት መልካሙን ለመምረጥ ሳያውቅ የፈራሃቸው የሁለቱ ነገሥታት አገር ባድማ ትሆናለች።

verses.en: The Lord shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fera venir sur toi, Sur ton peuple et sur la maison de ton père, Des jours tels qu''il n''y en a point eu Depuis le jour où Ephraïm s''est séparé de Juda Le roi d''Assyrie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኤፍሬም ከይሁዳ ከተለየበት ቀን ጀምሮ ያልመጣውን ዘመን በአንተና በሕዝብህ በአባትህም ቤት ላይ ያመጣል፤ እርሱም የአሦር ንጉሥ መምጣት ነው።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, l''Eternel sifflera les mouches Qui sont à l''extrémité des canaux de l''Egypte, Et les abeilles qui sont au pays d''Assyrie;
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር በግብጽ ወንዝ ዳርቻ ያለውን ዝምብ በአሦርም አገር ያለውን ንብ በፉጨት ይጠራል።

verses.en: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
verses.fr: Elles viendront, et se poseront toutes dans les vallons désolés, Et dans les fentes des rochers, Sur tous les buissons, Et sur tous les pâturages.
verses.am: ይመጡማል፥ እነርሱም ሁሉ በበረሃ ሸለቆ በድንጋይም ዋሻ ውስጥ በእሾህ ቍጥቋጦ ሁሉ ላይ በማሰማርያውም ሁሉ ላይ ይሰፍራሉ።

verses.en: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, le Seigneur rasera, avec un rasoir pris à louage Au delà du fleuve, Avec le roi d''Assyrie, La tête et le poil des pieds; Il enlèvera aussi la barbe.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ከወንዙ ማዶ በተከራየው ምላጭ በአሦር ንጉሥ የራሱንና የእግሩን ጠጕር ይላጨዋል፤ ምላጩም ጢሙን ደግሞ ይበላል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, Chacun entretiendra une jeune vache et deux brebis;
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ሰው አንዲት ጊደርን ሁለት በጎችንም ያሳድጋል፤

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
verses.fr: Et il y aura une telle abondance de lait Qu''on mangera de la crème, Car c''est de crème et de miel que se nourriront Tous ceux qui seront restés dans le pays.
verses.am: ከሚሰጡት ወተት ብዛት የተነሣ ቅቤ ይበላል፤ በአገሪቱም መካከል የቀረ ሁሉ ቅቤና ማር ይበላል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, Tout lieu qui contiendra mille ceps de vigne, Valant mille sicles d''argent, Sera livré aux ronces et aux épines:
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ሺህ ብር የተገመተ ሺህ የወይን ግንድ በነበረበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ለኵርንችትና ለእሾህ ይሆናል።

verses.en: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
verses.fr: On y entrera avec les flèches et avec l''arc, Car tout le pays ne sera que ronces et épines.
verses.am: ኵርንችትና እሾህ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ነውና በፍላጻና በቀስት ወደዚያ ይገባሉ።

verses.en: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
verses.fr: Et toutes les montagnes que l''on cultivait avec la bêche Ne seront plus fréquentées, par crainte des ronces et des épines: On y lâchera le boeuf, et la brebis en foulera le sol.
verses.am: በመቈፈርያም ወደ ተቈፈሩ ኮረብቶች ሁሉ ከኵርንችትና እሾህ ፍርሃት የተነሣ ወደዚያ አትሄድም፤ ነገር ግን የበሬ ማሰማርያና የበግ መራገጫ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Moreover the Lord said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Mahershalalhashbaz.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Prends une grande table, et écris dessus, d''une manière intelligible: Qu''on se hâte de piller, qu''on se précipite sur le butin.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ታላቅ ሰሌዳ ወስደህ። ምርኮ ፈጠነ፥ ብዝበዛ ቸኰለ ብለህ በሰው ፊደል ጻፍበት።

verses.en: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
verses.fr: Je pris avec moi des témoins dignes de foi, le sacrificateur Urie, et Zacharie, fils de Bérékia.
verses.am: የታመኑትን ሰዎች ካህኑን ኦርዮንና የበራክዩን ልጅ ዘካርያስን ምስክሮች አድርግልኝ አለኝ።

verses.en: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the Lord to me, Call his name Mahershalalhashbaz.
verses.fr: Je m''étais approché de la prophétesse; elle conçut, et elle enfanta un fils. L''Eternel me dit: Donne-lui pour nom Maher-Schalal-Chasch-Baz.
verses.am: ወደ ነቢይቱም ቀረብሁ፤ እርስዋም ፀነሰች ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች።

verses.en: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.
verses.fr: Car, avant que l''enfant sache dire: Mon père! ma mère! on emportera devant le roi d''Assyrie les richesses de Damas et le butin de Samarie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ሕፃኑ አባቱንና እናቱን መጥራት ሳያውቅ የደማስቆን ሀብትና የሰማርያን ምርኮ በአሦር ንጉሥ ፊት ይወስዳልና ስሙን። ምርኮ ፈጠነ፥ ብዝበዛ ቸኰለ ብለህ ጥራው አለኝ።

verses.en: The Lord spake also unto me again, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel me parla encore, et me dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ ተናገረኝ እንዲህም አለኝ።

verses.en: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;
verses.fr: Parce que ce peuple a méprisé les eaux de Siloé qui coulent doucement Et qu''il s''est réjoui au sujet de Retsin et du fils de Remalia,
verses.am: ይህ ሕዝብ በቀስታ የሚሄደውን የሰሊሆምን ውኃ ጠልቶአልና፥ ረአሶንንና የሮሜልዩንም ልጅ ወዶአልና ስለዚህ፥

verses.en: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
verses.fr: Voici, le Seigneur va faire monter contre eux Les puissantes et grandes eaux du fleuve Le roi d''Assyrie et toute sa gloire; Il s''élèvera partout au-dessus de son lit, Et il se répandra sur toutes ses rives;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ብርቱና ብዙ የሆነውን የወንዝ ውኃ፥ የአሦርን ንጉሥና ክብሩን ሁሉ፥ ያመጣባቸዋል፤ መስኖውንም ሁሉ ሞልቶ ይወጣል፥ በዳሩም ሁሉ ላይ ይፈስሳል፤

verses.en: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
verses.fr: Il pénétrera dans Juda, il débordera et inondera, Il atteindra jusqu''au cou. Le déploiement de ses ailes Remplira l''étendue de ton pays, ô Emmanuel!
verses.am: እየጐረፈም ወደ ይሁዳ ይገባል፤ እያጥለቀለቀም ያልፋል፥ እስከ አንገትም ይደርሳል፤ አማኑኤል ሆይ፥ የክንፉ መዘርጋት የአገርህን ስፋት ትሞላለች።

verses.en: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
verses.fr: Poussez des cris de guerre, peuples! et vous serez brisés; Prêtez l''oreille, vous tous qui habitez au loin! Préparez-vous au combat, et vous serez brisés; Préparez-vous au combat, et vous serez brisés.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ እወቁና ደንግጡ፤ እናንተም ምድራችሁ የራቀ ሁሉ፥ አድምጡ፤ ታጠቁም፥ ደንግጡ፤ ታጠቁ፤ ደንግጡ።

verses.en: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
verses.fr: Formez des projets, et ils seront anéantis; Donnez des ordres, et ils seront sans effet: Car Dieu est avec nous.
verses.am: ተመካከሩ፥ ምክራችሁም ይፈታል፤ ቃሉን ተናገሩ፥ ቃሉም አይጸናም፤ እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር ነውና።

verses.en: For the Lord spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
verses.fr: Ainsi m''a parlé l''Eternel, quand sa main me saisit, Et qu''il m''avertit de ne pas marcher dans la voie de ce peuple:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በጽኑ እጅ እንዲህ ተናገረኝ፥ በዚህም ሕዝብ መንገድ አንዳልሄድ አስጠነቀቀኝ፥ እንዲህም አለኝ።

verses.en: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
verses.fr: N''appelez pas conjuration tout ce que ce peuple appelle conjuration; Ne craignez pas ce qu''il craint, et ne soyez pas effrayés.
verses.am: ይህ ሕዝብ። ዱለት ነው በሚሉት ሁሉ። ዱለት ነው አትበሉ፤ መፈራታቸውንም አትፍሩ፥ አትደንግጡ።

verses.en: Sanctify the Lord of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
verses.fr: C''est l''Eternel des armées que vous devez sanctifier, C''est lui que vous devez craindre et redouter.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን ቀድሱት፤ የሚያስፈራችሁና የሚያስደነግጣችሁም እርሱ ይሁን።

verses.en: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Et il sera un sanctuaire, Mais aussi une pierre d''achoppement, Un rocher de scandale pour les deux maisons d''Israël, Un filet et un piège Pour les habitants de Jérusalem.
verses.am: እርሱም ለመቅደስ ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን ለሁለቱ ለእስራኤል ቤቶች ለዕንቅፋት ድንጋይና ለማሰናከያ ዓለት፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ለሚኖሩ ለወጥመድና ለአሽክላ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
verses.fr: Plusieurs trébucheront; Ils tomberont et se briseront, Ils seront enlacés et pris.
verses.am: ብዙዎችም በእርሱ ይሰናከላሉ፥ ይወድቁማል፥ ይሰበሩማል፥ ይጠመዱማል፥ ይያዙማል።

verses.en: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
verses.fr: Enveloppe cet oracle, Scelle cette révélation, parmi mes disciples. -
verses.am: ምስክሩን እሰር፤ በደቀ መዛሙርቶቼም መካከል ሕጉን አትም።

verses.en: And I will wait upon the Lord, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
verses.fr: J''espère en l''Eternel, Qui cache sa face à la maison de Jacob; Je place en lui ma confiance.
verses.am: ከያዕቆብም ቤት ፊቱን የመለሰውን እግዚአብሔርን እጠብቃለሁ፥ እተማመንበትማለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, I and the children whom the Lord hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the Lord of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
verses.fr: Voici, moi et les enfants que l''Eternel m''a donnés, Nous sommes des signes et des présages en Israël, De la part de l''Eternel des armées, Qui habite sur la montagne de Sion.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔና እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝ ልጆች ለእስራኤል በጽዮን ተራራ ከሚኖረው ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ምልክትና ተአምራት ነን።

verses.en: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?
verses.fr: Si l''on vous dit: Consultez ceux qui évoquent les morts et ceux qui prédisent l''avenir, Qui poussent des sifflements et des soupirs, Répondez: Un peuple ne consultera-t-il pas son Dieu? S''adressera-t-il aux morts en faveur des vivants?
verses.am: እነርሱም። የሚጮኹትንና ድምፃቸውን ዝቅ አድርገው የሚናገሩትን መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችን ጠይቁ ባሉአችሁ ጊዜ፥ ሕዝቡ ከአምላኩ መጠየቅ አይገባውምን? ወይስ ለሕያዋን ሲሉ ሙታንን ይጠይቃሉን?

verses.en: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.
verses.fr: A la loi et au témoignage! Si l''on ne parle pas ainsi, Il n''y aura point d''aurore pour le peuple.
verses.am: ወደ ሕግና ወደ ምስክር ሂዱ! እንዲህም ያለውን ቃል ባይናገሩ ንጋት አይበራላቸውም።

verses.en: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
verses.fr: Il sera errant dans le pays, accablé et affamé; Et, quand il aura faim, il s''irritera, Maudira son roi et son Dieu, Et tournera les yeux en haut;
verses.am: እነርሱም ተጨንቀውና ተርበው ያልፋሉ፤ በተራቡም ጊዜ ተቈጥተው ንጉሣቸውንና አምላካቸውን ይረግማሉ፥ ወደ ላይም ይመለከታሉ፤

verses.en: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
verses.fr: Puis il regardera vers la terre, Et voici, il n''y aura que détresse, obscurité et de sombres angoisses: Il sera repoussé dans d''épaisses ténèbres.
verses.am: ወደ ምድርም ይመለከታሉ፥ እነሆም፥ መከራና ጨለማ የሚያስጨንቅም ጭጋግ አለ፤ ወደ ድቅድቅም ጨለማ ይሰደዳሉ።

verses.en: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
verses.fr: Mais les ténèbres ne régneront pas toujours Sur la terre où il y a maintenant des angoisses: Si les temps passés ont couvert d''opprobre Le pays de Zabulon et le pays de Nephthali, Les temps à venir couvriront de gloire La contrée voisine de la mer, au delà du Jourdain, Le territoire des Gentils.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ተጨንቃ ለነበረች ጨለማ አይሆንም። በመጀመሪያው ዘመን የዛብሎንንና የንፍታሌምን ምድር አቃለለ፤ በኋለኛው ዘመን ግን በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በባሕር መንገድ ያለውን የአሕዛብን ገሊላ ያከብራል።

verses.en: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
verses.fr: Le peuple qui marchait dans les ténèbres Voit une grande lumière; Sur ceux qui habitaient le pays de l''ombre de la mort Une lumière resplendit.
verses.am: በጨለማ የሄደ ሕዝብ ብርሃን አየ፤ በሞት ጥላ አገርም ለኖሩ ብርሃን ወጣላቸው።

verses.en: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
verses.fr: Tu rends le peuple nombreux, Tu lui accordes de grandes joies; Il se réjouit devant toi, comme on se réjouit à la moisson, Comme on pousse des cris d''allégresse au partage du butin.
verses.am: ሕዝብን አብዝተሃል፥ ደስታንም ጨምረህላቸዋል፤ በመከር ደስ እንደሚላቸው፥ ሰዎችም ምርኮን ሲካፈሉ ደስ እንደሚላቸው በፊትህ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
verses.fr: Car le joug qui pesait sur lui, Le bâton qui frappait son dos, La verge de celui qui l''opprimait, Tu les brises, comme à la journée de Madian.
verses.am: በምድያም ጊዜ እንደ ሆነ የሸክሙን ቀንበር የጫንቃውንም በትር የአስጨናቂውንም ዘንግ ሰብረሃል።

verses.en: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.
verses.fr: Car toute chaussure qu''on porte dans la mêlée, Et tout vêtement guerrier roulé dans le sang, Seront livrés aux flammes, Pour être dévorés par le feu.
verses.am: የሚረግጡ የሰልፈኞች ጫማ ሁሉ፥ በደምም የተለወሰ ልብስ ለቃጠሎ ይሆናል፥ እንደ እሳት ማቃጠያም ሆኖ ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
verses.fr: Car un enfant nous est né, un fils nous est donné, Et la domination reposera sur son épaule; On l''appellera Admirable, Conseiller, Dieu puissant, Père éternel, Prince de la paix.
verses.am: ሕፃን ተወልዶልናልና፥ ወንድ ልጅም ተሰጥቶናልና፤ አለቅነትም በጫንቃው ላይ ይሆናል፤ ስሙም ድንቅ መካር፥ ኃያል አምላክ፥ የዘላለም አባት፥ የሰላም አለቃ ተብሎ ይጠራል።

verses.en: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.
verses.fr: Donner à l''empire de l''accroissement, Et une paix sans fin au trône de David et à son royaume, L''affermir et le soutenir par le droit et par la justice, Dès maintenant et à toujours: Voilà ce que fera le zèle de l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ በፍርድና በጽድቅ ያጸናውና ይደግፈው ዘንድ በዳዊት ዙፋንና በመንግሥቱ ላይ አለቅነቱ ይበዛል፥ ለሰላሙም ፍፃሜ የለውም። የእግዚአብሔር ቅንዓት ይህን ያደርጋል።

verses.en: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur envoie une parole à Jacob: Elle tombe sur Israël.
verses.am: ጌታ በያዕቆብ ላይ ቃልን ሰደደ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ወደቀ።

verses.en: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
verses.fr: Tout le peuple en aura connaissance, Ephraïm et les habitants de Samarie, Qui disent avec orgueil et fierté:
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ተራራ ላይ ተቋቋሚ ያስነሣበታል፥

verses.en: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.
verses.fr: Des briques sont tombées, Nous bâtirons en pierres de taille; Des sycomores ont été coupés, Nous les remplacerons par des cèdres.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ተራራ ላይ ተቋቋሚ ያስነሣበታል፥

verses.en: Therefore the Lord shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;
verses.fr: L''Eternel élèvera contre eux les ennemis de Retsin, Et il armera leurs ennemis,
verses.am: ጠላቶቹን ሶርያውያንንም ከምሥራቅ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ከምዕራብ ያንቀሳቅስበታል፤ እስራኤልንም በተከፈተ አፍ ይበሉታል። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፥ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።

verses.en: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.fr: Les Syriens à l''orient, les Philistins à l''occident; Et ils dévoreront Israël à pleine bouche. Malgré tout cela, sa colère ne s''apaise point, Et sa main est encore étendue.
verses.am: ሕዝቡ ግን ወደ ቀሠፋቸው አልተመለሱም፥ የሠራዊትንም ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን አልፈለጉም።

verses.en: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: Le peuple ne revient pas à celui qui le frappe, Et il ne cherche pas l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ራስና ጅራትን፥ የሰሌኑን ቅርንጫፍና እንግጫውን በአንድ ቀን ከእስራኤል ይቆርጣል።

verses.en: Therefore the Lord will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
verses.fr: Aussi l''Eternel arrachera d''Israël la tête et la queue, La branche de palmier et le roseau, En un seul jour.
verses.am: ሽማግሌውና ከበርቴው እርሱ ራስ ነው፤ በሐሰትም የሚያስተምር ነቢይ እርሱ ጅራት ነው።

verses.en: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
verses.fr: L''ancien et le magistrat, c''est la tête, Et le prophète qui enseigne le mensonge, c''est la queue.
verses.am: ይህን ሕዝብ የሚመሩ ያስቱአቸዋል፤ ተመሪዎቹም ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
verses.fr: Ceux qui conduisent ce peuple l''égarent, Et ceux qui se laissent conduire se perdent.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ ዝንጉና ክፉ ሠሪ ነውና፥ አፍም ሁሉ ስንፍናን ይናገራልና ስለዚህ ጌታ በጕልማሶቻቸው ደስ አይለውም፥ ለድሀ አደጎቻቸውና ለመበለቶቻቸውም አይራራም። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፥ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።

verses.en: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi le Seigneur ne saurait se réjouir de leurs jeunes hommes, Ni avoir pitié de leurs orphelins et de leurs veuves; Car tous sont des impies et des méchants, Et toutes les bouches profèrent des infamies. Malgré tout cela, sa colère ne s''apaise point, Et sa main est encore étendue.
verses.am: ክፋት እንደ እሳት ይቃጠላል፤ ኵርንችቱንና እሾሁን ይበላል፤ ጭፍቅ የሆነውንም ዱር ያቃጥላል፥ ጢሱም ተትጐልጕሎ እንደ ዓምድ ይወጣል።

verses.en: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.
verses.fr: Car la méchanceté consume comme un feu, Qui dévore ronces et épines; Il embrase l''épaisseur de la forêt, D''où s''élèvent des colonnes de fumée.
verses.am: በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ምድር ተቃጥላለች፤ ሕዝቡም እሳት እንደሚበላው እንጨት ሆኖአል፤ ሰውም ለወንድሙ አይራራም።

verses.en: Through the wrath of the Lord of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
verses.fr: Par la colère de l''Eternel des armées le pays est embrasé, Et le peuple est comme la proie du feu; Nul n''épargne son frère.
verses.am: ሰው በቀኙ በኩል ይነቅላል ይራብማል፤ በግራም በኩል ይበላል አይጠግብምም፤ እያንዳንዱም የክንዱን ሥጋ ይበላል፤

verses.en: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
verses.fr: On pille à droite, et l''on a faim; On dévore à gauche, et l''on n''est pas rassasié; Chacun dévore la chair de son bras.
verses.am: ምናሴ ኤፍሬምን ኤፍሬምም ምናሴን ይበላል፤ እነርሱ በአንድነት የይሁዳ ጠላቶች ይሆናሉ። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፥ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።

verses.en: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.fr: Manassé dévore Ephraïm, Ephraïm Manassé, Et ensemble ils fondent sur Juda. Malgré tout cela, sa colère ne s''apaise point, Et sa main est encore étendue.
verses.am: ፤ ምናሴ ኤፍሬምን ኤፍሬምም ምናሴን ይበላል፤ እነርሱ በአንድነት የይሁዳ ጠላቶች ይሆናሉ። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፥ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።

verses.en: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui prononcent des ordonnances iniques, Et à ceux qui transcrivent des arrêts injustes,
verses.am: [see v2]

verses.en: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!
verses.fr: Pour refuser justice aux pauvres, Et ravir leur droit aux malheureux de mon peuple, Pour faire des veuves leur proie, Et des orphelins leur butin!
verses.am: መበለቶችም ቅሚያቸው እንዲሆኑ፥ ድሀ አደጎችንም ብዝበዛቸው እንዲያደርጉ፥ የድሀውን ፍርድ ያጣምሙ ዘንድ፥ የችግረኛውንም ሕዝቤን ፍርድ ያጐድሉ ዘንድ የግፍን ትእዛዛት ለሚያዝዙ፥ ክፉንም ጽሕፈት ለሚጽፉ ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?
verses.fr: Que ferez-vous au jour du châtiment, Et de la ruine qui du lointain fondra sur vous? Vers qui fuirez-vous, pour avoir du secours, Et où laisserez-vous votre gloire?
verses.am: በተጎበኛችሁበት ቀን፥ መከራም ከሩቅ በሚመጣበት ዘመን ምን ታደርጉ ይሆን? ለረድኤትስ ወደ ማን ትሸሻላችሁ? ክብራችሁንስ ወዴት ትተዉታላችሁ?

verses.en: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.fr: Les uns seront courbés parmi les captifs, Les autres tomberont parmi les morts. Malgré tout cela, sa colère ne s''apaise point, Et sa main est encore étendue.
verses.am: ከእስረኞች በታች ይጐነበሳሉ፥ ከተገደሉትም በታች ይወድቃሉ። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፥ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።

verses.en: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.
verses.fr: Malheur à l''Assyrien, verge de ma colère! La verge dans sa main, c''est l''instrument de ma fureur.
verses.am: ለቍጣዬ በትር ለሆነ፥ የመዓቴም ጨንገር በእጁ ላለ ለአሦር ወዮለት!

verses.en: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.fr: Je l''ai lâché contre une nation impie, Je l''ai fait marcher contre le peuple de mon courroux, Pour qu''il se livre au pillage et fasse du butin, Pour qu''il le foule aux pieds comme la boue des rues.
verses.am: እርሱንም በዝንጉ ሕዝብ ላይ እልካለሁ፥ ምርኮውንና ብዝበዛውንም ይወስድ ዘንድ እንደ አደባባይም ጭቃ የተረገጡ ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ በምቈጣቸው ሰዎች ላይ አዝዘዋለሁ።

verses.en: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
verses.fr: Mais il n''en juge pas ainsi, Et ce n''est pas là la pensée de son coeur; Il ne songe qu''à détruire, Qu''à exterminer les nations en foule.
verses.am: እርሱ እንዲሁ አያስብም፥ በልቡም እንዲህ አይመስለውም፤ ነገር ግን ማጥፋት፥ ጥቂት ያይደሉትንም አሕዛብን መቍረጥ በልቡ አለ።

verses.en: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?
verses.fr: Car il dit: Mes princes ne sont-ils pas autant de rois?
verses.am: እንዲህ ይላል። መሳፍንቴ ሁሉ ነገሥታት አይደሉምን? ካልኖ እንደ ከርከሚሽ አይደለችምን?

verses.en: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
verses.fr: N''en a-t-il pas été de Calno comme de Carkemisch? N''en a-t-il pas été de Hamath comme d''Arpad? N''en a-t-il pas été de Samarie comme de Damas?
verses.am: ሐማትስ እንደ አርፋድ አይደለችምን? ሰማርያስ እንደ ደማስቆ አይደለችምን?

verses.en: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
verses.fr: De même que ma main a atteint les royaumes des idoles, Où il y avait plus d''images qu''à Jérusalem et à Samarie,
verses.am: የተቀረጹ ምስሎቻቸው ከኢየሩሳሌምና ከሰማርያ ምስሎች የበለጡትን የጣዖቶችን መንግሥታት እጄ እንዳገኘች፥

verses.en: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
verses.fr: Ce que j''ai fait à Samarie et à ses idoles, Ne le ferai-je pas à Jérusalem et à ses images?
verses.am: በሰማርያና በጣዖቶችዋም እንዳደረግሁ፥ እንዲሁስ በኢየሩሳሌምና በጣዖቶችዋ አላደርግምን?

verses.en: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
verses.fr: Mais, quand le Seigneur aura accompli toute son oeuvre Sur la montagne de Sion et à Jérusalem, Je punirai le roi d''Assyrie pour le fruit de son coeur orgueilleux, Et pour l''arrogance de ses regards hautains.
