verses.am: ስለዚህ እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ጌታ ሥራውን ሁሉ በጽዮን ተራራና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ በፈጸመ ጊዜ የአሦርን ንጉሥ የኩሩ ልብ ፍሬን የዓይኑንም ከፍታ ትምክሕት ይጐበኛል።

verses.en: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:
verses.fr: Car il dit: C''est par la force de ma main que j''ai agi, C''est par ma sagesse, car je suis intelligent; J''ai reculé les limites des peuples, et pillé leurs trésors, Et, comme un héros, j''ai renversé ceux qui siégeaient sur des trônes;
verses.am: እርሱ እንዲህ ብሎአልና። አስተዋይ ነኝና በእጄ ኃይልና በጥበቤ አደረግሁት፤ የአሕዛብን ድንበሮች አራቅሁ፥ ሀብታቸውንም ዘረፍሁ፥ እንደ ጀግናም ሆኜ በምድር የተቀመጡትን አዋረድሁ፤

verses.en: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.
verses.fr: J''ai mis la main sur les richesses des peuples, comme sur un nid, Et, comme on ramasse des oeufs abandonnés, J''ai ramassé toute la terre: Nul n''a remué l''aile, Ni ouvert le bec, ni poussé un cri. -
verses.am: እጄም የአሕዛብን ኃይል እንደ ወፍ ቤት አገኘች፤ የተተወም እንቍላል እንደሚሰበሰብ እንዲሁ እኔ ምድርን ሁሉ ሰበሰብሁ፤ ክንፉን የሚያራግብ አፉንም የሚከፍት የሚጮኽም የለም።

verses.en: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
verses.fr: La hache se glorifie-t-elle envers celui qui s''en sert? Ou la scie est-elle arrogante envers celui qui la manie? Comme si la verge faisait mouvoir celui qui la lève, Comme si le bâton soulevait celui qui n''est pas du bois!
verses.am: በውኑ መጥረቢያ በሚቈርጥበት ሰው ላይ ይመካልን? ወይስ መጋዝ በሚስበው ላይ ይጓደዳልን? ይህስ፥ በትር የሚያነሣውን እንደ መነቅነቅ ዘንግም እንጨት ያይደለውን እንደ ማንሣት ያህል ነው።

verses.en: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi le Seigneur, le Seigneur des armées, enverra Le dépérissement parmi ses robustes guerriers; Et, sous sa magnificence, éclatera un embrasement, Comme l''embrasement d''un feu.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በወፍራሞች ላይ ክሳትን ይልካል፤ ከክብሩም በታች ቃጠሎው እንደ እሳት መቃጠል ይነድዳል።

verses.en: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;
verses.fr: La lumière d''Israël deviendra un feu, Et son Saint une flamme, Qui consumera et dévorera ses épines et ses ronces, En un seul jour;
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ብርሃን እንደ እሳት ቅዱስም እንደ ነበልባል ይሆናል፤ እሾሁንና ኵርንችቱን በአንድ ቀን ያቃጥላል ይበላውማል።

verses.en: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standard-bearer fainteth.
verses.fr: Qui consumera, corps et âme, La magnificence de sa forêt et de ses campagnes. Il en sera comme d''un malade, qui tombe en défaillance.
verses.am: ከነፍስም እስከ ሥጋ ድረስ የዱሩንና የሚያፈራውን እርሻ ክብር ይበላል፤ ይህም የታመመ ሰው እንደሚሰለስል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.
verses.fr: Le reste des arbres de sa forêt pourra être compté, Et un enfant en écrirait le nombre.
verses.am: የያዕቆብም ቅሬታ ወደ ኃያል አምላክ ይምለሳሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, Le reste d''Israël et les réchappés de la maison de Jacob, Cesseront de s''appuyer sur celui qui les frappait; Ils s''appuieront avec confiance sur l''Eternel, le Saint d''Israël.
verses.am: የያዕቆብም ቅሬታ ወደ ኃያል አምላክ ይምለሳሉ።

verses.en: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
verses.fr: Le reste reviendra, le reste de Jacob, Au Dieu puissant.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ የሕዝብህ ቍጥር እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ ቢሆን ቅሬታው ይመለሳል። ጽድቅ የተትረፈረፈበትም ጥፋት ተወስኖአል።

verses.en: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
verses.fr: Quand ton peuple, ô Israël, serait comme le sable de la mer, Un reste seulement reviendra; La destruction est résolue, elle fera déborder la justice.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ያለቀ የተቈረጠ ነገርን በምድር ሁሉ መካከል ይፈጽማል።

verses.en: For the Lord God of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
verses.fr: Et cette destruction qui a été résolue, Le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées, l''accomplira dans tout le pays.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በጽዮን የምትኖር ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ አሦር በበትር ቢመታህ፥ ግብጽም እንዳደረገ ዘንጉን ቢያነሣብህ አትፍራው።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
verses.fr: Cependant, ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées: O mon peuple, qui habites en Sion, ne crains pas l''Assyrien! Il te frappe de la verge, Et il lève son bâton sur toi, comme faisaient les Egyptiens.
verses.am: ቍጣዬ እስኪፈጸም መዓቴም እስኪያጠፋቸው ድረስ ጥቂት ጊዜ ቀርቶአልና።

verses.en: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.
verses.fr: Mais, encore un peu de temps, Et le châtiment cessera, Puis ma colère se tournera contre lui pour l''anéantir.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ምድያምን በሔሬብ ዓለት በኩል እንደ መታው ጅራፍ ያነሣበታል፤ በትሩም በባሕር ላይ ይሆናል፥ በግብጽም እንዳደረገ ያነሣዋል።

verses.en: And the Lord of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées agitera le fouet contre lui, Comme il frappa Madian au rocher d''Oreb; Et, de même qu''il leva son bâton sur la mer, Il le lèvera encore, comme en Egypte.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ሸክሙ ከጫንቃህ ቀንበሩም ከአንገትህ ላይ ይወርዳል፤ ቀንበሩም ከውፍረት የተነሣ ይሰበራል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
verses.fr: En ce jour, son fardeau sera ôté de dessus ton épaule, Et son joug de dessus ton cou; Et la graisse fera éclater le joug.
verses.am: ወደ አንጋይ መጥቶአል፤ በመጌዶን በኩል አልፎአል፤ በማክማስ ውስጥ ዕቃውን አኑሮአል፤

verses.en: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
verses.fr: Il marche sur Ajjath, traverse Migron, Laisse ses bagages à Micmasch.
verses.am: በመተላለፊያ አልፎአል፤ በጌባ ማደሪያው ነው፤ ራማ ደንግጣለች፤ የሳኦል ጊብዓ ኰብልላለች።

verses.en: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
verses.fr: Ils passent le défilé, Ils couchent à Guéba; Rama tremble, Guibea de Saül prend la fuite.
verses.am: አንቺ የጋሊም ልጅ ሆይ፥ በታላቅ ድምፅሽ ጩኺ፤ ላይሳ ሆይ፥ አድምጪ፤ ዓናቶት ሆይ፥ መልሽላት።

verses.en: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
verses.fr: Fais éclater ta voix, fille de Gallim! Prends garde, Laïs! malheur à toi, Anathoth!
verses.am: መደቤና ሸሽታለች፤ በግቤርም የሚኖሩ ቤተ ሰቦቻቸውን አሽሽተዋል።

verses.en: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
verses.fr: Madména se disperse, Les habitants de Guébim sont en fuite.
verses.am: ዛሬ በኖብ ይቆማል፤ በጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ተራራ በኢየሩሳሌም ኮረብታ ላይ እጁን ያንቀሳቅሳል።

verses.en: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Encore un jour de halte à Nob, Et il menace de sa main la montagne de la fille de Sion, La colline de Jérusalem.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ቅርንጫፎቹን በሚያስፈራ ኃይል ይቈርጣል፤ በቁመት የረዘሙትም ይቈረጣሉ፥ ከፍ ያሉትም ይዋረዳሉ።

verses.en: Behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
verses.fr: Voici, le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées, Brise les rameaux avec violence: Les plus grands sont coupés, Les plus élevés sont abattus.
verses.am: ጭፍቅ የሆነውንም ዱር በብረት ይቈርጣል፥ ሊባኖስም በኃያሉ እጅ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
verses.fr: Il renverse avec le fer les taillis de la forêt, Et le Liban tombe sous le Puissant.
verses.am: ፤ ጭፍቅ የሆነውንም ዱር በብረት ይቈርጣል፥ ሊባኖስም በኃያሉ እጅ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
verses.fr: Puis un rameau sortira du tronc d''Isaï, Et un rejeton naîtra de ses racines.
verses.am: ከእሴይ ግንድ በትር ይወጣል፥ ከሥሩም ቍጥቋጥ ያፈራል።

verses.en: And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord;
verses.fr: L''Esprit de l''Eternel reposera sur lui: Esprit de sagesse et d''intelligence, Esprit de conseil et de force, Esprit de connaissance et de crainte de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ፥ የጥበብና የማስተዋል መንፈስ፥ የምክርና የኃይል መንፈስ፥ የእውቀትና እግዚአብሔርን የመፍራት መንፈስ ያርፍበታል።

verses.en: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the Lord: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
verses.fr: Il respirera la crainte de l''Eternel; Il ne jugera point sur l''apparence, Il ne prononcera point sur un ouï-dire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በመፍራት ደስታውን ያያል። ዓይኑም እንደምታይ አይፈርድም፥ ጆሮውም እንደምትሰማ አይበይንም፤

verses.en: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth: with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
verses.fr: Mais il jugera les pauvres avec équité, Et il prononcera avec droiture sur les malheureux de la terre; Il frappera la terre de sa parole comme d''une verge, Et du souffle de ses lèvres il fera mourir le méchant.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለድሆች በጽድቅ ይፈርዳል፥ ለምድርም የዋሆች በቅንነት ይበይናል፤ በአፉም በትር ምድርን ይመታል፥ በከንፈሩም እስትንፋስ ክፉዎችን ይገድላል።

verses.en: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
verses.fr: La justice sera la ceinture de ses flancs, Et la fidélité la ceinture de ses reins.
verses.am: የወገቡ መታጠቂያ ጽድቅ፥ የጎኑም መቀነት ታማኝነት ይሆናል።

verses.en: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
verses.fr: Le loup habitera avec l''agneau, Et la panthère se couchera avec le chevreau; Le veau, le lionceau, et le bétail qu''on engraisse, seront ensemble, Et un petit enfant les conduira.
verses.am: ተኵላ ከበግ ጠቦት ጋር ይቀመጣል፥ ነብርም ከፍየል ጠቦት ጋር ይተኛል፤ ጥጃና የአንበሳ ደቦል ፍሪዳም በአንድነት ያርፋሉ፤ ታናሽም ልጅ ይመራቸዋል።

verses.en: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
verses.fr: La vache et l''ourse auront un même pâturage, Leurs petits un même gîte; Et le lion, comme le boeuf, mangera de la paille.
verses.am: ላምና ድብ አብረው ይሰማራሉ፥ ግልገሎቻቸውም በአንድነት ያርፋሉ፤ አንበሳም እንደ በሬ ገለባ ይበላል።

verses.en: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.
verses.fr: Le nourrisson s''ébattra sur l''antre de la vipère, Et l''enfant sevré mettra sa main dans la caverne du basilic.
verses.am: የሚጠባውም ሕፃን በእባብ ጕድጓድ ላይ ይጫወታል፥ ጡት የጣለውም ሕፃን በእፉኝት ቤት ላይ እጁን ይጭናል።

verses.en: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.fr: Il ne se fera ni tort ni dommage Sur toute ma montagne sainte; Car la terre sera remplie de la connaissance de l''Eternel, Comme le fond de la mer par les eaux qui le couvrent.
verses.am: በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ ሁሉ ላይ አይጐዱም አያጠፉምም፤ ውኃ ባሕርን እንደሚከድን ምድር እግዚአብሔርን በማወቅ ትሞላለችና።

verses.en: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
verses.fr: En ce jour, le rejeton d''Isaï Sera là comme une bannière pour les peuples; Les nations se tourneront vers lui, Et la gloire sera sa demeure.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ለአሕዛብ ምልክት ሊሆን የቆመውን የእሴይን ሥር አሕዛብ ይፈልጉታል፤ ማረፊያውም የተከበረ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
verses.fr: Dans ce même temps, le Seigneur étendra une seconde fois sa main, Pour racheter le reste de son peuple, Dispersé en Assyrie et en Egypte, A Pathros et en Ethiopie, A Elam, à Schinear et à Hamath, Et dans les îles de la mer.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ የቀረውን የሕዝቡን ቅሬታ ከአሦርና ከግብጽ፥ ከጳትሮስና ከኢትዮጵያ፥ ከኤላምና ከሰናዖር ከሐማትም፥ ከባሕርም ደሴቶች ይመልስ ዘንድ ጌታ እንደ ገና እጁን ይገልጣል።

verses.en: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
verses.fr: Il élèvera une bannière pour les nations, Il rassemblera les exilés d''Israël, Et il recueillera les dispersés de Juda, Des quatre extrémités de la terre.
verses.am: ለአሕዛብም ምልክትን ያቆማል፥ ከእስራኤልም የተጣሉትን ይሰበስባል፥ ከይሁዳም የተበተኑትን ከአራቱ የምድር ማዕዘኖች ያከማቻል።

verses.en: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
verses.fr: La jalousie d''Ephraïm disparaîtra, Et ses ennemis en Juda seront anéantis; Ephraïm ne sera plus jaloux de Juda, Et Juda ne sera plus hostile à Ephraïm.
verses.am: የኤፍሬምም ምቀኝነት ይርቃል፥ ይሁዳንም የሚያስጨንቁ ይጠፋሉ፤ ኤፍሬምም በይሁዳ አይቀናም፥ ይሁዳም ኤፍሬምን አያስጨንቅም።

verses.en: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
verses.fr: Ils voleront sur l''épaule des Philistins à l''occident, Ils pilleront ensemble les fils de l''Orient; Edom et Moab seront la proie de leurs mains, Et les fils d''Ammon leur seront assujettis.
verses.am: በምዕራብም በኩል በፍልስጥኤማውያን ጫንቃ ላይ እየበረሩ ይወርዳሉ፥ የምሥራቅንም ልጆች በአንድነት ይበዘብዛሉ፤ በኤዶምያስና በሞዓብም ላይ እጃቸውን ይዘረጋሉ፥ የአሞንም ልጆች ለእነርሱ ይታዘዛሉ።

verses.en: And the Lord shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.
verses.fr: L''Eternel desséchera la langue de la mer d''Egypte, Et il lèvera sa main sur le fleuve, en soufflant avec violence: Il le partagera en sept canaux, Et on le traversera avec des souliers.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የግብጽን ባሕር ያጠፋል፤ በትኩሱም ነፋስ እጁን በወንዙ ላይ ያነሣል፥ ሰባት ፈሳሾችንም አድርጎ ይመታዋል፥ ሰዎችም በጫማቸው እንዲሻገሩ ያደርጋቸዋል።

verses.en: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Et il y aura une route pour le reste de son peuple, Qui sera échappé de l''Assyrie, Comme il y en eut une pour Israël, Le jour où il sortit du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ከግብጽም በወጣ ጊዜ ለእስራኤል እንደ ነበረ፥ ለቀረው ለሕዝቡ ቅሬታ ከአሦር ጐዳና ይሆናል።

verses.en: And in that day thou shalt say, O Lord, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
verses.fr: Tu diras en ce jour-là: Je te loue, ô Eternel! Car tu as été irrité contre moi, Ta colère s''est apaisée, et tu m''as consolé.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን። አቤቱ፥ ተቈጥተኸኛልና፥ ቍጣህንም ከእኔ መልሰሃልና፥ አጽናንተኸኛልምና አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
verses.fr: Voici, Dieu est ma délivrance, Je serai plein de confiance, et je ne craindrai rien; Car l''Eternel, l''Eternel est ma force et le sujet de mes louanges; C''est lui qui m''a sauvé.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አምላክ መድኃኒቴ ነው፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ኃይሌና ዝማሬዬ ነውና፥ መድኃኒቴም ሆኖአልና በእርሱ ታምኜ አልፈራም ትላለህ።

verses.en: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.fr: Vous puiserez de l''eau avec joie Aux sources du salut,
verses.am: ውኃውንም ከመድኃኒት ምንጮች በደስታ ትቀዳላችሁ።

verses.en: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the Lord, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
verses.fr: Et vous direz en ce jour-là: Louez l''Eternel, invoquez son nom, Publiez ses oeuvres parmi les peuples, Rappelez la grandeur de son nom!
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ትላላችሁ። እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ስሙንም ጥሩ፤ በአሕዛብ መካከል ሥራውን አስታውቁ፤ ስሙ ከፍ ያለ እንደ ሆነ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: Sing unto the Lord; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
verses.fr: Célébrez l''Eternel, car il a fait des choses magnifiques: Qu''elles soient connues par toute la terre!
verses.am: ታላቅ ሥራ ሠርቶአልና ለእግዚአብሔር ተቀኙ፤ ይህንም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ አስታውቁ።

verses.en: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
verses.fr: Pousse des cris de joie et d''allégresse, habitant de Sion! Car il est grand au milieu de toi, le Saint d''Israël.
verses.am: አንቺ በጽዮን የምትኖሪ ሆይ፥ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ በመካከልሽ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ደስ ይበልሽ እልልም በዪ።

verses.en: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
verses.fr: Oracle sur Babylone, révélé à Esaïe, fils d''Amots.
verses.am: የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ ያየው ስለ ባቢሎን የተንገረ ሸክም።

verses.en: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
verses.fr: Sur une montagne nue dressez une bannière, Elevez la voix vers eux, Faites des signes avec la main, Et qu''ils franchissent les portes des tyrans!
verses.am: ምድረ በዳ በሆነ ተራራ ላይ ምልክትን አቁሙ፥ ድምፅንም ከፍ አድርጉባቸው፤ በአለቆችም ደጆች እንዲገቡ በእጅ ጥቀሱ።

verses.en: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
verses.fr: J''ai donné des ordres à ma sainte milice, J''ai appelé les héros de ma colère, Ceux qui se réjouissent de ma grandeur.
verses.am: ቍጣዬን ይፈጽሙ ዘንድ ቅዱሳኔን አዝዣለሁ፥ እኔ ኃያላኔንና በታላቅነቴ ደስ የሚላቸውን ጠርቻለሁ።

verses.en: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the Lord of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
verses.fr: On entend une rumeur sur les montagnes, Comme celle d''un peuple nombreux; On entend un tumulte de royaumes, de nations rassemblées: L''Eternel des armées passe en revue l''armée qui va combattre.
verses.am: በተራሮች ላይ እንደ ታላቅ ሕዝብ ድምፅ የሆነ የብዙ ሰው ድምፅ አለ። የከተማቹት የአህዛብ መንግሥታት የውካታ ጫጫታ አለ። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሠራዊትን ለሰልፍ አሰልፎአል።

verses.en: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the Lord, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.fr: Ils viennent d''un pays lointain, De l''extrémité des cieux: L''Eternel et les instruments de sa colère Vont détruire toute la contrée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርና የቍጣው የጦር ዕቃ ምድርን ሁሉ ያጠፉአት ዘንድ ከሩቅ አገር ከሰማይ ዳርቻ ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: Howl ye; for the day of the Lord is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
verses.fr: Gémissez, car le jour de l''Eternel est proche: Il vient comme un ravage du Tout-Puissant.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ቀርቦአልና፥ አልቅሱ፤ ሁሉን ከሚችል አምላክ ዘንድ እንደሚመጣ ጥፋት ይመጣል።

verses.en: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi toutes les mains s''affaiblissent, Et tout coeur d''homme est abattu.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እጅ ሁሉ ትዝላለች፥ የሰውም ሁሉ ልብ ይቀልጣል።

verses.en: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
verses.fr: Ils sont frappés d''épouvante; Les spasmes et les douleurs les saisissent; Ils se tordent comme une femme en travail; Ils se regardent les uns les autres avec stupeur; Leurs visages sont enflammés.
verses.am: ይደነግጣሉ፤ ምጥና ሕማም ይይዛቸዋል፥ እንደምትወልድ ሴትም ያምጣሉ፤ አንዱም በሌላው ይደነቃል፥ ፊታቸውም የነበልባል ፊት ነው።

verses.en: Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
verses.fr: Voici, le jour de l''Eternel arrive, Jour cruel, jour de colère et d''ardente fureur, Qui réduira la terre en solitude, Et en exterminera les pécheurs.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ምድሪቱን ባድማ ሊያደርግ፥ ኃጢአተኞችዋንም ከእርስዋ ዘንድ ሊያጠፋ ጨካኝ ሆኖ በመዓትና በጽኑ ቍጣ ተሞልቶ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ይመጣል።

verses.en: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
verses.fr: Car les étoiles des cieux et leurs astres Ne feront plus briller leur lumière, Le soleil s''obscurcira dès son lever, Et la lune ne fera plus luire sa clarté.
verses.am: የሰማይም ከዋክብትና ሠራዊቱ ብርሃናቸውን አይሰጡም፥ ፀሐይም በወጣች ጊዜ ትጨልማለች፥ ጨረቃም በብርሃኑ አያበራም።

verses.en: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.fr: Je punirai le monde pour sa malice, Et les méchants pour leurs iniquités; Je ferai cesser l''orgueil des hautains, Et j''abattrai l''arrogance des tyrans.
verses.am: ዓለሙን ስለ ክፋታቸው ክፉዎቹንም ስለ በደላቸው እቀጣለሁ፤ የትዕቢተኞችንም ኵራት አዋርዳለሁ።

verses.en: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
verses.fr: Je rendrai les hommes plus rares que l''or fin, Je les rendrai plus rares que l''or d''Ophir.
verses.am: የቀሩትም ከጥሩ ወርቅ ይልቅ የከበሩ ይሆናሉ፥ ሰውም ከኦፊር ወርቅ ይልቅ የከበረ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the Lord of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi j''ébranlerai les cieux, Et la terre sera secouée sur sa base, Par la colère de l''Eternel des armées, Au jour de son ardente fureur.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር መዓት በጽኑ ቍጣ ቀንም ሰማያትን አነቃንቃለሁ፥ ምድርም ከስፍራዋ ትናወጣለች።

verses.en: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
verses.fr: Alors, comme une gazelle effarouchée, Comme un troupeau sans berger, Chacun se tournera vers son peuple, Chacun fuira vers son pays;
verses.am: እንደ ተባረረም ሚዳቋ፥ ማንም እንደማይሰበስበው እንደ በግ መንጋ፥ ሰው ሁሉ ወደ ወገኑ ይመለሳል፥ ሁሉም ወደ አገሩ ይሸሻል።

verses.en: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qu''on trouvera seront percés, Et tous ceux qu''on saisira tomberont par l''épée.
verses.am: የተገኘ ሁሉ የተወጋ ይሆናል፥ የተያዘም ሁሉ በሰይፍ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
verses.fr: Leurs enfants seront écrasés sous leurs yeux, Leurs maisons seront pillées, et leurs femmes violées.
verses.am: ሕፃናቶቻቸውም በፊታቸው ይጨፈጨፋሉ፥ ቤቶቻቸውም ይበዘበዛሉ፥ ሚስቶቻቸውም ይነወራሉ።

verses.en: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
verses.fr: Voici, j''excite contre eux les Mèdes, Qui ne font point cas de l''argent, Et qui ne convoitent point l''or.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ብር የማይሹትን፥ ወርቅም የማያምራቸውን ሜዶናውያንን በላያቸው አስነሣለሁ።

verses.en: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eyes shall not spare children.
verses.fr: De leurs arcs ils abattront les jeunes gens, Et ils seront sans pitié pour le fruit des entrailles: Leur oeil n''épargnera point les enfants.
verses.am: ፍላጾቻቸውም ጎበዞችን ይጨፈጭፋሉ፥ የማኅፀንንም ፍሬ አይምሩም፥ ዓይኖቻቸውም ለሕፃናት አይራሩም።

verses.en: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.fr: Et Babylone, l''ornement des royaumes, La fière parure des Chaldéens, Sera comme Sodome et Gomorrhe, que Dieu détruisit.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰዶምንና ገሞራን ባፈረሰ ጊዜ እንደ ነበረው፥ የመንግሥታት ክብር የከለዳውያንም ትዕቢት ጌጥ ባቢሎን እንዲሁ ትሆናለች።

verses.en: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
verses.fr: Elle ne sera plus jamais habitée, Elle ne sera plus jamais peuplée; L''Arabe n''y dressera point sa tente, Et les bergers n''y parqueront point leurs troupeaux.
verses.am: ለዘላለም የሚቀመጥባት አይገኝም፥ ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ ድረስ ሰው አይኖርባትም፤ ዓረባውያንም ድንኳንን በዚያ አይተክሉም፥ እረኞችም መንጎቻቸውን በዚያ አያሳርፉም።

verses.en: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
verses.fr: Les animaux du désert y prendront leur gîte, Les hiboux rempliront ses maisons, Les autruches en feront leur demeure Et les boucs y sauteront.
verses.am: በዚያም የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ያርፋሉ፥ ጕጕቶችም በቤቶቻቸው ይሞላሉ፤ ሰጎኖችም በዚያ ይኖራሉ፥ በዚያም አጋንንት ይዘፍናሉ።

verses.en: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
verses.fr: Les chacals hurleront dans ses palais, Et les chiens sauvages dans ses maisons de plaisance. Son temps est près d''arriver, Et ses jours ne se prolongeront pas.
verses.am: ተኵላዎችም በግንቦቻቸው፥ ቀበሮችም በሚያማምሩ አዳራሾቻቸው ይጮኻሉ፤ ጊዜዋም ለመምጣት ቀርቦአል ቀንዋም አይዘገይም።

verses.en: For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel aura pitié de Jacob, Il choisira encore Israël, Et il les rétablira dans leur pays; Les étrangers se joindront à eux, Et ils s''uniront à la maison de Jacob.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ያዕቆብን ይምረዋል፥ እስራኤልንም ደግሞ ይመርጠዋል፥ በአገራቸውም ያኖራቸዋል፤ መጻተኛም ከእርሱ ጋር ይተባበራል፥ ከያዕቆብም ቤት ጋር ይጣበቃል።

verses.en: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.fr: Les peuples les prendront, et les ramèneront à leur demeure, Et la maison d''Israël les possédera dans le pays de l''Eternel, Comme serviteurs et comme servantes; Ils retiendront captifs ceux qui les avaient faits captifs, Et ils domineront sur leurs oppresseurs.
verses.am: አሕዛብም ይዘው ወደ ስፍራቸው ያመጡአቸዋል፥ የእስራኤልም ቤት በእግዚአብሔር ምድር እንደ ሎሌዎችና እንደ ገረዶች አድርገው ይገዙአቸዋል፤ የማረኩአቸውን ይማርካሉ፥ አስጨናቂዎችንም ይገዛሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
verses.fr: Et quand l''Eternel t''aura donné du repos, Après tes fatigues et tes agitations, Et après la dure servitude qui te fut imposée,
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር ከኀዘንህና ከመከራህ ከተገዛህለትም ከጽኑ ባርነት ያሳርፍሃል።

verses.en: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
verses.fr: Alors tu prononceras ce chant sur le roi de Babylone, Et tu diras: Eh quoi! le tyran n''est plus! L''oppression a cessé!
verses.am: ይህንም ምሳሌ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ላይ ታነሣለህ እንዲህም ትላለህ። አስጨናቂ እንዴት ዐረፈ! አስገባሪም እንዴት ጸጥ አለ!

verses.en: The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a brisé le bâton des méchants, La verge des dominateurs.
verses.am: አሕዛብንም በመዓትና በማያቋርጥ መምታት የመታውን፥ አሕዛብንም ባልተከለከለ መከራ በቍጣው የገዛውን የኀጥኣንን በትር የአለቆችንም ዘንግ እግዚአብሔር ሰብሮአል።

verses.en: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
verses.fr: Celui qui dans sa fureur frappait les peuples, Par des coups sans relâche, Celui qui dans sa colère subjuguait les nations, Est poursuivi sans ménagement.
verses.am: አሕዛብንም በመዓትና በማያቋርጥ መምታት የመታውን፥ አሕዛብንም ባልተከለከለ መከራ በቍጣው የገዛውን የኀጥኣንን በትር የአለቆችንም ዘንግ እግዚአብሔር ሰብሮአል።

verses.en: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
verses.fr: Toute la terre jouit du repos et de la paix; On éclate en chants d''allégresse,
verses.am: ምድርም ሁሉ ዐርፋ በጸጥታ ተቀምጣለች እልልም ብላለች።

verses.en: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
verses.fr: Les cyprès même, les cèdres du Liban, se réjouissent de ta chute: Depuis que tu es tombé, personne ne monte pour nous abattre.
verses.am: ጥድና የሊባኖስ ዝግባ። አንተ ከተዋረድህ ጀምሮ ማንም ይቈርጠን ዘንድ አልወጣብንም ብለው በአንተ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.en: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
verses.fr: Le séjour des morts s''émeut jusque dans ses profondeurs, Pour t''accueillir à ton arrivée; Il réveille devant toi les ombres, tous les grands de la terre, Il fait lever de leurs trônes tous les rois des nations.
verses.am: ሲኦል በመምጣትህ ልትገናኝህ በታች ታወከች፤ የሞቱትንም፥ የምድርን ታላላቆች ሁሉ፥ ለአንተ አንቀሳቀሰች፥ የአሕዛብንም ነገሥታት ሁሉ ከዙፋኖቻቸው አስነሣች።

verses.en: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
verses.fr: Tous prennent la parole pour te dire: Toi aussi, tu es sans force comme nous, Tu es devenu semblable à nous!
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ። አንተ ደግሞ እንደ እኛ ደክመሃልን? እኛንስ መስለሃልን? ጌጥህና የበገናህ ድምፅ ወደ ሲኦል ወረደ፤

verses.en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
verses.fr: Ta magnificence est descendue dans le séjour des morts, Avec le son de tes luths; Sous toi est une couche de vers, Et les vers sont ta couverture.
verses.am: በበታችህም ብል ተነጥፎአል፥ ትልም መደረቢያህ ሆኖአል ብለው ይመልሱልሃል።

verses.en: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
verses.fr: Te voilà tombé du ciel, Astre brillant, fils de l''aurore! Tu es abattu à terre, Toi, le vainqueur des nations!
verses.am: አንተ የንጋት ልጅ አጥቢያ ኮከብ ሆይ፥ እንዴት ከሰማይ ወደቅህ! አሕዛብንም ያዋረድህ አንተ ሆይ፥ እንዴት እስከ ምድር ድረስ ተቈረጥህ!

verses.en: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
verses.fr: Tu disais en ton coeur: Je monterai au ciel, J''élèverai mon trône au-dessus des étoiles de Dieu; Je m''assiérai sur la montagne de l''assemblée, A l''extrémité du septentrion;
verses.am: አንተን በልብህ። ወደ ሰምይ ዐርጋለሁ፥ ዙፋኔንም ከእግዚአብሔር ከዋክብት በላይ ከፍ ከፍ አደርጋለሁ፥ በሰሜንም ዳርቻ በመሰብሰቢያ ተራራ ላይ እቀመጣለሁ፤

verses.en: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
verses.fr: Je monterai sur le sommet des nues, Je serai semblable au Très-Haut.
verses.am: ከዳመናዎች ከፍታ በላይ ዐርጋለሁ፥ በልዑልም እመሰላለሁ አልህ።

verses.en: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
verses.fr: Mais tu as été précipité dans le séjour des morts, Dans les profondeurs de la fosse.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ ሲኦል ወደ ጕድጓዱም ጥልቅ ትወርዳለህ።

verses.en: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
verses.fr: Ceux qui te voient fixent sur toi leurs regards, Ils te considèrent attentivement: Est-ce là cet homme qui faisait trembler la terre, Qui ébranlait les royaumes,
verses.am: የሚያዩህ ይመለከቱሃልና። በውኑ ምድርን ያንቀጠቀጠ፥ መንግሥታትንም ያናወጠ፥

verses.en: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?
verses.fr: Qui réduisait le monde en désert, Qui ravageait les villes, Et ne relâchait point ses prisonniers?
verses.am: ዓለሙን ሁሉ ባድማ ያደረገ፥ ከተሞችንም ያፈረሰ ምርከኞቹንም ወደ ቤታቸው ያልሰደደ ሰው ይህ ነውን? ብለው ያስተውሉሃል።

verses.en: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
verses.fr: Tous les rois des nations, oui, tous, Reposent avec honneur, chacun dans son tombeau.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ነገሥታት ሁሉ በየቤታቸው በክብር አንቀላፍተዋል።

verses.en: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
verses.fr: Mais toi, tu as été jeté loin de ton sépulcre, Comme un rameau qu''on dédaigne, Comme une dépouille de gens tués à coups d''épée, Et précipités sur les pierres d''une fosse, Comme un cadavre foulé aux pieds.
verses.am: አንተ ግን እንደ ተጠላ ቅርንጫፍ ከመቃብርህ ተጥለሃል፤ በሰይፍም የተወጉት፥ ተገድለውም ወደ ጕድጓዱ ድንጋዮች የወረዱት ከድነውሃል፤ እንደ ተረገጠም ሬሳ ሆነሃል።

verses.en: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
verses.fr: Tu n''es pas réuni à eux dans le sépulcre, Car tu as détruit ton pays, tu as fait périr ton peuple: On ne parlera plus jamais de la race des méchants.
verses.am: ምድርህን አጥፍተሃልና፥ ሕዝብህንም ገድለሃልና ከእነርሱ ጋር በመቃብር በአንድነት አትሆንም፤ የክፉዎች ዘር ለዘላለም የተጠራ አይሆንም።

verses.en: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
verses.fr: Préparez le massacre des fils, A cause de l''iniquité de leurs pères! Qu''ils ne se relèvent pas pour conquérir la terre, Et remplir le monde d''ennemis! -
verses.am: እንዳይነሡም፥ ምድርንም እንዳይወርሱ፥ የዓለሙንም ፊት በከተሞች እንዳይሞሉ ስለ አባቶቻቸው በደል ለልጆቹ ሞትን አዘጋጁላቸው።

verses.en: For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je me lèverai contre eux, Dit l''Eternel des armées; J''anéantirai le nom et la trace de Babylone, Ses descendants et sa postérité, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእነርሱ ላይ እነሣለሁ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ከባቢሎን ስምንና ቅሬታን፥ ዘርንና ትውልድንም እቈርጣለሁ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: J''en ferai le gîte du hérisson et un marécage, Et je la balaierai avec le balai de la destruction, Dit l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: የጃርት መኖርያ የውኃም መቋሚያ አደርጋታለሁ፤ በጥፋትም መጥረጊያ እጠርጋታለሁ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: The Lord of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées l''a juré, en disant: Oui, ce que j''ai décidé arrivera, Ce que j''ai résolu s''accomplira.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ምሎአል። እንደ ተናገርሁ በእርግጥ ይሆናል፥ እንደ አሰብሁም እንዲሁ ይቆማል።

verses.en: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
verses.fr: Je briserai l''Assyrien dans mon pays, Je le foulerai aux pieds sur mes montagnes; Et son joug leur sera ôté, Et son fardeau sera ôté de leurs épaules.
verses.am: አሦርን በምድሬ ላይ እሰብረዋለሁ፥ በተራራዬም ላይ እረግጠዋለሁ፤ ቀንበሩም ከእነርሱ ላይ ይነሣል፥ ሸክሙም ከጫንቃቸው ላይ ይወገዳል።

verses.en: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
verses.fr: Voilà la résolution prise contre toute la terre, Voilà la main étendue sur toutes les nations.
verses.am: በምድር ሁሉ ላይ እግዚአብሔር ያሰበው አሳብ ይህ ነው፥ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ ላይ የተዘረጋች እጅ ይህች ናት።

verses.en: For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées a pris cette résolution: qui s''y opposera? Sa main est étendue: qui la détournera?
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ይህን አስቦአል፤ የሚያስጥለውስ ማን ነው? እጁም ተዘርግታለች፤ የሚመልሳትስ ማን ነው?

verses.en: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
verses.fr: L''année de la mort du roi Achaz, cet oracle fut prononcé:
verses.am: ንጉሡ አካዝ በሞተበት ዓመት ይህ ሸክም ሆነ።

verses.en: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
verses.fr: Ne te réjouis pas, pays des Philistins, De ce que la verge qui te frappait est brisée! Car de la racine du serpent sortira un basilic, Et son fruit sera un dragon volant.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤም ሆይ፥ ከእባቡ ሥር እፉኝት ይወጣልና፥ ፍሬውም የሚበርርና እሳት የሚመስል እባብ ይሆናልና የመታሽ በትር ስለ ተሰበረ ሁላችሁም ደስ አይበላችሁ።

verses.en: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
verses.fr: Alors les plus pauvres pourront paître, Et les malheureux reposer en sécurité; Mais je ferai mourir ta racine par la faim, Et ce qui restera de toi sera tué.
verses.am: የድሆችም የበኵር ልጆች ይሰማራሉ፥ ችግረኞችም ተዘልለው ይተኛሉ፤ ሥርህንም በራብ እገድላለሁ፥ ቅሬታህም ይገደላል።

verses.en: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.
verses.fr: Porte, gémis! ville, lamente-toi! Tremble, pays tout entier des Philistins! Car du nord vient une fumée, Et les rangs de l''ennemi sont serrés. -
verses.am: አንተ በር ሆይ፥ ወዮ በል አንቺም ከተማ ሆይ፥ ጩኺ፤ ፍልስጥኤም ሆይ፥ ሁላችሁም ቀልጣችኋል፤ ጢስ ከሰሜን ይመጣል ከጭፍራውም ተለይቶ የሚቀር የለም።

verses.en: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
verses.fr: Et que répondra-t-on aux envoyés du peuple? -Que l''Eternel a fondé Sion, Et que les malheureux de son peuple y trouvent un refuge.
verses.am: ለሕዝቡም መልእክተኞች ምን ብሎ መመለስ ይገባል? እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን እንደ መሠረተ፥ የሕዝቡም ችግረኞች በእርስዋ ውስጥ እንደሚጠጉ ነው።

verses.en: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;
verses.fr: Oracle sur Moab. La nuit même où elle est ravagée, Ar-Moab est détruite! La nuit même où elle est ravagée, Kir-Moab est détruite!...
verses.am: ስለ ሞዓብ የተነገረ ሸክም። የሞዓብ ዔር በሌሊት ፈርሶ ጠፋ፤ ቂር የሚባልም የሞዓብ ምሽግ በሌሊት ፈርሶ ጠፋ።

verses.en: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.
verses.fr: On monte au temple et à Dibon, Sur les hauts lieux, pour pleurer; Moab est en lamentations, sur Nebo et sur Médeba: Toutes les têtes sont rasées, Toutes les barbes sont coupées.
verses.am: ወደ ባይት ወደ ዲቦንም ወደ ኮረብታ መስገጃዎችም ለልቅሶ ወጥተዋል፤ ሞዓብ በናባው በሜድባ ላይ ታለቅሳለች፤ ራሳቸው ሁሉ ተነጭቶአል፥ ጢማቸውም ሁሉ ተላጭቶአል።

verses.en: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
verses.fr: Dans les rues, ils sont couverts de sacs; Sur les toits et dans les places, Tout gémit et fond en larmes.
verses.am: በየመገዳቸውም በማቅ ታጥቀዋል፤ በየሰገነቶቻቸውና በየአደባባዮቻቸው እንባ እጅግ እያፈሰሱ ሁሉም አልቅሰዋል።

verses.en: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
verses.fr: Hesbon et Elealé poussent des cris, On entend leur voix jusqu''à Jahats; Même les guerriers de Moab se lamentent, Ils ont l''effroi dans l''âme.
verses.am: ሐሴቦንና ኤልያሊ ጮኹ፤ ድምፃቸው እስከ ያሀጽ ድረስ ይሰማል፤ ስለዚህ የሞዓብ ሰልፈኞች ጮኹ፤ ነፍስዋ በውስጥዋ ተንቀጠቀጠች።

verses.en: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.
verses.fr: Mon coeur gémit sur Moab, Dont les fugitifs se sauvent jusqu''à Tsoar, Jusqu''à Eglath-Schelischija; Car ils font, en pleurant, la montée de Luchith, Et ils jettent des cris de détresse sur le chemin de Choronaïm;
verses.am: ልቤ ስለ ሞዓብ ጮኸ፤ ከእርስዋም የሚሸሹ ወደ ዞዓር ወደ ዔግላት ሺሊሺያ ኰበለሉ፤ በሉሒት ዓቀበት ላይ እያለቀሱ ይወጣሉ፥ በሖሮናይምም መንገድ የዋይታ ጩኸት ያነሣሉ።

verses.en: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
verses.fr: Car les eaux de Nimrim sont ravagées, L''herbe est desséchée, le gazon est détruit, La verdure a disparu.
verses.am: የኔምሬም ውኆች ይደርቃሉ፤ ሣሩም ደርቋል፥ ለጋውም ጠውልጓል፥ ልምላሜውም ሁሉ የለም።

verses.en: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ils ramassent ce qui leur reste, Et ils transportent leurs biens au delà du torrent des saules.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የሰበሰቡትን ሀብትና መዝገባቸውን ወደ አኻያ ዛፍ ወንዝ ማዶ ይወስዱታል።

verses.en: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beerelim.
verses.fr: Car les cris environnent les frontières de Moab; Ses lamentations retentissent jusqu''à Eglaïm, Ses lamentations retentissent jusqu''à Beer-Elim.
verses.am: ጩኸት የሞዓብን ዳርቻ ሁሉ ዞረ፤ ልቅሶዋም ወደ ኤግላይምና ወደ ብኤርኢሊም ደረሰ።

verses.en: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.
verses.fr: Les eaux de Dimon sont pleines de sang, Et j''enverrai sur Dimon de nouveaux malheurs, Un lion contre les réchappés de Moab, Contre le reste du pays.
verses.am: የዲሞንም ውኃ ደም ተሞልታለች፤ በዲሞንም ላይ ሥቃይን እጨምራለሁ፥ ከሞዓባውያንም በሚያመልጡ፥ ከምድርም በሚቀሩ ላይ አንበሳን አመጣለሁ።

verses.en: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
verses.fr: Envoyez les agneaux au souverain du pays, Envoyez-les de Séla, par le désert, A la montagne de la fille de Sion.
verses.am: በምድርም ላይ ለሠለጠነው አለቃ የበግ ጠቦቶችን በምድረ በዳ ካለችው ከሴላ ወደ ጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ተራራ ስደዱ።

verses.en: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
verses.fr: Tel un oiseau fugitif, telle une nichée effarouchée, Telles seront les filles de Moab, au passage de l''Arnon. -
verses.am: እንደሚበርር ወፍ እንደ ተበተኑም ጫጩቶች እንዲሁ የሞዓብ ሴቶች ልጆች በአርኖን መሻገሪያዎች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
verses.fr: Donne conseil, fais justice, Couvre-nous en plein midi de ton ombre comme de la nuit, Cache ceux que l''on poursuit, Ne trahis pas le fugitif!
verses.am: ምክርን ምከሪ፥ ፍርድን አድርጊ፥ በቀትር ጊዜ ጥላሽን እንደ ሌሊት አድርጊ፤ የተሰደዱትን ሸሽጊ፥ የሸሹትን አትግለጪ።

verses.en: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
verses.fr: Laisse séjourner chez toi les exilés de Moab, Sois pour eux un refuge contre le dévastateur! Car l''oppression cessera, la dévastation finira, Celui qui foule le pays disparaîtra.
verses.am: ከሞዓብ የተሰደዱት ከአንቺ ጋር ይቀመጡ፤ ከሚያጠፋቸው ፊት መጋረጃ ሁኛቸው። የሚያስጨንቁ አልቀዋል፥ ጥፋትም ቀርቶአል፤ ይጨቍኑ የነበሩ ከምድር ጠፍተዋል።

verses.en: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
verses.fr: Et le trône s''affermira par la clémence; Et l''on y verra siéger fidèlement, dans la maison de David, Un juge ami du droit et zélé pour la justice. -
verses.am: ዙፋንም በምሕረት ይቀናል፥ በዚያም ላይ በዳዊት ድንኳን ፍርድን የሚሻ ጽድቅንም የሚያፈጥን ፈራጅ በእውነት ይቀመጣል

verses.en: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
verses.fr: Nous entendons l''orgueil du superbe Moab, Sa fierté et sa hauteur, son arrogance et ses vains discours.
verses.am: ስለ ሞዓብ ትዕቢት እጅግ ስለ መታበዩ፥ ስለ ኵራቱና ስለ ትዕቢቱ ስለ ቍጣውም ሰምተናል፤ ትምሕክቱ ከንቱ ነው።

verses.en: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi Moab gémit sur Moab, tout gémit; Vous soupirez sur les ruines de Kir-Haréseth, Profondément abattus.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሞዓብ ስለ ሞዓብ ዋይ ይላል፤ ሁሉም ዋይ ይላል፤ ስለ ቂርሐራሴት መሠራት በጥልቅ ኀዘን ታለቅሳላችሁ።

verses.en: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
verses.fr: Car les campagnes de Hesbon languissent; Les maîtres des nations ont brisé les ceps de la vigne de Sibma, Qui s''étendaient jusqu''à Jaezer, qui erraient dans le désert: Les rameaux se prolongeaient, et allaient au delà de la mer.
verses.am: የሐሴቦን እርሻዎችና የሴባማ ወይን ግንዶች አዝነዋል። የአሕዛብ አለቆች የሰባበሩአቸው ቅርንጫፎች እስከ ኢያዜር ደርሰው ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጥተው ነበር፤ ቍጥቋጦቹም ተዘርግተው ባሕርን ተሻግረው ነበር።

verses.en: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.
verses.fr: Aussi je pleure sur la vigne de Sibma, comme sur Jaezer; Je vous arrose de mes larmes, Hesbon, Elealé! Car sur votre récolte et sur votre moisson Est venu fondre un cri de guerre.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በኢያዜር ልቅሶ ስለ ሴባማ ወይን ግንድ አለቅሳለሁ፤ ሐሴቦንና ኤልያሊ ሆይ፥ በዛፍሽ ፍሬና በወይንሽ መከር የጦር ጩኸት ወድቆአልና በእንባዬ አረካሻለሁ።

verses.en: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
verses.fr: La joie et l''allégresse ont disparu des campagnes; Dans les vignes, plus de chants, plus de réjouissances! Le vendangeur ne foule plus le vin dans les cuves; J''ai fait cesser les cris de joie.
verses.am: ደስታና ሐሤትም ከፍሬያማው እርሻ ተወስዶአል፥ በወይኑም ቦታዎች ዝማሬና እልልታ የለም፤ በመጥመቂያም ወይን የሚረግጥ የለም፤ የረጋጮቹን እልልታ አጥፍቻለሁ።

verses.en: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kirharesh.
verses.fr: Aussi mes entrailles frémissent sur Moab, comme une harpe, Et mon coeur sur Kir-Harès.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ልቤ ስለ ሞዓብ አንጀቴም ስለ ቂርሔሬስ እንደ መሰንቆ ትጮኻለች።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
verses.fr: On voit Moab, qui se fatigue sur les hauts lieux; Il entre dans son sanctuaire pour prier, et il ne peut rien obtenir.
verses.am: ሞዓብም መጥቶ በኮረብታ መስገጃ ላይ በደከመና ለጸሎት ወደ መቅደሱ በገባ ጊዜ አያሸንፍም

verses.en: This is the word that the Lord hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
verses.fr: Telle est la parole que l''Eternel a prononcée dès longtemps sur Moab.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሞዓብ ላይ በድሮ ዘመን የተናገረው ነገር ይህ ነው።

verses.en: But now the Lord hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
verses.fr: Et maintenant l''Eternel parle, et dit: Dans trois ans, comme les années d''un mercenaire, La gloire de Moab sera l''objet du mépris, Avec toute cette grande multitude; Et ce qui restera sera peu de chose, presque rien.
verses.am: አሁን ግን እግዚአብሔር። በሦስት ዓመት ውስጥ እንደ ምንደኛ ዓመት የሞዓብ ክብርና የሕዝቡ ሁሉ ብዛት ይዋረዳል፥ ቅሬታውም እጅግ ያነሰና የተጠቃ ይሆናል ይላል።

verses.en: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
verses.fr: Oracle sur Damas. Voici, Damas ne sera plus une ville, Elle ne sera qu''un monceau de ruines.
verses.am: ስለ ደማስቆ የተነገረ ሸክም። እነሆ፥ ደማስቆ ከተማ ከመሆን ተቋርጣለች፤ ባድማና የፍርስራሽ ክምር ትሆናለች።

verses.en: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.fr: Les villes d''Aroër sont abandonnées, Elles sont livrées aux troupeaux; Ils s''y couchent, et personne ne les effraie.
verses.am: ከተሞችዋ ለዘላለም የተፈቱ ይሆናሉ፤ ለመንጋ ማሰማሪያ ሆናሉ፤ መንጎች በዚያ ያርፋሉ የሚያስፈራቸውም የለም።

verses.en: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: C''en est fait de la forteresse d''Ephraïm, Et du royaume de Damas, et du reste de la Syrie: Il en sera comme de la gloire des enfants d''Israël, Dit l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: ምሽግም ከኤፍሬም፥ መንግሥትም ከደማስቆ ተወገደች፤ የሶርያም ቅሬታ እንደ እስራኤል ልጆች ክብር ይሆናል ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
verses.fr: En ce jour, la gloire de Jacob sera affaiblie, Et la graisse de sa chair s''évanouira.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ የያዕቆብ ክብር ይደክማል የሥጋውም ውፍረት ይከሳል።

verses.en: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.fr: Il en sera comme quand le moissonneur récolte les blés, Et que son bras coupe les épis; Comme quand on ramasse les épis, Dans la vallée de Rephaïm.
verses.am: አጫጅ የቆመውን እህል በእጁ ሰብስቦ ዛላውን እንደሚያጭድ ይሆናል፤ በራፋይም ሸለቆ ቃርሚያ እንደሚለቅም እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the Lord God of Israel.
verses.fr: Il en restera un grappillage, comme quand on secoue l''olivier, Deux, trois olives, au haut de la cime, Quatre, cinq, dans ses branches à fruits, Dit l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: ወይራ በተመታ ጊዜ ሁለት ወይም ሦስት ፍሬ በራሱ ላይ እንደሚቀር፥ አራት ወይም አምስት በዛፊቱ ጫፍ እንደሚገኝ፥ በእርሱ ዘንድ ቃርሚያ ይቀራል ይላል የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: En ce jour, l''homme regardera vers son créateur, Et ses yeux se tourneront vers le Saint d''Israël;
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ሰው ወደ ፈጣሪው ይመለከታል፥ ዓይኖቹም ወደ እስራኤል ቅዱስ ያያሉ።

verses.en: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
verses.fr: Il ne regardera plus vers les autels, Ouvrage de ses mains, Et il ne contemplera plus ce que ses doigts ont fabriqué, Les idoles d''Astarté et les statues du soleil.
verses.am: እጁም የሠራችውን መሠዊያ አይመለከትም፤ ጣቶቹም ወደ አበጁአቸው፥ ወደ ማምለኪያ ዐፀዶች ወይም ወደ ፀሐይ ምስሎች፥ አያይም።

verses.en: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
verses.fr: En ce jour, ses villes fortes seront Comme des débris dans la forêt et sur la cime des montagnes, Abandonnés devant les enfants d''Israël: Et ce sera un désert.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት የአሞራውያንና የኤውያውያን ከተሞች እንደ ተፈቱ፥ እንዲሁ ከተሞችህ ይፈታሉ፥ ባድማም ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
verses.fr: Car tu as oublié le Dieu de ton salut, Tu ne t''es pas souvenu du rocher de ton refuge. Aussi tu as fait des plantations d''agrément, Tu as planté des ceps étrangers;
verses.am: የደኅንነትህን አምላክ ረስተሃል፥ የረድኤትህንም ጌታ አላሰብህም፤ ስለዚህ ያማረውን ተክል ተክለሃል፥ እንግዳንም ዘር ዘርተሃል።

verses.en: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
verses.fr: Lorsque tu les plantas, tu les entouras d''une haie, Et bientôt tu les fis venir en fleurs. Mais la récolte a fui, au moment de la jouissance: Et la douleur est sans remède.
verses.am: በተከልህበት ቀን ታበቅለዋለህ፥ በነጋውም ዘርህን እንዲያብብ ታደርገዋለህ፤ ነገር ግን በኀዘንና በትካዜ ቀን መከሩ ይሸሻል።

verses.en: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
verses.fr: Oh! quelle rumeur de peuples nombreux! Ils mugissent comme mugit la mer. Quel tumulte de nations! Elles grondent comme grondent les eaux puissantes.
verses.am: እንደ ባሕር ሞገድ ድምፅ ለሚተምሙ ለወገኖች ብዛት፥ እንደ ኃይለኛም ውኃ ጩኸት ለሚጮኹ አሕዛብ ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
verses.fr: Les nations grondent comme grondent les grandes eaux... Il les menace, et elles fuient au loin, Chassées comme la balle des montagnes au souffle du vent, Comme la poussière par un tourbillon.
verses.am: አሕዛብ እንደ ብዙ ውኃ ጩኸት ይጮኻሉ፤ እርሱ ግን ይገሥጻቸዋል፥ እነርሱም እየሸሹ ይርቃሉ፥ በተራራም ላይ እንዳለ እብቅ በነፋስ ፊት፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስ እንደሚያዞረው ትቢያ ይበተናሉ።

verses.en: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
verses.fr: Quand vient le soir, voici, c''est une ruine soudaine; Avant le matin, ils ne sont plus! Voilà le partage de ceux qui nous dépouillent, Le sort de ceux qui nous pillent.
verses.am: በመሸ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ድንጋጤ አለ፤ ከማለዳም በፊት አይገኙም። የዘረፉን ሰዎች እድል ፈንታ፥ የበዘበዙን ዕጣ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
verses.fr: Terre, où retentit le cliquetis des armes, Au delà des fleuves de l''Ethiopie!
verses.am: በኢትዮጵያ ወንዞች ማዶ ላለች፥ ክንፍ ያላቸው መርከቦች ላሉባት፥

verses.en: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!
verses.fr: Toi qui envoies sur mer des messagers, Dans des navires de jonc voguant à la surface des eaux! Allez, messagers rapides, vers la nation forte et vigoureuse, Vers ce peuple redoutable depuis qu''il existe, Nation puissante et qui écrase tout, Et dont le pays est coupé par des fleuves.
verses.am: መልእክተኞችን በባሕር ላይ የደንገል መርከቦችንም በውኃ ላይ ለምትልክ ምድር ወዮላት! እናንተ ፈጣኖች መልእክተኞች ሆይ፥ ወደ ረጅምና ወደ ለስላሳ ሕዝብ፥ ከመጀመሪያው አስደንጋጭ ወደ ሆነ ወገን፥ ወደሚሰፍርና ወደሚረግጥ፥ ወንዞችም ምድራቸውን ወደሚከፍሉት ሕዝብ ሂዱ።

verses.en: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.
verses.fr: Vous tous, habitants du monde, habitants de la terre, Voyez la bannière qui se dresse sur les montagnes, Ecoutez la trompette qui sonne!
verses.am: በዓለም የምትኖሩ ሁሉና በምድር የምትቀመጡ ሆይ፥ ምልክት በተራሮች ላይ በተነሣ ጊዜ እዩ፤ መለከትም በተነፋ ጊዜ ስሙ።

verses.en: For so the Lord said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
verses.fr: Car ainsi m''a parlé l''Eternel: Je regarde tranquillement de ma demeure, Par la chaleur brillante de la lumière, Et par la vapeur de la rosée, au temps de la chaude moisson.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር። በፀሐይ ጮራ እንደ ደረቅ ትኩሳት፥ በአጨዳም ወራት እንደ ጠል ደመና ሆኜ በማደሪያዬ በጸጥታ ተቀምጬ እመለከታለሁ ብሎኛልና።

verses.en: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.
verses.fr: Mais avant la moisson, quand la pousse est achevée, Quand la fleur devient un raisin qui mûrit, Il coupe les sarments avec des serpes, Il enlève, il tranche les ceps...
verses.am: እርሱ ከመከር በፊት አበባ በረገፈ ጊዜ የወይንም ፍሬ ጨርቋ ሲይዝ የወይኑን ዘንግ በማጭድ ይቆርጣል፥ ጫፎቹንም ይመለምላል ያስወግድማል።

verses.en: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
verses.fr: Ils seront tous abandonnés aux oiseaux de proie des montagnes Et aux bêtes de la terre; Les oiseaux de proie passeront l''été sur leurs cadavres, Et les bêtes de la terre y passeront l''hiver.
verses.am: በተራራ ላይ ላሉ ነጣቂዎች ወፎች፥ ለምድርም አውሬዎች በአንድነት ይቀራሉ፤ ነጣቂዎችም ወፎች ይባጁባቸዋል፥ የምድርም አውሬዎች ሁሉ ይከርሙባቸዋል።

verses.en: In that time shall the present be brought unto the Lord of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the Lord of hosts, the mount Zion.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, des offrandes seront apportées à l''Eternel des armées, Par le peuple fort et vigoureux, Par le peuple redoutable depuis qu''il existe, Nation puissante et qui écrase tout, Et dont le pays est coupé par des fleuves; Elles seront apportées là où réside le nom de l''Eternel des armées, Sur la montagne de Sion.
verses.am: በዚያን ዘመን ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር፥ ከረጅምና ከለስላሳ ሕዝብ፥ ከመጀመሪያው አስደንጋጭ ከሆነ ወገን፥ ከሚሰፍርና ከሚረግጥ፥ ወንዞችም ምድራቸውን ከሚከፍሉት ሕዝብ ዘንድ እጅ መንሻ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ስም ወደሚገኝበት ስፍራ ወደ ጽዮን ተራራ ይቀርባል።

verses.en: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
verses.fr: Oracle sur l''Egypte. Voici, l''Eternel est monté sur une nuée rapide, il vient en Egypte; Et les idoles de l''Egypte tremblent devant lui, Et le coeur des Egyptiens tombe en défaillance.
verses.am: ስለ ግብጽ የተነገረ ሸክም። እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በፈጣን ደመና እይበረረ ወደ ግብጽ ይመጣል፤ የግብጽም ጣዖታት በፊቱ ይርዳሉ፥ የግብጽም ልብ በውስጥዋ ይቀልጣል።

verses.en: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.fr: J''armerai l''Egyptien contre l''Egyptien, Et l''on se battra frère contre frère, ami contre ami, Ville contre ville, royaume contre royaume.
verses.am: ግብጻውያንን በግብጻውያን ላይ አስነሣለሁ፤ ወንድምም ወንድሙን፥ ሰውም ባልንጀራውን፥ ከተማም ከተማን፥ መንግሥትም መንግሥትን ይወጋል።

verses.en: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
verses.fr: L''esprit de l''Egypte disparaîtra du milieu d''elle, Et j''anéantirai son conseil; On consultera les idoles et les enchanteurs, Ceux qui évoquent les morts et ceux qui prédisent l''avenir.
verses.am: የግብጽም መንፈስ በውስጥዋ ባዶ ይሆናል፥ ምክራቸውንም አጠፋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ጣዖቶቻቸውን በድግምት የሚጠነቍሉትንም መናፍስት ጠሪዎቻቸውንም ጠንቋዮቻቸውንም ይጠይቃሉ።

verses.en: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: Et je livrerai l''Egypte entre les mains d''un maître sévère; Un roi cruel dominera sur eux, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: ግብጻውያንንም በጨካኝ ጌታ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፤ ጨካኝ ንጉሥም ይገዛቸዋል ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
verses.fr: Les eaux de la mer tariront, Le fleuve deviendra sec et aride;
verses.am: ውኆችም ከባሕር ይደርቃሉ፥ ወንዙም ያንሳል ደረቅም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
verses.fr: Les rivières seront infectes, Les canaux de l''Egypte seront bas et desséchés, Les joncs et les roseaux se flétriront.
verses.am: ወንዞቹም ይገማሉ፥ የግብጽም መስኖች ያንሳሉ ይደርቃሉም፤ ደንገልና ቄጤማ ይጠወልጋሉ።

verses.en: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
verses.fr: Ce ne sera que nudité le long du fleuve, à l''embouchure du fleuve; Tout ce qui aura été semé près du fleuve se desséchera, Se réduira en poussière et périra.
verses.am: በዓባይ ወንዝ ዳር ያለው መስክ በዓባይም ወንዝ አጠገብ የተዘራ እርሻ ሁሉ ይደርቃል፥ ይበተንማል፥ አይገኝምም።

verses.en: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
verses.fr: Les pêcheurs gémiront, Tous ceux qui jettent l''hameçon dans le fleuve se lamenteront, Et ceux qui étendent des filets sur les eaux seront désolés.
verses.am: ዓሣ አጥማጆቹ ያዝናሉ፥ በዓባይም ወንዝ መቃጥን የሚጥሉት ሁሉ ያለቅሳሉ፥ በውኆችም ላይ መረብ የሚዘረጉት ይዝላሉ።

verses.en: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
verses.fr: Ceux qui travaillent le lin peigné Et qui tissent des étoffes blanches seront confus.
verses.am: የተበጠረውንም የተልባ እግር የሚሠሩ፥ ነጩንም ልብስ የሚሠሩ ሸማኔዎች ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
verses.fr: Les soutiens du pays seront dans l''abattement, Tous les mercenaires auront l''âme attristée.
verses.am: ደገፋዎችዋም ሁሉ ይሰባበራሉ፥ የደመወዘኞችም ነፍስ ትተክዛለች።

verses.en: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
verses.fr: Les princes de Tsoan ne sont que des insensés, Les sages conseillers de Pharaon forment un conseil stupide. Comment osez-vous dire à Pharaon: Je suis fils des sages, fils des anciens rois?
verses.am: የጣኔዎስ አለቆች ፍጹም ሰነፎች ናቸው፤ ፈርዖንን የሚመክሩ ጥበበኞች ምክራቸው ድንቍርና ሆነች። ፈርዖንን። እኛ የጥበበኞች ልጆች የቀደሙም ነገሥታት ልጆች ነን እንዴት ትሉታላችሁ?

verses.en: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the Lord of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
verses.fr: Où sont-ils donc tes sages? Qu''ils te fassent des révélations, Et qu''on apprenne ce que l''Eternel des armées a résolu contre l''Egypte.
verses.am: አሁንሳ ጥበበኞችህ የት አሉ? አሁን ይንገሩህ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በግብጽ ላይ ያሰበውን ይወቁ።

verses.en: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
verses.fr: Les princes de Tsoan sont fous, Les princes de Noph sont dans l''illusion, Les chefs des tribus égarent l''Egypte;
verses.am: የጣኔዎስ አለቆች ሰነፎች ሆነዋል፥ የሜምፎስም አለቆች ተሸንግለዋል፤ የነገዶችዋ የማዕዘን ድንጋዮች የሆኑ ግብጽን አሳቱ።

verses.en: The Lord hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a répandu au milieu d''elle un esprit de vertige, Pour qu''ils fassent chanceler les Egyptiens dans tous leurs actes, Comme un homme ivre chancelle en vomissant.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የጠማምነትን መንፈስ በውስጥዋ ደባልቆአል፤ ሰካር በትፋቱ እንዲስት እንዲሁ ግብጽን በሥራዋ ሁሉ አሳቱ።

verses.en: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
verses.fr: Et l''Egypte sera hors d''état de faire Ce que font la tête et la queue, La branche de palmier et le roseau.
verses.am: ራስ ወይም ጅራት የሰሌን ቅርንጫፍ ወይም እንግጫ ቢሆን ሊሠራ የሚችል ሥራ ለግብጽ አይሆንላትም።

verses.en: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the Lord of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
verses.fr: En ce jour, l''Egypte sera comme des femmes: Elle tremblera et aura peur, En voyant s''agiter la main de l''Eternel des armées, Quand il la lèvera contre elle.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ግብጻውያን እንደ ሴቶች ይሆናሉ፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ላይ ከሚያንቀሳቅሳት ከእጁ መንቀሳቀስ የተነሣ ይሸበራሉ ይፈሩማል።

verses.en: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the Lord of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
verses.fr: Et le pays de Juda sera pour l''Egypte un objet d''effroi: Dès qu''on lui en parlera, elle sera dans l''épouvante, A cause de la résolution prise contre elle par l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ምድር ግብጽን የምታስደነግጥ ትሆናለች፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ከመከረባት ምክር የተነሣ ወሬዋን የሚሰማ ሁሉ ይፈራል።

verses.en: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the Lord of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, il y aura cinq villes au pays d''Egypte, Qui parleront la langue de Canaan, Et qui jureront par l''Eternel des armées: L''une d''elles sera appelée ville de la destruction.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን በግብጽ ምድር በከነዓን ቋንቋ የሚናገሩ፥ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔርም የሚምሉ አምስት ከተሞች ይሆናሉ፤ ከነዚህም አንዲቱ የጥፋት ከተማ ተብላ ትጠራለች።

verses.en: In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the Lord.
verses.fr: En ce même temps, il y aura un autel à l''Eternel Au milieu du pays d''Egypte, Et sur la frontière un monument à l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን በግብጽ ምድር መካከል ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ፥ በዳርቻዋም ለእግዚአብሔር ዓምድ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
verses.fr: Ce sera pour l''Eternel des armées un signe et un témoignage Dans le pays d''Egypte; Ils crieront à l''Eternel à cause des oppresseurs, Et il leur enverra un sauveur et un défenseur pour les délivrer.
verses.am: ይህም ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር በግብጽ ምድር ምልክትና ምስክር ይሆናል፤ ከሚያስጨንቁአቸው የተነሣ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጮኻሉና፥ እርሱም መድኃኒትንና ኃያልን ሰድዶ ያድናቸዋልና።

verses.en: And the Lord shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the Lord in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the Lord, and perform it.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel sera connu des Egyptiens, Et les Egyptiens connaîtront l''Eternel en ce jour-là; Ils feront des sacrifices et des offrandes, Ils feront des voeux à l''Eternel et les accompliront.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር በግብጽ የታወቀ ይሆናል፥ ግብጽAውያንም እግዚአብሔርን ያውቃሉ፤ በመሥዋዕትና በቍርባን ያመልካሉ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ስእለት ይሳላሉ ይፈጽሙትማል።

verses.en: And the Lord shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the Lord, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
verses.fr: Ainsi l''Eternel frappera les Egyptiens, Il les frappera, mais il les guérira; Et ils se convertiront à l''Eternel, Qui les exaucera et les guérira.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ግብጽን ይመታታል፤ ይመታታል ይፈውሳታልም፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመለሳሉ እርሱም ይለመናቸዋል ይፈውሳቸውማል።

verses.en: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
verses.fr: En ce même temps, il y aura une route d''Egypte en Assyrie: Les Assyriens iront en Egypte, et les Egyptiens en Assyrie, Et les Egyptiens avec les Assyriens serviront l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ከግብጽ ወደ አሦር መንገድ ይሆናል፥ አሦራዊውም ወደ ግብጽ፥ ግብጻዊውም ወደ አሦር ይገባል፤ ግብጻውያንም ከአሦራውያን ጋር ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.en: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:
verses.fr: En ce même temps, Israël sera, lui troisième, Uni à l''Egypte et à l''Assyrie, Et ces pays seront l''objet d''une bénédiction.

verses.en: Whom the Lord of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées les bénira, en disant: Bénis soient l''Egypte, mon peuple, Et l''Assyrie, oeuvre de mes mains, Et Israël, mon héritage!
verses.am: ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር። ሕዝቤ ግብጽ፥ የእጄም ሥራ አሦር፥ ርስቴም እስራኤል የተባረከ ይሁን ብሎ ይባርካቸዋልና በዚያ ቀን እስራኤል ለግብጽና ለአሦር ሦስተኛ ይሆናል፥ በምድርም መካከል በረከት ይሆናል።

verses.en: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
verses.fr: L''année où Tharthan, envoyé par Sargon, roi d''Assyrie, vint assiéger Asdod et s''en empara,
verses.am: የአሦር ንጉሥ ሳርጎን ተርታንን በሰደደ ጊዜ እርሱም ወደ አዛጦን በመጣ ጊዜ አዛጦንም ወግቶ በያዛት ጊዜ፥

verses.en: At the same time spake the Lord by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
verses.fr: en ce temps-là l''Eternel adressa la parole à Esaïe, fils d''Amots, et lui dit: Va, détache le sac de tes reins et ôte tes souliers de tes pieds. Il fit ainsi, marcha nu et déchaussé.
verses.am: በዚያ ዓመት እግዚአብሔር የአሞጽን ልጅ ኢሳይያስን። ሂድ፥ ማቅህን ከወገብህ አውጣ ጫማህንም ከእግርህ አውልቅ ብሎ ተናገረው። እንዲህም አደረገ፥ ራቁቱንም ባዶ እግሩንም ሄደ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit: De même que mon serviteur Esaïe marche nu et déchaussé, ce qui sera dans trois ans un signe et un présage pour l''Egypte et pour l''Ethiopie,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። ባሪያዬ ኢሳይያስ በግብጽና በኢትዮጵያ ላይ ሦስት ዓመት ለምልክትና ለተአምራት ሊሆን ራቁቱንና ባዶ እግሩን እንደ ሄደ፥

verses.en: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.fr: de même le roi d''Assyrie emmènera de l''Egypte et de l''Ethiopie captifs et exilés les jeunes hommes et les vieillards, nus et déchaussés, et le dos découvert, à la honte de l''Egypte.
verses.am: እንዲሁ የአሦር ንጉሥ የግብጽንና የኢትዮጵያን ምርኮ፥ ጐበዛዝቱንና ሽማግሌዎቹን፥ ራቁታቸውንና ባዶ እግራቸውን አድርጎ ገላቸውንም ገልጦ፥ ለግብጽ ጕስቍልና ይነዳቸዋል።

verses.en: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
verses.fr: Alors on sera dans l''effroi et dans la confusion, à cause de l''Ethiopie en qui l''on avait mis sa confiance, et de l''Egypte dont on se glorifiait.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከተስፋቸው ከኢትዮጵያ ከትምክሕታቸውም ከግብጽ የተነሣ ይፈራሉ ያፍሩማል፤

verses.en: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
verses.fr: Et les habitants de cette côte diront en ce jour: Voilà ce qu''est devenu l''objet de notre attente, sur lequel nous avions compté pour être secourus, pour être délivrés du roi d''Assyrie! Comment échapperons-nous?
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን በዚች ባሕር ዳርቻ የሚቀመጡ። እነሆ፥ ከአሦር ንጉሥ እንድን ዘንድ ለእርዳታ ወደ እነርሱ የሸሸንበት ተስፋችን ይህ ነበረ፤ እኛስ እንዴት እናመልጣለን? ይላሉ።

verses.en: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
verses.fr: Oracle sur le désert de la mer. Comme s''avance l''ouragan du midi, Il vient du désert, du pays redoutable.
verses.am: በባሕር አጠገብ ስላለው ስለ ምድረ በዳ የተነገረ ሸክም። ዐውሎ ነፋስ ከደቡብ እንደሚወጣ፥ እንዲሁ ከሚያስፈራ አገር ከምድረ በዳ ይወጣል።

verses.en: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
verses.fr: Une vision terrible m''a été révélée. L''oppresseur opprime, le dévastateur dévaste. -Monte, Elam! Assiège, Médie! Je fais cesser tous les soupirs. -
verses.am: ከባድ ራእይ ተነገረኝ፤ ወንጀለኛው ይወነጅላል አጥፊውም ያጠፋል። ኤላም ሆይ፥ ውጪ፤ ሜዶን ሆይ፥ ክበቢ፤ ትካዜውን ሁሉ አስቀርቻለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi mes reins sont remplis d''angoisses; Des douleurs me saisissent, Comme les douleurs d''une femme en travail; Les spasmes m''empêchent d''entendre, Le tremblement m''empêche de voir.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወገቤ ሕመም ተሞላ፤ እንደምትወልድ ሴት ምጥ ያዘኝ፤ ከሕመሜ የተነሣ አልሰማም፥ ከድንጋጤም የተነሣ አላይም።

verses.en: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.
verses.fr: Mon coeur est troublé, La terreur s''empare de moi; La nuit de mes plaisirs devient une nuit d''épouvante.
verses.am: ልቤ ተንበደበደ፥ ድንጋጤ አስፈራኝ፥ ተስፋ ያደረግሁትም ድንግዝግዝታ መንቀጥቀጥ ሆነብኝ።

verses.en: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
verses.fr: On dresse la table, la garde veille, on mange, on boit... Debout, princes! oignez le bouclier!
verses.am: ማዕዱን ያዘጋጃሉ፥ ምንጣፉንም ይዘረጋሉ፥ ይበሉማል፥ ይጠጡማል፤ እናንተ መሳፍንት ሆይ፥ ተነሡ፥ ጋሻውን አዘጋጁ።

verses.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
verses.fr: Car ainsi m''a parlé le Seigneur: Va, place la sentinelle; Qu''elle annonce ce qu''elle verra. -
verses.am: ጌታ እንዲህ ብሎኛልና። ሂድ ጉበኛም አቁም፥ የሚያየውንም ይናገር።

verses.en: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
verses.fr: Elle vit de la cavalerie, des cavaliers deux à deux, Des cavaliers sur des ânes, des cavaliers sur des chameaux; Et elle était attentive, très attentive.
verses.am: በከብት የሚቀመጡትን፥ ሁለት ሁለት እየሆኑ የሚሄዱት ፈረሰኞች፥ በአህዮች የሚቀመጡትንና በግመሎች የሚቀመጡትን ባየ ጊዜ በጽኑ ትጋት አስተውሎ ተግቶም ያድምጥ።

verses.en: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
verses.fr: Puis elle s''écria, comme un lion: Seigneur, je me tiens sur la tour toute la journée, Et je suis à mon poste toutes les nuits;
verses.am: ያየውም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ቀኑን ሁሉ ዘወትር በማማ ላይ ቆሜአለሁ፥ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ በመጠበቂያዬ ላይ ተተክያለሁ፥

verses.en: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
verses.fr: Et voici, il vient de la cavalerie, des cavaliers deux à deux! Elle prit encore la parole, et dit: Elle est tombée, elle est tombée, Babylone, Et toutes les images de ses dieux sont brisées par terre! -
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በፈረሶች የሚቀመጡ፥ ሁለት ሁለት ሁነው የሚሄዱ ፈረሰኞች ይመጣሉ ብሎ ጮኸ፤ እርሱም መልሶ። ባቢሎን ወደቀች ወደቀች፥ የተቀረጹም የአማልክቶችዋ ምስሎች ሁሉ በምድር ላይ ተጥለው ደቀቁ አለ።

verses.en: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
verses.fr: O mon peuple, qui as été battu comme du grain dans mon aire! Ce que j''ai appris de l''Eternel des armées, Dieu d''Israël, Je vous l''ai annoncé.
verses.am: እናንተ በአውድማዬ ላይ የተወቃችሁ የአውድማዬ ልጆች ሆይ፥ ከእስራኤል አምላክ ከሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የሰማሁትን ነገርኋችሁ።

verses.en: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
verses.fr: Oracle sur Duma. On me crie de Séir: Sentinelle, que dis-tu de la nuit? Sentinelle, que dis-tu de la nuit?
verses.am: ስለ ኤዶምያስ የተነገረ ሸክም። አንዱ ከሴይር። ጕበኛ ሆይ፥ ሌሊቱ ምን ያህል ነው? ጕበኛ ሆይ፥ ሌሊቱ ምን ያህል ነው? ብሎ ጠራኝ።

verses.en: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
verses.fr: La sentinelle répond: Le matin vient, et la nuit aussi. Si vous voulez interroger, interrogez; Convertissez-vous, et revenez.
verses.am: ጕበኛውም። ይነጋል ድግሞም ይመሻል፤ ትጠይቁ ዘንድ ብትወድዱ ጠይቁ፤ ተመልሳችሁም ኑ አለ።

verses.en: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
verses.fr: Oracle sur l''Arabie. Vous passerez la nuit dans les broussailles de l''Arabie, Caravanes de Dedan!
verses.am: ስለ ዓረብ የተነገረ ሸክም። የድዳናውያን ነጋዴዎች ሆይ፥ በዓረብ ዱር ውስጥ ታድራላችሁ።

verses.en: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
verses.fr: Portez de l''eau à ceux qui ont soif; Les habitants du pays de Théma Portent du pain aux fugitifs.
verses.am: በቴማን የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ወደ ተጠሙት ሰዎች ውኃ አምጡ እንጀራ ይዛችሁ የሸሹትን ሰዎች ተቀበሉአቸው።

verses.en: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
verses.fr: Car ils fuient devant les épées, Devant l''épée nue, devant l''arc tendu, Devant un combat acharné.
verses.am: ከሰይፍ፥ ከተመዘዘው ሰይፍ፥ ከተለጠጠውም ቀስት ከጽኑም ሰልፍ ሸሽተዋልና።

verses.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
verses.fr: Car ainsi m''a parlé le Seigneur: Encore une année, comme les années d''un mercenaire, Et c''en est fait de toute la gloire de Kédar.
verses.am: ጌታ እንዲህ ብሎኛልና። እንደ ምንደኛ ዓመት በአንድ ዓመት ውስጥ የቄዳር ክብር ሁሉ ይጠፋል፤

verses.en: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the Lord God of Israel hath spoken it.
verses.fr: Il ne restera qu''un petit nombre des vaillants archers, fils de Kédar, Car l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, l''a déclaré.
verses.am: ከቀስተኞች ቍጥር የቀሩት፥ የቄዳር ልጆች ኃያላን፥ ያንሳሉ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና።

verses.en: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
verses.fr: Oracle sur la vallée des visions. Qu''as-tu donc, que tout ton peuple monte sur les toits?
verses.am: ስለ ራእይ ሸለቆ የተነገረ ሸክም። እናንተ ሁላችሁ ወደ ሰገነት መውጣታቸሁ ምን ሆናችኋል?

verses.en: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
verses.fr: Ville bruyante, pleine de tumulte, Cité joyeuse! Tes morts ne périront pas par l''épée, Ils ne mourront pas en combattant.
verses.am: ጩኸትና ፍጅት የተሞላብሽ ከተማ፥ ደስታ ያለሽ ከተማ ሆይ፥ በአንቺ ውስጥ የተገደሉት በሰይፍ የተገደሉ አይደሉም፥ በሰልፍም የሞቱ አይደሉም።

verses.en: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.
verses.fr: Tous tes chefs fuient ensemble, Ils sont faits prisonniers par les archers; Tous tes habitants deviennent à la fois captifs, Tandis qu''ils prennent au loin la fuite.
verses.am: አለቆችሽ ሁሉ በአንድነት ሸሹ፥ ያለ ቀስትም ተማረኩ፤ ከሩቅ ሸሽተው ከአንቺ ዘንድ የተገኙት ሁሉ በአንድነት ታሰሩ።

verses.en: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je dis: Détournez de moi les regards, Laissez-moi pleurer amèrement; N''insistez pas pour me consoler Du désastre de la fille de mon peuple.
verses.am: ስለዚህ። ፊታችሁን ከእኔ ዘንድ አርቁ፤ መራራ ልቅሶ አለቅሳለሁ፤ ስለ ሕዝቤ ሴት ልጅ ጥፋት ታጽናኑኝ ዘንድ አትድከሙ አልሁ።

verses.en: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord God of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
verses.fr: Car c''est un jour de trouble, d''écrasement et de confusion, Envoyé par le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées, Dans la vallée des visions. On démolit les murailles, Et les cris de détresse retentissent vers la montagne.
verses.am: ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የድንጋጤና የመረገጥ የድብልቅልቅም ቀን፥ የቅጥርም መፍረስ ወደ ተራራም መጮኽ በራእይ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.fr: Elam porte le carquois; Des chars de combattants, des cavaliers, s''avancent; Kir met à nu le bouclier.
verses.am: ኤላምም ከሰረገለኞችና ከፈረሰኞች ጋር ሆኖ አፎቱን ተሸከመ፥ ቂርም ጋሻውን ገለጠ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
verses.fr: Tes plus belles vallées sont remplies de chars, Et les cavaliers se rangent en bataille à tes portes.
verses.am: መልካሞቹንም ሸለቆችሽን ሰረገሎች ሞሉባቸው፥ ፈረሰኞችም መቆሚያቸውን በበር ላይ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
verses.fr: Les derniers retranchements de Juda sont forcés, Et en ce jour tu visites les armures de la maison de la forêt.
verses.am: የይሁዳንም መጋረጃ ገለጠ፤ በዚያም ቀን በዱር ቤት የነበረውን የጦር ዕቃ ተመለከትህ፥

verses.en: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.fr: Vous regardez les brèches nombreuses faites à la ville de David, Et vous retenez les eaux de l''étang inférieur.
verses.am: የዳዊትም ከተማ ፍራሾች እንደ በዙ አይታችኋል፥ የታችኛውንም ኵሬ ውኃ አከማችታችኋል፥

verses.en: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
verses.fr: Vous comptez les maisons de Jérusalem, Et vous les abattez, pour fortifier la muraille.
verses.am: የኢየሩሳሌምን ቤቶች ቈጠራችሁ ቅጥሩንም ለማጥናት ቤቶችን አፈረሳችሁ።

verses.en: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
verses.fr: Vous faites un réservoir entre les deux murs, Pour les eaux de l''ancien étang. Mais vous ne regardez pas vers celui qui a voulu ces choses, Vous ne voyez pas celui qui les a préparées de loin.
