verses.am: በአሮጌው ኵሬ ላለው ውኃ በሁለቱ ቅጥር መካከል መከማቻ ሠራችሁ፤ ይህን ያደረገውን ግን አልተመለከታችሁም፥ ቀድሞ የሠራውንም አላያችሁም።

verses.en: And in that day did the Lord God of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées, vous appelle en ce jour A pleurer et à vous frapper la poitrine, A vous raser la tête et à ceindre le sac.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ልቅሶና ወደ ዋይታ ራስን ወደ መንጨትና ማቅንም ወደ መልበስ ጠራ።

verses.en: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
verses.fr: Et voici de la gaîté et de la joie! On égorge des boeufs et l''on tue des brebis, On mange de la viande et l''on boit du vin: Mangeons et buvons, car demain nous mourrons! -
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ሐሜትና ደስታ በሬውንና በጉንም ማረድ ሥጋንም መብላት የወይን ጠጅንም መጠጣት ሆነዋል፤ እናንተ። ነገ እንሞታለንና እንብላ እንጠጣ ብላችኋል።

verses.en: And it was revealed in mine ears by the Lord of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord God of hosts.
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées me l''a révélé: Non, ce crime ne vous sera point pardonné que vous ne soyez morts, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: ይህም ነገር በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ጆሮ ተሰማ። እስክትሞቱ ድረስ ይህ በደል በእውነት አይሰረይላችሁም ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées: Va vers ce courtisan, Vers Schebna, gouverneur du palais:
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በቤቱ ውስጥ ወደ ተሾመው ወደዚህ አዛዥ ወደ ሳምናስ ሂድ እንዲህም በለው።

verses.en: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
verses.fr: Qu''y a-t-il à toi ici, et qui as-tu ici, Que tu creuses ici un sépulcre? Il se creuse un sépulcre sur la hauteur, Il se taille une demeure dans le roc!
verses.am: መቃብር በዚህ ያስወቀርህ ከፍ ባለው ስፍራ መቃብር ያሰራህ በድንጋይም ውስጥ ለራስህ መኖርያ ያሳነጽህ በዚህ ምን አለህ? በዚህስ በአንተ ዘንድ ማን አለ?

verses.en: Behold, the Lord will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.
verses.fr: Voici, l''Eternel te lancera d''un jet vigoureux; Il t''enveloppera comme une pelote,
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በኃይል ወርውሮ ይጥልሃል፥ አጠንክሮም ይጨብጥሃል።

verses.en: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord's house.
verses.fr: Il te fera rouler, rouler comme une balle, Sur une terre spacieuse; Là tu mourras, là seront tes chars magnifiques, O toi, l''opprobre de la maison de ton maître!
verses.am: ጠቅልሎም ያንከባልልሃል ወደ ሰፊይቱም ምድር እንደ ኳስ ይጥልሃል፤ አንተ የጌታህ ቤት እፍረት! በዚያ ትሞታለህ በዚያም የክብርህ ሰረገላዎች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
verses.fr: Je te chasserai de ton poste, L''Eternel t''arrachera de ta place.
verses.am: ከአዛዥነት ሥራህ አሳድድሃለሁ፥ ከሹመትህም ትሻራለህ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, J''appellerai mon serviteur Eliakim, fils de Hilkija;
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ባሪያዬን የኬልቅያስን ልጅ ኤልያቄምን እጠራለሁ፥

verses.en: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.fr: Je le revêtirai de ta tunique, je le ceindrai de ta ceinture, Et je remettrai ton pouvoir entre ses mains; Il sera un père pour les habitants de Jérusalem Et pour la maison de Juda.
verses.am: መጐናጸፊያህንም አለብሰዋለሁ፥ በመታጠቂያህም አስታጥቀዋለሁ፥ ሹመትህንም በእጁ አሳልፌ እሰጠዋለሁ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ለሚኖሩ ለይሁዳም ቤት አባት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
verses.fr: Je mettrai sur son épaule la clé de la maison de David: Quand il ouvrira, nul ne fermera; Quand il fermera, nul n''ouvrira.
verses.am: የዳዊትንም ቤት መክፈቻ በጫንቃው ላይ አኖራለሁ፤ እርሱም ይከፍታል የሚዘጋም የለም እርሱም ይዘጋል የሚከፍትም የለም።

verses.en: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.
verses.fr: Je l''enfoncerai comme un clou dans un lieu sûr, Et il sera un siège de gloire pour la maison de son père.
verses.am: በታመነም ስፍራ እንደ ችንካር እተክለዋለሁ፥ ለአባቱም ቤት የክብር ዙፋን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
verses.fr: Il sera le soutien de toute la gloire de la maison de son père, Des rejetons nobles et ignobles, De tous les petits ustensiles, Des bassins comme des vases.
verses.am: የአባቱንም ቤት ክብር ሁሉ ልጆቹንም የልጅ ልጆቹንም፥ ከጽዋ ዕቃ ጀምሮ እስከ ማድጋ ዕቃ ድረስ፥ ታናናሹን ዕቃ ሁሉ ይሰቅሉበታል።

verses.en: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.fr: En ce jour, dit l''Eternel des armées, Le clou enfoncé dans un lieu sûr sera enlevé, Il sera abattu et tombera, Et le fardeau qui était sur lui sera détruit, Car l''Eternel a parlé.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ በታመነው ስፍራ የተከለው ችንካር ይወልቃል ተሰብሮም ይወድቃል፥ በእርሱም ላይ የተሰቀለው ሸክም ይጠፋል እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና።

verses.en: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
verses.fr: Oracle sur Tyr. Lamentez-vous, navires de Tarsis! Car elle est détruite: plus de maisons! plus d''entrée! C''est du pays de Kittim que la nouvelle leur en est venue.
verses.am: ስለ ጢሮስ የተነገረ ሸክም። የተርሴስ መርከቦች ሆይ፥ አልቅሱ፤ ፈርሶአልና ቤት የለም፥ መግባትም የለም፤ ከኪቲም አገር ጀምሮ ተገልጦላቸዋል።

verses.en: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
verses.fr: Soyez muets d''effroi, habitants de la côte, Que remplissaient les marchands de Sidon, parcourant la mer!
verses.am: እናንተ በደሴት የምትኖሩ በባሕርም የምትሻገሩ የሲዶና ነጋዴዎች ንግድ የሞሉባችሁ ሆይ፥ ጸጥ በሉ።

verses.en: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
verses.fr: A travers les vastes eaux, le blé du Nil, La moisson du fleuve, était pour elle un revenu; Elle était le marché des nations.
verses.am: የሺሖር ዘርና የዓባይ ወንዝ መከር በብዙ ውኆች ላይ ገቢዋ ነበረ፤ እርስዋም የአሕዛብ መናገጃ ነበረች።

verses.en: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
verses.fr: Sois confuse, Sidon! Car ainsi parle la mer, la forteresse de la mer: Je n''ai point eu de douleurs, je n''ai point enfanté, Je n''ai point nourri de jeunes gens, ni élevé de jeunes filles.
verses.am: ሲዶና ሆይ፥ ባሕር፥ የባሕር ምሽግ። አላማጥሁም፥ አልወለድሁም፤ ጐበዛዝትንም አላሳደግሁም፥ ደናግልንም አላሳደግሁም ብሎ ተናግሮአልና እፈሪ።

verses.en: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
verses.fr: Quand les Egyptiens sauront la nouvelle, Ils trembleront en apprenant la chute de Tyr.
verses.am: ወሬዋ ወደ ግብጽ በደረሰ ጊዜ በጢሮስ ወሬ ምጥ ይይዛቸዋል።

verses.en: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
verses.fr: Passez à Tarsis, Lamentez-vous, habitants de la côte!
verses.am: ወደ ተርሴስ ተሻገሩ፤ እናንተ በደሴት የምትኖሩ አልቅሱ።

verses.en: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
verses.fr: Est-ce là votre ville joyeuse? Elle avait une origine antique, Et ses pieds la mènent séjourner au loin.
verses.am: በቀድሞ ዘመን ተመሥርታ የነበረችው፥ በዚያም እንደ እንግዳ ሆና ትኖር ዘንድ እግሮችዋ ወደ ሩቅ ያፈለሱአት የደስታችሁ ከተማ ይህች ናትን?

verses.en: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
verses.fr: Qui a pris cette résolution contre Tyr, la dispensatrice des couronnes, Elle dont les marchands étaient des princes, Dont les commerçants étaient les plus riches de la terre?
verses.am: አክሊል ባስጫነች ከተማ በጢሮስ ላይ ይህን የወሰነ ማን ነው? ነጋዴዎችዋ አለቆች ናቸው፥ በእርስዋም የሚሸጡና የሚለውጡ የምድር ክቡራን ናቸው።

verses.en: The Lord of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
verses.fr: C''est l''Eternel des armées qui a pris cette résolution, Pour blesser l''orgueil de tout ce qui brille, Pour humilier tous les grands de la terre.
verses.am: የክብርን ሁሉ ትዕቢት ይሽር ዘንድ የምድርንም ክቡራን ሁሉ ያስንቅ ዘንድ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ወስኖታል።

verses.en: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
verses.fr: Parcours librement ton pays, pareille au Nil, Fille de Tarsis! Plus de joug!
verses.am: የተርሴስ ልጅ ሆይ፥ የሚከለክልሽ የለምና እንደ ዓባይ ወንዝ በአገርሽ ላይ ጐርፈሽ እለፊ።

verses.en: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the Lord hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a étendu sa main sur la mer; Il a fait trembler les royaumes; Il a ordonné la destruction des forteresses de Canaan.
verses.am: በባሕር ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ መንግሥታትንም አናወጠ፤ ምሽጎችዋንም ያጠፉ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ከነዓን አገር አዘዘ።

verses.en: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
verses.fr: Il a dit: Tu ne te livreras plus à la joie, Vierge déshonorée, fille de Sidon! Lève-toi, passe au pays de Kittim! Même là, il n''y aura pas de repos pour toi.
verses.am: እርሱም። አንቺ የተበደልሽ የሲዶና ድንግል ልጅ ሆይ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ደስ አይበልሽ፤ ተነሥተሽ ወደ ኪቲም ተሻገሪ፥ በዚያም ደግሞ አታርፊም አለ።

verses.en: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
verses.fr: Vois les Chaldéens, qui n''étaient pas un peuple, Ces habitants du désert, pour qui l''Assyrien a fondé un pays; Ils élèvent des tours, ils renversent les palais de Tyr, Ils les mettent en ruines.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የከለዳውያን አገር! ይህ ሕዝብ ሆኖ አይገኝም፤ አሦራውያን ለምድረ በዳ አራዊት ሰጥተውታል፤ ግንቦቻቸውን ሠሩ፥ አዳራሾችዋንም አፈረሱ፥ ባድማም አደረጓት።

verses.en: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
verses.fr: Lamentez-vous, navires de Tarsis! Car votre forteresse est détruite!
verses.am: እናንተ የተርሴስ መርከቦች ሆይ፥ ምሽጋችሁ ፈርሶአልና ዋይ በሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, Tyr tombera dans l''oubli soixante-dix ans, Ce que dure la vie d''un roi. Au bout de soixante-dix ans, il en sera de Tyr Comme de la prostituée dont parle la chanson: -
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ጢሮስ እንደ አንድ ንጉሥ ዘመን ሰባ ዓመት ያህል የተረሳች ትሆናለች፤ ከሰባ ዓመት በኋላ ግን ለጢሮስ በጋለሞታ ዘፈን እንደሚሆን እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
verses.fr: Prends la harpe, parcours la ville, Prostituée qu''on oublie! Joue bien, répète tes chants, Pour qu''on se souvienne de toi! -
verses.am: አንቺ የተረሳሽ ጋለሞታ ሆይ፥ መሰንቆ ያዢ በከተማ ላይም ዙሪ፤ መታሰቢያም ይሆንልሽ ዘንድ ዜማን አሳምሪ ዘፈንሽንም አብዢ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the Lord will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
verses.fr: Au bout de soixante-dix ans, l''Eternel visitera Tyr, Et elle retournera à son salaire impur; Elle se prostituera à tous les royaumes de la terre, Sur la face du monde.
verses.am: ከሰባ ዓመትም በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ጢሮስን ይጐበኛታል፥ ወደ ዋጋዋም ትምለሳለች፥ ደግሞም በምድር ፊት ላይ ከሆኑ ከዓለም መንግሥታት ሁሉ ጋር ትገለሙታለች።

verses.en: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the Lord: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the Lord, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
verses.fr: Mais son gain et son salaire impur seront consacrés à l''Eternel, Ils ne seront ni entassés ni conservés; Car son gain fournira pour ceux qui habitent devant l''Eternel Une nourriture abondante et des vêtements magnifiques.
verses.am: ንግድዋና ዋጋዋ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ይሆናል፤ ንግድዋም በልተው ይጠግቡ ዘንድ ማለፊያም ልብስ ይለብሱ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለሚኖሩ ይሆናል እንጂ በዕቃ ቤትና በግምጃ ቤት ውስጥ አይከተትም።

verses.en: Behold, the Lord maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
verses.fr: Voici, l''Eternel dévaste le pays et le rend désert, Il en bouleverse la face et en disperse les habitants.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ምድርን ባዶ ያደርጋታል፥ ባድማም ያደርጋታል፥ ይገለብጣትማል፥ በእርስዋም የተቀመጡትን ይበትናል።

verses.en: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
verses.fr: Et il en est du sacrificateur comme du peuple, Du maître comme du serviteur, De la maîtresse comme de la servante, Du vendeur comme de l''acheteur, Du prêteur comme de l''emprunteur, Du créancier comme du débiteur.
verses.am: እንደ ሕዝቡም እንዲሁ ካህኑ፥ እንደ ባሪያውም እንዲሁ ጌታው፥ እንደ ባሪያይቱም እንዲሁ እመቤትዋ፥ እንደሚገዛም እንዲሁ የሚሸጠው፥ እንደ አበዳሪውም እንዲሁ ተበዳሪው፥ እንደ ዕዳ አስከፋዩም እንዲሁ ዕዳ ከፋዩ ይሆናል።

verses.en: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the Lord hath spoken this word.
verses.fr: Le pays est dévasté, livré au pillage; Car l''Eternel l''a décrété.
verses.am: ምድር መፈታትን ትፈታለች፥ ፈጽማም ትበላሻላች፤ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ቃል ተናግሮአልና።

verses.en: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
verses.fr: Le pays est triste, épuisé; Les habitants sont abattus, languissants; Les chefs du peuple sont sans force.
verses.am: ምድርም አለቀሰች ረገፈችም፤ ዓለም ደከመች ረገፈችም፤ የምድርም ሕዝብ ታላላቆች ደከሙ።

verses.en: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.fr: Le pays était profané par ses habitants; Car ils transgressaient les lois, violaient les ordonnances, Ils rompaient l''alliance éternelle.
verses.am: ምድርም ከሚቀመጡባት በታች ረክሳለች፥ ሕጉን ተላልፈዋልና፥ ሥርዓቱንም ለውጠዋልና፥ የዘላለሙንም ቃል ኪዳን አፍርሰዋልና።

verses.en: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi la malédiction dévore le pays, Et ses habitants portent la peine de leurs crimes; C''est pourquoi les habitants du pays sont consumés, Et il n''en reste qu''un petit nombre.
verses.am: ስለዚህ መርገም ምድርን ትበላለች በእርስዋም የተቀመጡ ይቀጣሉ፤ ስለዚህ የምድር ሰዎች ይቃጠላሉ ጥቂት ሰዎችም ይቀራሉ።

verses.en: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
verses.fr: Le moût est triste, la vigne est flétrie; Tous ceux qui avaient le coeur joyeux soupirent.
verses.am: የወይን ጠጅ አለቀሰች፥ የወይን ንግድ ደከመች፥ ልባቸው ደስ ያለው ሁሉ ተከዙ።

verses.en: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
verses.fr: La joie des tambourins a cessé, la gaîté bruyante a pris fin, La joie de la harpe a cessé.
verses.am: የከበሮው ሐሤት ቀርቶአል፥ የደስተኞች ድምፅ ዝም ብሎአል፥ የመሰንቆ ደስታ ቀርቶአል።

verses.en: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
verses.fr: On ne boit plus de vin en chantant; Les liqueurs fortes sont amères au buveur.
verses.am: እየዘፈኑም የወይን ጠጅን አይጠጡትም፥ የሚያሰክርም መጠጥ ለሚጠጡት መራራ ይሆናል።

verses.en: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
verses.fr: La ville déserte est en ruines; Toutes les maisons sont fermées, on n''y entre plus.
verses.am: ባድማ የሆነችው ከተማ ፈረሰች፤ ቤት ሁሉ ማንም እንዳይገባበት ተዘጋ።

verses.en: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
verses.fr: On crie dans les rues, parce que le vin manque; Toute réjouissance a disparu, L''allégresse est bannie du pays.
verses.am: ስለ ወይኑም ጠጅ በአደባባይ ጩኸት ይሆናል፤ ደስታ ሁሉ ጨልሞአል፥ የምድርም ሐሤት ፈርሶአል።

verses.en: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
verses.fr: La dévastation est restée dans la ville, Et les portes abattues sont en ruines.
verses.am: ከተማይቱም ባድማ ሆናለች፥ በርዋም በጥፋት ተመትቶአል።

verses.en: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
verses.fr: Car il en est dans le pays, au milieu des peuples, Comme quand on secoue l''olivier, Comme quand on grappille après la vendange.
verses.am: የወይራን ዛፍ እንደ መምታት፥ ከወይንም መከር በኋላ ቃርሚያውን እንደ መልቀም፥ እንዲሁ በምድር መካከል በአሕዛብም መካከል ይሆናል።

verses.en: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the Lord, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
verses.fr: Ils élèvent leur voix, ils poussent des cris d''allégresse; Des bords de la mer, ils célèbrent la majesté de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነዚህ ድምፃቸውን ያነሣሉ፥ እልልም ይላሉ፥ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ክብርም ከባሕር ይጣራሉ።

verses.en: Wherefore glorify ye the Lord in the fires, even the name of the Lord God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
verses.fr: Glorifiez donc l''Eternel dans les lieux où brille la lumière, Le nom de l''Eternel, Dieu d''Israël, dans les îles de la mer! -
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔርን በምሥራቅ፥ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም በባሕር ደሴቶች አክብሩ።

verses.en: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
verses.fr: De l''extrémité de la terre nous entendons chanter: Gloire au juste! Mais moi je dis: Je suis perdu! je suis perdu! malheur à moi! Les pillards pillent, et les pillards s''acharnent au pillage.
verses.am: ለጻድቁ ክብር ይሁን የሚለውን ዝማሬ ከምድር ዳርቻ ሰምተናል። እኔ ግን። ከሳሁ፥ ከሳሁ፥ ወዮልኝ! ወንጀለኞች ወንጅለዋል፤ ወንጀለኞች እጅግ ወንጅለዋል አልሁ።

verses.en: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
verses.fr: La terreur, la fosse, et le filet, Sont sur toi, habitant du pays!
verses.am: በምድር ላይ የምትኖር ሆይ፥ ፍርሃትና ገደል ወጥመድም በአንተ ላይ አሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
verses.fr: Celui qui fuit devant les cris de terreur tombe dans la fosse, Et celui qui remonte de la fosse se prend au filet; Car les écluses d''en haut s''ouvrent, Et les fondements de la terre sont ébranlés.
verses.am: የሰማይ መስኮቶች ተከፍተዋልና፥ የምድርም መሠረት ተናውጣለችና ከፍርሃት ድምፅ የሸሸ በገደል ይወድቃል፥ ከገደልም የወጣ በወጥመድ ይያዛል።

verses.en: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
verses.fr: La terre est déchirée, La terre se brise, La terre chancelle.
verses.am: ምድር ተሰባበረች፥ ምድር ፈጽማ ደቀቀች፥ ምድር ተነዋወጠች።

verses.en: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
verses.fr: La terre chancelle comme un homme ivre, Elle vacille comme une cabane; Son péché pèse sur elle, Elle tombe, et ne se relève plus.
verses.am: ምድር እንደ ሰካር ሰው ትንገዳገዳለች፥ እንደ ዳስም ትወዛወዛለች፤ መተላለፍዋ ይከብድባታል፥ ትወድቅማለች ደግማም አትነሣም።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, l''Eternel châtiera dans le ciel l''armée d''en haut, Et sur la terre les rois de la terre.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንደዚህ ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር በከፍታ ያለውን ሠራዊት በከፍታ ላይ፥ በምድርም ያሉትን ነገሥታት በምድር ላይ ይቀጣቸዋል።

verses.en: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
verses.fr: Ils seront assemblés captifs dans une prison, Ils seront enfermés dans des cachots, Et, après un grand nombre de jours, ils seront châtiés.
verses.am: ግዞተኞች በጕድጓድ እንደሚከማቹ በአንድነት ይከማቻሉ፥ በግዞት ቤትም ውስጥ ተዘግተው ይኖራሉ፥ ከብዙ ቀንም በኋላ ይጐበኛሉ።

verses.en: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
verses.fr: La lune sera couverte de honte, Et le soleil de confusion; Car l''Eternel des armées régnera Sur la montagne de Sion et à Jérusalem, Resplendissant de gloire en présence de ses anciens.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም በጽዮን ተራራና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ይነግሣልና፥ በሽማግሌዎቹም ፊት ክብር ይሆናልና ጨረቃ ይታወካል ፀሐይም ያፍራል።

verses.en: O Lord, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
verses.fr: O Eternel! tu es mon Dieu; Je t''exalterai, je célébrerai ton nom, Car tu as fait des choses merveilleuses; Tes desseins conçus à l''avance se sont fidèlement accomplis.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ አምላኬ ነህ፤ ድንቅን ነገር የዱሮ ምክርን በታማኝነትና በእውነት አድርገሃልና ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ ስምህንም አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.en: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
verses.fr: Car tu as réduit la ville en un monceau de pierres, La cité forte en un tas de ruines; La forteresse des barbares est détruite, Jamais elle ne sera rebâtie.
verses.am: ከተማይቱን የድንጋይ ክምር፥ የተመሸገችውን ከተማ ውድማ እንድትሆን፥ የኀጥአንንም አዳራሽ ከተማ እንዳትሆን አድርገሃል፤ ከቶ አትሠራም።

verses.en: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi les peuples puissants te glorifient, Les villes des nations puissantes te craignent.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ኃያላኑ ወገኖች ያከብሩሃል፥ የጨካኞች አሕዛብ ከተማም ትፈራሃለች።

verses.en: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
verses.fr: Tu as été un refuge pour le faible, Un refuge pour le malheureux dans la détresse, Un abri contre la tempête, Un ombrage contre la chaleur; Car le souffle des tyrans Est comme l''ouragan qui frappe une muraille.
verses.am: የጨካኞችም ቍጣ እስትንፋስ ቅጥርን እንደሚመታ ዐውሎ ነፋስ በሆነ ጊዜ፥ ለድሀው መጠጊያ፥ ለችግረኛው በጭንቁ ጊዜ መጠጊያ፥ ከውሽንፍር መሸሸጊያ ከሙቀትም ጥላ ሆነሃል።

verses.en: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
verses.fr: Comme tu domptes la chaleur dans une terre brûlante, Tu as dompté le tumulte des barbares; Comme la chaleur est étouffée par l''ombre d''un nuage, Ainsi ont été étouffés les chants de triomphe des tyrans.
verses.am: እንደ ሙቀት በደረቅ ስፍራ የኀጥአንን ጩኸት ዝም ታሰኛለህ፤ ሙቀትም በደመና ጥላ እንዲበርድ እንዲሁ የጨካኞች ዝማሬ ይዋረዳል።

verses.en: And in this mountain shall the Lord of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées prépare à tous les peuples, sur cette montagne, Un festin de mets succulents, Un festin de vins vieux, De mets succulents, pleins de moelle, De vins vieux, clarifiés.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ለሕዝብ ሁሉ በዚህ ተራራ ላይ ታላቅ የሰባ ግብዣ፥ ያረጀ የወይን ጠጅ፥ ቅልጥም የሞላባቸው የሰቡ ነገሮች፥ የጥሩና ያረጀ የወይን ጠጅ ግብዣ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
verses.fr: Et, sur cette montagne, il anéantit le voile qui voile tous les peuples, La couverture qui couvre toutes les nations;
verses.am: በዚህም ተራራ ላይ በወገኖች ሁሉ ላይ የተጣለውን መጋረጃ፥ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ ላይ የተዘረጋውን መሸፈኛ ያጠፋል።

verses.en: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.fr: Il anéantit la mort pour toujours; Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, essuie les larmes de tous les visages, Il fait disparaître de toute la terre l''opprobre de son peuple; Car l''Eternel a parlé.
verses.am: ሞትን ለዘላለም ይውጣል፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ከፊት ሁሉ እንባን ያብሳል፥ የሕዝቡን ስድብ ከምድር ሁሉ ላይ ያስወግዳል፤ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና።

verses.en: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the Lord; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
verses.fr: En ce jour l''on dira: Voici, c''est notre Dieu, en qui nous avons confiance, Et c''est lui qui nous sauve; C''est l''Eternel, en qui nous avons confiance; Soyons dans l''allégresse, et réjouissons-nous de son salut!
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን። እነሆ፥ አምላካችን ይህ ነው፤ ተስፋ አድርገነዋል፥ ያድነንማል፤ እግዚአብሔር ይህ ነው፤ ጠብቀነዋል፤ በማዳኑ ደስ ይለናል ሐሤትም እናደርጋለን ይባላል።

verses.en: For in this mountain shall the hand of the Lord rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.
verses.fr: Car la main de l''Eternel repose sur cette montagne; Et Moab est foulé sur place, Comme la paille est foulée dans une mare à fumier.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም እጅ በዚህ ተራራ ላይ ታርፋለች፥ ጭድም በጭቃ ውስጥ እንደሚረገጥ እንዲሁ ሞዓብ በስፍራው ይረገጣል።

verses.en: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
verses.fr: Au milieu de cette mare, il étend ses mains, Comme le nageur les étend pour nager; Mais l''Eternel abat son orgueil, Et déjoue l''artifice de ses mains.
verses.am: ዋናተኛም ሲዋኝ እጁን እንደሚዘረጋ፥ እንዲሁ በመካከሉ እጁን ይዘረጋል፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ትዕቢቱን ከእጁ ተንኰል ጋር ያዋርዳል።

verses.en: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.
verses.fr: Il renverse, il précipite les fortifications élevées de tes murs, Il les fait crouler à terre, jusque dans la poussière.
verses.am: የተመሸገውንም ከፍ ከፍ ያለውንም ቅጥርህን ዝቅ ያደርገዋል፥ ያዋርደውማል፥ ወደ መሬትም እስከ አፈር ድረስ ይጥለዋል።

verses.en: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
verses.fr: En ce jour, on chantera ce cantique dans le pays de Juda: Nous avons une ville forte; Il nous donne le salut pour murailles et pour rempart.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ይህ ቅኔ በይሁዳ ምድር ይዘመራል። የጸናች ከተማ አለችን፤ ለቅጥርና ለምሽግ መድኃኒትን ያኖርባታል።

verses.en: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
verses.fr: Ouvrez les portes, Laissez entrer la nation juste et fidèle.
verses.am: እውነትን የሚጠብቅ ጻድቅ ሕዝብ ይገባ ዘንድ በሮችን ክፈቱ።

verses.en: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
verses.fr: A celui qui est ferme dans ses sentiments Tu assures la paix, la paix, Parce qu''il se confie en toi.
verses.am: በአንተ ታምናለችና በአንተ ለምትደገፍ ነፍስ ፈጽመህ በሰላም ትጠብቃታለህ።

verses.en: Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength:
verses.fr: Confiez-vous en l''Eternel à perpétuité, Car l''Eternel, l''Eternel est le rocher des siècles.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የዘላለም አምባ ነውና ለዘላለም በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ።

verses.en: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.
verses.fr: Il a renversé ceux qui habitaient les hauteurs, Il a abaissé la ville superbe; Il l''a abaissée jusqu''à terre, Il lui a fait toucher la poussière.
verses.am: በከፍታ የሚኖሩትን ሰዎች ዝቅ ያደርጋል፤ ከፍ ያለችውን ከተማ ያዋርዳል፥ እስከ መሬትም ድረስ ያዋርዳታል፥ እስከ አፈርም ድረስ ይጥላታል።

verses.en: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
verses.fr: Elle est foulée aux pieds, Aux pieds des pauvres, sous les pas des misérables.
verses.am: እግር፥ የድሀ እግርም የችግረኛም አረጋገጥ፥ ትረግጣታለች።

verses.en: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
verses.fr: Le chemin du juste est la droiture; Toi qui es juste, tu aplanis le sentier du juste.
verses.am: የጻድቃን መንገድ ቅን ናት፤ አንተ ቅን የሆንህ የጻድቃንን መንገድ ታቃናለህ።

verses.en: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Lord, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
verses.fr: Aussi nous t''attendons, ô Eternel! sur la voie de tes jugements; Notre âme soupire après ton nom et après ton souvenir.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በፍርድህ መንገድ ተስፋ አድርገንሃል፥ ስምህም መታሰቢያህም የነፍሳችን ምኞት ነው።

verses.en: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
verses.fr: Mon âme te désire pendant la nuit, Et mon esprit te cherche au dedans de moi; Car, lorsque tes jugements s''exercent sur la terre, Les habitants du monde apprennent la justice.
verses.am: ፍርድህን በምድር ባደረግህ ጊዜ በዓለም የሚኖሩት ጽድቅን ይማራሉና ነፍሴ በሌሊት ትናፍቅሃለች፥ መንፈሴም በውስጤ ወደ አንተ ትገሠግሣለች።

verses.en: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord.
verses.fr: Si l''on fait grâce au méchant, il n''apprend pas la justice, Il se livre au mal dans le pays de la droiture, Et il n''a point égard à la majesté de Dieu.
verses.am: ለኃጢአተኛ ሞገስ ቢደረግለት ጽድቅን አይማርም፤ በቅኖች ምድር ክፉን ነገር ያደርጋል፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ግርማ አያይም።

verses.en: Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
verses.fr: Eternel, ta main est puissante: Ils ne l''aperçoivent pas. Ils verront ton zèle pour le peuple, et ils en seront confus; Le feu consumera tes ennemis.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እጅህ ከፍ ከፍ አለች አላዩምም፤ ነገር ግን በሕዝብህ ላይ ያለህን ቅንዓት አይተው ያፍራሉ፤ እሳትም ጠላቶችህን ትበላለች።

verses.en: Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
verses.fr: Eternel, tu nous donnes la paix; Car tout ce que nous faisons, C''est toi qui l''accomplis pour nous.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሥራችንን ሁሉ ሠርተህልናልና ሰላምን ትሰጠናለህ።

verses.en: O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
verses.fr: Eternel, notre Dieu, d''autres maîtres que toi ont dominé sur nous; Mais c''est grâce à toi seul que nous invoquons ton nom.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላካችን ሆይ፥ ከአንተ በቀር ሌሎች ጌቶች ገዝተውናል፤ ነገር ግን በአንተ ብቻ ስምህን እናስባለን።

verses.en: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
verses.fr: Ceux qui sont morts ne revivront pas, Des ombres ne se relèveront pas; Car tu les as châtiés, tu les as anéantis, Et tu en as détruit tout souvenir.
verses.am: እነርሱ ሞተዋል፥ በሕይወት አይኖሩም፤ ጠፍተዋል፥ አይነሡም፤ ስለዚህ አንተ ጐብኝተሃቸዋል አጥፍተሃቸውማል፥ መታሰቢያቸውንም ሁሉ ምንምን አድርገሃል።

verses.en: Thou hast increased the nation, O Lord, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.
verses.fr: Multiplie le peuple, ô Eternel! Multiplie le peuple, manifeste ta gloire; Recule toutes les limites du pays.
verses.am: ሕዝብን አበዛህ፥ አቤቱ፥ ሕዝብን አበዛህ፤ አንተም ተከበርህ፥ የአገሪቱንም ዳርቻ ሁሉ አሰፋህ።

verses.en: Lord, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
verses.fr: Eternel, ils t''ont cherché, quand ils étaient dans la détresse; Ils se sont répandus en prières, quand tu les as châtiés.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በመከራ ጊዜ ፈለጉህ፥ በገሰጽሃቸውም ጊዜ ልመናቸውን ወደ አንተ አፈሰሱ።

verses.en: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O Lord.
verses.fr: Comme une femme enceinte, sur le point d''accoucher, Se tord et crie au milieu de ses douleurs, Ainsi avons-nous été, loin de ta face, ô Eternel!
verses.am: የፀነሰች ሴት ለመውለድ ስትቀርብ እንደምትጨነቅና በምጥ እንደምትጮኽ፥ አቤቱ፥ እንዲሁ በፊትህ ሆነናል።

verses.en: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.fr: Nous avons conçu, nous avons éprouvé des douleurs, Et, quand nous enfantons, ce n''est que du vent: Le pays n''est pas sauvé, Et ses habitants ne sont pas nés.
verses.am: እኛ ፀንሰናል ምጥም ይዞናል፥ ነፋስንም እንደምንወልድ ሆነናል፤ በምድርም ደኅንነት አላደረግነም፤ በዓለምም የሚኖሩ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
verses.fr: Que tes morts revivent! Que mes cadavres se relèvent! -Réveillez-vous et tressaillez de joie, habitants de la poussière! Car ta rosée est une rosée vivifiante, Et la terre redonnera le jour aux ombres.
verses.am: ሙታንህ ሕያዋን ይሆናሉ፥ ሬሳዎችም ይነሣሉ። በምድር የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ጠልህ የብርሃን ጠል ነውና፥ ምድርም ሙታንን ታወጣለችና ንቁ ዘምሩም።

verses.en: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
verses.fr: Va, mon peuple, entre dans ta chambre, Et ferme la porte derrière toi; Cache-toi pour quelques instants, Jusqu''à ce que la colère soit passée.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ና ወደ ቤትህም ግባ፥ ደጅህን በኋላህ ዝጋ ቍጣ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ ጥቂት ጊዜ ተሸሸግ።

verses.en: For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
verses.fr: Car voici, l''Eternel sort de sa demeure, Pour punir les crimes des habitants de la terre; Et la terre mettra le sang à nu, Elle ne couvrira plus les meurtres.
verses.am: በምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ በበደላቸው ምክንያት ቍጣውን ያመጣባቸው ዘንድ፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከስፍራው ይወጣል፤ ምድርም ደምዋን ትገልጣለች፥ ሙታኖችዋንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትከድንም።

verses.en: In that day the Lord with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
verses.fr: En ce jour, l''Eternel frappera de sa dure, grande et forte épée Le léviathan, serpent fuyard, Le léviathan, serpent tortueux; Et il tuera le monstre qui est dans la mer.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ፈጣኑን እባብ ሌዋታንን ጠማማውንም እባብ ሌዋታንን በጠንካራ በታላቅም በብርቱም ሰይፍ ይቀጣል፥ በባሕርም ውስጥ ያለውን ዘንዶ ይገድላል።

verses.en: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, Chantez un cantique sur la vigne.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ለተወደደው የወይን ቦታ ተቀኙለት።

verses.en: I the Lord do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
verses.fr: Moi l''Eternel, j''en suis le gardien, Je l''arrose à chaque instant; De peur qu''on ne l''attaque, Nuit et jour je la garde.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ጠባቂው ነኝ፤ ሁልጊዜ አጠጣዋለሁ፤ ማንም እንዳይጐዳው በሌሊትና በቀን እጠብቀዋለሁ።

verses.en: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
verses.fr: Il n''y a point en moi de colère; Mais si je trouve à combattre des ronces et des épines, Je marcherai contre elles, je les consumerai toutes ensemble,
verses.am: አልቈጣም፤ እሾህና ኵርንችት በእኔ ላይ ምነው በሰልፍ በነበሩ! በእነርሱ ላይ ተራምጄ በአንድነት ባቃጠልኋቸው ነበር።

verses.en: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
verses.fr: A moins qu''on ne me prenne pour refuge, Qu''on ne fasse la paix avec moi, qu''on ne fasse la paix avec moi.
verses.am: ወይም ጕልበቴን ይያዝ፥ ከእኔ ጋር ሰላም ያድርግ፤ ከእኔ ጋር ሰላም ያድርግ።

verses.en: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
verses.fr: Dans les temps à venir, Jacob prendra racine, Israël poussera des fleurs et des rejetons, Et il remplira le monde de ses fruits.
verses.am: በሚመጣው ዘመን ያዕቆብ ሥር ይሰድዳል፥ እስራኤልም ያብባል ይጨበጭብማል፤ በፍሬያቸውም የዓለሙን ፊት ይሞላሉ።

verses.en: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
verses.fr: L''Eternel l''a-t-il frappé comme il a frappé ceux qui le frappaient? L''a-t-il tué comme il a tué ceux qui le tuaient?
verses.am: በውኑ የመቱትን እንደ መታ እንዲሁ እርሱን መታውን? ወይስ እነርሱ እንደ ተገደሉበት መገደል እርሱ ተገድሎአልን?

verses.en: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
verses.fr: C''est avec mesure que tu l''as châtié par l''exil, En l''emportant par le souffle impétueux du vent d''orient.
verses.am: ነዳቸው ሰደዳቸው ቀሠፋቸው፤ የምሥራቅ ነፋስ እንደሚነፍስበት ቀን በጠንካራ ዐውሎ አስወገዳቸው።

verses.en: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
verses.fr: Ainsi le crime de Jacob a été expié, Et voici le fruit du pardon de son péché: L''Eternel a rendu toutes les pierres des autels Pareilles à des pierres de chaux réduites en poussière; Les idoles d''Astarté et les statues du soleil ne se relèveront plus.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችና የፀሐይ ምስሎች ዳግመኛ እንዳይነሡ የመሠዊያውን ድንጋይ ሁሉ እንደ ደቀቀ እንደ ኖራ ድንጋይ ባደረገ ጊዜ፥ እንዲሁ የያዕቆብ በደል ይሰረያል፥ ይህም ኀጢአትን የማስወገድ ፍሬ ሁሉ ነው።

verses.en: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
verses.fr: Car la ville forte est solitaire, C''est une demeure délaissée et abandonnée comme le désert; Là pâture le veau, il s''y couche, et broute les branches.
verses.am: የተመሸገችው ከተማ ብቻዋን ሆነች፤ እንደ ምድረ በዳ ሆና የተፈታችና የተተወች መኖሪያ ናት፤ በዚያም ጥጃ ይሰማራል በዚያም ይተኛል ቅርንጫፍዋንም ይበላል።

verses.en: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
verses.fr: Quand les rameaux sèchent, on les brise; Des femmes viennent, pour les brûler. C''était un peuple sans intelligence: Aussi celui qui l''a fait n''a point eu pitié de lui, Celui qui l''a formé ne lui a point fait grâce.
verses.am: ጫፎችዋ በደረቁ ጊዜ ይሰበራሉ፥ ሴቶችም መጥተው ያቃጥሉአቸዋል፤ የማያስተውል ሕዝብ ነውና ስለዚህ ፈጣሪው አይራራለትም ሠሪውም ምሕረት አያደርግለትም።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, L''Eternel secouera des fruits, Depuis le cours du fleuve jusqu''au torrent d''Egypte; Et vous serez ramassés un à un, enfants d''Israël!
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር ከወንዝ ፈሳሽ ጀምሮ እስከ ግብጽ ወንዝ ድረስ እህሉን ይወቃል፥ እናንተም የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ አንድ በአንድ ትሰበሰባላችሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the Lord in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: En ce jour, on sonnera de la grande trompette, Et alors reviendront ceux qui étaient exilés au pays d''Assyrie Ou fugitifs au pays d''Egypte; Et ils se prosterneront devant l''Eternel, Sur la montagne sainte, à Jérusalem.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ታላቅ መለከት ይነፋል፥ በአሦርም የጠፉ፥ በግብጽ ምድርም የተሰደዱ ይመጣሉ፥ በተቀደሰውም ተራራ በኢየሩሳሌም ለእግዚአብሔር ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.en: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
verses.fr: Malheur à la couronne superbe des ivrognes d''Ephraïm, A la fleur fanée, qui fait l''éclat de sa parure, Sur la cime de la fertile vallée de ceux qui s''enivrent!
verses.am: ለኤፍሬም ሰካሮች ትዕቢት አክሊል፥ በወይን ጠጅ ለተሸነፉ በወፍራም ሸለቆአቸው ራስ ላይ ላለችም ለረገፈች ለክብሩ ጌጥ አበባ ወዮ!

verses.en: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
verses.fr: Voici venir, de la part du Seigneur, un homme fort et puissant, Comme un orage de grêle, un ouragan destructeur, Comme une tempête qui précipite des torrents d''eaux: Il la fait tomber en terre avec violence.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በጌታ ዘንድ ኃያል ብርቱ የሆነ አለ። እንደ በረዶ ወጨፎ፥ እንደሚያጠፋም ዐውሎ ነፋስ፥ እንደሚያጥለቀልቅም እንደ ታላቅ ውኃ ፈሳሽ በጠነከረ እጅ ወደ ምድር ይጥላል።

verses.en: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
verses.fr: Elle sera foulée aux pieds, La couronne superbe des ivrognes d''Ephraïm;
verses.am: የኤፍሬም ሰካሮች ትዕቢት አክሊል በእግር ይረገጣል፤

verses.en: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
verses.fr: Et la fleur fanée, qui fait l''éclat de sa parure, Sur la cime de la fertile vallée, Sera comme une figue hâtive qu''on aperçoit avant la récolte, Et qui, à peine dans la main, est aussitôt avalée.
verses.am: በወፍራሙ ሸለቆ ራስ ላይ ያለች የረገፈች የክብሩ ጌጥ አበባ ከመከር በፊት አስቀድማ እንደምትበስል በለስ ትሆናለች፤ ሰው ባያት ጊዜ በእጁ እንዳለች ይበላታል።

verses.en: In that day shall the Lord of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
verses.fr: En ce jour, l''Eternel des armées sera Une couronne éclatante et une parure magnifique Pour le reste de son peuple,
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ለቀሩት ሕዝቡ የክብር ዘውድና የጌጥ አክሊል ይሆናል፤

verses.en: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.
verses.fr: Un esprit de justice pour celui qui est assis au siège de la justice, Et une force pour ceux qui repoussent l''ennemi jusqu''à ses portes.
verses.am: በፍርድ ወንበር ላይ ለሚቀመጥም የፍርድ መንፈስ፥ ሰልፉን ወደ በር ለሚመልሱም ኃይል ይሆናል።

verses.en: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.
verses.fr: Mais eux aussi, ils chancellent dans le vin, Et les boissons fortes leur donnent des vertiges; Sacrificateurs et prophètes chancellent dans les boissons fortes, Ils sont absorbés par le vin, Ils ont des vertiges à cause des boissons fortes; Ils chancellent en prophétisant, Ils vacillent en rendant la justice.
verses.am: እነዚህም ደግሞ ከወይን ጠጅ የተነሣ ይስታሉ፥ ከሚያሰክርም መጠጥ የተነሣ ይፋንናሉ፤ ካህኑና ነቢዩ ከሚያሰክር መጠጥ የተነሣ ይስታሉ፥ በወይን ጠጅም ይዋጣሉ፥ ከሚያሰክርም መጠጥ የተነሣ ይፋንናሉ፤ በራእይ ይስታሉ፥ በፍርድም ይሰናከላሉ።

verses.en: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.
verses.fr: Toutes les tables sont pleines de vomissements, d''ordures; Il n''y a plus de place. -
verses.am: ማዕዱ ሁሉ ትፋትንና ርኵሰትን ተሞልቶአታል፤ ንጹሕ ስፍራ እንኳ የለም።

verses.en: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.
verses.fr: A qui veut-on enseigner la sagesse? A qui veut-on donner des leçons? Est-ce à des enfants qui viennent d''être sevrés, Qui viennent de quitter la mamelle?
verses.am: እውቀትን ለማን ያስተምረዋል? ወይስ ወሬ ማስተዋልን ለማን ይሰጣል? ወተትን ለተዉ ወይስ ጡትን ለጣሉ ነውን?

verses.en: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:
verses.fr: Car c''est précepte sur précepte, précepte sur précepte, Règle sur règle, règle sur règle, Un peu ici, un peu là. -
verses.am: ትእዛዝ በትእዛዝ፥ ትእዛዝ በትእዛዝ፥ ሥርዓት በሥርዓት፥ ሥርዓት በሥርዓት፥ ጥቂት በዚህ ጥቂት በዚያ ነው።

verses.en: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.
verses.fr: Hé bien! c''est par des hommes aux lèvres balbutiantes Et au langage barbare Que l''Eternel parlera à ce peuple.
verses.am: በባዕድ አፍ በልዩም ልሳን ለዚህ ሕዝብ ይናገራል፤ እርሱም። ዕረፍት ይህች ናት፥

verses.en: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
verses.fr: Il lui disait: Voici le repos, Laissez reposer celui qui est fatigué; Voici le lieu du repos! Mais ils n''ont point voulu écouter.
verses.am: የደከመውን አሳርፉ፤ ይህችም ማረፊያ ናት አላቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን መስማትን እንቢ አሉ።

verses.en: But the word of the Lord was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
verses.fr: Et pour eux la parole de l''Eternel sera Précepte sur précepte, précepte sur précepte, Règle sur règle, règle sur règle, Un peu ici, un peu là, Afin qu''en marchant ils tombent à la renverse et se brisent, Afin qu''ils soient enlacés et pris.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሄደው ወደ ኋላ እንዲወድቁ እንዲሰበሩም ተጠምደውም እንዲያዙ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ትእዛዝ በትእዛዝ፥ ትእዛዝ በትእዛዝ፥ ሥርዓት በሥርዓት፥ ሥርዓት በሥርዓት፥ ጥቂት በዚህ ጥቂት በዚያ ይሆንላቸዋል።

verses.en: Wherefore hear the word of the Lord, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Ecoutez donc la parole de l''Eternel, moqueurs, Vous qui dominez sur ce peuple de Jérusalem!
verses.am: ስለዚህ በኢየሩሳሌም ያለውን ሕዝብ የምትገዙ ፌዘኞች ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:
verses.fr: Vous dites: Nous avons fait une alliance avec la mort, Nous avons fait un pacte avec le séjour des morts; Quand le fléau débordé passera, il ne nous atteindra pas, Car nous avons la fausseté pour refuge et le mensonge pour abri.
verses.am: እናንተም። ከሞት ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አድርገናል፥ ከሲኦልም ጋር ተማምለናል፤ ሐሰትን መሸሸጊያችን አድርገናልና፥ በሐሰትም ተሰውረናልና የሚትረፈረፍ መቅሠፍት ባለፈ ጊዜ አይደርስብንም ስላላችሁ፥

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, j''ai mis pour fondement en Sion une pierre, Une pierre éprouvée, une pierre angulaire de prix, solidement posée; Celui qui la prendra pour appui n''aura point hâte de fuir.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በጽዮን ድንጋይን ለመሠረት አስቀምጣለሁ፤ የተፈተነውን፥ የከበረውን፥ መሠረቱ የጸናውን የማዕዘን ድንጋይ፤ የሚያምን አያፍርም።

verses.en: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
verses.fr: Je ferai de la droiture une règle, Et de la justice un niveau; Et la grêle emportera le refuge de la fausseté, Et les eaux inonderont l''abri du mensonge.
verses.am: ለገመድ ፍርድን ለቱንቢም ጽድቅን አደርጋለሁ፤ በረዶውም የሐሰትን መሸሸጊያ ይጠርጋል፥ ውኆችም መሰወሪያውን ያሰጥማሉ።

verses.en: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
verses.fr: Votre alliance avec la mort sera détruite, Votre pacte avec le séjour des morts ne subsistera pas; Quand le fléau débordé passera, Vous serez par lui foulés aux pieds.
verses.am: ከሞትም ጋር ያደረጋችሁት ቃል ኪዳን ይፈርሳል፥ ከሲኦልም ጋር የተማማላችሁት መሐላ አይጸናም፤ የሚትረፈረፍ መቅሠፍት ባለፈ ጊዜ ትረገጡበታላችሁ።

verses.en: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.
verses.fr: Chaque fois qu''il passera, il vous saisira; Car il passera tous les matins, le jour et la nuit, Et son bruit seul donnera l''épouvante.
verses.am: ባለፈም ጊዜ ይወስዳችኋል፤ ማለዳ ማለዳ ቀንና ሌሊት ያልፋል፤ ወሬውንም ማስተዋል ድንጋጤ ይሆናል።

verses.en: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.
verses.fr: Le lit sera trop court pour s''y étendre, Et la couverture trop étroite pour s''en envelopper.
verses.am: ሰው በእርሱ ላይ ተዘርግቶ ቢተኛ አልጋው አጭር ነው፤ ሰውም ሰውነቱን መሸፈን ቢወድድ መጐናጸፊያ ጠባብ ነው።

verses.en: For the Lord shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel se lèvera comme à la montagne de Peratsim, Il s''irritera comme dans la vallée de Gabaon, Pour faire son oeuvre, son oeuvre étrange, Pour exécuter son travail, son travail inouï.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሥራውን ማለት እንግዳ ሥራውን ይሠራ ዘንድ፥ አድራጎቱንም ማለት ያልታወቀውን አድራጎቱን ያደርግ ዘንድ በፐራሲም ተራራ እንደ ነበረ ይነሣል፥ በገባዖንም ሸለቆ እንደ ነበረ ይቈጣል።

verses.en: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord God of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.
verses.fr: Maintenant, ne vous livrez point à la moquerie, De peur que vos liens ne soient resserrés; Car la destruction de tout le pays est résolue; Je l''ai appris du Seigneur, de l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: አሁንም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ የሚጸናውን የጥፋት ትእዛዝ ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሰምቻለሁና እስራት እንዳይጸንባችሁ አታፊዙ።

verses.en: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
verses.fr: Prêtez l''oreille, et écoutez ma voix! Soyez attentifs, et écoutez ma parole!
verses.am: አድምጡ ድምፄንም ስሙ፤ ልብ አድርጉ ንግግሬንም ስሙ።

verses.en: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?
verses.fr: Celui qui laboure pour semer laboure-t-il toujours? Ouvre-t-il et brise-t-il toujours son terrain?
verses.am: በውኑ ገበሬ ሊዘራ ሁልጊዜ ያርሳልን? ወይስ ሁልጊዜ እርሻውን ይገለግላልን?

verses.en: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas après en avoir aplani la surface Qu''il répand de la nielle et sème du cumin; Qu''il met le froment par rangées, L''orge à une place marquée, Et l''épeautre sur les bords?
verses.am: ጓሉንስ ይከሰክሳልን? እርሻውን ባስተካከለ ጊዜ ጥቁሩን አዝሙድ፥ ከሙኑንም፥ ስንዴውንም በተርታ፥ ገብሱንም በስፍራው፥ አጃንም በደረጃው የሚዘራ አይደለምን?

verses.en: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.
verses.fr: Son Dieu lui a enseigné la marche à suivre, Il lui a donné ses instructions.
verses.am: ይህንም ብልሃት አምላኩ ያስታውቀዋል ያስተምረውማል።

verses.en: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.
verses.fr: On ne foule pas la nielle avec le traîneau, Et la roue du chariot ne passe pas sur le cumin; Mais on bat la nielle avec le bâton, Et le cumin avec la verge.
verses.am: ጥቁሩ አዝሙድ በተሳለች መሄጃ አያኬድም፥ የሰረገላም መንኰራኵር በከሙን ላይ አይዞርም፤ ነገር ግን ጥቁሩ አዝሙድ በሽመል ከሙኑም በበትር ይወቃል።

verses.en: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.
verses.fr: On bat le blé, Mais on ne le bat pas toujours; On y pousse la roue du chariot et les chevaux, Mais on ne l''écrase pas.
verses.am: የእንጀራ እህል ይደቅቃልን? ለዘላለም አያኬደውም፤ የሰረገላውን መንኰራኵርና ፈረሶቹን ምንም ቢያስኬድበት አያደቅቀውም።

verses.en: This also cometh forth from the Lord of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.
verses.fr: Cela aussi vient de l''Eternel des armées; Admirable est son conseil, et grande est sa sagesse.
verses.am: ይህም ደግሞ ድንቅ ምክር ከሚመክር በግብሩም ማለፊያ ከሆነው ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ወጥቶአል።

verses.en: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
verses.fr: Malheur à Ariel, à Ariel, Cité dont David fit sa demeure! Ajoutez année à année, Laissez les fêtes accomplir leur cycle.
verses.am: ዳዊት ለሰፈረባት ከተማ ለአርኤል ወዮላት! ዓመት በዓመት ላይ ጨምሩ፥ በዓላትም ይመለሱ።

verses.en: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
verses.fr: Puis j''assiégerai Ariel; Il y aura des plaintes et des gémissements; Et la ville sera pour moi comme un Ariel.
verses.am: አርኤልንም አስጨንቃለሁ፥ ልቅሶና ዋይታም ይሆንባታል፤ እንደ አርኤልም ትሆንልኛለች።

verses.en: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.
verses.fr: Je t''investirai de toutes parts, Je te cernerai par des postes armés, J''élèverai contre toi des retranchements.
verses.am: በዙሪያሽም እሰፍራለሁ፥ በቅጥርም ከብቤ አስጨንቅሻለሁ፥ አምባም በላይሽ አቆማለሁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.
verses.fr: Tu seras abaissée, ta parole viendra de terre, Et les sons en seront étouffés par la poussière; Ta voix sortira de terre comme celle d''un spectre, Et c''est de la poussière que tu murmureras tes discours.
verses.am: ትዋረጂማለሽ፥ በመሬትም ላይ ሆነሽ ትናገሪያለሽ፥ ቃልሽም ዝቅ ብሎ ከአፈር ይወጣል፤ ድምፅሽም ከመሬት እንደሚወጣ እንደ መናፍስት ጠሪ ድምፅ ይሆናል፥ ቃልሽም ከአፈር ወጥቶ ይጮኻል።

verses.en: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
verses.fr: La multitude de tes ennemis sera comme une fine poussière, Cette multitude de guerriers sera comme la balle qui vole, Et cela tout à coup, en un instant.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የጠላቶችሽ ብዛት እንደ ደቀቀ ትቢያ፥ የጨካኞችም ብዛት እንደሚያልፍ ገለባ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Thou shalt be visited of the Lord of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
verses.fr: C''est de l''Eternel des armées que viendra le châtiment, Avec des tonnerres, des tremblements de terre et un bruit formidable, Avec l''ouragan et la tempête, Et avec la flamme d''un feu dévorant.
verses.am: ድንገትም ፈጥኖ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በነጐድጓድ፥ በምድርም መናወጥ፥ በታላቅም ድምፅ፥ በዐውሎ ነፋስም፥ በወጨፎም፥ በምትበላም በእሳት ነበልባል ይጐበኛታል።

verses.en: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
verses.fr: Et, comme il en est d''un songe, d''une vision nocturne, Ainsi en sera-t-il de la multitude des nations qui combattront Ariel, De tous ceux qui l''attaqueront, elle et sa forteresse, Et qui la serreront de près.
verses.am: በአርኤልም ላይ የሚዋጉ፥ እርስዋንና ምሽግዋንም የሚወጉ የሚያስጨንቋትም፥ የአሕዛብ ሁሉ ብዛት እንደ ሕልምና እንደ ሌሊት ራእይ ይሆናል።

verses.en: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
verses.fr: Comme celui qui a faim rêve qu''il mange, Puis s''éveille, l''estomac vide, Et comme celui qui a soif rêve qu''il boit, Puis s''éveille, épuisé et languissant; Ainsi en sera-t-il de la multitude des nations Qui viendront attaquer la montagne de Sion.
verses.am: ተርቦም እንደሚያልም ሰው ይሆናል፤ በሕልሙም፥ እነሆ፥ ይበላል፥ ነገር ግን ይነቃል ሰውነቱም ባዶ ነው፤ ተጠምቶም እንደሚያልም ሰው ይሆናል፤ በሕልሙም፥ እነሆ፥ ይጠጣል፥ ነገር ግን ይነቃል፥ እነሆም፥ ይዝላል ሰውነቱም አምሮት አለው፤ እንዲሁ የጽዮንን ተራራ የሚወጉ የአሕዛብ ሁሉ ብዛት ይሆናል።

verses.en: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
verses.fr: Soyez stupéfaits et étonnés! Fermez les yeux et devenez aveugles! Ils sont ivres, mais ce n''est pas de vin; Ils chancellent, mais ce n''est pas l''effet des liqueurs fortes.
verses.am: ተደነቁ ደንግጡም፤ ተጨፈኑም ዕውሮችም ሁኑ፤ በወይን ጠጅ አይሁን እንጂ ሰከሩ፤ በሚያሰክር መጠጥ አይሁን እንጂ ተንገደገዱ።

verses.en: For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel a répandu sur vous un esprit d''assoupissement; Il a fermé vos yeux les prophètes, Il a voilé vos têtes les voyants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የእንቅልፍ መንፈስ አፍስሶባችኋል ዓይኖቻችሁን ነቢያትንም ጨፍኖባችኋል ራሶቻችሁን ባለ ራእዮችን ሸፍኖባችኋል።

verses.en: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:
verses.fr: Toute la révélation est pour vous comme les mots d''un livre cacheté Que l''on donne à un homme qui sait lire, en disant: Lis donc cela! Et qui répond: Je ne le puis, Car il est cacheté;
verses.am: ራእዩም ሁሉ እንደ ታተመ መጽሐፍ ቃል ሆኖባችኋል፤ ማንበብንም ለሚያውቅ። ይህን አንብብ ብለው በሰጡት ጊዜ እርሱ። ታትሞአልና አልችልም ይላቸዋል፤

verses.en: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.
verses.fr: Ou comme un livre que l''on donne A un homme qui ne sait pas lire, en disant: Lis donc cela! Et qui répond: Je ne sais pas lire.
verses.am: ደግሞም መጽሐፉን ማንበብን ለማያውቅ። ይህን አንብብ ብለው በሰጡት ጊዜ እርሱ። ማንበብ አላውቅም ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
verses.fr: Le Seigneur dit: Quand ce peuple s''approche de moi, Il m''honore de la bouche et des lèvres; Mais son coeur est éloigné de moi, Et la crainte qu''il a de moi N''est qu''un précepte de tradition humaine.
verses.am: ጌታም። ይህ ሕዝብ በአፉ ወደ እኔ ይቀርባልና፥ በከንፈርቹም ያከብረኛልና፥ ልቡ ግን ከእኔ የራቀ ነውና፥ በሰዎች ሥርዓትና ትምህርት ብቻ ይፈራኛልና

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je frapperai encore ce peuple Par des prodiges et des miracles; Et la sagesse de ses sages périra, Et l''intelligence de ses hommes intelligents disparaîtra.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ድንቅ ነገርን በዚህ ሕዝብ መካከል፥ ድንቅ ነገርን ተአምራትንም፥ እንደ ገና አደርጋለሁ፤ የጥበበኞችም ጥበብ ትጠፋለች፥ የአስተዋዮችም ማስተዋል ትሰወራለች።

verses.en: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui cachent leurs desseins Pour les dérober à l''Eternel, Qui font leurs oeuvres dans les ténèbres, Et qui disent: Qui nous voit et qui nous connaît?
verses.am: ምክራቸውን ጥልቅ አድርገው ከእግዚአብሔር ለሚሰውሩ፥ ሥራቸውንም በጨለማ ውስጥ አድርገው። ማን ያየናል? ወይስ ማን ያውቀናል? ለሚሉ ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
verses.fr: Quelle perversité est la vôtre! Le potier doit-il être considéré comme de l''argile, Pour que l''ouvrage dise de l''ouvrier: Il ne m''a point fait? Pour que le vase dise du potier: Il n''a point d''intelligence?
verses.am: ይህ የእናንተ ጠማምነት ነው፤ እንደ ሸክላ ሠሪ ጭቃ የምትቈጠሩ አይደላችሁምን? በውኑ ሥራ ሠሪውን። አልሠራኸኝም ይለዋልን? ወይስ የተደረገው አድራጊውን። አታስተውልም ይለዋልን?

verses.en: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
verses.fr: Encore un peu de temps, Et le Liban se changera en verger, Et le verger sera considéré comme une forêt.
verses.am: ሊባኖስ እንደ ፍሬያማ እርሻ ሊለወጥ ፍሬያማውም እርሻ እንደ ዱር ሊቈጠር ጥቂት ዘመን የቀረ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, les sourds entendront les paroles du livre; Et, délivrés de l''obscurité et des ténèbres, Les yeux des aveugles verront.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ደንቆሮች የመጽሐፍን ቃል ይሰማሉ፥ የዕውሮችም ዓይኖች ከጭጋግና ከጨለማ ተለይተው ያያሉ።

verses.en: The meek also shall increase their joy in the Lord, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: Les malheureux se réjouiront de plus en plus en l''Eternel, Et les pauvres feront du Saint d''Israël le sujet de leur allégresse.
verses.am: የዋሃን ደስታቸውን በእግዚአብሔር ያበዛሉ፥ በሰዎች መካከል ያሉ ችግረኞችም ሐሤትን በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
verses.fr: Car le violent ne sera plus, le moqueur aura fini, Et tous ceux qui veillaient pour l''iniquité seront exterminés,
verses.am: ጨካኙ ሰው አልቆአልና፥ ፌዘኛውም ጠፍቶአልና፥ ለኃጢአትም የደፈጡ ሁሉ ይቈረጣሉና፤

verses.en: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
verses.fr: Ceux qui condamnaient les autres en justice, Tendaient des pièges à qui défendait sa cause à la porte, Et violaient par la fraude les droits de l''innocent.
verses.am: እነዚህም ሰውን በነገር በደለኛ የሚያደርጉ፥ በበርም ለሚገሥጸው አሽክላ የሚያኖሩ፥ ጻድቁንም በከንቱ ነገር የሚያስቱ ናቸው።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel à la maison de Jacob, Lui qui a racheté Abraham: Maintenant Jacob ne rougira plus, Maintenant son visage ne pâlira plus.
verses.am: ስለዚህ አብርሃምን የተቤዠ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ያዕቆብ ቤት እንዲህ ይላል። ያዕቆብ አሁን አያፍርም፥ ፊቱም አሁን አይለወጥም።

verses.en: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
verses.fr: Car, lorsque ses enfants verront au milieu d''eux l''oeuvre de mes mains, Ils sanctifieront mon nom; Ils sanctifieront le Saint de Jacob, Et ils craindront le Dieu d''Israël;
verses.am: ነገር ግን የእጄን ሥራ ልጆቹን በመካከሉ ባያቸው ጊዜ ስሜን ይቀድሳሉ፤ የያዕቆብንም ቅዱስ ይቀድሳሉ፥ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ ይፈራሉ።

verses.en: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
verses.fr: Ceux dont l''esprit s''égarait acquerront de l''intelligence, Et ceux qui murmuraient recevront instruction.
verses.am: በመንፈስም የሳቱ ማስተዋልን ያውቃሉ፥ የሚያጕረመርሙም ትምህርትን ይቀበላሉ።

verses.en: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
verses.fr: Malheur, dit l''Eternel, aux enfants rebelles, Qui prennent des résolutions sans moi, Et qui font des alliances sans ma volonté, Pour accumuler péché sur péché!
verses.am: ለዓመፀኞች ልጆች ወዮላቸው! ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከእኔ ዘንድ ያልሆነን ምክር ይመክራሉ፥ ኃጢአትንም በኃጢአት ላይ ይጨምሩ ዘንድ ከመንፈሴ ዘንድ ያልሆነውን ቃል ኪዳን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
verses.fr: Qui descendent en Egypte sans me consulter, Pour se réfugier sous la protection de Pharaon, Et chercher un abri sous l''ombre de l''Egypte!
verses.am: ከአፌም ነገርን ሳይጠይቁ በፈርዖን ኃይል ይጸኑ ዘንድ በግብጽም ጥላ ይታመኑ ዘንድ ወደ ግብጽ እንዲወርዱ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
verses.fr: La protection de Pharaon sera pour vous une honte, Et l''abri sous l''ombre de l''Egypte une ignominie.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የፈርዖን ኃይል እፍረት በግብጽም ጥላ መታመን ስድብ ይሆንባችኋል።

verses.en: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
verses.fr: Déjà ses princes sont à Tsoan, Et ses envoyés ont atteint Hanès.
verses.am: አለቆች ምንም በጣኔዎስ ቢሆኑ፥ መልክተኞችም ምንም ወደ ሓኔስ ቢደርሱ፥

verses.en: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
verses.fr: Tous seront confus au sujet d''un peuple qui ne leur sera point utile, Ni pour les secourir, ni pour les aider, Mais qui fera leur honte et leur opprobre.
verses.am: ሁላቸው ይጠቅሙአቸው ዘንድ ስለማይችሉ፥ እፍረትና ስድብ እንጂ ረድኤትና ረብ ስለማይሆኑ ሕዝብ ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.
verses.fr: Sentence des bêtes du midi: A travers une contrée de détresse et d''angoisse, D''où viennent la lionne et le lion, La vipère et le dragon volant, Ils portent à dos d''ânes leurs richesses, Et sur la bosse des chameaux leurs trésors, A un peuple qui ne leur sera point utile.
verses.am: በደቡብ ስላሉ እንስሶች የተነገረ ሸክም። ተባትና እንስት አንበሳ እፉኝትም ነዘር እባብም በሚወጡባት በመከራና በጭንቀት ምድር በኩል ብልጥግናቸውን በአህዮች ጫንቃ ላይ መዛግብቶቻቸውንም በግመሎች ሻኛ ላይ እየጫኑ ወደማይጠቅሙአቸው ሕዝብ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.
verses.fr: Car le secours de l''Egypte n''est que vanité et néant; C''est pourquoi j''appelle cela du bruit qui n''aboutit à rien.
verses.am: የግብጽ እርዳታ ከንቱና ምናምን ነው፤ ስለዚህ ስሙን። በቤት የሚቀመጥ ረዓብ ብዬ ጠርቼዋለሁ።

verses.en: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:
verses.fr: Va maintenant, écris ces choses devant eux sur une table, Et grave-les dans un livre, Afin qu''elles subsistent dans les temps à venir, Eternellement et à perpétuité.
verses.am: አሁንም ሂድ፥ ለሚመጣውም ዘመን ለዘላለም እንዲሆን በሰሌዳ ላይ በመጽሐፍም ውስጥ ጻፍላቸው።

verses.en: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the Lord:
verses.fr: Car c''est un peuple rebelle, Ce sont des enfants menteurs, Des enfants qui ne veulent point écouter la loi de l''Eternel,
verses.am: ዓመፀኛ ወገንና የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ለመስማት የማይወድዱ የሐሰት ልጆች ናቸውና፤

verses.en: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
verses.fr: Qui disent aux voyants: Ne voyez pas! Et aux prophètes: Ne nous prophétisez pas des vérités, Dites-nous des choses flatteuses, Prophétisez des chimères!
verses.am: ባለ ራእዮችን። አትመልከቱ ይላሉ፥ ነቢያትንም። ጣፋጩንና አታላዩን ነገር እንጂ ቅኑን ነገር አትንገሩን ከመንገድ ፈቀቅ በሉ፥

verses.en: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.
verses.fr: Détournez-vous du chemin, Ecartez-vous du sentier, Eloignez de notre présence le Saint d''Israël!
verses.am: ከጐዳናውም ዘወር በሉ፥ የእስራኤልንም ቅዱስ ከእኛ ዘንድ አስወግዱ ይሉአቸዋል።

verses.en: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Saint d''Israël: Puisque vous rejetez cette parole, Que vous vous confiez dans la violence et dans les détours Et que vous les prenez pour appuis,
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ እንዲህ ይላል። ይህችን ቃል አቃልላችኋልና፥ በግፍና በጠማምነት ታምናችኋልና፥ በእርሱም ተደግፋችኋልና

verses.en: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.
verses.fr: Ce crime sera pour vous Comme une partie crevassée qui menace ruine Et fait saillie dans un mur élevé, Dont l''écroulement arrive tout à coup, en un instant:
verses.am: ስለዚህ ይህ በደል አዘብዝቦ ለመፍረስ እንደ ቀረበ፥ አፈራረሱም ፈጥኖ ድንገት እንደሚመጣ እንደ ረጅም ቅጥር ይሆንባችኋል።

verses.en: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.
verses.fr: Il se brise comme se brise un vase de terre, Que l''on casse sans ménagement, Et dont les débris ne laissent pas un morceau Pour prendre du feu au foyer, Ou pour puiser de l''eau à la citerne.
verses.am: የሸክለኛ ማድጋ እንደሚሰበር ይሰብረዋል፥ ሳይራራም ያደቅቀዋል፤ ከስባሪውም እሳት ከማንደጃ የሚወስዱበት ወይም ውኃ ከጕድጓድ የሚቀዱበት ገል አይገኝም።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
verses.fr: Car ainsi a parlé le Seigneur, l''Eternel, le Saint d''Israël: C''est dans la tranquillité et le repos que sera votre salut, C''est dans le calme et la confiance que sera votre force. Mais vous ne l''avez pas voulu!
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቅዱስ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በመመለስና በማረፍ ትድናላችሁ፤ በጸጥታና በመታመን ኃይል ይሆንላችኋል፤ እናንተም እንቢ አላችሁ፥

verses.en: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
verses.fr: Vous avez dit: Non! nous prendrons la course à cheval! -C''est pourquoi vous fuirez à la course. -Nous monterons des coursiers légers! -C''est pourquoi ceux qui vous poursuivront seront légers.
verses.am: ነገር ግን። በፈረስ ላይ ትቀምጠን እንሸሻለን እንጂ እንዲህ አይሆንም አላችሁ፥ ስለዚህም ትሸሻላችሁ፤ ደግሞም። በፈጣን ፈረስ ላይ እንቀመጣለን አላችሁ፥ ስለዚህም የሚያሳድዱአችሁ ፈጣኖች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.
verses.fr: Mille fuiront à la menace d''un seul, Et, à la menace de cinq, vous fuirez, Jusqu''à ce que vous restiez Comme un signal au sommet de la montagne, Comme un étendard sur la colline.
verses.am: ከአንድ ሰው ዛቻ የተነሣ ሺህ ሰዎች ይሸሻሉ፤ እናንተም በተራራ ራስ ላይ እንዳለ ምሰሶ፥ በኮረብታም ላይ እንዳለ ምልክት ሆናችሁ እስክትቀሩ ድረስ፥ ከአምስት ሰዎች ዛቻ የተነሣ ትሸሻላችሁ።

verses.en: And therefore will the Lord wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the Lord is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
verses.fr: Cependant l''Eternel désire vous faire grâce, Et il se lèvera pour vous faire miséricorde; Car l''Eternel est un Dieu juste: Heureux tous ceux qui espèrent en lui!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የፍርድ አምላክ ነውና ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ይራራላችሁ ዘንድ ይታገሣል፥ ይምራችሁም ዘንድ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፤ እርሱን በመተማመን የሚጠባበቁ ሁሉ ብፁዓን ናቸው።

verses.en: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.
verses.fr: Oui, peuple de Sion, habitant de Jérusalem, Tu ne pleureras plus! Il te fera grâce, quand tu crieras; Dès qu''il aura entendu, il t''exaucera.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ በጽዮን የምትኖሩ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አታለቅስም፤ በጩኸትም ድምፅ ይራራልሃል፥ በሰማህም ጊዜ ይመልስልሃል።

verses.en: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:
verses.fr: Le Seigneur vous donnera du pain dans l''angoisse, Et de l''eau dans la détresse; Ceux qui t''instruisent ne se cacheront plus, Mais tes yeux verront ceux qui t''instruisent.
verses.am: ጌታም የጭንቀትን እንጀራና የመከራን ውኃ ቢሰጥህም አስተማሪህ እንግዲህ ከአንተ አይሰወርም፤ ዓይኖችህ ግን አስተማሪህን ያያሉ፥

verses.en: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
verses.fr: Tes oreilles entendront derrière toi la voix qui dira: Voici le chemin, marchez-y! Car vous iriez à droite, ou vous iriez à gauche.
verses.am: ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም ፈቀቅ ብትል ጆሮችህ በኋላህ። መንገዱ ይህች ናት በእርስዋም ሂድ የሚለውን ቃል ይሰማሉ።

verses.en: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.
verses.fr: Vous tiendrez pour souillés l''argent qui recouvre vos idoles, Et l''or dont elles sont revêtues; Tu en disperseras les débris comme une impureté: Hors d''ici! leur diras-tu.
verses.am: በብርም የተለበጡትን የተቀረጹትን ምስሎችህን በወርቅም የተለበጡትን ቀልጠው የተሠሩትን ምስሎችህን ታረክሳለህ፤ እንደ ርኩስም ነገር ትጥላቸዋለህ። ወግዱ ትላቸውማለህ።

verses.en: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.
verses.fr: Alors il répandra la pluie sur la semence que tu auras mise en terre, Et le pain que produira la terre sera savoureux et nourrissant; En ce même temps, tes troupeaux paîtront dans de vastes pâturages.
verses.am: በምድርም ለተዘራው ዘርህ ዝናብ ይሰጣል፥ ከምድርም ፍሬ የሚወጣ እንጀራ ወፍራምና ብዙ ይሆናል። በዚያም ቀን ከብቶችህ በሰፊ መስክ ይሰማራሉ፤

verses.en: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.
verses.fr: Les boeufs et les ânes, qui labourent la terre, Mangeront un fourrage salé, Qu''on aura vanné avec la pelle et le van.
verses.am: መሬትንም የሚያርሱ በሬዎችና አህዮች በመንሽና በወንፊት የነጻውን ጨው ጨው የሚለውን ገፈራ ይበላሉ።

verses.en: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
verses.fr: Sur toute haute montagne et sur toute colline élevée, Il y aura des ruisseaux, des courants d''eau, Au jour du grand carnage, A la chute des tours.
verses.am: በታላቅም እልቂት ቀን ግንቦች በወደቁ ጊዜ በረጅሙ ተራራ ሁሉ ከፍ ባለውም ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ ወንዞችና የውኃ ፈሳሾች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the Lord bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
verses.fr: La lumière de la lune sera comme la lumière du soleil, Et la lumière du soleil sera sept fois plus grande Comme la lumière de sept jours, Lorsque l''Eternel bandera la blessure de son peuple, Et qu''il guérira la plaie de ses coups.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የሕዝቡን ስብራት በጠገነ ዕለት፥ መቅሰፍቱ የቈሰለውንም በፈወሰ ዕለት፥ የጨረቃ ብርሃን እንደ ፀሐይ ብርሃን፥ የፀሐይም ብርሃን እንደ ሰባት ቀን ብርሃን ሰባት እጥፍ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Behold, the name of the Lord cometh from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:
verses.fr: Voici, le nom de l''Eternel vient de loin; Sa colère est ardente, c''est un violent incendie; Ses lèvres sont pleines de fureur, Et sa langue est comme un feu dévorant;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ስም ከሚነድድ ቍጣ ከሚትጐለጐልም ጢስ ጋር ከሩቅ ይመጣል፤ ከንፈሮቹም ቍጣን የሞሉ ናቸው፥ ምላሱም እንደምትበላ እሳት ናት፤

verses.en: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.
verses.fr: Son souffle est comme un torrent débordé qui atteint jusqu''au cou, Pour cribler les nations avec le crible de la destruction, Et comme un mors trompeur Entre les mâchoires des peuples.
verses.am: እስትንፋሱም አሕዛብን በአጥፊ ወንፊት ሊነፋቸው እንደሚያጥለቀልቅ እስከ አንገትም እንደሚደርስ ወንዝ ነው፥ በሕዝብም መንጋጋ የሚያስት ልጓም ይሆናል።

verses.en: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the Lord, to the mighty One of Israel.
verses.fr: Vous chanterez comme la nuit où l''on célèbre la fête, Vous aurez le coeur joyeux comme celui qui marche au son de la flûte, Pour aller à la montagne de l''Eternel, vers le rocher d''Israël.
verses.am: ዝማሬ በተቀደሰች የዐውደ ዓመት ሌሊት እንደሚሆን ዝማሬ ይሆንላችኋል፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ተራራ ወደ እስራኤል አምባ ይመጣ ዘንድ እንቢልታ ይዞ እንደሚሄድ ሰው የልብ ደስታ ይሆንላችኋል።

verses.en: And the Lord shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel fera retentir sa voix majestueuse, Il montrera son bras prêt à frapper, Dans l''ardeur de sa colère, Au milieu de la flamme d''un feu dévorant, De l''inondation, de la tempête et des pierres de grêle.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ክቡር ድምፁን ያሰማል፥ የክንዱንም መውረድ በሚነድድ ቍጣውና በምትበላ እሳት ነበልባል በዐውሎ ነፋስም በወጨፎም በበረዶ ጠጠርም ይገልጣል።

verses.en: For through the voice of the Lord shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.
verses.fr: A la voix de l''Eternel, l''Assyrien tremblera; L''Eternel le frappera de sa verge.
verses.am: አሦርም በበትር ከመታው ከእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ የተነሣ ይደነግጣል።

verses.en: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the Lord shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
verses.fr: A chaque coup de la verge qui lui est destinée, Et que l''Eternel fera tomber sur lui, On entendra les tambourins et les harpes; L''Eternel combattra contre lui à main levée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በላዩ በሚያወርድበት የታዘዘበቱ የበትር ድብደባ ሁሉ በከበሮና በመሰንቆ ይሆናል፤ በጦርነትም ክንዱን አንሥቶ ይዋጋቸዋል።

verses.en: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the Lord, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.
verses.fr: Depuis longtemps un bûcher est préparé, Il est préparé pour le roi, Il est profond, il est vaste; Son bûcher, c''est du feu et du bois en abondance; Le souffle de l''Eternel l''enflamme, comme un torrent de soufre.
verses.am: ከቀድሞም ጀምሮ የማቃጠያ ስፍራ ተዘጋጅታለች፥ ለንጉሥም ተበጅታለች፤ ጥልቅና ሰፊም አድርጎአታል፤ እሳትና ብዙ ማገዶ ተከምሮአል፤ የእግዚአብሔርም እስትንፋስ እንደ ዲን ፈሳሽ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui descendent en Egypte pour avoir du secours, Qui s''appuient sur des chevaux, Et se fient à la multitude des chars et à la force des cavaliers, Mais qui ne regardent pas vers le Saint d''Israël, Et ne recherchent pas l''Eternel!
verses.am: ስለ እርዳታ ወደ ግብጽ ለሚወርዱ በፈረሶችም ለሚደገፉ፥ ስለ ብዛታቸውም በሰረገሎች፥ እጅግ ብርቱዎችም ስለ ሆኑ በፈረሰኞች ለሚታመኑ፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ቅዱስ ለማይመለከቱ እግዚአብሔርንም ለማይፈልጉ ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
verses.fr: Lui aussi, cependant, il est sage, il fait venir le malheur, Et ne retire point ses paroles; Il s''élève contre la maison des méchants, Et contre le secours de ceux qui commettent l''iniquité.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ደግሞ ጠቢብ ነው፥ ክፉንም ነገር ያመጣል፥ ቃሉንም አይመልስም፥ በክፉም አድራጊዎች ቤት ላይ በደልንም በሚሠሩ ረዳት ላይ ይነሣል።

verses.en: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the Lord shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
verses.fr: L''Egyptien est homme et non dieu; Ses chevaux sont chair et non esprit. Quand l''Eternel étendra sa main, Le protecteur chancellera, le protégé tombera, Et tous ensemble ils périront.
verses.am: ግብጻውያን ሰዎች እንጂ አምላክ አይደሉም፥ ፈረሶቻቸውም ሥጋ እንጂ መንፈስ አይደሉም፤ እግዚአብሔርም እጁን በዘረጋ ጊዜ፥ ረጂው ይሰናከላል ተረጂውም ይወድቃል፥ ሁሉም በአንድ ላይ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: For thus hath the Lord spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
verses.fr: Car ainsi m''a parlé l''Eternel: Comme le lion, comme le lionceau rugit sur sa proie, Et, malgré tous les bergers rassemblés contre lui, Ne se laisse ni effrayer par leur voix, Ni intimider par leur nombre; De même l''Eternel des armées descendra Pour combattre sur la montagne de Sion et sur sa colline.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይለኛልና። አንበሳ ወይም የአንበሳ ደቦል በንጥቂያው ላይ ሲያገሳ፥ ብዙ እረኞች ቢከማቹበት ከቃላቸው እንደማይፈራ ከድምፃቸውም እንደማይዋረድ፥ እንዲሁ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ተራራና በኮረብታዋ ላይ ይዋጋ ዘንድ ይወርዳል።

verses.en: As birds flying, so will the Lord of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.
verses.fr: Comme des oiseaux déploient les ailes sur leur couvée, Ainsi l''Eternel des armées étendra sa protection sur Jérusalem; Il protégera et délivrera, Il épargnera et sauvera.
verses.am: እንደሚበርር ወፍ እንዲሁ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ይጋርዳታል፤ ይከልላታል፥ ይታደጋታል፥ አልፎም ያድናታል።

verses.en: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
verses.fr: Revenez à celui dont on s''est profondément détourné, Enfants d''Israël!
verses.am: እናንተ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ አጥብቃችሁ ወደ ዐመፃችሁበት ተመለሱ።

verses.en: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
