verses.fr: En ce jour, chacun rejettera ses idoles d''argent et ses idoles d''or, Que vous vous êtes fabriquées de vos mains criminelles.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እያንዳንዳቸው እጆቻቸው ለኃጢአት የሠሩላቸውን የብሩንና የወርቁን ጣዖቶቻቸውን ይጥላሉ።

verses.en: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
verses.fr: Et l''Assyrien tombera sous un glaive qui n''est pas celui d''un homme, Et un glaive qui n''est pas celui d''un homme le dévorera; Il s''enfuira devant le glaive, Et ses jeunes guerriers seront asservis.
verses.am: አሦርም የሰው ባልሆነ ሰይፍ ይወድቃል፥ የሰውም ያልሆነ ሰይፍ ይበላዋል፤ ከሰይፍም ይሸሻሉ ጐበዛዝቱም ገባሮች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the Lord, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Son rocher s''enfuira d''épouvante, Et ses chefs trembleront devant la bannière, Dit l''Eternel, qui a son feu dans Sion Et sa fournaise dans Jérusalem.
verses.am: አምባው ከፍርሃት የተነሣ ያልፋል መሳፍንቱም ከዓላማው የተነሣ ይደነግጣሉ፥ ይላል እሳቱ በጽዮን እቶኑም በኢየሩሳሌም የሆነ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
verses.fr: Alors le roi régnera selon la justice, Et les princes gouverneront avec droiture.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ንጉሥ በጽድቅ ይነግሣል፥ መሳፍንትም በፍርድ ይገዛሉ።

verses.en: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
verses.fr: Chacun sera comme un abri contre le vent, Et un refuge contre la tempête, Comme des courants d''eau dans un lieu desséché, Comme l''ombre d''un grand rocher dans une terre altérée.
verses.am: ሰውም ከነፋስ እንደ መሸሸጊያ ከዐውሎ ነፋስም እንደ መጠጊያ፥ በጥም ቦታም እንደ ወንዝ ፈሳሽ፥ በበረሃም አገር እንደ ትልቅ ድንጋይ ጥላ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
verses.fr: Les yeux de ceux qui voient ne seront plus bouchés, Et les oreilles de ceux qui entendent seront attentives.
verses.am: የሚያዩትም ሰዎች ዓይኖች አይጨፈኑም፥ የሚሰሙትም ጆሮች ያደምጣሉ።

verses.en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
verses.fr: Le coeur des hommes légers sera intelligent pour comprendre, Et la langue de ceux qui balbutient parlera vite et nettement.
verses.am: ጥንቃቄ የሌላቸው ሰዎች ልብ እውቀትን ታስተውላለች፥ የተብታቦችም ምላስ ደኅና አድርጋ ትናገራለች።

verses.en: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
verses.fr: On ne donnera plus à l''insensé le nom de noble, Ni au fourbe celui de magnanime.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ሰነፍ ከበርቴ ተብሎ አይጠራም፥ ንፉግም ለጋስ አይባልም።

verses.en: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the Lord, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.fr: Car l''insensé profère des folies, Et son coeur s''adonne au mal, Pour commettre l''impiété, Et dire des faussetés contre l''Eternel, Pour laisser à vide l''âme de celui qui a faim, Et enlever le breuvage de celui qui a soif.
verses.am: ሰነፍ ግን ስንፍናን ይናገራል፥ ልቡም ዝንጉነትን ይፈጽም ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔርም ላይ ስሕተትን ይናገር ዘንድ የተራበችውንም ሰውነት ባዶ ያደርግ ዘንድ ከተጠማም ሰው መጠጥን ይቈርጥ ዘንድ በደልን ይሠራል።

verses.en: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
verses.fr: Les armes du fourbe sont pernicieuses; Il forme de coupables desseins, Pour perdre les malheureux par des paroles mensongères, Même quand la cause du pauvre est juste.
verses.am: የንፉግም ዕቃ ክፉ ናት፤ ችግረኛ ቅን ነገርን በተናገረ ጊዜ እንኳ እርሱ በሐሰት ቃል ድሀውን ያጠፋ ዘንድ ክፉን አሳብ ያስባል።

verses.en: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
verses.fr: Mais celui qui est noble forme de nobles desseins, Et il persévère dans ses nobles desseins.
verses.am: ከበርቴ ሰው ግን ለመከበር ያስባል፥ በመከበርም ጸንቶ ይኖራል።

verses.en: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
verses.fr: Femmes insouciantes, Levez-vous, écoutez ma voix! Filles indolentes, Prêtez l''oreille à ma parole!
verses.am: እናንተ ዓለመኞች ሴቶች ሆይ፥ ተነሡ ድምፄንም ስሙ፤ እናንተ ተማምናችሁ የምትቀመጡ ሴቶች ልጆች ሆይ፥ ንግግሬን አድምጡ።

verses.en: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
verses.fr: Dans un an et quelques jours, Vous tremblerez, indolentes; Car c''en est fait de la vendange, La récolte n''arrivera pas.
verses.am: እናንተ ተማምናችሁ የምትቀመጡ ሴቶች ሆይ፥ ወይንን መቍረጥ ይጠፋልና፥ ፍሬም ማከማቸት አይመጣምና ከዓመትና ከጥቂት ቀን በኋላ ትንቀጠቀጣላችሁ።

verses.en: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
verses.fr: Soyez dans l''effroi, insouciantes! Tremblez, indolentes! Déshabillez-vous, mettez-vous à nu Et ceignez vos reins!
verses.am: እናንተ ዓለመኞች ሴቶች ሆይ፥ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ተማምናችሁም የምትቀመጡ ሆይ፥ ተንቀጥቀጡ፤ ልብሳችሁን አውልቁ፥ ዕራቁታችሁን ሁኑ፥ ወገባችሁንም በማቅ ታጠቁ።

verses.en: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.fr: On se frappe le sein, Au souvenir de la beauté des champs Et de la fécondité des vignes.
verses.am: ስለ ተወደደችውም እርሻ ስለሚያፈራውም ወይን ደረታችሁን ድቁ።

verses.en: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
verses.fr: Sur la terre de mon peuple Croissent les épines et les ronces, Même dans toutes les maisons de plaisance De la cité joyeuse.
verses.am: በሕዝቤ ምድር ላይ፥ በደስታ ከተማ ባሉት በደስታ ቤቶች ሁሉ ላይ እሾህና ኵርንችት ይወጣባቸዋል፤

verses.en: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
verses.fr: Le palais est abandonné, La ville bruyante est délaissée; La colline et la tour serviront à jamais de cavernes; Les ânes sauvages y joueront, les troupeaux y paîtront,
verses.am: አዳራሹ ወና ትሆናለችና፥ የብዙ ሰውም ከተማ ትለቀቃለችና፥ አምባውና ግንቡም ለዘላለም ዋሻ፥ የምድረ በዳም አህያ ደስታ፥ የመንጎችም ማሰማርያ ይሆናልና።

verses.en: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à ce que l''esprit soit répandu d''en haut sur nous, Et que le désert se change en verger, Et que le verger soit considéré comme une forêt.
verses.am: ይህም፥ መንፈስ ከላይ እስኪፈስስልን፥ ምድረ በዳውም ፍሬያማ እርሻ እስኪሆን፥ ፍሬያማውም እርሻ ዱር ተብሎ እስኪቈጠር ድረስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
verses.fr: Alors la droiture habitera dans le désert, Et la justice aura sa demeure dans le verger.
verses.am: ከዚያ በኋላ ፍርድ በምድረ በዳ ይኖራል፥ ጽድቅም በፍሬያማው እርሻ ያድራል።

verses.en: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
verses.fr: L''oeuvre de la justice sera la paix, Et le fruit de la justice le repos et la sécurité pour toujours.
verses.am: የጽድቅም ሥራ ሰላም፥ የጽድቅም ፍሬ ለዘላለም ጸጥታና መታመን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
verses.fr: Mon peuple demeurera dans le séjour de la paix, Dans des habitations sûres, Dans des asiles tranquilles.
verses.am: ሕዝቤም በሰላም ማደሪያ በታመነም ቤት በጸጥተኛ ማረፊያ ይቀመጣል።

verses.en: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
verses.fr: Mais la forêt sera précipitée sous la grêle, Et la ville profondément abaissée.
verses.am: በረዶ ግን በዱር ላይ ይወርዳል፥ ከተማም ፈጽማ ትዋረዳለች።

verses.en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
verses.fr: Heureux vous qui partout semez le long des eaux, Et qui laissez sans entraves le pied du boeuf et de l''âne!
verses.am: እናንተ የበሬና የአህያ እግር እየነዳችሁ በውኃ ሁሉ አጠገብ የምትዘሩ ብፁዓን ናችሁ።

verses.en: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
verses.fr: Malheur à toi qui ravages, et qui n''as pas été ravagé! Qui pilles, et qu''on n''a pas encore pillé! Quand tu auras fini de ravager, tu seras ravagé; Quand tu auras achevé de piller, on te pillera.
verses.am: አንተ ሳትጠፋ የምታጠፋ፥ በአንተም ላይ ወንጀል ሳይደረግ ወንጀል የምታደርግ ወዮልህ! ማጥፋትን በተውህ ጊዜ ትጠፋለህ፤ መወንጀልንም በተውህ ጊዜ ይወነጅሉሃል።

verses.en: O Lord, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.fr: Eternel, aie pitié de nous! Nous espérons en toi. Sois notre aide chaque matin, Et notre délivrance au temps de la détresse!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ማረን፤ አንተን ተማምነናል፤ ጥዋት ጥዋት ክንድ በመከራም ጊዜ ማዳን ሁነን።

verses.en: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
verses.fr: Quand ta voix retentit, Les peuples fuient; Quand tu te lèves, Les nations se dispersent.
verses.am: ከፍጅት ድምፅ ወገኖች ሸሹ፥ በመነሣትህም አሕዛብ ተበተኑ።

verses.en: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
verses.fr: On moissonne votre butin, Comme moissonne la sauterelle; On se précipite dessus, Comme se précipitent les sauterelles.
verses.am: አንበጣ እንደሚሰበስብ ምርኮአችሁ ትሰበሰባለች፥ ኩብኩባም እንደሚዘልል ሰዎች ይዘልሉበታል።

verses.en: The Lord is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est élevé, Car il habite en haut; Il remplit Sion De droiture et de justice.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአርያም ተቀምጦአልና ከፍ ከፍ አለ፤ ጽዮንን በፍርድና በጽድቅ ሞላት።

verses.en: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the Lord is his treasure.
verses.fr: Tes jours seront en sûreté; La sagesse et l''intelligence sont une source de salut; La crainte de l''Eternel, C''est là le trésor de Sion.
verses.am: የዘመንህም ጸጥታ፥ የመድኃኒት ብዛት፥ ጥበብና እውቀት ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት መዝገቡ ነው።

verses.en: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
verses.fr: Voici, les héros Poussent des cris au dehors; Les messagers de paix Pleurent amèrement.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ኃይለኞቻቸው በሜዳ ይጮኻሉ፤ የሰላም መልእክተኞች መራራ ልቅሶ ያለቅሳሉ።

verses.en: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
verses.fr: Les routes sont désertes; On ne passe plus dans les chemins. Il a rompu l''alliance, il méprise les villes, Il n''a de respect pour personne.
verses.am: መንገዶች ባድማ ሆኑ፥ ተላላፊም ቀረ፤ እርሱም ቃል ኪዳንን አፈረሰ ከተሞችንም ናቀ ሰውንም አልተመለከተም።

verses.en: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
verses.fr: Le pays est dans le deuil, dans la tristesse; Le Liban est confus, languissant; Le Saron est comme un désert; Le Basan et le Carmel secouent leur feuillage.
verses.am: ምድሪቱ አለቀሰች ከሳችም፤ ሊባኖስ አፈረ ጠወለገም፤ ሳሮን እንደ ምድረ በዳ ሆነ፤ ባሳንና ቀርሜሎስ ቅጠላቸውን አረገፉ።

verses.en: Now will I rise, saith the Lord; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
verses.fr: Maintenant je me lèverai, Dit l''Eternel, Maintenant je serai exalté, Maintenant je serai élevé.
verses.am: አሁን እነሣለሁ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አሁን እከበራለሁ፤ አሁን ከፍ ከፍ እላለሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
verses.fr: Vous avez conçu du foin, Vous enfanterez de la paille; Votre souffle, C''est un feu qui vous consumera.
verses.am: ገለባን ትፀንሳላችሁ፥ እብቅንም ትወልዳላችሁ፤ እስትንፋሳችሁ የምትበላችሁ እሳት ናት።

verses.en: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
verses.fr: Les peuples seront Des fournaises de chaux, Des épines coupées Qui brûlent dans le feu.
verses.am: አሕዛብም እንደ ተቃጠለ ኖራ፥ ተቈርጦም በእሳት እንደ ተቃጠለ እሾህ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
verses.fr: Vous qui êtes loin, écoutez ce que j''ai fait! Et vous qui êtes près, sachez quelle est ma puissance!
verses.am: እናንተ በሩቅ ያላችሁ የሠራሁትን ስሙ፥ እናንተም በቅርብ ያላችሁ ኃይሌን እወቁ።

verses.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
verses.fr: Les pécheurs sont effrayés dans Sion, Un tremblement saisit les impies: Qui de nous pourra rester auprès d''un feu dévorant? Qui de nous pourra rester auprès de flammes éternelles? -
verses.am: በጽዮን ያሉ ኃጢአተኞች ፈሩ፤ መንቀጥቀጥ ዝንጉዎቹን ያዘ፤ ከምትበላ እሳት ጋር መኖርን የሚችል ከእኛ ማን አለ? ለዘላለምም ከምትነድድ እሳት ጋር መኖርን የሚችል ከእኛ ማን አለ?

verses.en: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
verses.fr: Celui qui marche dans la justice, Et qui parle selon la droiture, Qui méprise un gain acquis par extorsion, Qui secoue les mains pour ne pas accepter un présent, Qui ferme l''oreille pour ne pas entendre des propos sanguinaires, Et qui se bande les yeux pour ne pas voir le mal,
verses.am: በጽድቅ የሚሄድ ቅን ነገርንም የሚናገር፥ በሽንገላ የሚገኝ ትርፍን የሚንቅ፥ መማለጃን ከመጨበጥ እጁን የሚያራግፍ፥ ደም ማፍሰስን ከመስማት ጆሮቹን የሚያደነቍር፥ ክፋትንም ከማየት ዓይኖቹን የሚጨፍን ነው።

verses.en: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
verses.fr: Celui-là habitera dans des lieux élevés; Des rochers fortifiés seront sa retraite; Du pain lui sera donné, De l''eau lui sera assurée.
verses.am: እርሱ ከፍ ባለ ስፍራ ይቀመጣል፤ ጠንካራ አምባ መጠጊያው ይሆናል፤ እንጀራም ይሰጠዋል፥ ውኃውም የታመነች ትሆናለች።

verses.en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
verses.fr: Tes yeux verront le roi dans sa magnificence, Ils contempleront le pays dans toute son étendue.
verses.am: ዓይኖችህ ንጉሥን በውበቱ ያዩታል፤ እነርሱም በሩቅ ያለች ምድርን ያዩአታል።

verses.en: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
verses.fr: Ton coeur se souviendra de la terreur: Où est le secrétaire, où est le trésorier? Où est celui qui inspectait les tours?
verses.am: ልብህም። ጸሐፊ ወዴት አለ? መዛኝስ ወዴት አለ? ግንቦቹንስ የቈጠረ ወዴት አለ? ብሎ የሚያስፈራ ነገር ያስባል።

verses.en: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
verses.fr: Tu ne verras plus le peuple audacieux, Le peuple au langage obscur qu''on n''entend pas, A la langue barbare qu''on ne comprend pas.
verses.am: ጨካኝን ሕዝብ፥ ቋንቋው ለማስተዋል ጥልቅ የሆነውንና አንደበቱ ለማስተዋል ጸያፍ የሆነውን ሕዝብ፥ አታይም።

verses.en: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
verses.fr: Regarde Sion, la cité de nos fêtes! Tes yeux verront Jérusalem, séjour tranquille, Tente qui ne sera plus transportée, Dont les pieux ne seront jamais enlevés, Et dont les cordages ne seront point détachés.
verses.am: የበዓላችንን ከተማ ጽዮንን ተመልከት፤ ዓይኖችህ የሰላም ማደሪያ፥ ካስማውም ለዘላለም የማይነቀል አውታሩም ሁሉ የማይበጠስ፥ የማይወገድ ድንኳን የሆነውን ኢየሩሳሌምን ያያሉ።

verses.en: But there the glorious Lord will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
verses.fr: C''est là vraiment que l''Eternel est magnifique pour nous: Il nous tient lieu de fleuves, de vastes rivières, Où ne pénètrent point de navires à rames, Et que ne traverse aucun grand vaisseau.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በዚያ የሰፉ ወንዞችና የመስኖች ስፍራ ሆኖ ከእኛ ጋር በግርማ ይሆናል፤ የሚቀዘፉ መርከቦች አይገቡባትም፥ ታላላቆችም መርከቦች አያልፉባትም።

verses.en: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; he will save us.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel est notre juge, L''Eternel est notre législateur, L''Eternel est notre roi: C''est lui qui nous sauve.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ፈራጃችን ነው፥ እግዚአብሔር ሕግን ሰጪያችን ነው፥ እግዚአብሔር ንጉሣችን ነው፤ እርሱ ያድነናል።

verses.en: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
verses.fr: Tes cordages sont relâchés; Ils ne serrent plus le pied du mât et ne tendent plus les voiles. Alors on partage la dépouille d''un immense butin; Les boiteux même prennent part au pillage:
verses.am: ገመዶችህ ላልተዋል፥ ደቀላቸውንም አላጸኑም፥ ሸራውንም መዘርጋት አልቻሉም። በዚያም ጊዜ የብዙ ምርኮ ብዝበዛ ተከፈለ፤ አንካሶች እንኳ ብዝበዛውን በዘበዙ።

verses.en: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.fr: Aucun habitant ne dit: Je suis malade! Le peuple de Jérusalem reçoit le pardon de ses iniquités.
verses.am: በዚያም የሚቀመጥ። ታምሜአለሁ አይልም፥ በእርስዋም ለሚቀመጡ ሰዎች በደላቸው ይቅር ይባልላቸዋል።

verses.en: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
verses.fr: Approchez, nations, pour entendre! Peuples, soyez attentifs! Que la terre écoute, elle et ce qui la remplit, Le monde et tout ce qu''il produit!
verses.am: እናንተ አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ ቅረቡ፥ ስሙ፤ እናንተ ወገኖች ሆይ፥ አድምጡ፤ ምድርና ሙላዋ፥ ዓለምና ከእርስዋ የሚወጣ ሁሉ ይስሙ።

verses.en: For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
verses.fr: Car la colère de l''Eternel va fondre sur toutes les nations, Et sa fureur sur toute leur armée: Il les voue à l''extermination, Il les livre au carnage.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ መዓቱም በሠራዊታቸው ሁሉ ላይ ነው፤ ፈጽሞ አጠፋቸው፥ ለመታረድም አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
verses.fr: Leurs morts sont jetés, Leurs cadavres exhalent la puanteur, Et les montagnes se fondent dans leur sang.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የተገደሉት ይጣላሉ፥ የሬሳቸውም ግማት ይሸታል፥ ተራሮችም ከደማቸው የተነሣ ይርሳሉ።

verses.en: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
verses.fr: Toute l''armée des cieux se dissout; Les cieux sont roulés comme un livre, Et toute leur armée tombe, Comme tombe la feuille de la vigne, Comme tombe celle du figuier.
verses.am: የሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ይበሰብሳሉ፥ ሰማያትም እንደ መጽሐፍ ጥቅልል ይጠቀለላሉ፥ ከወይንና ከበለስም ቅጠል እንደሚረግፍ ሠራዊታቸው ሁሉ ይረግፋል።

verses.en: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
verses.fr: Mon épée s''est enivrée dans les cieux; Voici, elle va descendre sur Edom, Sur le peuple que j''ai voué à l''extermination, pour le châtier.
verses.am: ሰይፌ በሰማይ ሆና እስክትረካ ድረስ ጠጥታለች፤ እነሆ፥ በኤዶምያስና በረገምሁት ሕዝብ ላይ ለፍርድ ትወርዳለች።

verses.en: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
verses.fr: L''épée de l''Eternel est pleine de sang, couverte de graisse, Du sang des agneaux et des boucs, De la graisse des reins des béliers; Car il y a des victimes de l''Eternel à Botsra, Et un grand carnage dans le pays d''Edom,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት በባሶራ፥ ታላቅም እርድ በኤዶምያስ ምድር አለውና የእግዚአብሔር ሰይፍ በደም ተሞልታለች፥ በስብም፥ በበግ ጠቦትና በፍየል ደምም፥ በአውራም በግ ኵላሊት ስብ ወፍራለች።

verses.en: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
verses.fr: Les buffles tombent avec eux, Et les boeufs avec les taureaux; La terre s''abreuve de sang, Et le sol est imprégné de graisse.
verses.am: ጎሽ ከእነርሱ ጋር፥ ወይፈኖችም ከኮርማዎች ጋር ይወድቃሉ፤ ምድራቸውም በደም ትረካለች፥ አፈራቸውም በስብ ትወፍራለች።

verses.en: For it is the day of the Lord's vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
verses.fr: Car c''est un jour de vengeance pour l''Eternel, Une année de représailles pour la cause de Sion.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር የበቀሉ ቀን፥ ስለ ጽዮንም ክርክር የብድራት ዓመት ነው።

verses.en: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
verses.fr: Les torrents d''Edom seront changés en poix, Et sa poussière en soufre; Et sa terre sera comme de la poix qui brûle.
verses.am: የኤዶምያስም ፈሳሾች ዝፍት ሆነው ይለወጣሉ፥ አፈርዋም ዲን ይሆናል፥ መሬትዋም የሚቀጠል ዝፍት ትሆናለች።

verses.en: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Elle ne s''éteindra ni jour ni nuit, La fumée s''en élèvera éternellement; D''âge en âge elle sera désolée, A tout jamais personne n''y passera.
verses.am: በሌሊትና በቀንም አትጠፋም፥ ጢስዋም ለዘላለም ይወጣል፤ ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድም ድረስ ባድማ ሆና ትኖራለች፤ ለዘላለም ዓለም ማንም አያልፍባትም።

verses.en: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
verses.fr: Le pélican et le hérisson la posséderont, La chouette et le corbeau l''habiteront. On y étendra le cordeau de la désolation, Et le niveau de la destruction.
verses.am: ጭልፊትና ጃርት ግን ይወርሱአታል፤ ጕጕትና ቍራም ይኖሩባታል፤ በላይዋም የመፍረስ ገመድና የባዶነት ቱንቢ ይዘረጋባታል።

verses.en: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
verses.fr: Il n''y aura plus de grands pour proclamer un roi, Tous ses princes seront anéantis.
verses.am: መሳፍንቶችዋን ወደ መንግሥት ይጠራሉ፥ ነገር ግን ማንም አይገኝባትም፤ አለቆችዋም ሁሉ ምናምኖች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
verses.fr: Les épines croîtront dans ses palais, Les ronces et les chardons dans ses forteresses. Ce sera la demeure des chacals, Le repaire des autruches;
verses.am: በአዳራሾችዋም እሾህ በቅጥሮችዋም ሳማን አሜከላ ይበቅሉባታል፤ የቀበሮም ማደሪያና የሰጐን ስፍራ ትሆናለች።

verses.en: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
verses.fr: Les animaux du désert y rencontreront les chiens sauvages, Et les boucs s''y appelleront les uns les autres; Là le spectre de la nuit aura sa demeure, Et trouvera son lieu de repos;
verses.am: የምድረ በዳም አራዊት ከተኵሎች ጋር ይገናኛሉ፥ አጋንንትም እርስ በርሳቸው ይጠራራሉ፤ ጅንም በዚያ ትኖራለች ለእርስዋም ማረፊያ ታገኛለች።

verses.en: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
verses.fr: Là le serpent fera son nid, déposera ses oeufs, Les couvera, et recueillera ses petits à son ombre; Là se rassembleront tous les vautours.
verses.am: በዚያም ዋሊያ ቤትዋን ትሠራለች እንቍላልም ትጥላለች ትቀፈቅፈውማለች ልጆችዋንም በጥላዋ ትሰበስባለች፤ በዚያም ደግሞ አሞራዎች እያንዳንዳቸው ከባልንጀሮቻቸው ጋር ይሰበሰባሉ።

verses.en: Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
verses.fr: Consultez le livre de l''Eternel, et lisez! Aucun d''eux ne fera défaut, Ni l''un ni l''autre ne manqueront; Car sa bouche l''a ordonné. C''est son esprit qui les rassemblera.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር መጽሐፍ ፈልጉ አንብቡም፤ አፌ አዝዞአልና፥ መንፈሱም ሰብስቦአቸዋልና ከእነዚህ አንዲት አትጠፋም፥ ባልንጀራውንም የሚያጣ የለም።

verses.en: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
verses.fr: Il a jeté pour eux le sort, Et sa main leur a partagé cette terre au cordeau, Ils la posséderont toujours, Ils l''habiteront d''âge en âge.
verses.am: እርሱም ዕጣ ጣለባቸው፥ እጁም በገመድ ከፈለችላቸው፤ ለዘላለም ይገዙአታል፥ ከትውልድም እስከ ትውልድ ድረስ ይቀመጡባታል።

verses.en: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
verses.fr: Le désert et le pays aride se réjouiront; La solitude s''égaiera, et fleurira comme un narcisse;
verses.am: ምድረ በዳውና ደረቁ ምድር ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ በረሀውም ሐሤት ያደርጋል እንደ ጽጌ ረዳም ያብባል።

verses.en: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the Lord, and the excellency of our God.
verses.fr: Elle se couvrira de fleurs, et tressaillira de joie, Avec chants d''allégresse et cris de triomphe; La gloire du Liban lui sera donnée, La magnificence du Carmel et de Saron. Ils verront la gloire de l''Eternel, la magnificence de notre Dieu.
verses.am: እጅግ ያብባል በደስታና በዝማሬ ሐሤትን ያደርጋል፤ የሊባኖስ ክብር፥ የቀርሜሎስና የሳሮን ግርማ ይሰጠዋል፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ክብር የአምላካችንንም ግርማ ያያሉ።

verses.en: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
verses.fr: Fortifiez les mains languissantes, Et affermissez les genoux qui chancellent;
verses.am: የደከሙትን እጆች አበርቱ፥ የላሉትንም ጕልበቶች አጽኑ።

verses.en: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
verses.fr: Dites à ceux qui ont le coeur troublé: Prenez courage, ne craignez point; Voici votre Dieu, la vengeance viendra, La rétribution de Dieu; Il viendra lui-même, et vous sauvera.
verses.am: ፈሪ ልብ ላላቸው። እነሆ፥ አምላካችሁ በበቀል በእግዚአብሔርም ብድራት ይመጣልና፥ መጥቶም ያድናችኋልና በርቱ፥ አትፍሩ በሉአቸው።

verses.en: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
verses.fr: Alors s''ouvriront les yeux des aveugles, S''ouvriront les oreilles des sourds;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም የዕውሮች ዓይን ይገለጣል፤ የደንቆሮችም ጆሮ ይከፈታል።

verses.en: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
verses.fr: Alors le boiteux sautera comme un cerf, Et la langue du muet éclatera de joie. Car des eaux jailliront dans le désert, Et des ruisseaux dans la solitude;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ አንካሳ እንደ ሚዳቋ ይዘልላል፥ የድዳም ምላስ ይዘምራል፤ በምድረ በዳ ውኃ፥ በበረሀም ፈሳሽ ይፈልቃልና።

verses.en: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
verses.fr: Le mirage se changera en étang Et la terre desséchée en sources d''eaux; Dans le repaire qui servait de gîte aux chacals, Croîtront des roseaux et des joncs.
verses.am: ደረቂቱ ምድር ኵሬ፥ የጥማት መሬት የውኃ ምንጭ ትሆናለች፤ ቀበሮ የተኛበት መኖሪያ ልምላሜና ሸምበቆ ደንገልም ይሆንበታል።

verses.en: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
verses.fr: Il y aura là un chemin frayé, une route, Qu''on appellera la voie sainte; Nul impur n''y passera; elle sera pour eux seuls; Ceux qui la suivront, même les insensés, ne pourront s''égarer.
verses.am: በዚያም ጐዳናና መንገድ ይሆናል እርሱም የተቀደሰ መንገድ ይባላል፤ ንጹሐንም ያልሆኑ አያልፉበትም፥ ለንጹሐን ግን ይሆናል፤ ተላላፊዎችና ሰነፎች እንኳ አይስቱበትም።

verses.en: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
verses.fr: Sur cette route, point de lion; Nulle bête féroce ne la prendra, Nulle ne s''y rencontrera; Les délivrés y marcheront.
verses.am: አንበሳም አይኖርበትም፥ ነጣቂ አውሬም አይወጣበትም፥ ከዚያም አይገኙም፤ የዳኑት ግን በዚያ ይሄዳሉ፤

verses.en: And the ransomed of the Lord shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.fr: Les rachetés de l''Eternel retourneront, Ils iront à Sion avec chants de triomphe, Et une joie éternelle couronnera leur tête; L''allégresse et la joie s''approcheront, La douleur et les gémissements s''enfuiront.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የተቤዣቸው ይመለሳሉ እየዘመሩም ወደ ጽዮን ይመጣሉ፤ የዘላለም ደስታ በራሳቸው ላይ ይሆናል፤ ሐሤትንና ደስታን ያገኛሉ፥ ኀዘንና ትካዜም ይሸሻሉ።

verses.en: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.fr: La quatorzième année du roi Ezéchias, Sanchérib, roi d''Assyrie, monta contre toutes les villes fortes de Juda et s''en empara.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በንጉሡ በሕዝቅያስ በአሥራ አራተኛው ዓመት የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም ወደ ይሁዳ ወደ ተመሸጉት ከተሞች ሁሉ ወጥቶ ወሰዳቸው።

verses.en: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.
verses.fr: Et le roi d''Assyrie envoya de Lakis à Jérusalem, vers le roi Ezéchias, Rabschaké avec une puissante armée. Rabschaké s''arrêta à l''aqueduc de l''étang supérieur, sur le chemin du champ du foulon.
verses.am: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ራፋስቂስን ከብዙ ሠራዊት ጋር ከለኪሶ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ላከ፥ እርሱም በአጣቢው እርሻ መንገድ ባለችው በላይኛይቱ ኵሬ መስኖ አጠገብ ቆመ።

verses.en: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder.
verses.fr: Alors Eliakim, fils de Hilkija, chef de la maison du roi, se rendit auprès de lui, avec Schebna, le secrétaire, et Joach, fils d''Asaph, l''archiviste.
verses.am: የቤቱም አዛዥ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም ጸሐፊውም ሳምናስ ታሪክ ጸሐፊም የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአስ ወደ እርሱ ወጡ።

verses.en: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
verses.fr: Rabschaké leur dit: Dites à Ezéchias: Ainsi parle le grand roi, le roi d''Assyrie: Quelle est cette confiance, sur laquelle tu t''appuies?
verses.am: ራፋስቂስም አላቸው። ለሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት። ታላቁ የአሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ የምትታመንበት መተማመኛ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
verses.fr: Je te le dis, ce ne sont que des paroles en l''air: il faut pour la guerre de la prudence et de la force. En qui donc as-tu placé ta confiance, pour t''être révolté contre moi?
verses.am: እኔ። ለሰልፍ የሆነው ምክርህና ኃያልህ ከንቱ ነገር ነው አልሁ፤ አሁንም በእኔ ላይ ያመፅኸው በማን ተማምነህ ነው?

verses.en: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
verses.fr: Voici, tu l''as placée dans l''Egypte, tu as pris pour soutien ce roseau cassé, qui pénètre et perce la main de quiconque s''appuie dessus: tel est Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, pour tous ceux qui se confient en lui.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በዚህ በተቀጠቀጠ በሸምበቆ በትር በግብጽ ትታመናለህ፤ ሰው ቢመረኰዘው ተሰብሮ በእጁ ይገባል ያቈስለውማል የግብጽ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ለሚታመኑበት ሁሉ አንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: But if thou say to me, We trust in the Lord our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
verses.fr: Peut-être me diras-tu: C''est en l''Eternel, notre Dieu, que nous nous confions. Mais n''est-ce pas lui dont Ezéchias a fait disparaître les hauts lieux et les autels, en disant à Juda et à Jérusalem: Vous vous prosternerez devant cet autel?
verses.am: አንተም። በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር እንታመናለን ብትለኝ፥ ሕዝቅያስ ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን። በዚህ መሠዊያ ፊት ስገዱ ብሎ የኮረብታ መስገጃዎቹንና መሠዊያዎቹን ይስፈረሰ ይህ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
verses.fr: Maintenant, fais une convention avec mon maître, le roi d''Assyrie, et je te donnerai deux mille chevaux, si tu peux fournir des cavaliers pour les monter.
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ ከጌታዬ ከአሦር ንጉሥ ጋር ተወራረድ፥ የሚቀመጡባቸውንም ሰዎች ማግኘት ቢቻልህ እኔ ሁለት ሺህ ፈረሶች እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.fr: Comment repousserais-tu un seul chef d''entre les moindres serviteurs de mon maître? Tu mets ta confiance dans l''Egypte pour les chars et pour les cavaliers.
verses.am: ስለ ሰረገሎችና ስለ ፈረሶኞች በግብጽ ስትታመን፥ ከጌታዬ ባሪያዎች የሚያንሰውን የአንዱን አለቃ ፊት ትቃወም ዘንድ እንዴት ይቻልሃል?

verses.en: And am I now come up without the Lord against this land to destroy it? the Lord said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.fr: D''ailleurs, est-ce sans la volonté de l''Eternel que je suis monté contre ce pays pour le détruire? L''Eternel m''a dit: Monte contre ce pays, et détruis-le.
verses.am: አሁንም በውኑ ያለ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ይህን አገር አጠፋ ዘንድ ወጥቻለሁን? እግዚአብሔር። ወደዚህ አገር ወጥተህ አጥፋው አለኝ።

verses.en: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
verses.fr: Eliakim, Schebna et Joach dirent à Rabschaké: Parle à tes serviteurs en araméen, car nous le comprenons; et ne nous parle pas en langue judaïque aux oreilles du peuple qui est sur la muraille.
verses.am: ኤልያቄምና ሳምናስ ዮአስም ራፋስቂስን። እኛ እንሰማለንና እባክህ፥ በሶርያ ቋንቋ ለባሪያዎችህ ተናገር፤ በቅጥርም ላይ ባለው ሕዝብ ጆሮ በአይሁድ ቋንቋ አትናገረን አሉት።

verses.en: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.fr: Rabschaké répondit: Est-ce à ton maître et à toi que mon maître m''a envoyé dire ces paroles? N''est-ce pas à ces hommes assis sur la muraille pour manger leurs excréments et pour boire leur urine avec vous?
verses.am: ራፋስቂስ ግን። ጌታዬ ይህን ቃል እናገር ዘንድ ወደ አንተና ወደ ጌታህ ልኮኛልን? ከእናንተ ጋር ኵሳቸውን ይበሉ ዘንድ ሽንታቸውንም ይጠጡ ዘንድ በቅጥር ላይ ወደ ተቀመጡት ሰዎች አይደለምን? አላቸው።

verses.en: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
verses.fr: Puis Rabschaké s''avança et cria de toute sa force en langue judaïque: Ecoutez les paroles du grand roi, du roi d''Assyrie!
verses.am: ራፋስቂስም ቆሞ በታላቅ ድምፅ በአይሁድ ቋንቋ እንዲህ ብሎ ጮኸ። የታላቁን የአሦርን ንጉሥ ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle le roi: Qu''Ezéchias ne vous abuse point, car il ne pourra vous délivrer.
verses.am: ንጉሡ እንዲህ ይላል። ያድናችሁ ዘንድ አይችልምና ሕዝቅያስ አያታልላችሁ፤

verses.en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, The Lord will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.fr: Qu''Ezéchias ne vous amène point à vous confier en l''Eternel, en disant: L''Eternel nous délivrera, cette ville ne sera pas livrée entre les mains du roi d''Assyrie.
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስም። እግዚአብሔር በእርግጥ ያድነናል ይህችም ከተማ በአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አትሰጥም ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር እንድትታመኑ አያድርጋችሁ።

verses.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;
verses.fr: N''écoutez point Ezéchias; car ainsi parle le roi d''Assyrie: Faites la paix avec moi, rendez-vous à moi, et chacun de vous mangera de sa vigne et de son figuier, et chacun boira de l''eau de sa citerne,
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስንም አትስሙ፤ የአሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል። ከእኔ ጋር ታረቁ ወደ እኔም ውጡ፤ እያንዳንዳችሁም ከወይናችሁና ከበለሳችሁ ብሉ፥ ከጕድጓዳችሁም ውኃ ጠጡ፤

verses.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.fr: jusqu''à ce que je vienne, et que je vous emmène dans un pays comme le vôtre, dans un pays de blé et de vin, un pays de pain et de vignes.
verses.am: ይህም መጥቼ ምድራችሁን ወደምትመስለው ምድር፥ እህልና የወይን ጠጅ፥ እንጀራና ወይን ወዳለበት ምድር እስካፈልሳችሁ ድረስ ነው።

verses.en: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, the Lord will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.fr: Qu''Ezéchias ne vous séduise point, en disant: L''Eternel nous délivrera. Les dieux des nations ont-ils délivré chacun son pays de la main du roi d''Assyrie?
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስም። እግዚአብሔር ያድነናል ብሎ እንዳያታልላችሁ ተጠንቀቁ። በውኑ የአሕዛብ አማልክት አገሮቻቸውን ከአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አድነዋቸዋልን?

verses.en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.fr: Où sont les dieux de Hamath et d''Arpad? Où sont les dieux de Sepharvaïm? Ont-ils délivré Samarie de ma main?
verses.am: የሐማትና የአርፋድ አማልክት ወዴት አሉ? የሴፈርዋይም አማልክት ወዴት አሉ? ሰማርያን ከእጄ አድነዋታልን?

verses.en: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
verses.fr: Parmi tous les dieux de ces pays, quels sont ceux qui ont délivré leur pays de ma main, pour que l''Eternel délivre Jérusalem de ma main?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ከእጄ ያድን ዘንድ ከእነዚህ አገሮች አማልክት ሁሉ አገሩን ከእጄ ያዳነ ማን ነው?

verses.en: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.fr: Mais ils se turent, et ne lui répondirent pas un mot; car le roi avait donné cet ordre: Vous ne lui répondrez pas.
verses.am: እነርሱም ዝም አሉ፥ አንዳችም አልመለሱለትም፤ ንጉሡ አንዳይመልሱለት አዝዞ ነበርና።

verses.en: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.fr: Et Eliakim, fils de Hilkija, chef de la maison du roi, Schebna, le secrétaire, et Joach, fils d''Asaph, l''archiviste, vinrent auprès d''Ezéchias, les vêtements déchirés, et lui rapportèrent les paroles de Rabschaké.
verses.am: የቤቱ አዛዥ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም ጸሐፊውም ሳምናስ ታሪክ ጸሐፊም የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአስ ልብሳቸውን ቀድደው ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መጡ፥ የራፋስቂስንም ቃል ነገሩት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Lorsque le roi Ezéchias eut entendu cela, il déchira ses vêtements, se couvrit d''un sac, et alla dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ንጉሡ ሕዝቅያስ ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀደደ፥ ማቅም ለበሰ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ገባ።

verses.en: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.fr: Il envoya Eliakim, chef de la maison du roi, Schebna, le secrétaire, et les plus anciens des sacrificateurs, couverts de sacs, vers Esaïe, le prophète, fils d''Amots.
verses.am: የቤቱንም አዛዥ ኤልያቄምን ጸሐፊውንም ሳምናስን የካህናቱንም ሽማግሌዎች ማቅ ለብሰው ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ አሞጽ ልጅ ወደ ኢሳይያስ ይሄዱ ዘንድ ላካቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
verses.fr: Et ils lui dirent: Ainsi parle Ezéchias: Ce jour est un jour d''angoisse, de châtiment et d''opprobre; car les enfants sont près de sortir du sein maternel, et il n''y a point de force pour l''enfantement.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ ቀን የመከራና የተግሣጽ የዘለፋም ቀን ነው፤ ልጆች የሚወለዱበት ጊዜ ደርሶአል ለመውለድም ኃይል የለም።

verses.en: It may be the Lord thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the Lord thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.
verses.fr: Peut-être l''Eternel, ton Dieu, a-t-il entendu les paroles de Rabschaké, que le roi d''Assyrie, son maître, a envoyé pour insulter le Dieu vivant, et peut-être l''Eternel, ton Dieu, exercera-t-il ses châtiments à cause des paroles qu''il a entendues. Fais donc monter une prière pour le reste qui subsiste encore.
verses.am: ምናልባት በሕያው አምላክ ላይ ይገዳደር ዘንድ ጌታው የአሦር ንጉሥ የላከውን የራፋስቂስን ቃል አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ይሰማ እንደ ሆነ፥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ሰማው ቃል ይገሥጸው እንደ ሆነ፥ ስለዚህ ለቀረው ቅሬታ ጸልይ አሉት።

verses.en: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.fr: Les serviteurs du roi Ezéchias allèrent donc auprès d''Esaïe.
verses.am: እንዲሁ የንጉሡ የሕዝቅያስ ባሪያዎች ወደ ኢሳይያስ መጡ።

verses.en: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the Lord, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.fr: Et Esaïe leur dit: Voici ce que vous direz à votre maître: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Ne t''effraie point des paroles que tu as entendues et par lesquelles m''ont outragé les serviteurs du roi d''Assyrie.
verses.am: ኢሳይያስም። ለጌታችሁ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአሦር ንጉሥ ባሪያዎች ስለ ሰደቡኝ፥ ስለ ሰማኸው ቃል አትፍራ።

verses.en: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
verses.fr: Je vais mettre en lui un esprit tel que, sur une nouvelle qu''il recevra, il retournera dans son pays; et je le ferai tomber par l''épée dans son pays.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በላዩ መንፈስን እሰድዳለሁ፥ ወሬንም ይሰማል፥ ወደ ምድሩም ይመለሳል፤ በምድሩም በሰይፍ እንዲወድቅ አደርጋለሁ በሉት አላቸው።

verses.en: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.fr: Rabschaké, s''étant retiré, trouva le roi d''Assyrie qui attaquait Libna, car il avait appris son départ de Lakis.
verses.am: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ከለኪሶ እንደ ራቀ ሰምቶ ነበርና ራፋስቂስ ተመልሶ በልብና ሲዋጋ አገኘው።

verses.en: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.fr: Alors le roi d''Assyrie reçut une nouvelle au sujet de Tirhaka, roi d''Ethiopie; on lui dit: Il s''est mis en marche pour te faire la guerre. Dès qu''il eut entendu cela, il envoya des messagers à Ezéchias, en disant:
verses.am: እርሱም። የኢትዮጵያ ንጉሥ ቲርሐቅ ሊዋጋህ መጥቶአል የሚል ወሬ ሰማ። በሰማም ጊዜ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መልእክተኞችን ላከ፥

verses.en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.fr: Vous parlerez ainsi à Ezéchias, roi de Juda: Que ton Dieu, auquel tu te confies, ne t''abuse point en disant: Jérusalem ne sera pas livrée entre les mains du roi d''Assyrie.
verses.am: እንዲህ ሲል። ለይሁዳ ንጉሠ ለሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት። ኢየሩሳሌም በአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አትሰጥም ብሎ የምትታመንበት አምላክህ አያታልልህ።

verses.en: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?
verses.fr: Voici, tu as appris ce qu''ont fait les rois d''Assyrie à tous les pays, et comment ils les ont détruits; et toi, tu serais délivré!
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የአሦር ነገሥታት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ያደረጉትን፥ እንዴትስ እንዳጠፉአቸው ሰምተሃል፤ አንተስ ትድናለህን?

verses.en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?
verses.fr: Les dieux des nations que mes pères ont détruites les ont-ils délivrées, Gozan, Charan, Retseph, et les fils d''Eden qui sont à Telassar?
verses.am: አባቶቼ ያጠፉአቸውን ጎዛንን፥ ካራንን፥ ራፊስን፥ በተላሳር የነበሩትንም የዔድንን ልጆች የአሕዛብ አማልክት አዳኑአቸውን?

verses.en: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?
verses.fr: Où sont le roi de Hamath, le roi d''Arpad, et le roi de la ville de Sepharvaïm, d''Héna et d''Ivva?
verses.am: የሐማት ንጉሥ፥ የአርፋድ ንጉሥ፥ የሴፈርዋይም ከተማ ንጉሥ፥ የሄናና የዒዋ ንጉሥ ወዴት አሉ?

verses.en: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.
verses.fr: Ezéchias prit la lettre de la main des messagers, et la lut. Puis il monta à la maison de l''Eternel, et la déploya devant l''Eternel,
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስም ደብዳቤውን ከመልእክተኞች እጅ ተቀብሎ አነበበው፤ ሕዝቅያስም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወጥቶ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዘረጋው።

verses.en: And Hezekiah prayed unto the Lord, saying,
verses.fr: qui il adressa cette prière:
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስም ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ጸለየ።

verses.en: O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.
verses.fr: Eternel des armées, Dieu d''Israël, assis sur les chérubins! C''est toi qui es le seul Dieu de tous les royaumes de la terre, c''est toi qui as fait les cieux et la terre.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በኪሩቤል ላይ የምትቀመጥ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ብቻህን የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ አምላክ ነህ፤ ሰማይንና ምድርን ፈጥረሃል።

verses.en: Incline thine ear, O Lord, and hear; open thine eyes, O Lord, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.
verses.fr: Eternel, incline ton oreille, et écoute! Eternel, ouvre tes yeux, et regarde! Entends toutes les paroles que Sanchérib a envoyées pour insulter au Dieu vivant!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጆሮህን አዘንብልና ስማ፤ አቤቱ፥ ዓይንህን ክፈትና እይ፤ በሕያው አምላክ ላይ ይገዳደር ዘንድ የላከውን የሰናክሬም ቃል ስማ።

verses.en: Of a truth, Lord, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
verses.fr: Il est vrai, ô Eternel! que les rois d''Assyrie ont ravagé tous les pays et leur propre pays,
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በእውነት የአሦር ነገሥታት ዓለሙን ሁሉ አገሮቻቸውንም አፍርሰዋል፥

verses.en: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.fr: et qu''ils ont jeté leurs dieux dans le feu; mais ce n''étaient point des dieux, c''étaient des ouvrages de mains d''homme, du bois et de la pierre; et ils les ont anéantis.
verses.am: አማልክቶቻቸውንም በእሳት ላይ ጥለዋል፤ የእንጨትና የድንጋይ የሰው እጅ ሥራ ነበሩ እንጂ አማልክት አልነበሩምና ስለዚህ አጥፍተዋቸዋል።

verses.en: Now therefore, O Lord our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the Lord, even thou only.
verses.fr: Maintenant, Eternel, notre Dieu, délivre-nous de la main de Sanchérib, et que tous les royaumes de la terre sachent que toi seul es l''Eternel!
verses.am: እንግዲህም አምላካችን አቤቱ፥ የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ አንተ ብቻ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንህ ያውቁ ዘንድ ከእጁ አድነን።

verses.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:
verses.fr: Alors Esaïe, fils d''Amots, envoya dire à Ezéchias: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: J''ai entendu la prière que tu m''as adressée au sujet de Sanchérib, roi d''Assyrie.
verses.am: የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ እንዲህ ብሎ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ላከ። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ አሦር ንጉሥ ስለ ሰናክሬም ወደ እኔ ለምነሃልና

verses.en: This is the word which the Lord hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
verses.fr: Voici la parole que l''Eternel a prononcée contre lui: Elle te méprise, elle se moque de toi, La vierge, fille de Sion; Elle hoche la tête après toi, La fille de Jérusalem.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እርሱ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው። ድንግሊቱ የጽዮን ልጅ ቀላል አድርጋሃለች፥ በንቀትም ስቃብሃለች፤ የኢየሩሳሌም ልጅ ራስዋን ነቅንቃብሃለች።

verses.en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: Qui as-tu insulté et outragé? Contre qui as-tu élevé la voix? Tu as porté tes yeux en haut Sur le Saint d''Israël.
verses.am: የተገዳደርኸው የሰደብኸውስ ማን ነው? ቃልህንስ ከፍ ከፍ ያደረግህበት ዓይንህንስ ወደ ላይ ያነሣህበት ማን ነው? በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.
verses.fr: Par tes serviteurs tu as insulté le Seigneur, Et tu as dit: Avec la multitude de mes chars, J''ai gravi le sommet des montagnes, Les extrémités du Liban; Je couperai les plus élevés de ses cèdres, Les plus beaux de ses cyprès, Et j''atteindrai sa dernière cime, Sa forêt semblable à un verger;
verses.am: አንተም። በሰረገላዬ ብዛት ወደ ተራሮች ከፍታ፥ ወደ ሊባኖስ ጥግ ላይ ወጥቻለሁ፤ ረጃጅሞቹንም ዝግባዎች የተመረጡትንም ጥዶች እቈርጣለሁ፥ ወደ ከፍታውም ዳርቻ ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ዱር እገባለሁ።

verses.en: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
verses.fr: J''ai ouvert des sources, et j''en ai bu les eaux, Et je tarirai avec la plante de mes pieds Tous les fleuves de l''Egypte.
verses.am: ቈፈርሁም ውኃም ጠጣሁ የግብጽንም ወንዞች ሁሉ በእግሬ ጫማ አደርቃለሁ ብለህ በባሪያዎችህ እጅ በጌታ ላይ ተገዳደርህ።

verses.en: Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.
verses.fr: N''as-tu pas appris que j''ai préparé ces choses de loin, Et que je les ai résolues dès les temps anciens? Maintenant j''ai permis qu''elles s''accomplissent, Et que tu réduisisses des villes fortes en monceaux de ruines.
verses.am: እኔ ጥንቱን እንደ ሠራሁት፥ ቀድሞውንም እንዳደረግሁት አልሰማህምን? አሁንም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች የፍርስራሽ ክምር እስኪሆኑ ድረስ እንድታፈርስ አደረግሁህ።

verses.en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
verses.fr: Leurs habitants sont impuissants, Epouvantés et confus; Ils sont comme l''herbe des champs et la tendre verdure, Comme le gazon des toits Et le blé qui sèche avant la formation de sa tige.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የሚኖሩባቸው ሰዎች እጃቸው ዝሎአል፥ ደንግጠውም ታውከዋል፤ እንደ ምድረ በዳ ሣር፥ እንደ ለመለመም ቡቃያ፥ በሰገነትም ላይ እንዳለ ሣር፥ ሳይሸት ዋግ እንደ መታው እህል ሆነዋል።

verses.en: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
verses.fr: Mais je sais quand tu t''assieds, quand tu sors et quand tu entres, Et quand tu es furieux contre moi.
verses.am: እኔ ግን መቀመጫህንና መውጫህን መግቢያህንም በእኔም ላይ የተቈጣኸውን ቍጣ አውቄአለሁ።

verses.en: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
verses.fr: Parce que tu es furieux contre moi, Et que ton arrogance est montée à mes oreilles, Je mettrai ma boucle à tes narines et mon mors entre tes lèvres, Et je te ferai retourner par le chemin par lequel tu es venu.
verses.am: ቍጣህና ትዕቢትህ ወደጆሮዬ ደርሶአልና ስለዚህ ስናጋዬን በአፍንጫህ ልጓሜንም በከንፈርህ አደርጋለሁ፥ በመጣህበትም መንገድ እመልስሃለሁ።

verses.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
verses.fr: Que ceci soit un signe pour toi: On a mangé une année le produit du grain tombé, et une seconde année ce qui croît de soi-même; mais la troisième année, vous sèmerez, vous moissonnerez, vous planterez des vignes, et vous en mangerez le fruit.
verses.am: ይህም ምልክት ይሆንሃል፤ በዚህ ዓመት የገቦውን፥ በሁለተኛውም ዓመት ከገቦው የበቀለውን ትበላላችሁ፤ በሦስተኛውም ዓመት ትዘራላችሁ ታጭዱማላችሁ፥ ወይንም ትተክላላችሁ ፍሬውንም ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:
verses.fr: Ce qui aura été sauvé de la maison de Juda, ce qui sera resté poussera encore des racines par-dessous, et portera du fruit par-dessus.
verses.am: ያመለጠው የይሁዳ ቤት ቅሬታ ሥሩን ወደ ታች ይሰድዳል፥ ወደ ላይም ያፈራል።

verses.en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.
verses.fr: Car de Jérusalem il sortira un reste, et de la montagne de Sion des réchappés. Voilà ce que fera le zèle de l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: ከኢየሩሳሌም ቅሬታ ከጽዮንም ተራራ ያመለጡት ይወጣሉና፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቅንዓት ይህን ያደርጋል።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel sur le roi d''Assyrie: Il n''entrera point dans cette ville, Il n''y lancera point de traits, Il ne lui présentera point de boucliers, Et il n''élèvera point de retranchements contre elle.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር ስለ አሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል። ወደዚች ከተማ አይመጣም፥ ፍላጻንም አይወረውርባትም፥ በጋሻም አይመጣባትም፥ የአፈርንም ድልድል አይደለድልባትም።

verses.en: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Il s''en retournera par le chemin par lequel il est venu, Et il n''entrera point dans cette ville, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በመጣበት መንገድ በዚያው ይመለሳል፥ ወደዚችም ከተማ አይመጣም ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
verses.fr: Je protégerai cette ville pour la sauver, A cause de moi, et à cause de David, mon serviteur.
verses.am: ስለ እኔም ስለ ባሪያዬም ስለ ዳዊት ይህችን ከተማ አድናት ዘንድ እጋርዳታለሁ።

verses.en: Then the angel of the Lord went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel sortit, et frappa dans le camp des Assyriens cent quatre-vingt-cinq mille hommes. Et quand on se leva le matin, voici, c''étaient tous des corps morts.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ወጣ፥ ከአሦራውያንም ሰፈር መቶ ሰማንያ አምስት ሺህ ገደለ፤ ማለዳም በተነሡ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ሁሉ በድኖች ነበሩ።

verses.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.fr: Alors Sanchérib, roi d''Assyrie, leva son camp, partit et s''en retourna; et il resta à Ninive.
verses.am: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም ተነሥቶ ሄደ፥ ተመልሶም በነነዌ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Or, comme il était prosterné dans la maison de Nisroc, son dieu, Adrammélec et Scharetser, ses fils, le frappèrent par l''épée, et s''enfuirent au pays d''Ararat. Et Esar-Haddon, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: በአምላኩም በናሳራክ ቤት ሲሰግድ ልጆቹ አድራሜሌክና ሳራሳር በሰይፍ ገደሉት፤ ወደ አራራትም አገር ኰበለሉ። ልጁም አስራዶን በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, Ezéchias fut malade à la mort. Le prophète Esaïe, fils d''Amots, vint auprès de lui, et lui dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Donne tes ordres à ta maison, car tu vas mourir, et tu ne vivras plus.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት ሕዝቅያስ ለሞት እስኪደርስ ታመመ። ነቢዩም የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ትሞታለህ እንጂ በሕይወት አትኖርምና ቤትህን አስተካክል አለው።

verses.en: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the Lord,
verses.fr: Ezéchias tourna son visage contre le mur, et fit cette prière à l''Eternel:
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስም ፊቱን ወደ ግድግዳው መልሶ እንዲህ ሲል ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ።

verses.en: And said, Remember now, O Lord, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
verses.fr: O Eternel! souviens-toi que j''ai marché devant ta face avec fidélité et intégrité de coeur, et que j''ai fait ce qui est bien à tes yeux! Et Ezéchias répandit d''abondantes larmes.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በፊትህ በእውነትና በፍጹም ልብ እንደ ሄድሁ ደስ የሚያሰኝህንም እንዳደረግሁ ታስብ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ። ሕዝቅያስም እጅግ አድርጎ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: Then came the word of the Lord to Isaiah, saying,
verses.fr: Puis la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Esaïe, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኢሳይያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
verses.fr: Va, et dis à Ezéchias: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu de David, ton père: J''ai entendu ta prière, j''ai vu tes larmes. Voici, j''ajouterai à tes jours quinze années.
verses.am: ሂድ፥ ሕዝቅያስን እንዲህ በለው። የአባትህ የዳዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጸሎትህን ሰምቻለሁ፥ እንባህንም አይቻለሁ፤ እነሆ፥ በዕድሜህ ላይ አሥራ አምስት ዓመት አጨምራለሁ።

verses.en: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
verses.fr: Je te délivrerai, toi et cette ville, de la main du roi d''Assyrie; je protégerai cette ville.
verses.am: አንተንና ይህችንም ከተማ ከአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ እታደጋለሁ፥ ይህችንም ከተማ እጋርዳታለሁ።

verses.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the Lord, that the Lord will do this thing that he hath spoken;
verses.fr: Et voici, de la part de l''Eternel, le signe auquel tu connaîtras que l''Eternel accomplira la parole qu''il a prononcée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የተገረውን ነገር እንዲፈጽመው ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ምልክቱ ይህ ይሆንልሃል።

verses.en: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
verses.fr: Je ferai reculer de dix degrés en arrière avec le soleil l''ombre des degrés qui est descendue sur les degrés d''Achaz. Et le soleil recula de dix degrés sur les degrés où il était descendu.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በአካዝ የጥላ ስፍረ ሰዓት ላይ ከፀሐይ ጋር የወረደውን በደረጃዎች ያለውን ጥላ አሥር ደረጃ ወደ ኋላ እንዲመለስ አደርጋለሁ። ፀሐይም በጥላ ስፍረ ሰዓት ላይ የወረደበት አሥር ደረጃ ወደ ኋላ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
verses.fr: Cantique d''Ezéchias, roi de Juda, sur sa maladie et sur son rétablissement.
verses.am: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ታምሞ ከደዌው በተፈወሰ ጊዜ የጻፈው ጽሕፈት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
verses.fr: Je disais: Quand mes jours sont en repos, je dois m''en aller Aux portes du séjour des morts. Je suis privé du reste de mes années!
verses.am: እኔ። በሕይወት ዘመኔ መካከል ወደ ሲኦል በሮች እገባለሁ፤ የቀረው ዘመኔ ጐደለብኝ አልሁ።

verses.en: I said, I shall not see the Lord, even the Lord, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
verses.fr: Je disais: Je ne verrai plus l''Eternel, L''Eternel, sur la terre des vivants; Je ne verrai plus aucun homme Parmi les habitants du monde!
verses.am: ደግሞም። በሕያዋን ምድር እግዚአብሔርን አላይም፤ በዓለምም ከሚኖሩ ጋር ሰውን እንግዲህ አልመለከትም አልሁ።

verses.en: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.fr: Ma demeure est enlevée et transportée loin de moi, Comme une tente de berger; Je sens le fil de ma vie coupé comme par un tisserand Qui me retrancherait de sa trame. Du jour à la nuit tu m''auras achevé!
verses.am: ማደሪያዬ ተነቀለች፥ እንደ እረኛ ድንኳንም ከእኔ ዘንድ ተወገደች፤ ሕይወቴንም እንደ ሸማኔ ጠቀለልሁ፥ እርሱም ከመጠቅለያው ይቈርጠኛል፤ ከማለዳም ጀምሮ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ታጠፋኛለህ።

verses.en: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.fr: Je me suis contenu jusqu''au matin; Comme un lion, il brisait tous mes os, Du jour à la nuit tu m''auras achevé!
verses.am: እስኪነጋ ድረስ ቈይቼ ነበር፤ እርሱ እንደ አንበሳ አጥንቴን ሁሉ ሰበረ፤ ከማለዳ ጀምሮ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ታጠፋኛለህ።

verses.en: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O Lord, I am oppressed; undertake for me.
verses.fr: Je poussais des cris comme une hirondelle en voltigeant, Je gémissais comme la colombe; Mes yeux s''élevaient languissants vers le ciel: O Eternel! je suis dans l''angoisse, secours-moi!
verses.am: እንደ ጨረባና እንደ ሽመላ ተንጫጫሁ፥ እንደ ርግብም አጕረመረምሁ፤ ዓይኖቼ ወደ ላይ ከማየት ደከሙ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ተጨንቄአለሁና መከታ ሁነኝ።

verses.en: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.fr: Que dirai-je? Il m''a répondu, et il m''a exaucé. Je marcherai humblement jusqu''au terme de mes années, Après avoir été ainsi affligé.
verses.am: ምን እላለሁ? እርሱ ተናግሮኛል፥ እርሱ ራሱም ይህን አድርጎአል፤ በዘመኔ ሁሉ ስለ ነፍሴ ምሬት ቀስ ብዬ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
verses.fr: Seigneur, c''est par tes bontés qu''on jouit de la vie, C''est par elles que je respire encore; Tu me rétablis, tu me rends à la vie.
verses.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ በዚህ ነገር ሰዎች በሕይወት ይኖራሉ፥ በዚህም ሁሉ የመንፈሴ ሕይወት ነው፤ አንተም ፈወስኸኝ ወደ ሕይወትም መለስኸኝ።

verses.en: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
verses.fr: Voici, mes souffrances mêmes sont devenues mon salut; Tu as pris plaisir à retirer mon âme de la fosse du néant, Car tu as jeté derrière toi tous mes péchés.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ታላቅ ምሬት ለደኅንነቴ ሆነ፤ አንተም ነፍሴን ከጥፋት ጕድጓድ አዳንሃት፥ ኃጢአቴንም ሁሉ ወደ ኋላህ ጣልህ።

verses.en: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas le séjour des morts qui te loue, Ce n''est pas la mort qui te célèbre; Ceux qui sont descendus dans la fosse n''espèrent plus en ta fidélité.
verses.am: ሲኦል አያመሰግንህምና፥ ሞትም አያከብርህምና፤ ወደ ጕድጓዱ የሚወርዱ እውነትህን ተስፋ አያደርጉም።

verses.en: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
verses.fr: Le vivant, le vivant, c''est celui-là qui te loue, Comme moi aujourd''hui; Le père fait connaître à ses enfants ta fidélité.
verses.am: እኔ ዛሬ አንደማደርግ ሕያዋን እነርሱ ያመሰግኑሃል፤ አባት ለልጆች እውነትህን ያስታውቃል።

verses.en: The Lord was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: L''Eternel m''a sauvé! Nous ferons résonner les cordes de nos instruments, Tous les jours de notre vie, Dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያድነኛል፤ ስለዚህ በዕድሜያችን ዘመን ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ቅኔዎችን አውታር ባለው ዕቃ እንዘምራለን።

verses.en: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
verses.fr: Esaïe avait dit: Qu''on apporte une masse de figues, et qu''on les étende sur l''ulcère; et Ezéchias vivra.
verses.am: ኢሳይያስም። የበለስ ጥፍጥፍ አምጥተው በእባጩ ላይ ይለብጡት፥ እርሱም ይፈወሳል ብሎ ነበር።

verses.en: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the Lord?
verses.fr: Et Ezéchias avait dit: A quel signe connaîtrai-je que je monterai à la maison de l''Eternel?
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስም። ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እወጣ ዘንድ ምልክቱ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ነበር።

verses.en: At that time Merodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.
verses.fr: En ce même temps, Merodac-Baladan, fils de Baladan, roi de Babylone, envoya une lettre et un présent à Ezéchias, parce qu''il avait appris sa maladie et son rétablissement.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት የባቢሎን ንጉሥ የባልዳን ልጅ መሮዳክ ባልዳን ሕዝቅያስ ታምሞ እንደ ተፈወሰ ሰምቶ ነበርና ደብዳቤና እጅ መንሻ ላከለት።

verses.en: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
verses.fr: Ezéchias en eut de la joie, et il montra aux envoyés le lieu où étaient ses choses de prix, l''argent et l''or, les aromates et l''huile précieuse, tout son arsenal, et tout ce qui se trouvait dans ses trésors: il n''y eut rien qu''Ezéchias ne leur fît voir dans sa maison et dans tous ses domaines.
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስም ደስ አለው፥ ግምጃ ቤቱንም፥ ብሩንና ወርቁንም፥ ቅመሙንና የከበረውንም ዘይት፥ መሣርያም ያለበትን ቤት ሁሉ፥ በቤተ መዛግብቱም የተገኘውን ሁሉ አሳያቸው፤ በቤቱና በግዛቱ ሁሉ ካለው ሕዝቅያስ ያላሳያቸው የለም።

verses.en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.
verses.fr: Esaïe, le prophète, vint ensuite auprès du roi Ezéchias, et lui dit: Qu''ont dit ces gens-là, et d''où sont-ils venus vers toi? Ezéchias répondit: Ils sont venus vers moi d''un pays éloigné, de Babylone.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ኢሳይያስ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መጥቶ። እነዚህ ሰዎች ምን አሉ? ከወዴትስ መጡልህ? አለው። ሕዝቅያስም። ከሩቅ አገር ከባቢሎን መጡልኝ አለው።

verses.en: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
verses.fr: Esaïe dit encore: Qu''ont-ils vu dans ta maison? Ezéchias répondit: Ils ont vu tout ce qui est dans ma maison: il n''y a rien dans mes trésors que je ne leur aie fait voir.
verses.am: እርሱም። በቤትህ ያዩት ምንድር ነው? አለው፤ ሕዝቅያስም። በቤቴ ያለውን ሁሉ አይተዋል፤ በቤተ መዛግብቴ ካለው ያላሳየኋቸው የለም አለው።

verses.en: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the Lord of hosts:
verses.fr: Alors Esaïe dit à Ezéchias: Ecoute la parole de l''Eternel des armées!
verses.am: ኢሳይያስም ሕዝቅያስን። የሠራዊትን ጌታ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Voici, les temps viendront où l''on emportera à Babylone tout ce qui est dans ta maison et ce que tes pères ont amassé jusqu''à ce jour; il n''en restera rien, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በቤትህ ያለው ሁሉ፥ አባቶችህም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ያከማቹት ሁሉ ወደ ባቢሎን የሚፈልስበት ወራት ይመጣል፤ ምንም አይቀርም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.fr: Et l''on prendra de tes fils, qui seront sortis de toi, que tu auras engendrés, pour en faire des eunuques dans le palais du roi de Babylone.
verses.am: ከአንተም ከሚወጡት ከምትወልዳቸው ልጆችህ ማርከው ይወስዳሉ፤ በባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ቤት ውስጥ ጃንደረቦች ይሆናሉ አለው።

verses.en: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
verses.fr: Ezéchias répondit à Esaïe: La parole de l''Eternel, que tu as prononcée, est bonne; car, ajouta-t-il, il y aura paix et sécurité pendant ma vie.
verses.am: ሕዝቅያስም ኢሳይያስን። የተናገርኸው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል መልካም ነው አለው። ደግሞም። በዘመኔ ሰላምና እውነት ይሁን አለ።

verses.en: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
verses.fr: Consolez, consolez mon peuple, Dit votre Dieu.
verses.am: አጽናኑ፥ ሕዝቤን አጽናኑ ይላል አምላካችሁ።

verses.en: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the Lord's hand double for all her sins.
verses.fr: Parlez au coeur de Jérusalem, et criez lui Que sa servitude est finie, Que son iniquité est expiée, Qu''elle a reçu de la main de l''Eternel Au double de tous ses péchés.
verses.am: ለኢየሩሳሌም ልብ ተናገሩ የተቀጠረችበት ወራት እንደ ተፈጸመ፥ ኃጢአትዋም እንደ ተሰረየ፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም እጅ ስለ ኃጢአትዋ ሁሉ ሁለት እጥፍ እንደ ተቀበለች ወደ እርስዋ ጩኹ።

verses.en: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
verses.fr: Une voix crie: Préparez au désert le chemin de l''Eternel, Aplanissez dans les lieux arides Une route pour notre Dieu.
verses.am: የአዋጅ ነጋሪ ቃል። የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ በምድረ በዳ ጥረጉ፥ ለአምላካችንም ጐዳና በበረሀ አስተካከሉ።

verses.en: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
verses.fr: Que toute vallée soit exhaussée, Que toute montagne et toute colline soient abaissées! Que les coteaux se changent en plaines, Et les défilés étroits en vallons!
verses.am: ሸለቆው ሁሉ ከፍ ይላል፥ ተራራውና ኮረብታውም ሁሉ ዝቅ ይላል፤ ጠማማውም ይቃናል፥ ስርጓጕጡም ሜዳ ይሆናል፤

verses.en: And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.fr: Alors la gloire de l''Eternel sera révélée, Et au même instant toute chair la verra; Car la bouche de l''Eternel a parlé.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ይገለጣል፥ ሥጋ ለባሹም ሁሉ በአንድነት ያየዋል፥ የእግዚአብሔር አፍ ይህን ተናግሮአልና።

verses.en: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
verses.fr: Une voix dit: Crie! -Et il répond: Que crierai-je? Toute chair est comme l''herbe, Et tout son éclat comme la fleur des champs.
verses.am: ጩኽ የሚል ሰው ቃል፤ ምን ብዬ ልጩኽ? አልሁ። ሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ሣር ነው፥ ክብሩም ሁሉ እንደ ምድረ በዳ አበባ ነው።

verses.en: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the Lord bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
verses.fr: L''herbe sèche, la fleur tombe, Quand le vent de l''Eternel souffle dessus. -Certainement le peuple est comme l''herbe:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር እስትንፋስ ይነፍስበታልና ሣሩ ይደርቃል አበባውም ይረግፋል፤ በእውነት ሕዝቡ ሣር ነው።

verses.en: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
verses.fr: L''herbe sèche, la fleur tombe; Mais la parole de notre Dieu subsiste éternellement.
verses.am: ሣሩ ይደርቃል አበባውም ይረግፋል፥ የአምላካችን ቃል ግን ለዘላለም ጸንታ ትኖራለች።

verses.en: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
verses.fr: Monte sur une haute montagne, Sion, pour publier la bonne nouvelle; Elève avec force ta voix, Jérusalem, pour publier la bonne nouvelle; Elève ta voix, ne crains point, Dis aux villes de Juda: Voici votre Dieu!
verses.am: የምስራች የምትነግሪ ጽዮን ሆይ፥ ከፍ ወዳለው ተራራ ውጪ የምስራች የምትነግሪ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ድምፅሽን በኃይል አንሺ፤ አንሺ፥ አትፍሪ፤ ለይሁዳም ከተሞች። እነሆ፥ አምላካችሁ! ብለሽ ንገሪ።

verses.en: Behold, the Lord God will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
verses.fr: Voici, le Seigneur, l''Eternel vient avec puissance, Et de son bras il commande; Voici, le salaire est avec lui, Et les rétributions le précèdent.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ኃያል ይመጣል ክንዱም ስለ እርሱ ይገዛል፤ እነሆ፥ ዋጋው ከእርሱ ጋር ደመወዙም በፊቱ ነው።

verses.en: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
verses.fr: Comme un berger, il paîtra son troupeau, Il prendra les agneaux dans ses bras, Et les portera dans son sein; Il conduira les brebis qui allaitent.
verses.am: መንጋውን እንደ እረኛ ያሰማራል፥ ጠቦቶቹን በክንዱ ሰብስቦ በብብቱ ይሸከማል፥ የሚያጠቡትንም በቀስታ ይመራል።

verses.en: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
verses.fr: Qui a mesuré les eaux dans le creux de sa main, Pris les dimensions des cieux avec la paume, Et ramassé la poussière de la terre dans un tiers de mesure? Qui a pesé les montagnes au crochet, Et les collines à la balance?
verses.am: ውኆችን በእፍኙ የሰፈረ፥ ሰማይንም በስንዝር የለካ፥ የምድርንም አፈር በመስፈሪያ ሰብስቦ የያዘ፥ ተራሮችን በሚዛን ኮረብቶችንም በሚዛኖች የመዘነ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or being his counsellor hath taught him?
verses.fr: Qui a sondé l''esprit de l''Eternel, Et qui l''a éclairé de ses conseils?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን መንፈስ ያዘዘ፥ ወይስ አማካሪ ሆኖ ያስተማረው ማን ነው?

verses.en: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
verses.fr: Avec qui a-t-il délibéré pour en recevoir de l''instruction? Qui lui a appris le sentier de la justice? Qui lui a enseigné la sagesse, Et fait connaître le chemin de l''intelligence?
verses.am: ወይስ ከማን ጋር ተመካከረ? ወይስ ማን መከረው? የፍርድንም መንገድ ማን አስተማረው? እውቀትንስ ማን አስተማረው? የማስተዋልንስ መንገድ ማን አሳየው?

verses.en: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
verses.fr: Voici, les nations sont comme une goutte d''un seau, Elles sont comme de la poussière sur une balance; Voici, les îles sont comme une fine poussière qui s''envole.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አሕዛብ በገንቦ እንዳለች ጠብታ ናቸው፥ በሚዛንም እንዳለ ትንሽ ትቢያ ተቈጥረዋል፤ እነሆ፥ ደሴቶችን እንደ ቀላል ነገር ያነሣል።

verses.en: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
verses.fr: Le Liban ne suffit pas pour le feu, Et ses animaux ne suffisent pas pour l''holocauste.
verses.am: ሊባኖስ ለማንደጃ እንስሶችዋም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አይበቁም።

verses.en: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
verses.fr: Toutes les nations sont devant lui comme un rien, Elles ne sont pour lui que néant et vanité.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሁሉ በፊቱ እንዳልነበሩ ናቸው፤ ከምናምን እንደሚያንሱ፥ እንደ ከንቱ ነገርም ይቈጥራቸዋል።

verses.en: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
verses.fr: A qui voulez-vous comparer Dieu? Et quelle image ferez-vous son égale?
verses.am: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔርን በማን ትመስሉታላችሁ? ወይስ በምን ምሳሌ ታስተያዩታላችሁ?

verses.en: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
verses.fr: C''est un ouvrier qui fond l''idole, Et c''est un orfèvre qui la couvre d''or, Et y soude des chaînettes d''argent.
verses.am: የተቀረጸውንስ ምስል ሠራተኛ ሠርቶታል፥ አንጥረኛም በወርቅ ለብጦታል፥ የብሩንም ሰንሰለት አፍስሶለታል።

verses.en: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.
verses.fr: Celui que la pauvreté oblige à donner peu Choisit un bois qui résiste à la vermoulure; Il se procure un ouvrier capable, Pour faire une idole qui ne branle pas.
verses.am: ለዚህ መባዕ ገንዘቡ ያልበቃው ድሀ የማይነቅዘውን እንጨት ይመርጣል፤ ምስሉም እንዳይናወጥ ያቆመው ዘንድ ብልህ ሠራተኛን ይፈልጋል።

verses.en: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.fr: Ne le savez-vous pas? ne l''avez-vous pas appris? Ne vous l''a-t-on pas fait connaître dès le commencement? N''avez-vous jamais réfléchi à la fondation de la terre?
verses.am: አላወቃችሁምን? ወይስ አልሰማችሁምን? ከጥንትስ አልተወራላችሁምን? ወይስ ምድር ከተመሠረተች ጀምሮ አላስተዋላችሁምን?

verses.en: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
verses.fr: C''est lui qui est assis au-dessus du cercle de la terre, Et ceux qui l''habitent sont comme des sauterelles; Il étend les cieux comme une étoffe légère, Il les déploie comme une tente, pour en faire sa demeure.
verses.am: እርሱ በምድር ክበብ ላይ ይቀምጣል፥ በእርስዋም የሚኖሩት እንደ አንበጣ ናቸው፤ ሰማያትን እንደ መጋረጃ የሚዘረጋቸው እንደ ድንኳንም ለመኖርያ የሚዘረጋቸው፥

verses.en: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
verses.fr: C''est lui qui réduit les princes au néant, Et qui fait des juges de la terre une vanité;
verses.am: አለቆችንም እንዳልነበሩ፥ የምድርንም ፈራጆች እንደ ከንቱ ነገር የሚያደርጋቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
verses.fr: Ils ne sont pas même plantés, pas même semés, Leur tronc n''a pas même de racine en terre: Il souffle sur eux, et ils se dessèchent, Et un tourbillon les emporte comme le chaume.
verses.am: ገና እንደ ተተከሉና እንደ ተዘሩ፥ በምድርም ሥር ገና እንደ ሰደዱ ወዲያውኑ ነፈሰባቸው፥ እነርሱም ደረቁ፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስም እንደ እብቅ ጠረጋቸው።

verses.en: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.
verses.fr: A qui me comparerez-vous, pour que je lui ressemble? Dit le Saint.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እተካከለው ዘንድ በማን መሰላችሁኝ? ይላል ቅዱሱ።

verses.en: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.
verses.fr: Levez vos yeux en haut, et regardez! Qui a créé ces choses? Qui fait marcher en ordre leur armée? Il les appelle toutes par leur nom; Par son grand pouvoir et par sa force puissante, Il n''en est pas une qui fasse défaut.
verses.am: ዓይናችሁን ወደ ላይ አንሥታችሁ ተመልከቱ፤ እነዚህን የፈጠረ ማን ነው? ሠራዊታቸውን በቍጥር የሚያወጣ እርሱ ነው፥ ሁሉንም በየስማቸው ይጠራቸዋል፤ በኃይሉ ብዛትና በችሎቱ ብርታት አንድስ እንኳ አይታጣውም።

verses.en: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the Lord, and my judgment is passed over from my God?
verses.fr: Pourquoi dis-tu, Jacob, Pourquoi dis-tu, Israël: Ma destinée est cachée devant l''Eternel, Mon droit passe inaperçu devant mon Dieu?
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ እስራኤልም ሆይ። መንገዴ ከእግዚአብሔር ተሰውራለች ፍርዴም ከአምላኬ አልፋለች ለምን ትላለህ? ለምንስ እንዲህ ትናገራለህ?

verses.en: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the Lord, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
verses.fr: Ne le sais-tu pas? ne l''as-tu pas appris? C''est le Dieu d''éternité, l''Eternel, Qui a créé les extrémités de la terre; Il ne se fatigue point, il ne se lasse point; On ne peut sonder son intelligence.
verses.am: አላወቅህምን? አልሰማህምን? እግዚአብሔር የዘላለም አምላክ፥ የምድርም ዳርቻ ፈጣሪ ነው፤ አይደክምም፥ አይታክትም፥ ማስተዋሉም አይመረመርም።

verses.en: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
verses.fr: Il donne de la force à celui qui est fatigué, Et il augmente la vigueur de celui qui tombe en défaillance.
verses.am: ለደካማ ኃይልን ይሰጣል፥ ጕልበት ለሌለውም ብርታትን ይጨምራል።

verses.en: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
verses.fr: Les adolescents se fatiguent et se lassent, Et les jeunes hommes chancellent;
verses.am: ብላቴኖች ይደክማሉ ይታክቱማል፥ ጐበዛዝቱም ፈጽሞ ይወድቃሉ፤

verses.en: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.fr: Mais ceux qui se confient en l''Eternel renouvellent leur force. Ils prennent le vol comme les aigles; Ils courent, et ne se lassent point, Ils marchent, et ne se fatiguent point.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በመተማመን የሚጠባበቁ ግን ኃይላቸውን ያድሳሉ፤ እንደ ንስር በክንፍ ይወጣሉ፤ ይሮጣሉ፥ አይታክቱም፤ ይሄዳሉ፥ አይደክሙም።

verses.en: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
verses.fr: Iles, faites silence pour m''écouter! Que les peuples raniment leur force, Qu''ils avancent, et qu''ils parlent! Approchons pour plaider ensemble.
verses.am: ደሴቶች ሆይ፥ በፊቴ ዝም በሉ፤ አሕዛብም ኃይላቸውን ያድሱ፤ ይቅረቡም በዚያን ጊዜም ይናገሩ፤ ለፍርድ ለአንድነት እንቅረብ።

verses.en: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.
verses.fr: Qui a suscité de l''orient Celui que le salut appelle à sa suite? Qui lui a livré les nations et assujetti des rois? Qui a réduit leur glaive en poussière, Et leur arc en un chaume qui s''envole?
verses.am: ከምሥራቅ አንዱን ያስነሣ በጽድቅም ወደ እግሩ የተጠራው ማን ነው? አሕዛብንም አሳልፎ በፊቱ ሰጠው፥ ነገሥታትንም አስገዛለት፤ ለሰይፉ እንደ ትቢያ ለቀስቱም እንደ ተጠረገ እብቅ አድርጎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.
verses.fr: Il s''est mis à leur poursuite, il a parcouru avec bonheur Un chemin que son pied n''avait jamais foulé.
verses.am: አሳደዳቸው፥ እግሮቹም አስቀድመው ባልሄዱባት መንገድ በደኅነት አለፈ።

verses.en: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the Lord, the first, and with the last; I am he.
verses.fr: Qui a fait et exécuté ces choses? C''est celui qui a appelé les générations dès le commencement, Moi, l''Eternel, le premier Et le même jusqu''aux derniers âges.
verses.am: ይህን የሠራና ያደረገ፥ ትውልድንም ከጥንት የጠራ ማን ነው? እኔ እግዚአብሔር፥ ፊተኛው በኋላኞችም ዘንድ የምኖር እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
verses.fr: Les îles le voient, et sont dans la crainte, Les extrémités de la terre tremblent: Ils s''approchent, ils viennent.
