verses.am: ደሴቶች አይተው ፈሩ፥ የምድርም ዳርቾች ተንቀጠቀጡ፤ ቀረቡም ደረሱም።

verses.en: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
verses.fr: Ils s''aident l''un l''autre, Et chacun dit à son frère: Courage!
verses.am: ሁሉም እያንዳንዱ ባልንጀራውን ይረዳው ነበር፥ ወንድሙንም። አይዞህ ይለው ነበር።

verses.en: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
verses.fr: Le sculpteur encourage le fondeur; Celui qui polit au marteau encourage celui qui frappe sur l''enclume; Il dit de la soudure: Elle est bonne! Et il fixe l''idole avec des clous, pour qu''elle ne branle pas.
verses.am: አናጢውም አንጥረኛውን፥ በመዶሻም የሚያሳሳውን መስፍ መችውን አጽናና፥ ስለ ማጣበቅ ሥራውም። መልካም ነው አለ፤ እንዳይንቀሳቀስም በችንካር አጋጠመው።

verses.en: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.
verses.fr: Mais toi, Israël, mon serviteur, Jacob, que j''ai choisi, Race d''Abraham que j''ai aimé!
verses.am: ባሪያዬ እስራኤል፥ የመረጥሁህ ያዕቆብ፥ የወዳጄ የአብርሃም ዘር ሆይ፥

verses.en: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.
verses.fr: Toi, que j''ai pris aux extrémités de la terre, Et que j''ai appelé d''une contrée lointaine, A qui j''ai dit: Tu es mon serviteur, Je te choisis, et ne te rejette point!
verses.am: አንተ ከምድር ዳርቻ የያዝሁህ ከማዕዘንዋም የጠራሁህና። አንተ ባሪያዬ ነህ፥ መርጬሃለሁ አልጥልህም ያልሁህ ሆይ፥

verses.en: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
verses.fr: Ne crains rien, car je suis avec toi; Ne promène pas des regards inquiets, car je suis ton Dieu; Je te fortifie, je viens à ton secours, Je te soutiens de ma droite triomphante.
verses.am: እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና አትፍራ፤ እኔ አምላክህ ነኝና አትደንግጥ፤ አበረታሃለሁ፥ እረዳህማለሁ፥ በጽድቄም ቀኝ ደግፌ እይዝሃለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.
verses.fr: Voici, ils seront confondus, ils seront couverts de honte, Tous ceux qui sont irrités contre toi; Ils seront réduits à rien, ils périront, Ceux qui disputent contre toi.
verses.am: እነሆ የሚቆጡህ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ፥ ይዋረዱማል፤ የሚከራከሩህም እንዳልነበሩ ይሆናሉ፥ ይጠፉማል።

verses.en: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
verses.fr: Tu les chercheras, et ne les trouveras plus, Ceux qui te suscitaient querelle; Ils seront réduits à rien, réduits au néant, Ceux qui te faisaient la guerre.
verses.am: የሚያጣሉህንም ትሻቸዋለህ አታገኛቸውምም፥ የሚዋጉህም እንዳልነበሩና እንደ ምናምን ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
verses.fr: Car je suis l''Eternel, ton Dieu, Qui fortifie ta droite, Qui te dis: Ne crains rien, Je viens à ton secours.
verses.am: እኔ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር። አትፍራ፥ እረዳሃለሁ ብዬ ቀኝህን እይዛለሁና።

verses.en: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: Ne crains rien, vermisseau de Jacob, Faible reste d''Israël; Je viens à ton secours, dit l''Eternel, Et le Saint d''Israël est ton sauveur.
verses.am: አንተ ትል ያዕቆብ የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ሆይ፥ አትፍሩ፤ እረዳሃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የሚቤዥህም የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ነው።

verses.en: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.
verses.fr: Voici, je fais de toi un traîneau aigu, tout neuf, Garni de pointes; Tu écraseras, tu broieras les montagnes, Et tu rendras les collines semblables à de la balle.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እንደ ተሳለች እንደ አዲስ ባለ ጥርስ ማሄጃ አድርጌሃለሁ፤ ተራሮችንም ታሄዳለህ ታደቅቃቸውማለህ፥ ኮረብቶችንም እንደ ገለባ ታደርጋቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the Lord, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: Tu les vanneras, et le vent les emportera, Et un tourbillon les dispersera. Mais toi, tu te réjouiras en l''Eternel, Tu mettras ta gloire dans le Saint d''Israël.
verses.am: ታበጥራቸዋለህ፥ ነፋስም ይጠርጋቸዋል፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ይበትናቸዋል፤ አንተም በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይልሃል፥ በእስራኤልም ቅዱስ ትመካለህ።

verses.en: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the Lord will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
verses.fr: Les malheureux et les indigents cherchent de l''eau, et il n''y en a point; Leur langue est desséchée par la soif. Moi, l''Eternel, je les exaucerai; Moi, le Dieu d''Israël, je ne les abandonnerai pas.
verses.am: ድሆችና ምስኪኖችም ውኃ ይሻሉ አያገኙምም፥ ምላሳቸውም በጥማት ደርቋል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እሰማቸዋለሁ፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ እኔ አልተዋቸውም።

verses.en: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
verses.fr: Je ferai jaillir des fleuves sur les collines, Et des sources au milieu des vallées; Je changerai le désert en étang, Et la terre aride en courants d''eau;
verses.am: በወናዎቹ ኮረብቶች ላይ ወንዞችን፥ በሸለቆችም መካከል ምንጮችን እከፍታለሁ፤ ምድረ በዳውን ለውኃ መቆሚያ፥ የጥማትንም ምድር ለውኃ መፍለቂያ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:
verses.fr: Je mettrai dans le désert le cèdre, l''acacia, Le myrte et l''olivier; Je mettrai dans les lieux stériles Le cyprès, l''orme et le buis, tous ensemble;
verses.am: ክርክራችሁን አቅርቡ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ማስረጃችሁን አምጡ፥ ይላል የያዕቆብ ንጉሥ።

verses.en: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the Lord hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
verses.fr: Afin qu''ils voient, qu''ils sachent, Qu''ils observent et considèrent Que la main de l''Eternel a fait ces choses, Que le Saint d''Israël en est l''auteur.
verses.am: ክርክራችሁን አቅርቡ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ማስረጃችሁን አምጡ፥ ይላል የያዕቆብ ንጉሥ።

verses.en: Produce your cause, saith the Lord; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.
verses.fr: Plaidez votre cause, Dit l''Eternel; Produisez vos moyens de défense, Dit le roi de Jacob.
verses.am: ያምጡ፥ የሚሆነውንም ይንገሩን፤ ልብም እናደርግ ዘንድ ፍጻሜአቸውንም እናውቅ ዘንድ፥ የቀደሙት ነገሮች ምን እንደ ሆኑ ተናገሩ፥ የሚመጡትንም አሳዩን።

verses.en: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
verses.fr: Qu''ils les produisent, et qu''ils nous déclarent Ce qui doit arriver. Quelles sont les prédictions que jadis vous avez faites? Dites-le, pour que nous y prenions garde, Et que nous en reconnaissions l''accomplissement; Ou bien, annoncez-nous l''avenir.
verses.am: አማልክትም መሆናችሁን እናውቅ ዘንድ በኋላ የሚመጡትን ተናገሩ፤ እንደነግጥም ዘንድ በአንድነትም እናይ ዘንድ መልካሙን ወይም ክፉውን አድርጉ።

verses.en: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.
verses.fr: Dites ce qui arrivera plus tard, Pour que nous sachions si vous êtes des dieux; Faites seulement quelque chose de bien ou de mal, Pour que nous le voyions et le regardions ensemble.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እንዳልነበረ ናችሁ፥ ሥራችሁም ከንቱ ነው፤ የሚመርጣችሁም አስጻያፊ ነው።

verses.en: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.
verses.fr: Voici, vous n''êtes rien, Et votre oeuvre est le néant; C''est une abomination que de se complaire en vous.
verses.am: አንዱን ከሰሜን አነሣሁ መጥቶአልም፤ አንዱም ከፀሐይ መውጫ ስሜን የሚጠራ ይመጣል፤ በጭቃ ላይ እንደሚመጣ ሰው አፈርም እንደሚረግጥ ሸክለኛ በአለቆች ላይ ይመጣል።

verses.en: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.
verses.fr: Je l''ai suscité du septentrion, et il est venu; De l''orient, il invoque mon nom; Il foule les puissants comme de la boue, Comme de l''argile que foule un potier.
verses.am: እናውቅ ዘንድ ከጥንት የተናገረው። እውነት ነው እንልም ዘንድ ቀድሞ የተናገረው ማን ነው? የሚናገር የለም፥ የሚገልጥም የለም፥ ቃላችሁንም የሚሰማ የለም።

verses.en: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.
verses.fr: Qui l''a annoncé dès le commencement, pour que nous le sachions, Et longtemps d''avance, pour que nous disions: C''est vrai? Nul ne l''a annoncé, nul ne l''a prédit, Et personne n''a entendu vos paroles.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያ ለጽዮን። እነኋቸው እላለሁ፤ ለኢየሩሳሌምም የምስራች ነጋሪን እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.
verses.fr: C''est moi le premier qui ai dit à Sion: Les voici, les voici! Et à Jérusalem: J''envoie un messager de bonnes nouvelles!
verses.am: ብመለከት ማንም አልነበረም፤ ብጠይቃቸውም የሚመልስልኝ አማካሪ በመካከላቸው የለም።

verses.en: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
verses.fr: Je regarde, et il n''y a personne, Personne parmi eux qui prophétise, Et qui puisse répondre, si je l''interroge.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እነርሱ ሁሉ ከንቱዎች ናቸው፥ ሥራቸውም ምንምን ናት፤ ቀልጠው የተሠሩት ምስሎቻቸውም ነፋስና ኢምንት ናቸው።

verses.en: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.
verses.fr: Voici, ils ne sont tous que vanité, Leurs oeuvres ne sont que néant, Leurs idoles ne sont qu''un vain souffle.
verses.am: ፤ እነሆ፥ እነርሱ ሁሉ ከንቱዎች ናቸው፥ ሥራቸውም ምንምን ናት፤ ቀልጠው የተሠሩት ምስሎቻቸውም ነፋስና ኢምንት ናቸው።

verses.en: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.fr: Voici mon serviteur, que je soutiendrai, Mon élu, en qui mon âme prend plaisir. J''ai mis mon esprit sur lui; Il annoncera la justice aux nations.
verses.am: እነሆ ደግፌ የያዝሁት ባሪያዬ፤ ነፍሴ ደስ የተሰኘችበት ምርጤ፤ በእርሱ ላይ መንፈሴን አድርጌአለሁ፥ እርሱም ለአሕዛብ ፍርድን ያወጣል።

verses.en: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
verses.fr: Il ne criera point, il n''élèvera point la voix, Et ne la fera point entendre dans les rues.
verses.am: አይጮኽም ቃሉንም አያነሣም፥ ድምፁንም በሜዳ አያሰማም።

verses.en: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
verses.fr: Il ne brisera point le roseau cassé, Et il n''éteindra point la mèche qui brûle encore; Il annoncera la justice selon la vérité.
verses.am: የተቀጠቀጠን ሸምበቆ አይሰብርም፥ የሚጤስንም ክር አያጠፋም፤ በእውነት ፍርድን ያወጣል።

verses.en: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
verses.fr: Il ne se découragera point et ne se relâchera point, Jusqu''à ce qu''il ait établi la justice sur la terre, Et que les îles espèrent en sa loi.
verses.am: በምድርም ፍርድን እስኪያደርግ ድረስ ይበራል እንጂ አይጠፋም፤ አሕዛብም በስሙ ይታመናሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith God the Lord, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle Dieu, l''Eternel, Qui a créé les cieux et qui les a déployés, Qui a étendu la terre et ses productions, Qui a donné la respiration à ceux qui la peuplent, Et le souffle à ceux qui y marchent.
verses.am: ሰማያትን የፈጠረ የዘረጋቸውም፥ ምድርንና በውስጥዋ ያለውን ያጸና፥ በእርስዋ ላይ ለሚኖሩ ሕዝብ እስትንፋስን፥ ለሚሄዱባትም መንፈስን የሚሰጥ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: I the Lord have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
verses.fr: Moi, l''Eternel, je t''ai appelé pour le salut, Et je te prendrai par la main, Je te garderai, et je t''établirai pour traiter alliance avec le peuple, Pour être la lumière des nations,
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር በጽድቅ ጠርቼሃለሁ፥ እጅህንም እይዛለሁ እጠብቅህማለሁ፥ የዕውሩንም ዓይን ትከፍት ዘንድ የተጋዘውንም ከግዞት ቤት በጨለማም የተቀመጡትን ከወህኒ ቤት ታወጣ ዘንድ ለሕዝብ ቃል ኪዳን ለአሕዛብም ብርሃን አድርጌ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
verses.fr: Pour ouvrir les yeux des aveugles, Pour faire sortir de prison le captif, Et de leur cachot ceux qui habitent dans les ténèbres.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር በጽድቅ ጠርቼሃለሁ፥ እጅህንም እይዛለሁ እጠብቅህማለሁ፥ የዕውሩንም ዓይን ትከፍት ዘንድ የተጋዘውንም ከግዞት ቤት በጨለማም የተቀመጡትን ከወህኒ ቤት ታወጣ ዘንድ ለሕዝብ ቃል ኪዳን ለአሕዛብም ብርሃን አድርጌ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: I am the Lord: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
verses.fr: Je suis l''Eternel, c''est là mon nom; Et je ne donnerai pas ma gloire à un autre, Ni mon honneur aux idoles.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ ስሜ ይህ ነው፤ ክብሬን ለሌላ፥ ምስጋናዬንም ለተቀረጹ ምስሎች አልሰጥም።

verses.en: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
verses.fr: Voici, les premières choses se sont accomplies, Et je vous en annonce de nouvelles; Avant qu''elles arrivent, je vous les prédis.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የቀድሞው ነገር ተፈጸመ፥ አዲስ ነገርንም እናገራለሁ፤ አስቀድሞም ሳይበቅል እርሱን አስታውቃችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.fr: Chantez à l''Eternel un cantique nouveau, Chantez ses louanges aux extrémités de la terre, Vous qui voguez sur la mer et vous qui la peuplez, Iles et habitants des îles!
verses.am: ወደ ባሕር የምትወርዱ በእርስዋም ውስጥ ያላችሁ ሁሉ፥ ደሴቶችና በእነርሱም ላይ የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር አዲስ መዝሙር፥ ከምድርም ዳርቻ ምስጋናውን ዘምሩ።

verses.en: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.fr: Que le désert et ses villes élèvent la voix! Que les villages occupés par Kédar élèvent la voix! Que les habitants des rochers tressaillent d''allégresse! Que du sommet des montagnes retentissent des cris de joie!
verses.am: ምድረ በዳውና ከተሞቹ የቄዳርም ሰዎች የሚቀመጡባቸው መንደሮች ድምፃቸውን ያንሡ፤ በሴላ የሚኖሩ እልል ይበሉ፥ በተራሮችም ራስ ላይ ሆነው ይጩኹ።

verses.en: Let them give glory unto the Lord, and declare his praise in the islands.
verses.fr: Qu''on rende gloire à l''Eternel, Et que dans les îles on publie ses louanges!
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ክብርን ይስጡ፥ ምስጋናውንም በደሴቶች ይናገሩ።

verses.en: The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
verses.fr: L''Eternel s''avance comme un héros, Il excite son ardeur comme un homme de guerre; Il élève la voix, il jette des cris, Il manifeste sa force contre ses ennemis.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ኃያል ይወጣል እንደ ሰልፈኛም ቅንዓትን ያስነሣል፤ ይጮኻል ድምፁንም ያሰማል በጠላቶቹም ላይ ይበረታል።

verses.en: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
verses.fr: J''ai longtemps gardé le silence, je me suis tu, je me suis contenu; Je crierai comme une femme en travail, Je serai haletant et je soufflerai tout à la fois.
verses.am: ከድሮ ዘመን ጀምሮ ዝም ብያለሁ፥ ዝም ብዬም ታግሻለሁ፤ አሁን ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት እጮኻለሁ፤ አጠፋለሁ በአንድነትም እጨርሳለሁ።

verses.en: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
verses.fr: Je ravagerai montagnes et collines, Et j''en dessécherai toute la verdure; Je changerai les fleuves en terre ferme, Et je mettrai les étangs à sec.
verses.am: ተራሮችንና ኮረብቶችን አፈርሳለሁ፥ ቡቃያዎቻቸውንም ሁሉ አደርቃለሁ፤ ወንዞችንም ደሴቶች አደርጋለሁ፥ ኵሬዎችንም አደርቃለሁ።

verses.en: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
verses.fr: Je ferai marcher les aveugles sur un chemin qu''ils ne connaissent pas, Je les conduirai par des sentiers qu''ils ignorent; Je changerai devant eux les ténèbres en lumière, Et les endroits tortueux en plaine: Voilà ce que je ferai, et je ne les abandonnerai point.
verses.am: ዕውሮችንም በማያውቋት መንገድ አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ በማያውቋትም ጎዳና እመራቸዋለሁ፤ በፊታቸውም ጨለማውን ብርሃን አደርጋለሁ፥ ጠማማውንም አቀናለሁ። ይህን አደርግላቸዋለሁ፥ አልተዋቸውምም።

verses.en: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.
verses.fr: Ils reculeront, ils seront confus, Ceux qui se confient aux idoles taillées, Ceux qui disent aux idoles de fonte: Vous êtes nos dieux!
verses.am: በተቀረጹትም ምስሎች የሚታመኑ፥ ቀልጠው የተሠሩትንም ምስሎች። አምላኮቻችን ናችሁ የሚሉ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሳሉ ፈጽመውም ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
verses.fr: Sourds, écoutez! Aveugles, regardez et voyez!
verses.am: እናንተ ደንቆሮች፥ ስሙ፤ እናንተም ዕውሮች፥ ታዩ ዘንድ ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the Lord's servant?
verses.fr: Qui est aveugle, sinon mon serviteur, Et sourd comme mon messager que j''envoie? Qui est aveugle, comme l''ami de Dieu, Aveugle comme le serviteur de l''Eternel?
verses.am: ከባሪያዬ በቀር ዕውር ማን ነው? እንደምልከው መልእክተኛዬስ በቀር ደንቆሮ የሆነ ማን ነው? እንደ ፍጹሙ ወይስ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ዕውር የሆነ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.
verses.fr: Tu as vu beaucoup de choses, mais tu n''y as point pris garde; On a ouvert les oreilles, mais on n''a point entendu.
verses.am: ብዙ ነገርን ታያላችሁ ነገር ግን አትጠባበቁትም፤ ጆሮአችሁም ተከፍተዋል፥ ነገር ግን አትሰሙም።

verses.en: The Lord is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a voulu, pour le bonheur d''Israël, Publier une loi grande et magnifique.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ጽድቁ ሕጉን ታላቅ ያደርግና ያከብር ዘንድ ወደደ።

verses.en: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.
verses.fr: Et c''est un peuple pillé et dépouillé! On les a tous enchaînés dans des cavernes, Plongés dans des cachots; Ils ont été mis au pillage, et personne qui les délivre! Dépouillés, et personne qui dise: Restitue!
verses.am: ይህ ግን የተበዘበዘና የተዘረፈ ሕዝብ ነው፤ ሁላቸው በዋሻ ውስጥ ተጠምደዋል በግዞት ቤትም ተሸሽገዋል፤ ብዝበዛ ሆነዋል የሚያድንም የለም፥ ምርኮም ሆነዋል፥ ማንም። መልሱ አይልም።

verses.en: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
verses.fr: Qui parmi vous prêtera l''oreille à ces choses? Qui voudra s''y rendre attentif et écouter à l''avenir?
verses.am: ከመካከላችሁ ይህን የሚያደምጥ፥ ለሚመጣውም ጊዜ የሚያደምጥና የሚሰማ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the Lord, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
verses.fr: Qui a livré Jacob au pillage, Et Israël aux pillards? N''est-ce pas l''Eternel? Nous avons péché contre lui. Ils n''ont point voulu marcher dans ses voies, Et ils n''ont point écouté sa loi.
verses.am: ያዕቆብን ለማረኩ እስራኤልንም ለበዘበዙ ሰዎች የሰጠ ማን ነው? እኛ የበደልነው፥ እነርሱም በመንገዱ ይሄዱ ዘንድ ያልወደዱት ለሕጉም ያልታዘዙለት እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
verses.fr: Aussi a-t-il versé sur Israël l''ardeur de sa colère Et la violence de la guerre; La guerre l''a embrasé de toutes parts, et il n''a point compris; Elle l''a consumé, et il n''y a point pris garde.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የቍጣውን መዓትና የሰልፉን ጽናት አፈሰሰበት፤ በዙሪያም አነደደው እርሱ ግን አላወቀም፥ አቃጠለውም እርሱ ግን ልብ አላደረገም።

verses.en: But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle maintenant l''Eternel, qui t''a créé, ô Jacob! Celui qui t''a formé, ô Israël! Ne crains rien, car je te rachète, Je t''appelle par ton nom: tu es à moi!
verses.am: አሁንም ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ የፈጠረህ፥ እስራኤልም ሆይ፥ የሠራህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ተቤዥቼሃለሁና አትፍራ፤ በስምህም ጠርቼሃለሁ፥ አንተ የእኔ ነህ።

verses.en: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
verses.fr: Si tu traverses les eaux, je serai avec toi; Et les fleuves, ils ne te submergeront point; Si tu marches dans le feu, tu ne te brûleras pas, Et la flamme ne t''embrasera pas.
verses.am: በውኃ ውስጥ ባለፍህ ጊዜ ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ፥ በወንዞችም ውስጥ ባለፍህ ጊዜ አያሰጥሙህም፤ በእሳትም ውስጥ በሄድህ ጊዜ አትቃጠልም፥ ነበልባሉም አይፈጅህም።

verses.en: For I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
verses.fr: Car je suis l''Eternel, ton Dieu, Le Saint d''Israël, ton sauveur; Je donne l''Egypte pour ta rançon, L''Ethiopie et Saba à ta place.
verses.am: እኔ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር መድኃኒትህ ነኝ፤ ግብጽን ለአንተ ቤዛ አድርጌ፥ ኢትዮጵያንና ሳባንም ለአንተ ፋንታ ሰጥቻለሁ።

verses.en: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
verses.fr: Parce que tu as du prix à mes yeux, Parce que tu es honoré et que je t''aime, Je donne des hommes à ta place, Et des peuples pour ta vie.
verses.am: በዓይኔ ፊት የከበርህና የተመሰገንህ ነህና፥ እኔም ወድጄሃለሁና ስለዚህ ሰዎችን ለአንተ አሕዛብንም ለነፍስህ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
verses.fr: Ne crains rien, car je suis avec toi; Je ramènerai de l''orient ta race, Et je te rassemblerai de l''occident.
verses.am: እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና አትፍራ፤ ዘርህንም ከምሥራቅ አመጣዋለሁ፥ ከምዕራብም እሰበስብሃለሁ።

verses.en: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
verses.fr: Je dirai au septentrion: Donne! Et au midi: Ne retiens point! Fais venir mes fils des pays lointains, Et mes filles de l''extrémité de la terre,
verses.am: ሰሜንን። መልሰህ አምጣ፥ ደቡብንም። አትከልክል፤ ወንዶች ልጆቼን ከሩቅ ሴቶች ልጆቼንም ከምድር ዳርቻ፥ በስሜ የተጠራውን ለክብሬም የፈጠርሁትን፥ የሠራሁትንና ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ አምጣ እለዋለሁ።

verses.en: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui s''appellent de mon nom, Et que j''ai créés pour ma gloire, Que j''ai formés et que j''ai faits.
verses.am: ሰሜንን። መልሰህ አምጣ፥ ደቡብንም። አትከልክል፤ ወንዶች ልጆቼን ከሩቅ ሴቶች ልጆቼንም ከምድር ዳርቻ፥ በስሜ የተጠራውን ለክብሬም የፈጠርሁትን፥ የሠራሁትንና ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ አምጣ እለዋለሁ።

verses.en: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
verses.fr: Qu''on fasse sortir le peuple aveugle, qui a des yeux, Et les sourds, qui ont des oreilles.
verses.am: ዓይኖች ያሉአቸውን ዕውሮችን ሕዝብ፥ ጆሮችም ያሉአቸውን ደንቆሮቹን አውጣ።

verses.en: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
verses.fr: Que toutes les nations se rassemblent, Et que les peuples se réunissent. Qui d''entre eux a annoncé ces choses? Lesquels nous ont fait entendre les premières prédictions? Qu''ils produisent leurs témoins et établissent leur droit; Qu''on écoute et qu''on dise: C''est vrai!
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሁሉ በአንድነት ይሰብሰቡ ወገኖችም ይከማቹ፤ ከመካከላቸው፤ ይህን የሚናገር፥ የቀድሞውንስ ነገር የሚያሳየን ማን ነው? ይጸድቁ ዘንድ ምስክሮቻቸውን ያምጡ፥ ሰምተውም እውነት ነው ይበሉ።

verses.en: Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
verses.fr: Vous êtes mes témoins, dit l''Eternel, Vous, et mon serviteur que j''ai choisi, Afin que vous le sachiez, Que vous me croyiez et compreniez que c''est moi: Avant moi il n''a point été formé de Dieu, Et après moi il n''y en aura point.
verses.am: ታውቁና ታምኑብኝ ዘንድ እኔም እንደሆንሁ ታስተውሉ ዘንድ፥ እናንተ የመረጥሁትም ባሪያዬ ምስክሮቼ ናችሁ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከእኔ በፊት አምላክ አልተሠራም ከእኔም በኋላ አይሆንም።

verses.en: I, even I, am the Lord; and beside me there is no saviour.
verses.fr: C''est moi, moi qui suis l''Eternel, Et hors moi il n''y a point de sauveur.
verses.am: እኔ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፥ ከእኔ ሌላም የሚያድን የለም።

verses.en: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, that I am God.
verses.fr: C''est moi qui ai annoncé, sauvé, prédit, Ce n''est point parmi vous un dieu étranger; Vous êtes mes témoins, dit l''Eternel, C''est moi qui suis Dieu.
verses.am: ተናግሬአለሁ አድኜማለሁ አሳይቼማለሁ፥ በእናንተም ዘንድ ባዕድ አምላክ አልነበረም፤ ስለዚህ እናንተ ምስክሮቼ ናችሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እኔም አምላክ ነኝ።

verses.en: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
verses.fr: Je le suis dès le commencement, Et nul ne délivre de ma main; J''agirai: qui s''y opposera?
verses.am: ከጥንት ጀምሮ እኔ ነኝ ከእጄም የሚያመልጥ የለም፤ እሠራለሁ፥ የሚከለክልስ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, Votre rédempteur, le Saint d''Israël: A cause de vous, j''envoie l''ennemi contre Babylone, Et je fais descendre tous les fuyards, Même les Chaldéens, sur les navires dont ils tiraient gloire.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቅዱስ፥ የሚቤዣችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ እናንተ ወደ ባቢሎን ሰድጃለሁ፥ ከለዳውያንንም ሁሉ ስደተኞች አድርጌ በሚመኩባቸው መርከቦች አዋርዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: I am the Lord, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
verses.fr: Je suis l''Eternel, votre Saint, Le créateur d''Israël, votre roi.
verses.am: ቅዱሳችሁ፥ የእስራኤል ፈጣሪ፥ ንጉሣችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, Qui fraya dans la mer un chemin, Et dans les eaux puissantes un sentier,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በባሕር ውስጥ መንገድን በኃይለኛም ውኃ ውስጥ መተላለፊያን ያደርጋል፤

verses.en: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
verses.fr: Qui mit en campagne des chars et des chevaux, Une armée et de vaillants guerriers, Soudain couchés ensemble, pour ne plus se relever, Anéantis, éteints comme une mèche:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሰረገላውንና ፈረሱን ሠራዊቱንና አርበኛውን ያወጣል፤ እነርሱ ግን በአንድነት ተኝተዋል፥ አይነሡም፤ ቀርተዋል፥ እንደ ጥዋፍ ኩስታሪም ጠፍተዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
verses.fr: Ne pensez plus aux événements passés, Et ne considérez plus ce qui est ancien.
verses.am: የፊተኛውን ነገር አታስተውሉ፥ የጥንቱንም ነገር አታስቡ።

verses.en: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.fr: Voici, je vais faire une chose nouvelle, sur le point d''arriver: Ne la connaîtrez-vous pas? Je mettrai un chemin dans le désert, Et des fleuves dans la solitude.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አዲስ ነገርን አደርጋለህ፤ እርሱም አሁን ይበቅላል፥ እናንተም አታውቁትምን? በምድረ በዳም መንገድን በበረሀም ወንዞችን አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
verses.fr: Les bêtes des champs me glorifieront, Les chacals et les autruches, Parce que j''aurai mis des eaux dans le désert, Des fleuves dans la solitude, Pour abreuver mon peuple, mon élu.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ አንተ ግን አልጠራኸኝም፥ አንተም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ በእኔ ዘንድ ደክመሃል።

verses.en: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
verses.fr: Le peuple que je me suis formé Publiera mes louanges.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ አንተ ግን አልጠራኸኝም፥ አንተም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ በእኔ ዘንድ ደክመሃል።

verses.en: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
verses.fr: Et tu ne m''as pas invoqué, ô Jacob! Car tu t''es lassé de moi, ô Israël!
verses.am: ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በጎችህን አላቀረብህልኝም በሌላም መሥዋዕትህ አላከበርኸኝም፤ በእህልም ቍርባን አላስቸገርሁህም በዕጣንም አላደከምሁህም።

verses.en: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.
verses.fr: Tu ne m''as pas offert tes brebis en holocauste, Et tu ne m''as pas honoré par tes sacrifices; Je ne t''ai point tourmenté pour des offrandes, Et je ne t''ai point fatigué pour de l''encens.
verses.am: ዕጣንም በገንዘብ አልገዛህልኝም በመሥዋዕትህም ስብ አላጠገብኸኝም፤ ነገር ግን በኃጢአትህ አስቸገርኸኝ፥ በበደልህም አደከምኸኝ።

verses.en: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
verses.fr: Tu n''as pas à prix d''argent acheté pour moi des aromates, Et tu ne m''as pas rassasié de la graisse de tes sacrifices; Mais tu m''as tourmenté par tes péchés, Tu m''as fatigué par tes iniquités.
verses.am: መተላለፍህን። ስለ እኔ ስል የምደመስስ እኔ ነኝ፤ ኃጢአትህንም አላስብም።

verses.en: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
verses.fr: C''est moi, moi qui efface tes transgressions pour l''amour de moi, Et je ne me souviendrai plus de tes péchés.
verses.am: አሳስበኝ፥ በአንድነትም ሆነን እንፋረድ፤ እንድትጸድቅ ነገርህን ተናገር።

verses.en: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
verses.fr: Réveille ma mémoire, plaidons ensemble, Parle toi-même, pour te justifier.
verses.am: ፊተኛው አባትህ ኃጢአት ሠርቶአል፥ መምህሮችህም በድለውኛል።

verses.en: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
verses.fr: Ton premier père a péché, Et tes interprètes se sont rebellés contre moi.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የመቅደሱን አለቆች አረከስሁ፥ ያዕቆብንም እርግማን፥ እስራኤልንም ስድብ አደረግሁ።

verses.en: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi j''ai traité en profanes les chefs du sanctuaire, J''ai livré Jacob à la destruction, Et Israël aux outrages.
verses.am: ፤ ስለዚህ የመቅደሱን አለቆች አረከስሁ፥ ያዕቆብንም እርግማን፥ እስራኤልንም ስድብ አደረግሁ።

verses.en: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:
verses.fr: Ecoute maintenant, ô Jacob, mon serviteur! O Israël, que j''ai choisi!
verses.am: አሁንም ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ የመረጥሁህም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, qui t''a fait, Et qui t''a formé dès ta naissance, Celui qui est ton soutien: Ne crains rien, mon serviteur Jacob, Mon Israël, que j''ai choisi.
verses.am: የፈጠረህ ከማኅፀንም የሠራህ የሚረዳህም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ የመረጥሁህም ይሹሩን ሆይ፥ አትፍራ።

verses.en: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
verses.fr: Car je répandrai des eaux sur le sol altéré, Et des ruisseaux sur la terre desséchée; Je répandrai mon esprit sur ta race, Et ma bénédiction sur tes rejetons.
verses.am: በተጠማ ላይ ውኃን በደረቅም መሬት ላይ ፈሳሾችን አፈስሳለሁና፤ መንፈሴን በዘርህ ላይ በረከቴንም በልጆችህ ላይ አፈስሳለሁ፥

verses.en: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
verses.fr: Ils pousseront comme au milieu de l''herbe, Comme les saules près des courants d''eau.
verses.am: በፈሳሾችም አጠገብ እንደሚበቅሉ እንደ አኻያ ዛፎች በሣር መካከል ይበቅላሉ።

verses.en: One shall say, I am the Lord's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the Lord, and surname himself by the name of Israel.
verses.fr: Celui-ci dira: Je suis à l''Eternel; Celui-là se réclamera du nom de Jacob; Cet autre écrira de sa main: à l''Eternel! Et prononcera avec amour le nom d''Israël.
verses.am: ይህ። እኔ የእግዚአብሔር ነኝ ይላል፥ ያም በያዕቆብ ስም ይጠራል፤ ይህም። እኔ የእግዚአብሔር ነኝ ብሎ በእጁ ይጽፋል በእስራኤልም የቁልምጫ ስም ይጠራል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord the King of Israel, and his redeemer the Lord of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, roi d''Israël et son rédempteur, L''Eternel des armées: Je suis le premier et je suis le dernier, Et hors moi il n''y a point de Dieu.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥ እግዚአብሔር፥ የሚቤዥም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ ፊተኛ ነኝ እኔም ኋለኛ ነኝ፥ ከእኔ ሌላም አምላክ የለም።

verses.en: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
verses.fr: Qui a, comme moi, fait des prédictions Qu''il le déclare et me le prouve!, Depuis que j''ai fondé le peuple ancien? Qu''ils annoncent l''avenir et ce qui doit arriver!
verses.am: እንደ እኔ ያለ ማን ነው? ይነሣና ይጥራ ይናገርም፤ ከጥንት የፈጠርሁትን ሕዝብ ያዘጋጅልኝ፥ የሚመጣውም ነገር ሳይደርስ ይንገሩኝ።

verses.en: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.
verses.fr: N''ayez pas peur, et ne tremblez pas; Ne te l''ai-je pas dès longtemps annoncé et déclaré? Vous êtes mes témoins: Y a-t-il un autre Dieu que moi? Il n''y a pas d''autre rocher, je n''en connais point.
verses.am: አትፍሩ አትደንግጡም፤ ከጥንቱ ጀምሬ አልነገርኋችሁምን? ወይስ አላሳየኋችሁምን? እናንተ ምስክሮቼ ናችሁ። ከእኔ ሌላ አምላክ አለን? አምባ የለም፤ ማንንም አላውቅም።

verses.en: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
verses.fr: Ceux qui fabriquent des idoles ne sont tous que vanité, Et leurs plus belles oeuvres ne servent à rien; Elles le témoignent elles-mêmes: Elles n''ont ni la vue, ni l''intelligence, Afin qu''ils soient dans la confusion.
verses.am: የተቀረጸውን ምስል የሚሠሩ ሁሉ ከንቱዎች ናቸው፥ የወደዱትም ነገር አይረባቸውም፤ ምስክሮቻቸውም አያዩምና አያውቁም፤ ስለዚህ ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
verses.fr: Qui est-ce qui fabrique un dieu, ou fond une idole, Pour n''en retirer aucune utilité?
verses.am: አምላክን የሠራ ወይስ ለምንም የማይረባ ምስልን የቀረጸ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.
verses.fr: Voici, tous ceux qui y travaillent seront confondus, Et les ouvriers ne sont que des hommes; Qu''ils se réunissent tous, qu''ils se présentent, Et tous ensemble ils seront tremblants et couverts de honte.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ባልንጀሮቹ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ፥ ሠራተኞቹም ከሰዎች ወገን ናቸው፤ ሁላቸው ተሰብስበው ይቁሙ፤ ይፈራሉ በአንድነትም ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
verses.fr: Le forgeron fait une hache, Il travaille avec le charbon, Et il la façonne à coups de marteau; Il la forge d''un bras vigoureux; Mais a-t-il faim, le voilà sans force; Ne boit-il pas d''eau, le voilà épuisé.
verses.am: ብረት ሠሪ መጥረቢያውን ይሠራል፥ በፍምም ውስጥ ያደርገዋል፥ በመዶሻም መትቶ ቅርጽ ይሰጠዋል፥ በክንዱም ኃይል ይሠራዋል፥ እርሱም ይራባል ይደክምማል፥ ውኃም አይጠጣም ይታክትማል።

verses.en: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
verses.fr: Le charpentier étend le cordeau, Fait un tracé au crayon, Façonne le bois avec un couteau, Et marque ses dimensions avec le compas; Et il produit une figure d''homme, Une belle forme humaine, Pour qu''elle habite dans une maison.
verses.am: ጠራቢውም ገመድ ይዘረጋል በበረቅም ያመለክተዋል በመቅረጫም ይቀርጸዋል በመለኪያም ይለካዋል፤ በቤትም ውስጥ ይቀመጥ ዘንድ በሰው አምሳልና በሰው ውበት ያስመስለዋል።

verses.en: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.
verses.fr: Il se coupe des cèdres, Il prend des rouvres et des chênes, Et fait un choix parmi les arbres de la forêt; Il plante des pins, Et la pluie les fait croître.
verses.am: የዝግባን ዛፎች ይቈርጣል፤ የዞጲንና የኮምቦልን ዛፍ ይመርጣል፥ ከዱር ዛፎችም መካከል ይጠነክር ዘንድ ይተወዋል፤ የጥድንም ዛፍ ይተክላል ዝናብም ያበቅለዋል።

verses.en: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
verses.fr: Ces arbres servent à l''homme pour brûler, Il en prend et il se chauffe. Il y met aussi le feu pour cuire du pain; Et il en fait également un dieu, qu''il adore, Il en fait une idole, devant laquelle il se prosterne.
verses.am: ለሰውም ማገዶ ይሆናል፤ ከእርሱም ወስዶ ይሞቃል፥ አንድዶም እንጀራ ይጋግርበታል፤ ከእርሱም አምላክ አበጅቶ ይሰግድለታል፥ የተቀረጸውንም ምስል ሠርቶ በእርሱ ፊት ይንበረከካል።

verses.en: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
verses.fr: Il brûle au feu la moitié de son bois, Avec cette moitié il cuit de la viande, Il apprête un rôti, et se rassasie; Il se chauffe aussi, et dit: Ha! Ha! Je me chauffe, je vois la flamme!
verses.am: ግማሹን በእሳት ያቃጥላል፥ በዚያ በግማሹ ሥጋ ይበላል፥ ሥጋም ይጠብስበትና ይጠግባል፤ ይሞቃልና። እሰይ ሞቅሁ፥ እሳቱን አይቻለሁ ይላል።

verses.en: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.
verses.fr: Et avec le reste il fait un dieu, son idole, Il se prosterne devant elle, il l''adore, il l''invoque, Et s''écrie: Sauve-moi! Car tu es mon dieu!
verses.am: የቀረውንም እንጨት አምላክ አድርጎ ምስል ይቀርጽበታል፤ በፊቱም ተጐንብሶ ይሰግዳል ወደ እርሱም እየጸለየ። አምላኬ ነህና አድነኝ ይላል።

verses.en: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
verses.fr: Ils n''ont ni intelligence, ni entendement, Car on leur a fermé les yeux pour qu''ils ne voient point, Et le coeur pour qu''ils ne comprennent point.
verses.am: አያውቁም፥ አያስቡም፤ እንዳያዩ ዓይኖቻቸውን፥ እንዳያስተውሉ ልቦቻቸውን ጨፍነዋል።

verses.en: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
verses.fr: Il ne rentre pas en lui-même, Et il n''a ni l''intelligence, ni le bon sens de dire: J''en ai brûlé une moitié au feu, J''ai cuit du pain sur les charbons, J''ai rôti de la viande et je l''ai mangée; Et avec le reste je ferais une abomination! Je me prosternerais devant un morceau de bois!
verses.am: በልቡም ማንም አያስብም። ግማሽዋን በእሳት አቃጥያለሁ፥ በፍምዋም ላይ እንጀራን ጋግሬአለሁ፥ ሥጋም ጠብሼ በልቻለሁ፤ የቀረውንም አስጸያፊ ነገር አደርጋለሁን? ለዛፍስ ግንድ እሰግዳለሁን? እንዲልም እውቀትና ማስተዋል የለውም።

verses.en: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
verses.fr: Il se repaît de cendres, Son coeur abusé l''égare, Et il ne sauvera point son âme, et ne dira point: N''est-ce pas du mensonge que j''ai dans ma main?
verses.am: አመድ ይበላል፥ የተታለለ ልብ አስቶታል፥ ነፍሱን ለማዳን አይችልም፥ ወይም። በቀኝ እጄ ሐሰት አለ አይልም።

verses.en: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi de ces choses, ô Jacob! O Israël! car tu es mon serviteur; Je t''ai formé, tu es mon serviteur; Israël, je ne t''oublierai pas.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ አንተም እስራኤል፥ ባሪያዬ ነህና ይህን አስብ፤ እኔ ሠርቼሃለሁ አንተም ባሪያዬ ነህ፤ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ በእኔ ዘንድ ያልተረሳ ትሆናለህ።

verses.en: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
verses.fr: J''efface tes transgressions comme un nuage, Et tes péchés comme une nuée; Reviens à moi, Car je t''ai racheté.
verses.am: መተላለፍህን እንደ ደመና፥ ኃጢአትህንም እንደ ጭጋግ ደምስሼአለሁ፤ ተቤዥቼሃለሁና ወደ እኔ ተመለስ።

verses.en: Sing, O ye heavens; for the Lord hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
verses.fr: Cieux, réjouissez-vous! car l''Eternel a agi; Profondeurs de la terre, retentissez d''allégresse! Montagnes, éclatez en cris de joie! Vous aussi, forêts, avec tous vos arbres! Car l''Eternel a racheté Jacob, Il a manifesté sa gloire en Israël.
verses.am: ሰማያት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር አድርጎታልና ዘምሩ፤ እግዚአብሔር ያዕቆብን ተቤዥቶአልና፥ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ይከበራልና አንተ የምድር ጥልቅ ሆይ፥ ጩኽ፤ እናንተም ተራሮች አንተም ዱር በአንተም ያለ ዛፍ ሁሉ፥ እልል በሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the Lord that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, ton rédempteur, Celui qui t''a formé dès ta naissance: Moi, l''Eternel, j''ai fait toutes choses, Seul j''ai déployé les cieux, Seul j''ai étendu la terre.
verses.am: ከማኅፀን የሠራህ፥ የሚቤዥህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል ። ሁሉን የፈጠርሁ፥ ሰማያትን ለብቻዬ የዘረጋሁ ምድርንም ያጸናሁ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ፤ ከእኔ ጋር ማን ነበረ?

verses.en: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
verses.fr: J''anéantis les signes des prophètes de mensonge, Et je proclame insensés les devins; Je fais reculer les sages, Et je tourne leur science en folie.
verses.am: የሐሰተኞችን ምልክት ከንቱ አደርጋለሁ፥ ምዋርተኞችንም አሳብዳለሁ፥ ጥበበኞቹንም ወደ ኋላ እመልሳለሁ እውቀታቸውንም ስንፍና አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.en: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
verses.fr: Je confirme la parole de mon serviteur, Et j''accomplis ce que prédisent mes envoyés; Je dis de Jérusalem: Elle sera habitée, Et des villes de Juda: Elles seront rebâties; Et je relèverai leurs ruines.
verses.am: የባሪያዬን ቃል አጸናለሁ፥ የመልእክተኞቼንም ምክር እፈጽማለሁ፤ ኢየሩሳሌምን። የሰው መኖሪያ ትሆኛለሽ፥ የይሁዳንም ከተሞች። ትታነጻላችሁ ፍራሾቻችሁንም አቆማለሁ እላለሁ፤

verses.en: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
verses.fr: Je dis à l''abîme: Dessèche-toi, Je tarirai tes fleuves.
verses.am: ቀላዩንም። ደረቅ ሁን፥ ፈሳሾችህንም አደርቃለሁ እላለሁ፤

verses.en: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.
verses.fr: Je dis de Cyrus: Il est mon berger, Et il accomplira toute ma volonté; Il dira de Jérusalem: Qu''elle soit rebâtie! Et du temple: Qu''il soit fondé!
verses.am: ቂሮስንም። እርሱ እረኛዬ ነው፤ እርሱም ኢየሩሳሌምን ። ትታነጺያለሽ ቤተ መቅደስም ይመሠረታል ብሎ ፈቃዴን ሁሉ ይፈጽማል እላለሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel à son oint, à Cyrus, Qu''il tient par la main, Pour terrasser les nations devant lui, Et pour relâcher la ceinture des rois, Pour lui ouvrir les portes, Afin qu''elles ne soient plus fermées;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለቀባሁት፥ አሕዛብንም በፊቱ አስገዛ ዘንድ የነገሥታትንም ወገብ እፈታ ዘንድ፥ በሮቹም እንዳይዘጉ መዝጊያዎቹን በፊቱ እከፍት ዘንድ፥ ቀኝ እጁን ለያዝሁት ለቂሮስ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
verses.fr: Je marcherai devant toi, J''aplanirai les chemins montueux, Je romprai les portes d''airain, Et je briserai les verrous de fer.
verses.am: በፊትህ እሄዳለሁ ተራሮችንም ትክክል አደርጋለሁ፥ የናሱንም ደጆች እሰብራለሁ የብረቱንም መወርወሪያዎች እቈርጣለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.
verses.fr: Je te donnerai des trésors cachés, Des richesses enfouies, Afin que tu saches Que je suis l''Eternel qui t''appelle par ton nom, Le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: በስምህም የምጠራህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቅ ዘንድ በጨለማ የነበረችውን መዝገብ በስውርም የተደበቀችውን ሀብት እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
verses.fr: Pour l''amour de mon serviteur Jacob, Et d''Israël, mon élu, Je t''ai appelé par ton nom, Je t''ai parlé avec bienveillance, avant que tu me connusses.
verses.am: ስለ ባሪያዬ ስለ ያዕቆብ፥ ስለ መረጥሁትም ስለ እስራኤል ብዬ በስምህ ጠርቼሃለሁ፤ በቍልምጫ ስምህ ጠራሁህ፥ አንተ ግን አላወቅኸኝም።

verses.en: I am the Lord, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
verses.fr: Je suis l''Eternel, et il n''y en a point d''autre, Hors moi il n''y a point de Dieu; Je t''ai ceint, avant que tu me connusses.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ ከእኔም ሌላ ማንም የለም፤ ከእኔም በቀር አምላክ የለም፤ በፀሐይ መውጫና በምዕራብ ያሉ ከእኔ በቀር ማንም ሌላ እንደሌለ ያውቁ ዘንድ አስታጠቅሁህ፥ አንተ ግን አላወቅኸኝም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፥ ከእኔም ሌላ ማንም የለም።

verses.en: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the Lord, and there is none else.
verses.fr: C''est afin que l''on sache, du soleil levant au soleil couchant, Que hors moi il n''y a point de Dieu: Je suis l''Eternel, et il n''y en a point d''autre.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ ከእኔም ሌላ ማንም የለም፤ ከእኔም በቀር አምላክ የለም፤ በፀሐይ መውጫና በምዕራብ ያሉ ከእኔ በቀር ማንም ሌላ እንደሌለ ያውቁ ዘንድ አስታጠቅሁህ፥ አንተ ግን አላወቅኸኝም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፥ ከእኔም ሌላ ማንም የለም።

verses.en: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the Lord do all these things.
verses.fr: Je forme la lumière, et je crée les ténèbres, Je donne la prospérité, et je crée l''adversité; Moi, l''Eternel, je fais toutes ces choses.
verses.am: ብርሃንን ሠራሁ፥ ጨለማውንም ፈጠርሁ፤ ደኅንነትን እሠራለሁ፥ ክፋትንም እፈጥራለሁ፤ እነነዚህን ሁሉ ያደረግሁ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the Lord have created it.
verses.fr: Que les cieux répandent d''en haut Et que les nuées laissent couler la justice! Que la terre s''ouvre, que le salut y fructifie, Et qu''il en sorte à la fois la délivrance! Moi, l''Eternel, je crée ces choses.
verses.am: እናንተ ሰማያት ከላይ አንጠባጥቡ ደመናትም ጽድቅን ያዝንቡ፤ ምድርም ትከፈት መድኃኒትንም ታብቅል፥ ጽድቅም በአንድነት ይብቀል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ፈጥሬዋለሁ።

verses.en: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
verses.fr: Malheur à qui conteste avec son créateur! -Vase parmi des vases de terre! -L''argile dit-elle à celui qui la façonne: Que fais-tu? Et ton oeuvre: Il n''a point de mains?
verses.am: ከሠሪው ጋር ለሚታገል ወዮለት! በምድር ሸክላዎች መካከል ያለ ሸክላ ነው። ጭቃ ሠሪውን። ምን ትሠራለህ? ወይስ ሥራህ። እጅ የለውም ይላልን?

verses.en: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?
verses.fr: Malheur à qui dit à son père: Pourquoi m''as-tu engendré? Et à sa mère: Pourquoi m''as-tu enfanté?
verses.am: አባትን። ምን ወልደሃል? ወይም ሴትን። ምን አማጥሽ? ለሚል ወዮ!

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Saint d''Israël, et son créateur: Veut-on me questionner sur l''avenir, Me donner des ordres sur mes enfants et sur l''oeuvre de mes mains?
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ሠሪውም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለሚመጣው ነገር ጠይቁኝ፥ ስለ ልጆቼና ስለ እጄ ሥራም እዘዙኝ።

verses.en: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
verses.fr: C''est moi qui ai fait la terre, Et qui sur elle ai créé l''homme; C''est moi, ce sont mes mains qui ont déployé les cieux, Et c''est moi qui ai disposé toute leur armée.
verses.am: እኔ ምድርን ሠርቻለሁ ሰውንም በእርስዋ ላይ ፈጥሬአለሁ፤ እኔ በእጄ ሰማያትን ዘርግቼአለሁ፥ ሠራዊታቸውንም ሁሉ አዝዣለሁ።

verses.en: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: C''est moi qui ai suscité Cyrus dans ma justice, Et j''aplanirai toutes ses voies; Il rebâtira ma ville, et libérera mes captifs, Sans rançon ni présents, Dit l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: እኔ በጽድቅ አስነሥቼዋለሁ መንገዱንም ሁሉ አቀናለሁ፤ እርሱ ከተማዬን ይሠራል፥ በዋጋም ወይም በደመወዝ ሳይሆን ምርኮኞቼን ያወጣል፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Les gains de l''Egypte et les profits de l''Ethiopie, Et ceux des Sabéens à la taille élevée, Passeront chez toi et seront à toi; Ces peuples marcheront à ta suite, Ils passeront enchaînés, Ils se prosterneront devant toi, et te diront en suppliant: C''est auprès de toi seulement que se trouve Dieu, Et il n''y a point d''autre Dieu que lui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። የግብጽ ድካምና የኢትዮጵያ ንግድ ቁመተ ረጅሞችም የሳባ ሰዎች ወደ አንተ ያልፋሉ፤ ለአንተም ይሆናሉ እጆቻቸውም ታስረው ይከተሉሃል፤ በፊትህም ያልፋሉ፥ ለአንተም እየሰገዱ። በእውነት እግዚአብሔር በአንተ አለ፥ ከእርሱም ሌላ አምላክ የለም ብለው ይለምኑሃል።

verses.en: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
verses.fr: Mais tu es un Dieu qui te caches, Dieu d''Israël, sauveur!
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ መድኃኒት ሆይ፥ በእውነት አንተ ራስህን የምትሰውር አምላክ ነህ።

verses.en: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
verses.fr: Ils sont tous honteux et confus, Ils s''en vont tous avec ignominie, Les fabricateurs d''idoles.
verses.am: ሁሉም ያፍራሉ ይዋረዱማል፥ ጣዖታትንም የሚሠሩ በአንድነት ወደ ውርደት ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: But Israel shall be saved in the Lord with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
verses.fr: C''est par l''Eternel qu''Israël obtient le salut, Un salut éternel; Vous ne serez ni honteux ni confus, Jusque dans l''éternité.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን እስራኤልን በዘላለማዊ መድኃኒት ያድነዋል፥ እናንተም ለዘላለም አታፍሩምና አትዋረዱም።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord; and there is none else.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel, Le créateur des cieux, le seul Dieu, Qui a formé la terre, qui l''a faite et qui l''a affermie, Qui l''a créée pour qu''elle ne fût pas déserte, Qui l''a formée pour qu''elle fût habitée: Je suis l''Eternel, et il n''y en a point d''autre.
verses.am: ሰማያትን የፈጠረ እግዚአብሔር፥ እርሱም ምድርን የሠራና ያደረገ ያጸናትም፥ መኖሪያም ልትሆን እንጂ ለከንቱ እንድትሆን ያልፈጠራት አምላክ፥ እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ የለም።

verses.en: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the Lord speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
verses.fr: Je n''ai point parlé en cachette, Dans un lieu ténébreux de la terre; Je n''ai point dit à la postérité de Jacob: Cherchez-moi vainement! Moi, l''Eternel, je dis ce qui est vrai, Je proclame ce qui est droit.
verses.am: በስውር ወይም በጨለማ ምድር ስፍራ አልተናገርሁም፤ ለያዕቆብ ዘር። በከንቱ ፈልጉኝ አላልሁም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ጽድቅን እናገራለሁ ቅንንም አወራለሁ።

verses.en: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
verses.fr: Assemblez-vous et venez, approchez ensemble, Réchappés des nations! Ils n''ont point d''intelligence, ceux qui portent leur idole de bois, Et qui invoquent un dieu incapable de sauver.
verses.am: እናንተ ከአሕዛብ ወገን ሆናችሁ ያመለጣችሁ፥ ተሰብስባችሁ ኑ በአንድነትም ቅረቡ፤ የተቀረጸውን የምስላቸውን እንጨት የሚሸከሙና ያድን ዘንድ ወደማይችል አምላክ የሚጸልዩ እውቀት የላቸውም።

verses.en: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the Lord? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
verses.fr: Déclarez-le, et faites-les venir! Qu''ils prennent conseil les uns des autres! Qui a prédit ces choses dès le commencement, Et depuis longtemps les a annoncées? N''est-ce pas moi, l''Eternel? Il n''y a point d''autre Dieu que moi, Je suis le seul Dieu juste et qui sauve.
verses.am: ይናገሩ ይቅረቡም በአንድነትም ይማከሩ፤ ከጥንቱ ይህን ያሳየ ከቀድሞስ የተናገረ ማን ነው? ያሳየሁም የተናገርሁም እኔ እግዚአብሔር አይደለሁምን? ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ አምላክ የለም፤ እኔ ጻድቅ አምላክና መድኃኒት ነኝ፥ ከእኔም በቀር ማንም የለም።

verses.en: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.
verses.fr: Tournez-vous vers moi, et vous serez sauvés, Vous tous qui êtes aux extrémités de la terre! Car je suis Dieu, et il n''y en a point d''autre.
verses.am: እናንተ የምድር ዳርቻ ሁሉ፥ እኔ አምላክ ነኝና፥ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ የለምና ወደ እኔ ዘወር በሉ ትድኑማላችሁ።

verses.en: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
verses.fr: Je le jure par moi-même, La vérité sort de ma bouche et ma parole ne sera point révoquée: Tout genou fléchira devant moi, Toute langue jurera par moi.
verses.am: ቃሌ ከአፌ በጽድቅ ወጥታለች፥ አትመለስም። ጕልበት ሁሉ ለእኔ ይንበረከካል፥ ምላስም ሁሉ በእኔ ይምላል ብዬ በራሴ ምያለሁ።

verses.en: Surely, shall one say, in the Lord have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
verses.fr: En l''Eternel seul, me dira-t-on, résident la justice et la force; A lui viendront, pour être confondus, Tous ceux qui étaient irrités contre lui.
verses.am: ስለ እኔም። በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ብቻ ጽድቅና ኃይል አለ፥ ወደ እርሱም ሰዎች ይመጣሉ፥ በእርሱም ላይ የተቈጡ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
verses.fr: Par l''Eternel seront justifiés et glorifiés Tous les descendants d''Israël.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ዘር ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ይጸድቃሉ፥ ይመካሉም ይባላል።

verses.en: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.
verses.fr: Bel s''écroule, Nebo tombe; On met leurs idoles sur des animaux, sur des bêtes; Vous les portiez, et les voilà chargées, Devenues un fardeau pour l''animal fatigué!
verses.am: ቤል ተዋረደ፥ ናባው ተሰባበረ፤ ጣዖቶቻቸው በእንስሳና በከብት ላይ ተጭነዋል፤ ሸክሞቻችሁ ለደካማ እንስሳ ከባድ ጭነት ሆነዋል።

verses.en: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
verses.fr: Ils sont tombés, ils se sont écroulés ensemble, Ils ne peuvent sauver le fardeau, Et ils s''en vont eux-mêmes en captivité.
verses.am: ተጐነበሱ በአንድነትም ተዋረዱ፤ ሸክሙን ለማዳን አልቻሉም፥ ራሳቸው ግን ተማረኩ።

verses.en: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
verses.fr: Ecoutez-moi, maison de Jacob, Et vous tous, restes de la maison d''Israël, Vous que j''ai pris à ma charge dès votre origine, Que j''ai portés dès votre naissance!
verses.am: እናንተ የያዕቆብ ቤት ሆይ፥ የእስራኤልም ቤት ቅሬታ ሁሉ፥ ከሆድ ያነሣኋችሁ ከማኅፀንም የተሸከምኋችሁ፥ ስሙኝ።

verses.en: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à votre vieillesse je serai le même, Jusqu''à votre vieillesse je vous soutiendrai; Je l''ai fait, et je veux encore vous porter, Vous soutenir et vous sauver.
verses.am: እስከ ሽምግልና ድረስ እኔ ነኝ፥ እስከ ሽበትም ድረስ እሸከማችኋለሁ፤ እኔ ሠርቻለሁ እኔም አነሣለሁ፤ እኔ እሸከማለሁ እኔም አድናለሁ።

verses.en: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
verses.fr: A qui me comparerez-vous, pour le faire mon égal? A qui me ferez-vous ressembler, pour que nous soyons semblables?
verses.am: በማን ትመስሉኛላችሁ? ከማንስ ጋር ታስተካክሉኛላችሁ? እንመሳሰል ዘንድ ከማን ጋር ታስተያዩኛላችሁ?

verses.en: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
verses.fr: Ils versent l''or de leur bourse, Et pèsent l''argent à la balance; Ils paient un orfèvre, pour qu''il en fasse un dieu, Et ils adorent et se prosternent.
verses.am: ወርቁን ከኮረጆ የሚያፈስሱ ብሩንም በሚዛን የሚመዝኑ እነርሱ አንጥረኛውን ይቀጥራሉ፥ እርሱም አምላክ አድርጎ ይሠራ ዋል፤ ለዚያም ይጐነበሱለታል ይሰግዱለትማል።

verses.en: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
verses.fr: Ils le portent, ils le chargent sur l''épaule, Ils le mettent en place, et il y reste; Il ne bouge pas de sa place; Puis on crie vers lui, mais il ne répond pas, Il ne sauve pas de la détresse.
verses.am: በጫንቃቸው ላይ አንሥተው ይሸከሙታል በስፍራውም ያደርጉታል፥ በዚያም ይቆማል፥ ከስፍራውም ፈቀቅ አይልም፤ ሰውም ወደ እርሱ ቢጮኽ አይሰማውም ከመከራውም አያድነውም።

verses.en: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
verses.fr: Souvenez-vous de ces choses, et soyez des hommes! Pécheurs, rentrez en vous-mêmes!
verses.am: ይህን አስቡና አልቅሱ፤ ተላላፊዎች ሆይ፥ ንስሐ ግቡ፥ ልባችሁንም መልሱ።

verses.en: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,
verses.fr: Souvenez-vous de ce qui s''est passé dès les temps anciens; Car je suis Dieu, et il n''y en a point d''autre, Je suis Dieu, et nul n''est semblable à moi.
verses.am: እኔ አምላክ ነኝና፥ ሌላም የለምና የቀድሞውን የጥንቱን ነገር አስቡ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ እንደ እኔም ያለ ማንም የለም።

verses.en: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
verses.fr: J''annonce dès le commencement ce qui doit arriver, Et longtemps d''avance ce qui n''est pas encore accompli; Je dis: Mes arrêts subsisteront, Et j''exécuterai toute ma volonté.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያ መጨረሻውን፥ ከጥንትም ያልተደረገውን እነግራለሁ፤ ምክሬ ትጸናለች ፈቃዴንም ሁሉ እፈጽማለሁ እላለሁ።

verses.en: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.
verses.fr: C''est moi qui appelle de l''orient un oiseau de proie, D''une terre lointaine un homme pour accomplir mes desseins, Je l''ai dit, et je le réaliserai; Je l''ai conçu, et je l''exécuterai.
verses.am: ከምሥራቅ ነጣቂ ወፍን፥ ከሩቅም አገር ምክሬን የሚያደርገውን ሰው እጠራዋለሁ። ተናግሬአለሁ፤ እፈጽማለሁ፤ አስቤአለሁ አደርግማለሁ።

verses.en: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:
verses.fr: Ecoutez-moi, gens endurcis de coeur, Ennemis de la droiture!
verses.am: እናንተ ከጽድቅ የራቃችሁ እልከኞች፥ ስሙኝ፤

verses.en: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
verses.fr: Je fais approcher ma justice: elle n''est pas loin; Et mon salut: il ne tardera pas. Je mettrai le salut en Sion, Et ma gloire sur Israël.
verses.am: ጽድቄን አቀርባለሁ፥ አይርቅም መድኃኒቴም አይዘገይም፤ ከጽዮን ለክብር እንዲሆን መድኃኒትን ለእስራኤል ሰጥቻለሁ።

verses.en: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.
verses.fr: Descends, et assieds-toi dans la poussière, Vierge, fille de Babylone! Assieds-toi à terre, sans trône, Fille des Chaldéens! On ne t''appellera plus délicate et voluptueuse.
verses.am: አንቺ ድንግል የባቢሎን ልጅ ሆይ፥ ውረጂ በትቢያም ላይ ተቀመጪ፤ የከለዳውያን ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ከዚህ በኋላ ቅልጣናምና ቅምጥል አትባይምና ያለ ዙፋን በመሬት ላይ ተቀመጪ።

verses.en: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
verses.fr: Prends les meules, et mouds de la farine; Ote ton voile, relève les pans de ta robe, Découvre tes jambes, traverse les fleuves!
verses.am: ወፍጮ ወስደሽ ዱቄትን ፍጪ፤ መሸፈኛሽን አውጪ ረጅሙንም ልብስሽን አውልቀሽ ጣዪው፤ ባትሽን ግለጪ፥ ወንዙን ተሻገሪ።

verses.en: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.
verses.fr: Ta nudité sera découverte, Et ta honte sera vue. J''exercerai ma vengeance, Je n''épargnerai personne. -
verses.am: ኀፍረተ ሥጋሽ ይገለጣል እፍረትሽም ይታያል፤ እኔ እበቀላለሁ፥ ለማንም አልራራም።

verses.en: As for our redeemer, the Lord of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: Notre rédempteur, c''est celui qui s''appelle l''Eternel des armées, C''est le Saint d''Israël. -
verses.am: ታዳጊያችን፥ ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ነው።

verses.en: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
verses.fr: Assieds-toi en silence, et va dans les ténèbres, Fille des Chaldéens! On ne t''appellera plus la souveraine des royaumes.
verses.am: የከለዳውያን ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ከዚህ በኋላ። የመንግሥታት እመቤት አትባይምና ዝም ብለሽ ተቀመጪ ወደ ጨለማም ውስጥ ግቢ።

verses.en: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.
verses.fr: J''étais irrité contre mon peuple, J''avais profané mon héritage, Et je les avais livrés entre tes mains: Tu n''as pas eu pour eux de la compassion, Tu as durement appesanti ton joug sur le vieillard.
verses.am: በሕዝቤ ላይ ተቈጥቼ ነበር ርስቴንም አረከስሁ በእጅሽም አሳልፌ ሰጠኋቸው፤ ከእነርሱ ጋር ምሕረት አላደረግሽም፥ በሽማግሌዎቻቸው ላይ ቀንበርሽን እጅግ አክብደሻል።

verses.en: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.
verses.fr: Tu disais: A toujours je serai souveraine! Tu n''as point mis dans ton esprit, Tu n''as point songé que cela prendrait fin.
verses.am: አንቺም። እኔ ለዘላለም እመቤት እሆናለሁ ብለሻል፤ ይህንም በልብሽ አላደረግሽም ፍጻሜውንም አላሰብሽም።

verses.en: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
verses.fr: Ecoute maintenant ceci, voluptueuse, Qui t''assieds avec assurance, Et qui dis en ton coeur: Moi, et rien que moi! Je ne serai jamais veuve, Et je ne serai jamais privée d''enfants!
verses.am: አሁንም አንቺ ቅምጥል ተዘልለሽ የምትቀመጪ፥ በልብሽም። እኔ ነኝ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ የለም፤ መበለትም ሆኜ አልኖርም የወላድ መካንነትንም አላውቅም የምትዪ ይህን ስሚ፤

verses.en: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.
verses.fr: Ces deux choses t''arriveront subitement, au même jour, La privation d''enfants et le veuvage; Elles fondront en plein sur toi, Malgré la multitude de tes sortilèges, Malgré le grand nombre de tes enchantements.
verses.am: አሁን ግን በአንድ ቀን እነዚህ ሁለት ነገሮች፥ የወላድ መካንነትና መበለትነት፥ በድንገት ይመጡብሻል፤ ስለ መተቶችሽ ብዛትና ስለ አስማቶችሽ ጽናት ፈጽመው ይመጡብሻል።

verses.en: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.
verses.fr: Tu avais confiance dans ta méchanceté, Tu disais: Personne ne me voit! Ta sagesse et ta science t''ont séduite. Et tu disais en ton coeur: Moi, et rien que moi!
verses.am: በክፋትሽ ታምነሻል፤ የሚያየኝ የለም ብለሻል፤ ጥበብሽና እውቀትሽ አታልለውሻል፥ በልብሽም። እኔ ነኝ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ የለም ብለሻል።

verses.en: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.
verses.fr: Le malheur viendra sur toi, Sans que tu en voies l''aurore; La calamité tombera sur toi, Sans que tu puisses la conjurer; Et la ruine fondra sur toi tout à coup, A l''improviste.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ምክንያት ክፉ ነገር ይመጣብሻል፥ በምዋርትሽም እንዴት እንደምታርቂው አታውቂም፤ ጉዳት ይውድቅብሻል ታስወግጅውም ዘንድ አይቻልሽም፤ የማትውቂያትም ጕስቍልና ድንገት ትመጣብሻለች።

verses.en: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.
verses.fr: Reste donc au milieu de tes enchantements Et de la multitude de tes sortilèges, Auxquels tu as consacré ton travail dès ta jeunesse; Peut-être pourras-tu en tirer profit, Peut-être deviendras-tu redoutable.
verses.am: ምናልባትም መጠቀም ትችዪ ወይም ታስደነግጪ እንደ ሆነ፥ ከአስማቶችሽና ከሕፃንነትሽ ጀምረሽ ከደከምሽበት ከመተቶችሽ ብዛት ጋር ቁሚ።

verses.en: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.
verses.fr: Tu t''es fatiguée à force de consulter: Qu''ils se lèvent donc et qu''ils te sauvent, Ceux qui connaissent le ciel, Qui observent les astres, Qui annoncent, d''après les nouvelles lunes, Ce qui doit t''arriver!
verses.am: በምክርሽ ብዛት ደክመሻል፤ አሁንም የሰማይን ከዋክብት የሚቈጥሩ፥ ከዋክብትንም የሚመለከቱ፥ በየመባቻውም የሚመጣውን ነገር የሚናገሩ ተነሥተው ከሚመጣብሽ ነገር ያድኑሽ።

verses.en: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.
verses.fr: Voici, ils sont comme de la paille, le feu les consume, Ils ne sauveront pas leur vie des flammes: Ce ne sera pas du charbon dont on se chauffe, Ni un feu auprès duquel on s''assied.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እንደ እብቅ ይሆናሉ፥ እሳትም ያቃጥላቸዋል ሰውነታቸውንም ከነበልባል ኃይል አያድኑም፤ እርሱም ሰው እንደሚሞቀው ፍም፥ ወይም በፊቱ ሰው እንደሚቀመጥበት እሳት ያለ አይደለም።

verses.en: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.
verses.fr: Tel sera le sort de ceux que tu te fatiguais à consulter. Et ceux avec qui tu as trafiqué dès ta jeunesse Se disperseront chacun de son côté: Il n''y aura personne qui vienne à ton secours.
verses.am: የደከምሽባቸው ነገሮች እንዲህ ይሆኑብሻል፤ ከሕፃንነትሽ ጀምረው ከአንቺ ጋር ይነግዱ የነበሩ እያንዳንዳቸው ወደ ስፍራቸው ይሄዳሉ፥ የሚያድንሽም የለም።

verses.en: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the Lord, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
verses.fr: Ecoutez ceci, maison de Jacob, Vous qui portez le nom d''Israël, Et qui êtes sortis des eaux de Juda; Vous qui jurez par le nom de l''Eternel, Et qui invoquez le Dieu d''Israël, Mais sans vérité ni droiture!
verses.am: እናንተ በእስራኤል ስም የተጠራችሁ ከይሁዳም ውኆች የወጣችሁ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ስም የምትምሉ፥ በእውነት ሳይሆን በጽድቅም ሳይሆን የእስራኤልን አምላክ የምትጠሩ፥

verses.en: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The Lord of hosts is his name.
verses.fr: Car ils prennent leur nom de la ville sainte, Et ils s''appuient sur le Dieu d''Israël, Dont le nom est l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: በቅድስት ከተማ ስም የተጠራችሁ፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በሚባል በእስራኤል አምላክ የምትደገፉ፥ የያዕቆብ ቤት ሆይ፥ ይህን ስሙ።

verses.en: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.
verses.fr: Dès longtemps j''ai fait les premières prédictions, Elles sont sorties de ma bouche, et je les ai publiées: Soudain j''ai agi, et elles se sont accomplies.
verses.am: የቀድሞውን ነገር ከጥንት ተናግሬአለሁ፥ ከአፌም ወጥቶአል አሳይቼውማለሁ፤ ድንገት አድርጌዋለሁ ተፈጽሞማል።

verses.en: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
verses.fr: Sachant que tu es endurci, Que ton cou est une barre de fer, Et que tu as un front d''airain,
verses.am: አንተ እልከኛ፥ አንገትህም የብረት ጅማት፥ ግምባርህም ናስ እንደሆነ አውቄአለሁ፤

verses.en: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
verses.fr: Je t''ai annoncé dès longtemps ces choses, je te les ai déclarées avant qu''elles arrivassent, Afin que tu ne dises pas: C''est mon idole qui les a faites, C''est mon image taillée ou mon image en fonte qui les a ordonnées.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ አንተ። ጣዖቴ ይህን አድርጎአል፥ የተቀረጸው ምስሌና ቀልጦ የተሠራው ምስሌ ይህን አዘዙኝ እንዳትል፥ አስቀድሜ ነግሬህ ነበር ሳይሆንም አሳይቼህ ነበር።

verses.en: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.
verses.fr: Tu entends! Considère tout cela! Et vous, ne l''avouerez-vous pas?... Maintenant, je t''annonce des choses nouvelles, Cachées, inconnues de toi.
verses.am: ሰምተሃል፤ ይህን ሁሉ ተመልከት፤ እናንተም የምትናገሩት አይደላችሁምን? የተሰወሩትን ያላወቅሃቸውንም አዲሶች ነገሮችን ከዚህ ጀምሬ አሳይቼሃለሁ።

verses.en: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.
verses.fr: Elles se produisent à présent, et n''appartiennent point au passé; Jusqu''à leur avènement tu n''en avais aucune connaissance, Afin que tu ne dises pas: Voici, je le savais.
verses.am: እነርሱም አሁን እንጂ ከጥንት አልተፈጠሩም፤ አንተም ። እነሆ፥ አውቄአቸዋለሁ እንዳትል ከዛሬ በፊት አልሰማሃቸውም።

verses.en: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.fr: Tu n''en as rien appris, tu n''en as rien su, Et jadis ton oreille n''en a point été frappée: Car je savais que tu serais infidèle, Et que dès ta naissance tu fus appelé rebelle.
verses.am: አልሰማህም፥ አላወቅህም፥ ጆሮህ ከጥንት አልተከፈተችም፤ አንተ ፈጽሞ ወንጀለኛ እንደ ሆንህ ከማኅፀንም ጀምረህ ተላላፊ ተብለህ እንደተጠራህ አውቄአለሁና።

verses.en: For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
verses.fr: A cause de mon nom, je suspends ma colère; A cause de ma gloire, je me contiens envers toi, Pour ne pas t''exterminer.
verses.am: ስለ ስሜ ቍጣዬን አዘገያለሁ፥ እንዳላጠፋህም ስለ ምስጋናዬ እታገሣለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
verses.fr: Je t''ai mis au creuset, mais non pour retirer de l''argent; Je t''ai éprouvé dans la fournaise de l''adversité.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አንጥሬሃለሁ ነገር ግን እንደ ብር አይደለም፤ በመከራም እቶን ፈትኜሃለሁ።

verses.en: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
verses.fr: C''est pour l''amour de moi, pour l''amour de moi, que je veux agir; Car comment mon nom serait-il profané? Je ne donnerai pas ma gloire à un autre.
verses.am: ስለ እኔ፥ ስለ ራሴ አደርገዋለሁ ስሜ ተነቅፎአልና፤ ክብሬንም ለሌላ አልሰጥም።

verses.en: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
verses.fr: Ecoute-moi, Jacob! Et toi, Israël, que j''ai appelé! C''est moi, moi qui suis le premier, C''est aussi moi qui suis le dernier.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ የጠራሁህም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማኝ፤ እኔ ነኝ፤ እኔ ፊተኛው ነኝ እኔም ኋለኛው ነኝ።

verses.en: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
verses.fr: Ma main a fondé la terre, Et ma droite a étendu les cieux: Je les appelle, et aussitôt ils se présentent.
verses.am: እጄም ምድርን መሥርታለች ቀኜም ሰማያትን ዘርግታለች፤ በጠራኋቸው ጊዜ በአንድነት ይቆማሉ።

verses.en: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The Lord hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
verses.fr: Vous tous, assemblez-vous, et écoutez! Qui d''entre eux a annoncé ces choses? Celui que l''Eternel aime exécutera sa volonté contre Babylone, Et son bras s''appesantira sur les Chaldéens.
verses.am: እናንተ ሁሉ፥ በአንድነት ተሰብስባችሁ ስሙ፤ ከእነርሱ ይህን የተናገረ ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔር የወደደው ፈቃዱን በባቢሎን ላይ ያደርጋል፥ ክንዱም በከለዳውያን ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.en: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.fr: Moi, moi, j''ai parlé, et je l''ai appelé; Je l''ai fait venir, et son oeuvre réussira.
verses.am: እኔ ራሴ ተናግሬአለሁ፤ እኔ ጠርቼዋለሁ፤ አምጥቼዋለሁ፥ መንገዱም ትከናወንለታለች።

verses.en: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord God, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
verses.fr: Approchez-vous de moi, et écoutez! Dès le commencement, je n''ai point parlé en cachette, Dès l''origine de ces choses, j''ai été là. Et maintenant, le Seigneur, l''Eternel, m''a envoyé avec son esprit.
verses.am: ወደ እኔ ቅረቡ ይህንም ስሙ፤ እኔ ከጥንት ጀምሬ በስውር አልተናገርሁም፤ ከሆነበት ዘመን ጀምሮ እኔ በዚያ ነበርሁ፥ አሁንም ጌታ እግዚአብሔርና መንፈሱ ልከውኛል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, ton rédempteur, le Saint d''Israël: Moi, l''Eternel, ton Dieu, je t''instruis pour ton bien, Je te conduis dans la voie que tu dois suivre.
verses.am: ታዳጊህ፥ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል ። እኔ የሚረባህን ነገር የማስተምርህ በምትሄድባትም መንገድ የምመራህ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
verses.fr: Oh! si tu étais attentif à mes commandements! Ton bien-être serait comme un fleuve, Et ton bonheur comme les flots de la mer;
verses.am: ትእዛዜን ብትሰማ ኖሮ፥ ሰላምህ እንደ ወንዝ ጽድቅህም እንደ ባሕር ሞገድ በሆነ ነበር፤

verses.en: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
verses.fr: Ta postérité serait comme le sable, Et les fruits de tes entrailles comme les grains de sable; Ton nom ne serait point effacé, anéanti devant moi.
verses.am: ዘርህም እንደ አሸዋ የሆድህም ትውልድ እንደ ምድር ትቢያ በሆነ ነበር፥ ስሙም ከፊቴ ባልጠፋና ባልፈረሰ ነበር።

verses.en: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The Lord hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
verses.fr: Sortez de Babylone, fuyez du milieu des Chaldéens! Avec une voix d''allégresse annoncez-le, publiez-le, Faites-le savoir jusqu''à l''extrémité de la terre, Dites: L''Eternel a racheté son serviteur Jacob!
verses.am: ከባቢሎን ውጡ ከከለዳውያንም ኰብልሉ፤ በእልልታ ድምፅ ተናገሩ ይህንም ንገሩ እስከ ምድርም ዳርቻ ድረስ አውሩና። እግዚአብሔር ባሪያውን ያዕቆብን ታድጎታል በሉ።

verses.en: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
verses.fr: Et ils n''auront pas soif dans les déserts où il les conduira: Il fera jaillir pour eux l''eau du rocher, Il fendra le rocher, Et l''eau coulera.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ በኩል በመራቸው ጊዜ አልተጠሙም፤ ውኃንም ከዓለቱ ውስጥ አፈለቀላቸው፥ ዓለቱንም ሰነጠቀ ውኃውም ፈሰሰ።

verses.en: There is no peace, saith the Lord, unto the wicked.
verses.fr: Il n''y a point de paix pour les méchants, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለክፉዎች ሰላም የላቸውም ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The Lord hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
verses.fr: Iles, écoutez-moi! Peuples lointains, soyez attentifs! L''Eternel m''a appelé dès ma naissance, Il m''a nommé dès ma sortie des entrailles maternelles.
verses.am: ደሴቶች ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፥ እናንተም በሩቅ ያላችሁ አሕዛብ፥ አድምጡ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከማኅፀን ጠርቶኛል፥ ከእናቴም ሆድ ጀምሮ ስሜን አንሥቶአል፤

verses.en: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
verses.fr: Il a rendu ma bouche semblable à un glaive tranchant, Il m''a couvert de l''ombre de sa main; Il a fait de moi une flèche aiguë, Il m''a caché dans son carquois.
verses.am: አፌንም እንደ ተሳለ ሰይፍ አድርጎአል፥ በእጁ ጥላ ሰውሮኛል፤ እንደ ተሳለ ፍላጻም አድርጎኛል፥ በሰገባውም ውስጥ ሽጎኛል።

verses.en: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
verses.fr: Et il m''a dit: Tu es mon serviteur, Israël en qui je me glorifierai.
verses.am: እርሱም። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አንተ ባሪያዬ ነህ በአንተም እከበራለሁ አለኝ።

verses.en: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the Lord, and my work with my God.
verses.fr: Et moi j''ai dit: C''est en vain que j''ai travaillé, C''est pour le vide et le néant que j''ai consumé ma force; Mais mon droit est auprès de l''Eternel, Et ma récompense auprès de mon Dieu.
verses.am: እኔ ግን። በከንቱ ደከምሁ፥ ምንም ጥቅም ለሌለውና ለከንቱ ጕልበቴን ፈጀሁ፤ ፍርዴ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ፥ ዋጋዬም በአምላኬ ዘንድ ነው አልሁ።

verses.en: And now, saith the Lord that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the Lord, and my God shall be my strength.
verses.fr: Maintenant, l''Eternel parle, Lui qui m''a formé dès ma naissance Pour être son serviteur, Pour ramener à lui Jacob, Et Israël encore dispersé; Car je suis honoré aux yeux de l''Eternel, Et mon Dieu est ma force.
verses.am: አሁንም በእግዚአብሔር ዓይን ከብሬአለሁና፥ አምላኬም ጕልበት ሆኖኛልና ያዕቆብን ወደ እርሱ እንድመልስ እስራኤልንም ወደ እርሱ እንድሰበስብ ባሪያ እሆነው ዘንድ ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ የሠራኝ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
verses.fr: Il dit: C''est peu que tu sois mon serviteur Pour relever les tribus de Jacob Et pour ramener les restes d''Israël: Je t''établis pour être la lumière des nations, Pour porter mon salut jusqu''aux extrémités de la terre.
verses.am: እርሱም። የያዕቆብን ነገዶች እንድታስነሣ ከእስራኤልም የዳኑትን እንድትመስል ባሪያዬ ትሆን ዘንድ እጅግ ቀላል ነገር ነውና እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ መድኃኒት ትሆን ዘንድ ለአሕዛብ ብርሃን አድርጌ ሰጥቼሃለሁ ይላል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the Lord that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le rédempteur, le Saint d''Israël, A celui qu''on méprise, qui est en horreur au peuple, A l''esclave des puissants: Des rois le verront, et ils se lèveront, Des princes, et ils se prosterneront, A cause de l''Eternel, qui est fidèle, Du Saint d''Israël, qui t''a choisi.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ታዳጊ ቅዱሱም፥ እግዚአብሔር፥ ሰዎች ለሚንቁት ሕዝብም ለሚጠላው ለገዥዎች ባሪያ እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ ታማኙ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ስለ መረጠህም ስለ እስራኤል ቅዱስ ነገሥታት አይተው ይነሣሉ፥ መሳፍንትም አይተው ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Au temps de la grâce je t''exaucerai, Et au jour du salut je te secourrai; Je te garderai, et je t''établirai pour traiter alliance avec le peuple, Pour relever le pays, Et pour distribuer les héritages désolés;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በተወደደ ጊዜ ሰምቼሃለሁ፥ በመድኃኒትም ቀን ረድቼሃለሁ፤ እጠብቅህማለሁ፥ ምድርንም ታቀና ዘንድ፥ ውድማ የሆኑትንም ርስቶች ታወርስ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.
verses.fr: Pour dire aux captifs: Sortez! Et à ceux qui sont dans les ténèbres: Paraissez! Ils paîtront sur les chemins, Et ils trouveront des pâturages sur tous les coteaux.
verses.am: የተጋዙትንም። ውጡ በጨለማም የተቀመጡትን። ተገለጡ ትል ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳን አድርጌ ለሕዝቡ ሰጥቼሃለሁ። በመንገድም ላይ ይሰማራሉ፥ ማሰማርያቸውም በወና ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.en: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
