verses.fr: Ils n''auront pas faim et ils n''auront pas soif; Le mirage et le soleil ne les feront point souffrir; Car celui qui a pitié d''eux sera leur guide, Et il les conduira vers des sources d''eaux.
verses.am: የሚራራላቸውም ይመራቸዋልና፥ በውኃም ምንጮች በኩል ይነዳቸዋልና አይራቡም፥ አይጠሙም፥ ትኩሳት ወይም ፀሐይ አይጐዳቸውም።

verses.en: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
verses.fr: Je changerai toutes mes montagnes en chemins, Et mes routes seront frayées.
verses.am: ተራሮቼንም ሁሉ መንገድ አደርጋለሁ፥ ጎዳኖቼም ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ።

verses.en: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
verses.fr: Les voici, ils viennent de loin, Les uns du septentrion et de l''occident, Les autres du pays de Sinim.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እነዚህ ከሩቅ፥ እነሆም፥ እነዚህ ከሰሜንንና ከምዕራብ፥ እነዚህም ከሲኒም አገር ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the Lord hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
verses.fr: Cieux, réjouissez-vous! Terre, sois dans l''allégresse! Montagnes, éclatez en cris de joie! Car l''Eternel console son peuple, Il a pitié de ses malheureux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አጽናንቶአልና፥ ለችግረኞቹም ራርቶአልና ሰማያት ሆይ፥ ዘምሩ፥ ምድር ሆይ፥ ደስ ይበልሽ ተራሮችም ሆይ፥ እልል በሉ።

verses.en: But Zion said, The Lord hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.
verses.fr: Sion disait: L''Eternel m''abandonne, Le Seigneur m''oublie! -
verses.am: ጽዮን ግን። እግዚአብሔር ትቶኛል ጌታም ረስቶኛል አለች።

verses.en: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
verses.fr: Une femme oublie-t-elle l''enfant qu''elle allaite? N''a-t-elle pas pitié du fruit de ses entrailles? Quand elle l''oublierait, Moi je ne t''oublierai point.
verses.am: በውኑ ሴት ከማኅፀንዋ ለተወለደው ልጅ እስከማትራራ ድረስ ሕፃንዋን ትረሳ ዘንድ ትችላለችን? አዎን፥ እርስዋ ትረሳ ይሆናል፥ እኔ ግን አልረሳሽም።

verses.en: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
verses.fr: Voici, je t''ai gravée sur mes mains; Tes murs sont toujours devant mes yeux.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ በእጄ መጻፍ ቀርጬሻለሁ፥ ቅጥሮችሽም ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ አሉ።

verses.en: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.
verses.fr: Tes fils accourent; Ceux qui t''avaient détruite et ravagée Sortiront du milieu de toi.
verses.am: ልጆችሽ ይፈጥናሉ፤ ያፈረሱሽና ያወደሙሽ ከአንቺ ዘንድ ይወጣሉ።

verses.en: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the Lord, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.
verses.fr: Porte tes yeux alentour, et regarde: Tous ils s''assemblent, ils viennent vers toi. Je suis vivant! dit l''Eternel, Tu les revêtiras tous comme une parure, Tu t''en ceindras comme une fiancée.
verses.am: ዓይንሽን አንሥተሽ በዙሪያሽ ተመልከቺ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ ተሰብስበው ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ። እኔ ሕያው ነኝና እነዚህን ሁሉ እንደ ጌጥ ትለብሻቸዋለሽ፥ እንደ ሙሽራም ትጐናጸፊአቸዋለሽ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
verses.fr: Dans tes places ravagées et désertes, Dans ton pays ruiné, Tes habitants seront désormais à l''étroit; Et ceux qui te dévoraient s''éloigneront.
verses.am: ባድማሽና ውድማሽ ወናም የሆነው ምድርሽ ከሚኖሩብሽ የተሣ ዛሬ ጠባብ ትሆናለችና፥ የዋጡሽም ይርቃሉና።

verses.en: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
verses.fr: Ils répéteront à tes oreilles, Ces fils dont tu fus privée: L''espace est trop étroit pour moi; Fais-moi de la place, pour que je puisse m''établir.
verses.am: የወላድ መካን ከሆንሽ በኋላ የተወለዱልሽ ልጆችሽ በጆሮሽ። ስፍራ ጠብቦኛልና እቀመጥ ዘንድ ቦታ አስፊልኝ ይላሉ።

verses.en: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?
verses.fr: Et tu diras en ton coeur: Qui me les a engendrés? Car j''étais sans enfants, j''étais stérile. J''étais exilée, répudiée: qui les a élevés? J''étais restée seule: ceux-ci, où étaient-ils?
verses.am: አንቺም በልብሽ፥ የወላድ መካን ሆኛለሁና፥ እኔም ብቻዬን ተሰድጄአለሁና ተቅበዝበዤ አለሁምና እነዚህን ማን ወለደልኝ? እነዚህንስ ማን አሳደጋቸው? እነሆ፥ ብቻዬን ቀርቼ ነበር፤ እነዚህስ ወዴት ነበሩ? ትያለሽ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
verses.fr: Ainsi a parlé le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici: Je lèverai ma main vers les nations, Je dresserai ma bannière vers les peuples; Et ils ramèneront tes fils entre leurs bras, Ils porteront tes filles sur les épaules.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ እጄን ወደ አሕዛብ አነሣለሁ፥ ዓለማዬንም ወደ ወገኖች አቆማለሁ፤ ወንዶች ልጆችሽንም በብብታቸው ያመጡአቸዋል፥ ሴቶች ልጆችሽንም በጫንቃቸው ላይ ይሸከሙአቸዋል።

verses.en: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
verses.fr: Des rois seront tes nourriciers, et leurs princesses tes nourrices; Ils se prosterneront devant toi la face contre terre, Et ils lécheront la poussière de tes pieds, Et tu sauras que je suis l''Eternel, Et que ceux qui espèrent en moi ne seront point confus.
verses.am: ነገሥታትም አሳዳጊ አባቶችሽ ይሆናሉ፥ እቴጌዎቻቸውም ሞግዚቶችሽ ይሆናሉ፤ ግምባራቸውንም ወደ ምድር ዝቅ አድርገው ይሰግዱልሻል፥ የእግርሽንም ትቢያ ይልሳሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቂያለሽ፥ እኔንም በመተማመን የሚጠባበቁ አያፍሩም።

verses.en: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?
verses.fr: Le butin du puissant lui sera-t-il enlevé? Et la capture faite sur le juste échappera-t-elle? -
verses.am: በውኑ ብዝበዛ ከኃያል እጅ ይወሰዳልን? ወይስ የጨካኙ ምርኮኞች ያመልጣሉን?

verses.en: But thus saith the Lord, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.
verses.fr: Oui, dit l''Eternel, la capture du puissant lui sera enlevée, Et le butin du tyran lui échappera; Je combattrai tes ennemis, Et je sauverai tes fils.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን እንዲህ ይላል። በኃያላን የተማረኩ ይወሰዳሉ፥ የጨካኞችም ብዝበዛ ያመልጣል፤ ከአንቺ ጋር የሚጣሉትን እጣላቸዋለሁ፥ ልጆችሽንም አድናለሁ።

verses.en: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.fr: Je ferai manger à tes oppresseurs leur propre chair; Ils s''enivreront de leur sang comme du moût; Et toute chair saura que je suis l''Eternel, ton sauveur, Ton rédempteur, le puissant de Jacob.
verses.am: አስጨናቂዎችሽንም ሥጋቸውን አስበላቸዋለሁ፥ እንደ ጣፋጭም ወይን ጠጅ ደማቸውን ጠጥተው ይሰክራሉ፤ ሥጋ ለባሹም ሁሉ እኔ እግዚአብሔር መድኃኒትሽና ታዳጊሽ፥ የያዕቆብ ኃያል እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Où est la lettre de divorce par laquelle j''ai répudié votre mère? Ou bien, auquel de mes créanciers vous ai-je vendus? Voici, c''est à cause de vos iniquités que vous avez été vendus, Et c''est à cause de vos péchés que votre mère a été répudiée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እናታችሁን የፈታሁበት የፍችዋ ጽሕፈት የት አለ? ወይስ እናንተን የሸጥሁ ከአበዳሪዎች ለየትኛው ነው? እነሆ፥ ስለ ኃጢአታችሁ ተሽጣችኋል፥ ስለ በደላችሁም እናታችሁ ተፈትታለች።

verses.en: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.
verses.fr: Je suis venu: pourquoi n''y avait-il personne? J''ai appelé: pourquoi personne n''a-t-il répondu? Ma main est-elle trop courte pour racheter? N''ai-je pas assez de force pour délivrer? Par ma menace, je dessèche la mer, Je réduis les fleuves en désert; Leurs poissons se corrompent, faute d''eau, Et ils périssent de soif.
verses.am: በመጣሁስ ጊዜ ሰው ስለ ምን አልነበረም? በጠራሁስ ጊዜ የሚመልስ ስለ ምን አልነበረም? መታደግ እንዳትችል እጄ አጭር ሆናለችን? ወይስ ለማዳን ኃይል የለኝምን? እነሆ፥ በገሠጽሁ ጊዜ ባሕርን አደርቃለሁ፥ ወንዞችንም ምድረ በዳ አደርጋቸዋለሁ፤ ውኃም በማጣት ዓሦቻቸው ይገማሉ በጥማትም ይሞታሉ።

verses.en: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
verses.fr: Je revêts les cieux d''obscurité, Et je fais d''un sac leur couverture.
verses.am: ሰማያትን ጥቍረት አለብሳቸዋለሁ፥ መጋረጃቸውንም ማቅ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: The Lord God hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, m''a donné une langue exercée, Pour que je sache soutenir par la parole celui qui est abattu; Il éveille, chaque matin, il éveille mon oreille, Pour que j''écoute comme écoutent des disciples.
verses.am: የደከመውን በቃል እንዴት እንደምደግፍ አውቅ ዘንድ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የተማሩትን ምላስ ሰጥቶኛል ማለዳ ማለዳ ያነቃኛል፥ እንደ ተማሪዎችም ትሰማ ዘንድ ጆሮዬን ያነቃቃል።

verses.en: The Lord God hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, m''a ouvert l''oreille, Et je n''ai point résisté, Je ne me suis point retiré en arrière.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ጆሮዬን ከፍቶአል፥ እኔም ዓመፀኛ አልነበርሁም ወደ ኋላዬም አልተመለስሁም።

verses.en: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
verses.fr: J''ai livré mon dos à ceux qui me frappaient, Et mes joues à ceux qui m''arrachaient la barbe; Je n''ai pas dérobé mon visage Aux ignominies et aux crachats.
verses.am: ጀርባዬን ለገራፊዎች ጕንጬንም ለጠጕር ነጪዎች ሰጠሁ፥ ፊቴንም ከውርደትና ከትፋት አልመለስሁም።

verses.en: For the Lord God will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
verses.fr: Mais le Seigneur, l''Eternel, m''a secouru; C''est pourquoi je n''ai point été déshonoré, C''est pourquoi j''ai rendu mon visage semblable à un caillou, Sachant que je ne serais point confondu.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ይረዳኛልና ስለዚህ አልታወክሁም፤ ስለዚህም ፊቴን እንደ ባልጩት ድንጋይ አድርጌዋለሁ፥ እንዳላፍርም አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
verses.fr: Celui qui me justifie est proche: Qui disputera contre moi? Comparaissons ensemble! Qui est mon adversaire? Qu''il s''avance vers moi!
verses.am: የሚያጸድቀኝ ቅርብ ነው፤ ከእኔስ ጋር የሚከራከር ማን ነው? በአንድነት እንቁም፤ የሚከራከረኝ ማን ነው? ወደ እኔ ይቅረብ።

verses.en: Behold, the Lord God will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
verses.fr: Voici, le Seigneur, l''Eternel, me secourra: Qui me condamnera? Voici, ils tomberont tous en lambeaux comme un vêtement, La teigne les dévorera.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ይረዳኛል፤ ማን ይፈርድብኛል? እነሆ፥ ሁሉ እንደ ልብስ ያረጃሉ ብልም ይበላቸዋል።

verses.en: Who is among you that feareth the Lord, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon his God.
verses.fr: Quiconque parmi vous craint l''Eternel, Qu''il écoute la voix de son serviteur! Quiconque marche dans l''obscurité et manque de lumière, Qu''il se confie dans le nom de l''Eternel, Et qu''il s''appuie sur son Dieu!
verses.am: ከእናንተ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ፥ የባሪያውንም ቃል የሚሰማ፥ በጨለማም የሚሄድ፥ ብርሃንም የሌለው፥ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ስም የሚታመን፥ በአምላኩም የሚደገፍ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
verses.fr: Voici, vous tous qui allumez un feu, Et qui êtes armés de torches, Allez au milieu de votre feu et de vos torches enflammées! C''est par ma main que ces choses vous arriveront; Vous vous coucherez dans la douleur.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እሳት የምታነድዱ የእሳትንም ወላፈን የምትታጠቁ ሁላችሁ፥ በእሳታችሁ ነበልባል ባነደዳችሁትም ወላፈን ሂዱ፤ ይህ ከእጄ ይሆንባችኋል፤ በኀዘን ትተኛላችሁ።

verses.en: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the Lord: look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.
verses.fr: Ecoutez-moi, vous qui poursuivez la justice, Qui cherchez l''Eternel! Portez les regards sur le rocher d''où vous avez été taillés, Sur le creux de la fosse d''où vous avez été tirés.
verses.am: እናንተ ጽድቅን የምትከተሉ እግዚአብሔርንም የምትሹ፥ ስሙኝ፤ ከእርሱ የተቈረጣችሁበትን ድንጋይ ከእርሱም የተቈፈራችሁበትን ጕድጓድ ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.
verses.fr: Portez les regards sur Abraham votre père, Et sur Sara qui vous a enfantés; Car lui seul je l''ai appelé, Je l''ai béni et multiplié.
verses.am: ወደ አባታችሁ ወደ አብርሃም፥ ወደ ወለደቻችሁም ወደ ሳራ ተመልከቱ፤ አንድ ብቻውን በሆነ ጊዜ ጠራሁት፥ ባረክሁትም አበዛሁትም።

verses.en: For the Lord shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the Lord; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
verses.fr: Ainsi l''Eternel a pitié de Sion, Il a pitié de toutes ses ruines; Il rendra son désert semblable à un Eden, Et sa terre aride à un jardin de l''Eternel. La joie et l''allégresse se trouveront au milieu d''elle, Les actions de grâces et le chant des cantiques.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ጽዮንን ያጽናናል፤ በእርስዋም ባድማ የሆነውን ሁሉ ያጽናናል፥ ምድረ በዳዋንም እንደ ዔደን በረሀዋንም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ገነት ያደርጋል፤ ደስታና ተድላ ምስጋናና የዝማሬ ድምፅ ይገኝበታል።

verses.en: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
verses.fr: Mon peuple, sois attentif! Ma nation, prête-moi l''oreille! Car la loi sortira de moi, Et j''établirai ma loi pour être la lumière des peuples.
verses.am: ወገኔ ሆይ፥ አድምጠኝ፤ ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ስማኝ፤ ሕግ ከእኔ ይወጣልና ፍርዴም ለአሕዛብ ብርሃን ይሆናልና።

verses.en: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.
verses.fr: Ma justice est proche, mon salut va paraître, Et mes bras jugeront les peuples; Les îles espéreront en moi, Elles se confieront en mon bras.
verses.am: ጽድቄ ፈጥኖ ቀርቦአል፥ ማዳኔም ወጥቶአል፥ ክንዴም በአሕዛብ ላይ ይፈርዳል፤ ደሴቶች እኔን በመተማመን ይጠባበቃሉ፥ በክንዴም ይታመናሉ።

verses.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
verses.fr: Levez les yeux vers le ciel, et regardez en bas sur la terre! Car les cieux s''évanouiront comme une fumée, La terre tombera en lambeaux comme un vêtement, Et ses habitants périront comme des mouches; Mais mon salut durera éternellement, Et ma justice n''aura point de fin.
verses.am: ዓይናችሁን ወደ ሰማይ አንሡ፥ ወደ ታችም ወደ ምድር ተመልከቱ፤ ሰማያት እንደ ጢስ በንነው ይጠፋሉ፥ ምድርም እንደ ልብስ ታረጃለች፥ የሚኖሩባትም እንዲሁ ይሞታሉ፤ ማዳኔ ግን ለዘላለም ይሆናል፥ ጽድቄም አይፈርስም።

verses.en: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
verses.fr: Ecoutez-moi, vous qui connaissez la justice, Peuple, qui as ma loi dans ton coeur! Ne craignez pas l''opprobre des hommes, Et ne tremblez pas devant leurs outrages.
verses.am: ጽድቅን የምታውቁ ሕጌም በልባችሁ ያለ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ የሰውን ተግዳሮት አትፍሩ፥ በስድባቸውም አትደንግጡ።

verses.en: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
verses.fr: Car la teigne les dévorera comme un vêtement, Et la gerce les rongera comme de la laine; Mais ma justice durera éternellement, Et mon salut s''étendra d''âge en âge.
verses.am: እንደ ልብስም ብል ይበላቸዋል፥ እንደ በግ ጠጕርም ትል ይበላቸዋል፤ ጽድቄ ግን ለዘላለም ማዳኔም ለትውልድ ሁሉ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the Lord; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
verses.fr: Réveille-toi, réveille-toi! revêts-toi de force, bras de l''Eternel! Réveille-toi, comme aux jours d''autrefois, Dans les anciens âges! N''est-ce pas toi qui abattis l''Egypte, Qui transperças le monstre?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ክንድ ሆይ፥ ተነሥ፥ ተነሥ፥ ኃይልንም ልበስ፤ በቀድሞው ወራትና በጥንቱ ዘመን በነበረው ትውልድ እንደ ሆነው ተነሥ። ረዓብን የቈራረጥህ ዘንዶውንም የወጋህ አንተ አይደለህምን?

verses.en: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas toi qui mis à sec la mer, Les eaux du grand abîme, Qui frayas dans les profondeurs de la mer Un chemin pour le passage des rachetés?
verses.am: ባሕሩንና የታላቁን ጥልቅ ውኃ ያደረቅኸው፥ የዳኑትም ይሻገሩ ዘንድ ጠሊቁን ባሕር መንገድ ያደረግህ አንተ አይደለህምን?

verses.en: Therefore the redeemed of the Lord shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.
verses.fr: Ainsi les rachetés de l''Eternel retourneront, Ils iront à Sion avec chants de triomphe, Et une joie éternelle couronnera leur tête; L''allégresse et la joie s''approcheront, La douleur et les gémissements s''enfuiront.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የተቤዣቸው ይመለሳሉ ወደ ጽዮንም ይመጣሉ፤ የዘላለምም ደስታ በራሳቸው ላይ ይሆናል፤ ደስታንና ተድላን ያገኛሉ፥ ኀዘንና ልቅሶም ይሸሻል።

verses.en: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;
verses.fr: C''est moi, c''est moi qui vous console. Qui es-tu, pour avoir peur de l''homme mortel, Et du fils de l''homme, pareil à l''herbe?
verses.am: የማጽናናችሁ እኔ ነኝ፥ እኔ ነኝ፤ የሚሞተውን ሰው እንደ ሣርም የሚጠወልገውን የሰው ልጅ ትፈራ ዘንድ አንተ ማን ነህ?

verses.en: And forgettest the Lord thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?
verses.fr: Et tu oublierais l''Eternel, qui t''a fait, Qui a étendu les cieux et fondé la terre! Et tu tremblerais incessamment tout le jour Devant la colère de l''oppresseur, Parce qu''il cherche à détruire! Où donc est la colère de l''oppresseur?
verses.am: ሰማያትንም የዘረጋው ምድርንም የመሠረተውን ፈጣሪህን እግዚአብሔርን ረስተሃል፤ ያጠፋ ዘንድ ባዘጋጀ ጊዜ ከአስጨናቂው ቍጣ የተነሣ ሁልጊዜ ቀኑን ሁሉ ፈርተሃል፤ የአስጨናቂው ቍጣ የት አለ?

verses.en: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
verses.fr: Bientôt celui qui est courbé sous les fers sera délivré; Il ne mourra pas dans la fosse, Et son pain ne lui manquera pas.
verses.am: ምርኮኛ ፈጥኖ ይፈታል፤ አይሞትም ወደ ጕድጓድም አይወርድም፥ እንጀራም አይጐድልበትም።

verses.en: But I am the Lord thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The Lord of hosts is his name.
verses.fr: Je suis l''Eternel, ton Dieu, Qui soulève la mer et fais mugir ses flots. L''Eternel des armées est son nom.
verses.am: ሞገዱም እንዲተምም ባሕርን የማናውጥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ፥ ስሜም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.
verses.fr: Je mets mes paroles dans ta bouche, Et je te couvre de l''ombre de ma main, Pour étendre de nouveaux cieux et fonder une nouvelle terre, Et pour dire à Sion: Tu es mon peuple!
verses.am: ሰማያትን እዘረጋ ዘንድ ምድርንም እመሠርት ዘንድ፥ ጽዮንንም። አንቺ ሕዝቤ ነሽ እል ዘንድ ቃሌን በአፍህ አድርጌአለሁ፥ በእጄም ጥላ ጋርጄሃለሁ።

verses.en: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the Lord the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.
verses.fr: Réveille-toi, réveille-toi! lève-toi, Jérusalem, Qui as bu de la main de l''Eternel la coupe de sa colère, Qui as bu, sucé jusqu''à la lie la coupe d''étourdissement!
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ የቍጣውን ጽዋ የጠጣሽ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ንቂ፥ ንቂ፥ ቁሚ፤ የሚያንገደግድን ዋንጫ ጠጥተሻል ጨልጠሽውማል።

verses.en: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up.
verses.fr: Il n''y en a aucun pour la conduire De tous les fils qu''elle a enfantés, Il n''y en a aucun pour la prendre par la main De tous les fils qu''elle a élevés.
verses.am: ከወለደቻቸው ልጆች ሁሉ የሚመራት የለም፥ ካሳደገቻቸውም ልጆች ሁሉ እጅዋን የሚይዝ የለም።

verses.en: These two things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?
verses.fr: Ces deux choses te sont arrivées: -Qui te plaindra? -Le ravage et la ruine, la famine et l''épée. -Qui suis-je pour te consoler? -
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁለት ነገሮች ሆነውብሻል፥ ማንስ ያስተዛዝንሻል? መፈታትና ጥፋት ራብና ሰይፍ ናቸው፤ እንዴትስ አድርጌ አጽናናሻለሁ?

verses.en: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the Lord, the rebuke of thy God.
verses.fr: Tes fils en défaillance gisaient à tous les coins de rues, Comme le cerf dans un filet, Chargés de la colère de l''Eternel, Des menaces de ton Dieu.
verses.am: ልጆችሽ ዝለዋል፤ በወጥመድ እንደተያዘ ሚዳቋ በአደባባይ ሁሉ ራስ ላይ ተኝተዋል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣና በአምላክሽ ተግሣጽ ተሞልተዋል።

verses.en: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, écoute ceci, malheureuse, Ivre, mais non de vin!
verses.am: ስለዚህም ያለ ወይን ጠጅ የሰከርሽ አንቺ ችግረኛ፥ ይህን ስሚ፤

verses.en: Thus saith thy Lord the Lord, and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle ton Seigneur, l''Eternel, Ton Dieu, qui défend son peuple: Voici, je prends de ta main la coupe d''étourdissement, La coupe de ma colère; Tu ne la boiras plus!
verses.am: ስለ ወገኑ የሚምዋገት አምላክሽ ጌታሽ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የሚያንገደግድን ጽዋ የቍጣዬንም ዋንጫ ከእጅሽ ወስጃለሁ፤ ደግመሽም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትጠጪውም።

verses.en: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
verses.fr: Je la mettrai dans la main de tes oppresseurs, Qui te disaient: Courbe-toi, et nous passerons! Tu faisais alors de ton dos comme une terre, Comme une rue pour les passants.
verses.am: ነፍስሽንም። እንሻገር ዘንድ ዝቅ በዪ በሚሉአት በአስጨናቂዎችሽ እጅ አኖረዋለሁ፤ ጀርባሽንም ለሚሻገሩት እንደ መሬትና እንደ መንገድ አደረግሽላቸው።

verses.en: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.
verses.fr: Réveille-toi! réveille-toi! revêts ta parure, Sion! Revêts tes habits de fête, Jérusalem, ville sainte! Car il n''entrera plus chez toi ni incirconcis ni impur.
verses.am: ጽዮን ሆይ፥ ተነሺ፥ ተነሺ፥ ኃይልሽን ልበሺ፤ ቅድስቲቱ ከተማ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ያልተገረዘና ርኩስ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይገባብሽምና ጌጠኛ ልብስሽን ልበሺ።

verses.en: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
verses.fr: Secoue ta poussière, lève-toi, Mets-toi sur ton séant, Jérusalem! Détache les liens de ton cou, Captive, fille de Sion!
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ትቢያን አራግፊ፤ ተነሺ፥ ተቀመጪ፤ ምርኮኛይቱ የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ የአንገትሽን እስራት ፍቺ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: C''est gratuitement que vous avez été vendus, Et ce n''est pas à prix d''argent que vous serez rachetés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በከንቱ ተሽጣችሁ ነበር፥ ያለ ገንዘብም ትቤዣላችሁ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Jadis mon peuple descendit en Egypte, pour y séjourner; Puis l''Assyrien l''opprima sans cause.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወገኔ በዚያ እንግዳ ሆኖ ይቀመጥ ዘንድ አስቀድሞ ወደ ግብጽ ወረደ፥ አሦርም ያለ ምክንያት በደለው።

verses.en: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the Lord, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the Lord; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, qu''ai-je à faire, dit l''Eternel, Quand mon peuple a été gratuitement enlevé? Ses tyrans poussent des cris, dit l''Eternel, Et toute la durée du jour mon nom est outragé.
verses.am: ወገኔ በከንቱ ተወስዶአልና አሁን ከዚህ ምን አለኝ? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ የሚገዙአቸው ይጮኻሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ስሜም ሁልጊዜ ቀኑን ሁሉ ይሰደባል።

verses.en: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak: behold, it is I.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi mon peuple connaîtra mon nom; C''est pourquoi il saura, en ce jour, Que c''est moi qui parle: me voici!
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወገኔ ስሜን ያውቃል፥ ስለዚህም የምናገር እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ በዚያ ቀን ያውቃሉ፤ እነሆ፥ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
verses.fr: Qu''ils sont beaux sur les montagnes, Les pieds de celui qui apporte de bonnes nouvelles, Qui publie la paix! De celui qui apporte de bonnes nouvelles, Qui publie le salut! De celui qui dit à Sion: ton Dieu règne!
verses.am: የምስራች የሚናገር፥ ሰላምንም የሚያወራ፥ የመልካምንም ወሬ የምስራች የሚናገር፥ መድኃኒትንም የሚያወራ፥ ጽዮንንም። አምላክሽ ነግሦአል የሚል ሰው እግሩ በተራሮች ላይ እጅግ ያማረ ነው።

verses.en: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the Lord shall bring again Zion.
verses.fr: La voix de tes sentinelles retentit; Elles élèvent la voix, Elles poussent ensemble des cris d''allégresse; Car de leurs propres yeux elles voient Que l''Eternel ramène Sion.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ጕበኞችሽ ጮኸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ጽዮን በተመለሰ ጊዜ ዓይን በዓይን ይተያያሉና ድምፃቸውን ያነሣሉ፥ በአንድነትም ይዘምራሉ።

verses.en: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the Lord hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Eclatez ensemble en cris de joie, Ruines de Jérusalem! Car l''Eternel console son peuple, Il rachète Jérusalem.
verses.am: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ፍርስራሾች ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አጽናንቶአልና፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ታድጎአልና ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ በአንድነትም ዘምሩ።

verses.en: The Lord hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
verses.fr: L''Eternel découvre le bras de sa sainteté, Aux yeux de toutes les nations; Et toutes les extrémités de la terre verront Le salut de notre Dieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰውን ክንዱን በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ፊት ገልጦአል፥ በምድር ዳርቻ የሚኖሩትም ሁሉ የአምላካችንን መድኃኒት ያያሉ።

verses.en: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the Lord.
verses.fr: Partez, partez, sortez de là! Ne touchez rien d''impur! Sortez du milieu d''elle! Purifiez-vous, vous qui portez les vases de l''Eternel!
verses.am: እናንተ የእግዚአብሔር ዕቃ የምትሸከሙ ሆይ፥ እልፍ በሉ፥ እልፍ በሉ፥ ከዚያ ውጡ፥ ርኩስን ነገር አትንኩ፥ ከመካከልዋ ውጡ፥ ንጽሐን ሁኑ።

verses.en: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the Lord will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your reward.
verses.fr: Ne sortez pas avec précipitation, Ne partez pas en fuyant; Car l''Eternel ira devant vous, Et le Dieu d''Israël fermera votre marche.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይቀድማችኋልና፥ የእስራኤልም አምላክ ይከተላችኋልና በችኰላ አትወጡም በመኰብለልም አትሄዱም።

verses.en: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
verses.fr: Voici, mon serviteur prospérera; Il montera, il s''élèvera, il s''élèvera bien haut.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ባሪያዬ በማስተዋል ያደርጋል፤ ይከብራል ከፍ ከፍም ይላል፥ እጅግ ታላቅም ይሆናል።

verses.en: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
verses.fr: De même qu''il a été pour plusieurs un sujet d''effroi, -Tant son visage était défiguré, Tant son aspect différait de celui des fils de l''homme, -
verses.am: ፊቱ ከሰዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ፥ መልኩም ከሰዎች ልጆች ይልቅ ተጐሳቍሎአልና ብዙ ሰዎች ስለ አንተ እንደ ተደነቁ፥ እንዲሁ ብዙ አሕዛብን ያስደንቃል፤

verses.en: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.
verses.fr: De même il sera pour beaucoup de peuples un sujet de joie; Devant lui des rois fermeront la bouche; Car ils verront ce qui ne leur avait point été raconté, Ils apprendront ce qu''ils n''avaient point entendu.
verses.am: ያልተነገረላቸውንም ያያሉና፥ ያልሰሙትንም ያስተውላሉና ነገሥታት ስለ እርሱ አፋቸውን ይዘጋሉ።

verses.en: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the Lord revealed?
verses.fr: Qui a cru à ce qui nous était annoncé? Qui a reconnu le bras de l''Eternel?
verses.am: የሰማነውን ነገር ማን አምኖአል? የእግዚአብሔርስ ክንድ ለማን ተገልጦአል?

verses.en: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
verses.fr: Il s''est élevé devant lui comme une faible plante, Comme un rejeton qui sort d''une terre desséchée; Il n''avait ni beauté, ni éclat pour attirer nos regards, Et son aspect n''avait rien pour nous plaire.
verses.am: በፊቱ እንደ ቡቃያ ከደረቅም መሬት እንደ ሥር አድጎአል። መልክና ውበት የለውም፥ ባየነውም ጊዜ እንወድደው ዘንድ ደም ግባት የለውም።

verses.en: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
verses.fr: Méprisé et abandonné des hommes, Homme de douleur et habitué à la souffrance, Semblable à celui dont on détourne le visage, Nous l''avons dédaigné, nous n''avons fait de lui aucun cas.
verses.am: የተናቀ ከሰውም የተጠላ፥ የሕማም ሰው ደዌንም የሚያውቅ ነው፤ ሰውም ፊቱን እንደሚሰውርበት የተናቀ ነው፥ እኛም አላከበርነውም።

verses.en: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
verses.fr: Cependant, ce sont nos souffrances qu''il a portées, C''est de nos douleurs qu''il s''est chargé; Et nous l''avons considéré comme puni, Frappé de Dieu, et humilié.
verses.am: በእውነት ደዌያችንን ተቀበለ ሕመማችንንም ተሸክሞአል፤ እኛ ግን እንደ ተመታ በእግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተቀሠፈ እንደ ተቸገረም ቈጠርነው።

verses.en: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
verses.fr: Mais il était blessé pour nos péchés, Brisé pour nos iniquités; Le châtiment qui nous donne la paix est tombé sur lui, Et c''est par ses meurtrissures que nous sommes guéris.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ስለ መተላለፋችን ቈሰለ፥ ስለ በደላችንም ደቀቀ፤ የደኅንነታችንም ተግሣጽ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ፥ በእርሱም ቍስል እኛ ተፈወስን።

verses.en: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the Lord hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.fr: Nous étions tous errants comme des brebis, Chacun suivait sa propre voie; Et l''Eternel a fait retomber sur lui l''iniquité de nous tous.
verses.am: እኛ ሁላችን እንደ በጎች ተቅበዝብዘን ጠፋን፤ ከእኛ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ገዛ መንገዱ አዘነበለ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሁላችንን በደል በእርሱ ላይ አኖረ።

verses.en: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
verses.fr: Il a été maltraité et opprimé, Et il n''a point ouvert la bouche, Semblable à un agneau qu''on mène à la boucherie, A une brebis muette devant ceux qui la tondent; Il n''a point ouvert la bouche.
verses.am: ተጨነቀ ተሣቀየም አፉንም አልከፈተም፤ ለመታረድ እንደሚነዳ ጠቦት፥ በሸላቶቹም ፊት ዝም እንደሚል በግ፥ እንዲሁ አፉን አልከፈተም።

verses.en: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
verses.fr: Il a été enlevé par l''angoisse et le châtiment; Et parmi ceux de sa génération, qui a cru Qu''il était retranché de la terre des vivants Et frappé pour les péchés de mon peuple?
verses.am: በማስጨነቅና በፍርድ ተወሰደ፤ ስለ ሕዝቤ ኃጢአት ተመትቶ ከሕያዋን ምድር እንደ ተወገደ ከትውልዱ ማን አስተዋለ?

verses.en: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.
verses.fr: On a mis son sépulcre parmi les méchants, Son tombeau avec le riche, Quoiqu''il n''eût point commis de violence Et qu''il n''y eût point de fraude dans sa bouche.
verses.am: ከክፉዎችም ጋር መቃብሩን አደረጉ፥ ከባለጠጎችም ጋር በሞቱ ሆኖም ግፍን አላደረገም ነበር፥ በአፉም ተንኮል አልተገንበትም ነበር።

verses.en: Yet it pleased the Lord to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the Lord shall prosper in his hand.
verses.fr: Il a plu à l''Eternel de le briser par la souffrance... Après avoir livré sa vie en sacrifice pour le péché, Il verra une postérité et prolongera ses jours; Et l''oeuvre de l''Eternel prospérera entre ses mains.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በደዌ ያደቅቀው ዘንድ ፈከደ፤ ነፍሱን ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ካደረገ በኋላ ዘሩን ያያል፥ ዕድሜውም ይረዝማል፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ፈቃድ በእጁ ይከናወናል።

verses.en: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
verses.fr: A cause du travail de son âme, il rassasiera ses regards; Par sa connaissance mon serviteur juste justifiera beaucoup d''hommes, Et il se chargera de leurs iniquités.
verses.am: ከነፍሱ ድካም ብርሃን ያያል ደስም ይለዋል፤ ጻድቅ ባሪያዬም በእውቀቱ ብዙ ሰዎችን ያጸድቃል፥ ኃጢአታቸውን ይሰከማል።

verses.en: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je lui donnerai sa part avec les grands; Il partagera le butin avec les puissants, Parce qu''il s''est livré lui-même à la mort, Et qu''il a été mis au nombre des malfaiteurs, Parce qu''il a porté les péchés de beaucoup d''hommes, Et qu''il a intercédé pour les coupables.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እርሱ ብዙዎችን ይወርሳል፥ ከኃያላንም ጋር ምርኮን ይከፋፈላል፤ ነፍሱን ለሞት አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአልና፥ ከዓመፀኞችም ጋር ተቈጥሮአልና፤ እርሱ ግን የብዙ ሰዎችን ኃጢአት ተሸከመ፥ ስለ ዓመፀኞችም ማለደ።

verses.en: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Réjouis-toi, stérile, toi qui n''enfantes plus! Fais éclater ton allégresse et ta joie, toi qui n''as plus de douleurs! Car les fils de la délaissée seront plus nombreux Que les fils de celle qui est mariée, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: አንቺ ያልወለድሽ መካን ሆይ፥ ዘምሪ፤ አንቺ ያላማጥሽ ሆይ፥ እልል በዪ፥ ጩኺም፤ ባል ካላት ይልቅ ፈት የሆነቺቱ ልጆች በዝተዋልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
verses.fr: Elargis l''espace de ta tente; Qu''on déploie les couvertures de ta demeure: Ne retiens pas! Allonge tes cordages, Et affermis tes pieux!
verses.am: የድንኳንሽን ስፍራ አስፊ፥ መጋረጃዎችሽንም ይዘርጉ፤ አትቈጥቢ፤ አውታሮችሽን አስረዝሚ ካስሞችሽንም አጽኚ።

verses.en: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
verses.fr: Car tu te répandras à droite et à gauche; Ta postérité envahira des nations, Et peuplera des villes désertes.
verses.am: በቀኝና በግራ ትሰፋፊያለሽና፥ ዘርሽም አሕዛብን ይወርሳልና፥ የፈረሱትንም ከተሞች መኖሪያ ያደርጋልና።

verses.en: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
verses.fr: Ne crains pas, car tu ne seras point confondue; Ne rougis pas, car tu ne seras pas déshonorée; Mais tu oublieras la honte de ta jeunesse, Et tu ne te souviendras plus de l''opprobre de ton veuvage.
verses.am: አታፍሪምና አትፍሪ፤ አተዋረጂምና አትደንግጪ፤ የሕፃንነትሽንም እፍረት ትረሺዋለሽ፥ የመበለትነትሽንም ስድብ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አታስቢም።

verses.en: For thy Maker is thine husband; the Lord of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
verses.fr: Car ton créateur est ton époux: L''Eternel des armées est son nom; Et ton rédempteur est le Saint d''Israël: Il se nomme Dieu de toute la terre;
verses.am: ፈጣሪሽ ባልሽ ነው፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ ታዲጊሽ ነው፥ እርሱም የምድር ሁሉ አምላክ ይባላል።

verses.en: For the Lord hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel te rappelle comme une femme délaissée et au coeur attristé, Comme une épouse de la jeunesse qui a été répudiée, dit ton Dieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተተወችና እንደ ተበሳጨች በልጅነትዋም እንደ ተጣለች ሚስት ጠርቶሻል፥ ይላል አምላክሽ።

verses.en: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
verses.fr: Quelques instants je t''avais abandonnée, Mais avec une grande affection je t''accueillerai;
verses.am: ጥቂት ጊዜ ተውሁሽ፥ በታላቅም ምሕረት እሰበስብሻለሁ።

verses.en: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the Lord thy Redeemer.
verses.fr: Dans un instant de colère, je t''avais un moment dérobé ma face, Mais avec un amour éternel j''aurai compassion de toi, Dit ton rédempteur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: በጥቂት ቍጣ ለቅጽበት ዓይን ፊቴን ከአንቺ ሰወርሁ፥ በዘላለምም ቸርነት እምርሻለሁ፥ ይላል ታዳጊሽ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
verses.fr: Il en sera pour moi comme des eaux de Noé: J''avais juré que les eaux de Noé ne se répandraient plus sur la terre; Je jure de même de ne plus m''irriter contre toi Et de ne plus te menacer.
verses.am: ይህ ለእኔ እንደ ኖኅ ውኃ ነው፤ የኖኅ ውኃ ደግሞ በምድር ላይ እንዳያልፍ እንደ ማልሁ፥ እንዲሁ አንቺን እንዳልቈጣ እንዳልዘልፍሽም ምያለሁ።

verses.en: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the Lord that hath mercy on thee.
verses.fr: Quand les montagnes s''éloigneraient, Quand les collines chancelleraient, Mon amour ne s''éloignera point de toi, Et mon alliance de paix ne chancellera point, Dit l''Eternel, qui a compassion de toi.
verses.am: ተራሮች ይፈልሳሉ፥ ኮረብቶችም ይወገዳሉ፤ ቸርነቴ ግን ከአንቺ ዘንድ አይፈልስም የሰላሜም ቃል ኪዳን አይወገድም፥ ይላል መሐሪሽ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
verses.fr: Malheureuse, battue de la tempête, et que nul ne console! Voici, je garnirai tes pierres d''antimoine, Et je te donnerai des fondements de saphir;
verses.am: አንቺ የተቸገርሽ በዐውል ነፋስም የተናወጥሽ ያልተጽናናሽም፥ እነሆ፥ ድንጋዮችሽን ሸላልሜ እገነባለሁ፥ በሰንፔርም እመሠርትሻለሁ።

verses.en: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
verses.fr: Je ferai tes créneaux de rubis, Tes portes d''escarboucles, Et toute ton enceinte de pierres précieuses.
verses.am: የግንብሽንም ጕልላት በቀይ ዕንቍ፥ በሮችሽንም በሚያብረቀርቅ ዕንቍ፥ ዳርቻሽንም ሁሉ በከበሩ ድንጋዮች እሠራለሁ።

verses.en: And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
verses.fr: Tous tes fils seront disciples de l''Eternel, Et grande sera la prospérité de tes fils.
verses.am: ልጆችሽም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር የተማሩ ይሆናሉ፥ የልጆችሽም ሰላም ብዙ ይሆናል።

verses.en: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
verses.fr: Tu seras affermie par la justice; Bannis l''inquiétude, car tu n''as rien à craindre, Et la frayeur, car elle n''approchera pas de toi.
verses.am: በጽድቅ ትታነጺያለሽ፤ ከግፍ ራቂ፥ አትፈሪምም፥ ድንጋጤም ወደ አንቺ አትቀርብም።

verses.en: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
verses.fr: Si l''on forme des complots, cela ne viendra pas de moi; Quiconque se liguera contre toi tombera sous ton pouvoir.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ይሰበሰባሉ፥ ነገር ግን ከእኔ ዘንድ አይሆንም፤ በአንቺም ላይ የሚሰበሰቡ ሁሉ ከአንቺ የተነሣ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
verses.fr: Voici, j''ai créé l''ouvrier qui souffle le charbon au feu, Et qui fabrique une arme par son travail; Mais j''ai créé aussi le destructeur pour la briser.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ፍሙን በወናፍ የሚያናፋ ለሥራውም መሣሪያ የሚያወጣ ብረት ሠሪን እኔ ፈጥሬአለሁ፤ የሚያፈርሰውንም እንዲያጠፋ ፈጥሬአለሁ።

verses.en: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Toute arme forgée contre toi sera sans effet; Et toute langue qui s''élèvera en justice contre toi, Tu la condamneras. Tel est l''héritage des serviteurs de l''Eternel, Tel est le salut qui leur viendra de moi, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በአንቺ ላይ የተሠራ መሣሪያ ሁሉ አይከናወንም፤ በፍርድም በሚነሣብሽ ምላስ ሁሉ ትፈርጂበታለሽ። የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ርስት ይህ ነው፥ ጽድቃቸውም ከእኔ ዘንድ ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
verses.fr: Vous tous qui avez soif, venez aux eaux, Même celui qui n''a pas d''argent! Venez, achetez et mangez, Venez, achetez du vin et du lait, sans argent, sans rien payer!
verses.am: እናንተ የተጠማችሁ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ውኃ ኑ፥ ገንዘብም የሌላችሁ ኑና ግዙ ብሉም፤ ኑ ያለ ገንዘብም ያለ ዋጋም የወይን ጠጅና ወተት ግዙ።

verses.en: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
verses.fr: Pourquoi pesez-vous de l''argent pour ce qui ne nourrit pas? Pourquoi travaillez-vous pour ce qui ne rassasie pas? Ecoutez-moi donc, et vous mangerez ce qui est bon, Et votre âme se délectera de mets succulents.
verses.am: ገንዘብን እንጀራ ላይደለ፥ የድካማችሁንም ዋጋ ለማያጠግብ ነገር ለምን ትመዝናላችሁ? አድምጡኝ፥ በረከትንም ብሉ፥ ሰውነታችሁም በጮማ ደስ ይበለው።

verses.en: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
verses.fr: Prêtez l''oreille, et venez à moi, Ecoutez, et votre âme vivra: Je traiterai avec vous une alliance éternelle, Pour rendre durables mes faveurs envers David.
verses.am: ጆሮአችሁን አዘንብሉ ወደ እኔም ቅረቡ፤ ስሙ ሰውነታችሁም በሕይወት ትኖራለች፤ የታመነችይቱን የዳዊትን ምሕረት፥ የዘላለምን ቃል ኪዳን ከእናንተ ጋር አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
verses.fr: Voici, je l''ai établi comme témoin auprès des peuples, Comme chef et dominateur des peuples.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ለአሕዛብ ምስክር፥ ለወገኖችም አለቃና አዛዥ እንዲሆን ሰጥቼዋለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the Lord thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.
verses.fr: Voici, tu appelleras des nations que tu ne connais pas, Et les nations qui ne te connaissent pas accourront vers toi, A cause de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, Du Saint d''Israël, qui te glorifie.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የማታውቀውን ሕዝብ ትጠራለህ፥ የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ አክብሮሃልና ስለ አምላክህ ስለ እግዚአብሔር የማያውቁህ ሕዝብ ወደ አንተ ይሮጣሉ።

verses.en: Seek ye the Lord while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
verses.fr: Cherchez l''Eternel pendant qu''il se trouve; Invoquez-le, tandis qu''il est près.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሚገኝበት ጊዜ ፈልጉት፥ ቀርቦም ሳለ ጥሩት፤

verses.en: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the Lord, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
verses.fr: Que le méchant abandonne sa voie, Et l''homme d''iniquité ses pensées; Qu''il retourne à l''Eternel, qui aura pitié de lui, A notre Dieu, qui ne se lasse pas de pardonner.
verses.am: ክፉ ሰው መንገዱን በደለኛም አሳቡን ይተው፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመለስ እርሱም ይምረዋል፥ ይቅርታውም ብዙ ነውና ወደ አምላካችን ይመለስ።

verses.en: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Car mes pensées ne sont pas vos pensées, Et vos voies ne sont pas mes voies, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: አሳቤ እንደ አሳባችሁ መንገዳችሁም እንደ መንገዴ አይደለምና ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.fr: Autant les cieux sont élevés au-dessus de la terre, Autant mes voies sont élevées au-dessus de vos voies, Et mes pensées au-dessus de vos pensées.
verses.am: ሰማይ ከምድር ከፍ እንደሚል፥ እንዲሁ መንገዴ ከመንገዳችሁ አሳቤም ከአሳባችሁ ከፍ ያለ ነው።

verses.en: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
verses.fr: Comme la pluie et la neige descendent des cieux, Et n''y retournent pas Sans avoir arrosé, fécondé la terre, et fait germer les plantes, Sans avoir donné de la semence au semeur Et du pain à celui qui mange,
verses.am: ዝናብና በረዶ ከሰማይ እንደሚወርድ፥ ምድርን እንደሚያረካት፥ ታበቅልና ታፈራም ዘንድ እንደሚያደርጋት፥ ዘርንም ለሚዘራ እንጀራንም ለሚበላ እንደሚሰጥ እንጂ ወደ ሰማይ እንደማይመለስ፥

verses.en: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verses.fr: Ainsi en est-il de ma parole, qui sort de ma bouche: Elle ne retourne point à moi sans effet, Sans avoir exécuté ma volonté Et accompli mes desseins.
verses.am: ከአፌ የሚወጣ ቃሌ እንዲሁ ይሆናል፤ የምሻውን ያደርጋል የላክሁትንም ይፈጽማል እንጂ ወደ እኔ በከንቱ አይመለስም።

verses.en: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
verses.fr: Oui, vous sortirez avec joie, Et vous serez conduits en paix; Les montagnes et les collines éclateront d''allégresse devant vous, Et tous les arbres de la campagne battront des mains.
verses.am: እናንተም በደስታ ትወጣላችሁ በሰላምም ትሸኛላችሁ፤ ተራሮችና ኮረብቶች በፊታችሁ እልልታ ያደርጋሉ፥ የሜዳም ዛፎች ሁሉ ያጨበጭባሉ።

verses.en: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the Lord for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.
verses.fr: Au lieu de l''épine s''élèvera le cyprès, Au lieu de la ronce croîtra le myrte; Et ce sera pour l''Eternel une gloire, Un monument perpétuel, impérissable.
verses.am: በእሾህም ፋንታ ጥድ በኩርንችትም ፋንታ ባርሰነት ይበቅላል፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም መታሰቢያን ለዘላለምም የማይጠፋ፥ ምልክት ይሆናል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Observez ce qui est droit, et pratiquez ce qui est juste; Car mon salut ne tardera pas à venir, Et ma justice à se manifester.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ማዳኔ ሊመጣ ጽድቄም ሊገለጥ ቀርቦአልና ፍርድን ጠብቁ ጽድቅንም አድርጉ።

verses.en: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.
verses.fr: Heureux l''homme qui fait cela, Et le fils de l''homme qui y demeure ferme, Gardant le sabbat, pour ne point le profaner, Et veillant sur sa main, pour ne commettre aucun mal!
verses.am: ይህን የሚያደርግ ሰው ይህንንም የሚይዝ የሰው ልጅ፥ እንዳያረክሰው ሰንበትንም የሚጠብቅ እጁንም ክፋት ከማድረግ የሚጠብቅ ብፁዕ ነው።

verses.en: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the Lord, speak, saying, The Lord hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
verses.fr: Que l''étranger qui s''attache à l''Eternel ne dise pas: L''Eternel me séparera de son peuple! Et que l''eunuque ne dise pas: Voici, je suis un arbre sec!
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም የተጠጋ መጻተኛ። በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ከሕዝቡ ይለየኛል አይበል፤ ጃንደረባም። እነሆ፥ እኔ ደረቅ ዛፍ ነኝ አይበል።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: Aux eunuques qui garderont mes sabbats, Qui choisiront ce qui m''est agréable, Et qui persévéreront dans mon alliance,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሰንበቴን ስለሚጠብቁ ደስ የሚያሰኘኝንም ነገር ስለሚመርጡ ቃል ኪዳኔንም ስለሚይዙ ጃንደረቦች እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.en: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
verses.fr: Je donnerai dans ma maison et dans mes murs une place et un nom Préférables à des fils et à des filles; Je leur donnerai un nom éternel, Qui ne périra pas.
verses.am: በቤቴና በቅጥሬ ውስጥ ከወንዶችና ከሴቶች ልጆች ይልቅ የሚበልጥ መታሰቢያና ስም እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ የማይጠፋም የዘላለም ስም እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the Lord, to serve him, and to love the name of the Lord, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;
verses.fr: Et les étrangers qui s''attacheront à l''Eternel pour le servir, Pour aimer le nom de l''Eternel, Pour être ses serviteurs, Tous ceux qui garderont le sabbat, pour ne point le profaner, Et qui persévéreront dans mon alliance,
verses.am: ያገለግሉት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ይወድዱ ዘንድ ባሪያዎቹም ይሆኑ ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚጠጉትንም መጻተኞች፥ እንዳያረክሱት ሰንበትን የሚጠብቁትን ቃል ኪዳኔንም የሚይዙትን ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
verses.fr: Je les amènerai sur ma montagne sainte, Et je les réjouirai dans ma maison de prière; Leurs holocaustes et leurs sacrifices seront agréés sur mon autel; Car ma maison sera appelée une maison de prière pour tous les peuples.
verses.am: ወደ ተቀደሰ ተራራዬ አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ በጸሎቴም ቤት ደስ አሰኛቸዋለሁ፤ ቤቴ ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ የሚሆን የጸሎት ቤት ይባላልና የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታቸውንና ሌላ መሥዋዕታቸውን በመሠዊያዬ ላይ እቀበላለሁ።

verses.en: The Lord God, which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, parle, Lui qui rassemble les exilés d''Israël: Je réunirai d''autres peuples à lui, aux siens déjà rassemblés.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል የተበተኑትን የሚሰበስብ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር። ወደ ተሰበሰቡት ዘንድ ሌሎችን እሰበስብለታለሁ ይላል።

verses.en: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.
verses.fr: Vous toutes, bêtes des champs, Venez pour manger, vous toutes, bêtes de la forêt!
verses.am: እናንተ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ሁሉ፥ እናንተም የዱር አራዊት ሁሉ፥ ትበሉ ዘንድ ቅረቡ።

verses.en: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
verses.fr: Ses gardiens sont tous aveugles, sans intelligence; Ils sont tous des chiens muets, incapables d''aboyer; Ils ont des rêveries, se tiennent couchés, Aiment à sommeiller.
verses.am: ጕበኞቹ ዕውሮች ናቸው፥ ሁሉ ያለ እውቀት ናቸው፤ ሁሉም ዲዳ የሆኑ ውሾች ናቸው ይጮኹም ዘንድ አይችሉም፤ ሕልምን ያልማሉ፤ ይተኛሉ፤ ማንቀላፋትንም ይወድዳሉ።

verses.en: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
verses.fr: Et ce sont des chiens voraces, insatiables; Ce sont des bergers qui ne savent rien comprendre; Tous suivent leur propre voie, Chacun selon son intérêt, jusqu''au dernier: -
verses.am: መብል ወዳጆች ከቶ የማይጠግቡ ውሾች ናቸው፥ እነርሱም ያስተውሉ ዘንድ የማይችሉ እረኞች ናቸው፤ ሁሉ ወደ መንገዳቸው፥ ከፊተኛው እስከ ኋለኛው ድረስ ሁሉ፥ እያንዳንዳቸው ወደ ጥቅማቸው ዘወር ብለዋል።

verses.en: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.
verses.fr: Venez, je vais chercher du vin, Et nous boirons des liqueurs fortes! Nous en ferons autant demain, Et beaucoup plus encore! -
verses.am: ኑ የወይን ጠጅ እንውሰድ፥ በሚያሰክርም መጠጥ እንርካ፤ ዛሬም እንደ ሆነ እንዲሁ ነገ ይሆናል፥ ከዛሬም ይልቅ እጅግ ይበልጣል ይላሉ።

verses.en: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.
verses.fr: Le juste périt, et nul n''y prend garde; Les gens de bien sont enlevés, et nul ne fait attention Que c''est par suite de la malice que le juste est enlevé.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ይሞታል፥ በልቡም ነገሩን የሚያኖር የለም፤ ምሕረተኞችም ይወገዳሉ፥ ጽድቅም ከክፋት ፊት እንደ ተወገደ ማንም አያስተውልም።

verses.en: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
verses.fr: Il entrera dans la paix, Il reposera sur sa couche, Celui qui aura suivi le droit chemin.
verses.am: ወደ ሰላም ይገባል፤ በቅንነት የሄደ በአልጋው ላይ ያርፋል።

verses.en: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
verses.fr: Mais vous, approchez ici, fils de l''enchanteresse, Race de l''adultère et de la prostituée!
verses.am: እናንተ የአስማተኛይቱ ልጆች፥ የአመንዝራውና የጋለሞታይቱ ዘር፥ ወደዚህ ቅረቡ።

verses.en: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood.
verses.fr: De qui vous moquez-vous? Contre qui ouvrez-vous une large bouche Et tirez-vous la langue? N''êtes-vous pas des enfants de péché, Une race de mensonge,
verses.am: በማን ታላግጣላችሁ? በማንስ ላይ አፋችሁን ታላቅቃላችሁ? ምላሳችሁንስ በማን ላይ ታስረዝማላችሁ?

verses.en: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
verses.fr: S''échauffant près des térébinthes, sous tout arbre vert, Egorgeant les enfants dans les vallées, Sous des fentes de rochers?
verses.am: እናንተ በአድባር ዛፎች መካከል በለመለመም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች በፍትወት የምትቃጠሉ፥ እናንተም በሸለቆች ውስጥ በዓለትም ስንጣቂዎች በታች ሕፃናትን የምታርዱ፥ የዓመፅ ልጆችና የሐሰት ዘር አይደላችሁምን?

verses.en: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
verses.fr: C''est dans les pierres polies des torrents qu''est ton partage, Voilà, voilà ton lot; C''est à elles que tu verses des libations, Que tu fais des offrandes: Puis-je être insensible à cela?
verses.am: በሸለቆው ውስጥ ያሉ የለዘቡ ድንጋዮች እድል ፈንታሽ ናቸው፥ እነርሱም ዕጣሽ ናቸው፤ ለእነርሱም የመጠጥ ቍርባን አፍስሰሻል፥ የእህልንም ቍርባን አቅርበሻል። እንግዲህ በዚህ ነገር አልቈጣምን?

verses.en: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
verses.fr: C''est sur une montagne haute et élevée que tu dresses ta couche; C''est aussi là que tu montes pour offrir des sacrifices.
verses.am: ከፍ ባለውም በረዘመውም ተራራ ላይ መኝታሽን አደረግሽ፥ መሥዋዕትንም ትሠዊ ዘንድ ወደዚያ ወጣሽ።

verses.en: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.
verses.fr: Tu mets ton souvenir derrière la porte et les poteaux; Car, loin de moi, tu lèves la couverture et tu montes, Tu élargis ta couche, et tu traites alliance avec eux, Tu aimes leur commerce, tu choisis une place.
verses.am: ከመዝጊያውና ከመቃኑ በኋላ መታሰቢያሽን አደረግሽ፤ እኔን ትተሽ ለሌላ ተገልጠሻል፥ ወጥተሽ መኝታሽን አስፍተሻል፤ ቃል ኪዳንም ተጋባሻቸው፥ ባየሽበትም ስፍራ ሁሉ መኝታቸውን ወደድሽ።

verses.en: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.
verses.fr: Tu vas auprès du roi avec de l''huile, Tu multiplies tes aromates, Tu envoies au loin tes messagers, Tu t''abaisses jusqu''au séjour des morts.
verses.am: ዘይትም ይዘሽ ወደ ንጉሡ ሄድሽ፥ ሽቱሽንም አበዛሽ፥ መልእክተኞችሽንም ወደ ሩቅ ላክሽ፥ እስከ ሲኦልም ድረስ ተዋረድሽ።

verses.en: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
verses.fr: A force de marcher tu te fatigues, Et tu ne dis pas: J''y renonce! Tu trouves encore de la vigueur dans ta main: Aussi n''es-tu pas dans l''abattement.
verses.am: በመንገድሽም ብዛት ደከምሽ፥ ነገር ግን። ተስፋ የለም አላልሽም፤ የጕልበትን መታደስ አገኘሽ፥ ስለዚህም አልዛልሽም።

verses.en: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
verses.fr: Et qui redoutais-tu, qui craignais-tu, pour être infidèle, Pour ne pas te souvenir, te soucier de moi? Est-ce que je ne garde pas le silence, et depuis longtemps? C''est pourquoi tu ne me crains pas.
verses.am: ሐሰትን የተናገርሺው እኔንም ያላሰብሺው በልብሽም ነገሩን ያላኖርሺው ማንን ሰግተሽ ነው? ማንንስ ፈርተሽ ነው? እኔ ብዙ ጊዜ ዝም አልሁ፥ አንቺም አልፈራሽም።

verses.en: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
verses.fr: Je vais publier ta droiture, Et tes oeuvres ne te profiteront pas.
verses.am: እኔ ጽድቅሽን እናገራለሁ፥ ሥራሽም አይረባሽም።

verses.en: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
verses.fr: Quand tu crieras, la foule de tes idoles te délivrera-t-elle? Le vent les emportera toutes, un souffle les enlèvera. Mais celui qui se confie en moi héritera le pays, Et possédera ma montagne sainte.
verses.am: ወደ አንቺ የሰበሰብሻቸው በጮኽሽ ጊዜ ይታደጉሽ፤ ንፋስ ግን ይወስዳቸዋል ሽውሽውታም ሁሉን ያስወግዳቸዋል። በእኔ የታመነ ግን ምድሪቱን ይገዛል፥ የተቀደሰውንም ተራራዬን ይወርሳል።

verses.en: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
verses.fr: On dira: Frayez, frayez, préparez le chemin, Enlevez tout obstacle du chemin de mon peuple!
verses.am: እርሱም። ጥረጉ፥ መንገድን አዘጋጁ፥ ከሕዝቤም መንገድ ዕንቅፋትን አውጡ ይላል።

verses.en: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle le Très-Haut, Dont la demeure est éternelle et dont le nom est saint: J''habite dans les lieux élevés et dans la sainteté; Mais je suis avec l''homme contrit et humilié, Afin de ranimer les esprits humiliés, Afin de ranimer les coeurs contrits.
verses.am: ለዘላለም የሚኖር ስሙም ቅዱስ የሆነ፥ ከፍ ያለው ልዑል እንዲህ ይላል። የተዋረዱትን ሰዎች መንፈስ ሕያው አደርግ ዘንድ፥ የተቀጠቀጠውንም ልብ ሕያው አደርግ ዘንድ፥ የተቀጠቀጠና የተዋረደ መንፈስ ካለው ጋር በከፍታና በተቀደሰ ስፍራ እቀመጣለሁ።

verses.en: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
verses.fr: Je ne veux pas contester à toujours, Ni garder une éternelle colère, Quand devant moi tombent en défaillance les esprits, Les âmes que j''ai faites.
verses.am: መንፈስም የፈጠርሁትም ነፍስ ከፊቴ እንዳይዝል ለዘላለም አልጣላም፥ ሁልጊዜም አልቈጣም።

verses.en: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
verses.fr: A cause de son avidité coupable, je me suis irrité et je l''ai frappé, Je me suis caché dans mon indignation; Et le rebelle a suivi le chemin de son coeur.
verses.am: ስለ ኃጢአቱ ጥቂት ጊዜ ተቈጥቼ ቀሠፍሁት፥ ፊቴን ሰውሬ ተቈጣሁ፤ እርሱም በልቡ መንገድ እያፈገፈገ ሄደ።

verses.en: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
verses.fr: J''ai vu ses voies, Et je le guérirai; Je lui servirai de guide, Et je le consolerai, lui et ceux qui pleurent avec lui.
verses.am: መንገዱን አይቻለሁ እፈውሰውማለሁ፥ እመራውማለሁ፥ ለእርሱና ስለ እርሱም ለሚያለቅሱ መጽናናትን እመልሳለሁ።

verses.en: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the Lord; and I will heal him.
verses.fr: Je mettrai la louange sur les lèvres. Paix, paix à celui qui est loin et à celui qui est près! dit l''Eternel. Je les guérirai.
verses.am: የከንፈሮችን ፍሬ እፈጥራለሁ፤ በሩቅም በቅርብም ላለው ሰላም ሰላም ይሁን፥ እፈውሰውማለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
verses.fr: Mais les méchants sont comme la mer agitée, Qui ne peut se calmer, Et dont les eaux soulèvent la vase et le limon.
verses.am: ክፉዎች ግን እንደሚንቀሳቀስ ባሕር ናቸው፤ ጸጥ ይል ዘንድ አይችልምና፥ ውኆቹም ጭቃና ጕድፍ ያወጣሉና።

verses.en: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
verses.fr: Il n''y a point de paix pour les méchants, dit mon Dieu.
verses.am: ለክፉዎች ሰላም የላቸውም ይላል አምላኬ።

verses.en: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.fr: Crie à plein gosier, ne te retiens pas, Elève ta voix comme une trompette, Et annonce à mon peuple ses iniquités, A la maison de Jacob ses péchés!
verses.am: በኃይልህ ጩኽ፥ አትቈጥብ፥ ድምፅህን እንደ መለከት አንሣ፥ ለሕዝቤ መተላለፋቸውን ለያዕቆብ ቤትም ኃጢአታቸውን ንገር።

verses.en: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.
verses.fr: Tous les jours ils me cherchent, Ils veulent connaître mes voies; Comme une nation qui aurait pratiqué la justice Et n''aurait pas abandonné la loi de son Dieu, Ils me demandent des arrêts de justice, Ils désirent l''approche de Dieu. -
verses.am: ነገር ግን ዕለት ዕለት ይሹኛል መንገዴንም ያውቁ ዘንድ ይወድዳሉ፤ ጽድቅን እንዳደረጉ የአምላካቸውንም ፍርድ እንዳልተዉ ሕዝብ እውነተኛውን ፍርድ ይለምኑኛል፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ለመቅረብ ይወድዳሉ።

verses.en: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
verses.fr: Que nous sert de jeûner, si tu ne le vois pas? De mortifier notre âme, si tu n''y as point égard? -Voici, le jour de votre jeûne, vous vous livrez à vos penchants, Et vous traitez durement tous vos mercenaires.
verses.am: ስለ ምን ጾምን፥ አንተም አልተመለከትኸንም? ሰውነታችንንስ ስለ ምን አዋረድን፥ አንተም አላወቅህም? ይላሉ። እነሆ፥ በጾማችሁ ቀን ፈቃዳችሁን ታደርጋላችሁ፥ ሠራተኞቻችሁንም ሁሉ ታስጨንቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.fr: Voici, vous jeûnez pour disputer et vous quereller, Pour frapper méchamment du poing; Vous ne jeûnez pas comme le veut ce jour, Pour que votre voix soit entendue en haut.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ለጥልና ለክርክር ትጾማላችሁ በግፍ ጡጫም ትማታላችሁ፤ ድምፃችሁንም ወደ ላይ ታሰሙ ዘንድ ዛሬ እንደምትጾሙት አትጾሙም።

verses.en: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the Lord?
verses.fr: Est-ce là le jeûne auquel je prends plaisir, Un jour où l''homme humilie son âme? Courber la tête comme un jonc, Et se coucher sur le sac et la cendre, Est-ce là ce que tu appelleras un jeûne, Un jour agréable à l''Eternel?
verses.am: እኔ የመረጥሁት ጾም ይህ ነውን? ሰውስ ነፍሱን የሚያዋርደው እንደዚህ ባለ ቀን ነውን? በውኑ ራሱን እንደ እንግጫ ዝቅ ያደርግ ዘንድ ማቅንና አመድንም በበታቹ ያነጥፍ ዘንድ ነውን? በውኑ ይህን ጾም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ የተወደደ ቀን ትለዋለህን?

verses.en: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
verses.fr: Voici le jeûne auquel je prends plaisir: Détache les chaînes de la méchanceté, Dénoue les liens de la servitude, Renvoie libres les opprimés, Et que l''on rompe toute espèce de joug;
verses.am: እኔስ የመረጥሁት ጾም ይህ አይደለምን? የበደልን እስራት ትፈቱ ዘንድ፥ የቀንበርንስ ጠፍር ትለቅቁ ዘንድ፥ የተገፉትንስ አርነት ትሰድዱ ዘንድ፥ ቀንበሩንስ ሁሉ ትሰብሩ ዘንድ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
verses.fr: Partage ton pain avec celui qui a faim, Et fais entrer dans ta maison les malheureux sans asile; Si tu vois un homme nu, couvre-le, Et ne te détourne pas de ton semblable.
verses.am: እንጀራህንስ ለተራበ ትቈርስ ዘንድ፥ ስደተኞቹን ድሆች ወደ ቤትህ ታገባ ዘንድ፥ የተራቈተውንስ ብታይ ታለብሰው ዘንድ፥ ከሥጋ ዘምድህ እንዳትሸሽግ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the Lord shall be thy reward.
verses.fr: Alors ta lumière poindra comme l''aurore, Et ta guérison germera promptement; Ta justice marchera devant toi, Et la gloire de l''Eternel t''accompagnera.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ ብርሃንህ እንደ ንጋት ይበራል፥ ፈውስህም ፈጥኖ ይበቅላል፥ ጽድቅህም በፊትህ ይሄዳል፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር በኋላህ ሆኖ ይጠብቅሃል።

verses.en: Then shalt thou call, and the Lord shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
verses.fr: Alors tu appelleras, et l''Eternel répondra; Tu crieras, et il dira: Me voici! Si tu éloignes du milieu de toi le joug, Les gestes menaçants et les discours injurieux,
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ ትጠራለህ እግዚአብሔርም ይሰማሃል፤ ትጮኻለህ እርሱም። እነሆኝ ይላል። ከመካከልህ ቀንበርን ብታርቅ፥ ጣትህንም መጥቀስ ብትተው፥

verses.en: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noon day:
verses.fr: Si tu donnes ta propre subsistance à celui qui a faim, Si tu rassasies l''âme indigente, Ta lumière se lèvera sur l''obscurité, Et tes ténèbres seront comme le midi.
verses.am: ባታንጐራጕርም፥ ነፍስህንም ለተራበ ብታፈስስ፥ የተጨነቀውንም ነፍስ ብታጠግብ፥ ብርሃንህ በጨለማ ይወጣል ጨለማህም እንደ ቀትር ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the Lord shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
verses.fr: L''Eternel sera toujours ton guide, Il rassasiera ton âme dans les lieux arides, Et il redonnera de la vigueur à tes membres; Tu seras comme un jardin arrosé, Comme une source dont les eaux ne tarissent pas.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሁልጊዜ ይመራሃል፤ ነፍስህንም በመልካም ነገር ያጠግባል አጥንትህንም ያጠናል፤ አንተም እንደሚጠጣ ገነት፥ ውኃውም እንደማያቋርጥ ምንጭ ትሆናለህ።

verses.en: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
verses.fr: Les tiens rebâtiront sur d''anciennes ruines, Tu relèveras des fondements antiques; On t''appellera réparateur des brèches, Celui qui restaure les chemins, qui rend le pays habitable.
verses.am: ከዱሮ ዘመን የፈረሱት ስፍራዎች ይሠራሉ፥ የብዙ ትውልድም መሠረት ይታነጻል፤ አንተም። ሰባራውን ጠጋኝ፥ የመኖሪያ መንገድን አዳሽ ትባላለህ።

verses.en: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the Lord, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:
verses.fr: Si tu retiens ton pied pendant le sabbat, Pour ne pas faire ta volonté en mon saint jour, Si tu fais du sabbat tes délices, Pour sanctifier l''Eternel en le glorifiant, Et si tu l''honores en ne suivant point tes voies, En ne te livrant pas à tes penchants et à de vains discours,
verses.am: ፈቃድህን በተቀደሰው ቀኔ ከማድረግ እግርህን ከሰንበት ብትመልስ፥ ሰንበትንም ደስታ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የቀደሰውን ክቡር ብትለው፥ የገዛ መንገድህንም ከማድረግ ፈቃድህንም ከማግኘት ከንቱ ነገርንም ከመናገር ተከልክለህ ብታከብረው፥

verses.en: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the Lord; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.fr: Alors tu mettras ton plaisir en l''Eternel, Et je te ferai monter sur les hauteurs du pays, Je te ferai jouir de l''héritage de Jacob, ton père; Car la bouche de l''Eternel a parlé.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይልሃል፥ በምድርም ከፍታዎች ላይ አወጣሃለሁ፥ የአባትህንም የያዕቆብን ርስት አበላሃለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔር አፍ ተናግሮአልና።

verses.en: Behold, the Lord's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
verses.fr: Non, la main de l''Eternel n''est pas trop courte pour sauver, Ni son oreille trop dure pour entendre.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ ከማዳን አላጠረችም፥ ጆሮውም ከመስማት አልደነቈረችም፤

verses.en: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
verses.fr: Mais ce sont vos crimes qui mettent une séparation Entre vous et votre Dieu; Ce sont vos péchés qui vous cachent sa face Et l''empêchent de vous écouter.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በደላችሁ በእናንተና በአምላካችሁ መካከል ለይታለች፥ እንዳይሰማም ኃጢአታችሁ ፊቱን ከእናንተ ሰውሮታል።

verses.en: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
verses.fr: Car vos mains sont souillées de sang, Et vos doigts de crimes; Vos lèvres profèrent le mensonge, Votre langue fait entendre l''iniquité.
verses.am: እጃችሁ በደም ጣታችሁም በበደል ረክሳለች፥ ከንፈራችሁም ሐሰትን ተናግሮአል፥ ምላሳችሁም ኃጢአትን አሰምቶአል።

verses.en: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
verses.fr: Nul ne se plaint avec justice, Nul ne plaide avec droiture; Ils s''appuient sur des choses vaines et disent des faussetés, Ils conçoivent le mal et enfantent le crime.
verses.am: በጽድቅ የሚጠራ በእውነትም የሚፈርድ የለም፤ በምናምንቴ ነገር ታምነዋል ሐሰትንም ተናግረዋል፤ ጕዳትን ፀንሰዋል በደልንም ወልደዋል፤

verses.en: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
verses.fr: Ils couvent des oeufs de basilic, Et ils tissent des toiles d''araignée. Celui qui mange de leurs oeufs meurt; Et, si l''on en brise un, il sort une vipère.
verses.am: የእባብን እንቍላል ቀፈቀፉ፥ የሸረሪትንም ድር አደሩ፤ እንቍላላቸውንም የሚበላ ሰው ይሞታል፥ እንቍላሉም ሲሰበር እፉኝት ይወጣል።

verses.en: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
verses.fr: Leurs toiles ne servent point à faire un vêtement, Et ils ne peuvent se couvrir de leur ouvrage; Leurs oeuvres sont des oeuvres d''iniquité, Et les actes de violence sont dans leurs mains.
verses.am: ድሮቻቸውም ልብስ አይሆኑላቸውም፥ በሥራቸውም አይሸፈኑም፤ ሥራቸውም የበደል ሥራ ነው፥ የግፍም ሥራ በእጃቸው ነው።

verses.en: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
verses.fr: Leurs pieds courent au mal, Et ils ont hâte de répandre le sang innocent; Leurs pensées sont des pensées d''iniquité, Le ravage et la ruine sont sur leur route.
verses.am: እግሮቻቸው ወደ ክፋት ይሮጣሉ፥ ንጹሑን ደም ለማፍሰስ ይፈጥናሉ፤ አሳባቸው የኃጢአት አሳብ ነው፥ ጕስቍልናና ቅጥቃጤ በመንገዳቸው አለ።

verses.en: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
verses.fr: Ils ne connaissent pas le chemin de la paix, Et il n''y a point de justice dans leurs voies; Ils prennent des sentiers détournés: Quiconque y marche ne connaît point la paix. -
verses.am: የሰላምን መንገድ አያውቁም፥ በአካሄዳቸውም ፍርድ የለም፤ መንገዳቸውን አጣምመዋል፥ የሚሄድባትም ሁሉ ሰላምን አያውቅም።

verses.en: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi l''arrêt de délivrance est loin de nous, Et le salut ne nous atteint pas; Nous attendons la lumière, et voici les ténèbres, La clarté, et nous marchons dans l''obscurité.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ፍርድ ከእኛ ዘንድ ርቆአል፥ ጽድቅም አላገኘንም፤ ብርሃንን በተስፋ እንጠባበቅ ነበር፥ እነሆም፥ ጨለማ ሆነ፤ ጸዳልን በተስፋ እንጠባበቅ ነበር፥ ነገር ግን በጨለማ ሄድን።

verses.en: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noon day as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
verses.fr: Nous tâtonnons comme des aveugles le long d''un mur, Nous tâtonnons comme ceux qui n''ont point d''yeux; Nous chancelons à midi comme de nuit, Au milieu de l''abondance nous ressemblons à des morts.
verses.am: እንደ ዕውሮች ወደ ቅጥሩ ተርመሰመስን፥ ዓይን እንደሌላቸው ተርመሰመስን፤ በቀትር ጊዜ በድግዝግዝታ እንዳለ ሰው ተሰናከልን፥ እንደ ሙታን በጨለማ ስፍራ ነን።

verses.en: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
verses.fr: Nous grondons tous comme des ours, Nous gémissons comme des colombes; Nous attendons la délivrance, et elle n''est pas là, Le salut, et il est loin de nous.
verses.am: ሁላችን እንደ ድቦች እንጮኻለን፥ እንደ ርግብ እንለቃቀሳለን፤ ፍርድን በተስፋ እንጠባበቅ ነበር እርሱም የለም፤ መዳንም ከእኛ ዘንድ ርቆአል።

verses.en: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
verses.fr: Car nos transgressions sont nombreuses devant toi, Et nos péchés témoignent contre nous; Nos transgressions sont avec nous, Et nous connaissons nos crimes.
verses.am: ዓመፃችን በአንተ ፊት በዝቶአልና፥ ኃጢአታችን መስክሮብናልና፥ ዓመፃችን ከእኛ ጋር ነውና፥ በደላችንን እናውቃለንና።

verses.en: In transgressing and lying against the Lord, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.fr: Nous avons été coupables et infidèles envers l''Eternel, Nous avons abandonné notre Dieu; Nous avons proféré la violence et la révolte, Conçu et médité dans le coeur des paroles de mensonge;
verses.am: ዐምፀናል፥ ሐሰትን ተናግረናል፥ አምላካችንንም ከመከተል ተመልሰናል፤ ግፍንና ዓመፅንም ተናግረናል፥ የኃጢአት ቃልንም ፀንሰን ከልብ አውጥተናል።

verses.en: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
verses.fr: Et la délivrance s''est retirée, Et le salut se tient éloigné; Car la vérité trébuche sur la place publique, Et la droiture ne peut approcher.
verses.am: ፍርድም ወደ ኋላ ተመልሶአል፥ ጽድቅም በሩቅ ቆሞአል፤ እውነትም በአደባባይ ላይ ወድቆአልና፥ ቅንነትም ሊገባ አልቻለምና።

verses.en: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
verses.fr: La vérité a disparu, Et celui qui s''éloigne du mal est dépouillé. -L''Eternel voit, d''un regard indigné, Qu''il n''y a plus de droiture.
verses.am: እውነትም ታጥቶአል፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ሰው ለብዝበዛ ሆኖአል።  እግዚአብሔርም አየ፥ ፍርድም ስለሌለ ተከፋ።

verses.en: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
verses.fr: Il voit qu''il n''y a pas un homme, Il s''étonne de ce que personne n''intercède; Alors son bras lui vient en aide, Et sa justice lui sert d''appui.
verses.am: ሰውም እንደሌለ አየ፥ ወደ እርሱ የሚማልድ እንደሌለ ተረዳ ተደነቀም፤ ስለዚህ የገዛ ክንዱ መድኃኒት አመጣለት፥ ጽድቁም አገዘው።

verses.en: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloak.
verses.fr: Il se revêt de la justice comme d''une cuirasse, Et il met sur sa tête le casque du salut; Il prend la vengeance pour vêtement, Et il se couvre de la jalousie comme d''un manteau.
verses.am: ጽድቅንም እንደ ጥሩር ለበሰ፥ በራሱም ላይ የማዳንን ራስ ቍር አደረገ፤ የበቀልንም ልብስ ለበሰ፥ በቅንዓትም መጐናጸፊያ ተጐናጸፈ።

verses.en: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
verses.fr: Il rendra à chacun selon ses oeuvres, La fureur à ses adversaires, La pareille à ses ennemis; Il rendra la pareille aux îles.
verses.am: እንደ ሥራቸው መጠን እንዲሁ ቍጣን ለባላጋራዎቹ፥ ፍዳንም ለጠላቶቹ ይከፍላል፤ ለደሴቶችም ፍዳቸውን ይከፍላል።

verses.en: So shall they fear the name of the Lord from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him.
verses.fr: On craindra le nom de l''Eternel depuis l''occident, Et sa gloire depuis le soleil levant; Quand l''ennemi viendra comme un fleuve, L''esprit de l''Eternel le mettra en fuite.
verses.am: እርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ነፋስ እንደሚነዳው እንደ ጐርፍ ፈሳሽ ይመጣልና በምዕራብ ያሉት የእግዚአብሔርን ስም፥ በፀሐይ መውጫም ያሉት ክብሩን ይፈራሉ።

verses.en: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Un rédempteur viendra pour Sion, Pour ceux de Jacob qui se convertiront de leurs péchés, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለጽዮን ታዳጊ ይመጣል፥ በያዕቆብም ዘንድ ከኃጢአት ለሚርቁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the Lord; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the Lord, from henceforth and for ever.
verses.fr: Voici mon alliance avec eux, dit l''Eternel: Mon esprit, qui repose sur toi, Et mes paroles, que j''ai mises dans ta bouche, Ne se retireront point de ta bouche, ni de la bouche de tes enfants, Ni de la bouche des enfants de tes enfants, Dit l''Eternel, dès maintenant et à jamais.
verses.am: ከእርሱ ጋር ያለው ቃል ኪዳኔ ይህ ነው ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በአንተ ላይ ያለው መንፈሴ በአፍህም ውስጥ ያደረግሁት ቃሌ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ከአፍህ ከዘርህም አፍ ከዘር ዘርህም አፍ አያልፍም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, sois éclairée, car ta lumière arrive, Et la gloire de l''Eternel se lève sur toi.
verses.am: ብርሃንሽ መጥቶአልና፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ወጥቶልሻልና ተነሺ፥ አብሪ።

verses.en: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
verses.fr: Voici, les ténèbres couvrent la terre, Et l''obscurité les peuples; Mais sur toi l''Eternel se lève, Sur toi sa gloire apparaît.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ጨለማ ምድርን ድቅድቅ ጨለማም አሕዛብን ይሸፍናል፤ ነገር ግን በአንቺ ላይ እግዚአብሔር ይወጣል ክብሩም በአንቺ ላይ ይታያል፤

verses.en: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
verses.fr: Des nations marchent à ta lumière, Et des rois à la clarté de tes rayons.
verses.am: አሕዛብም ወደ ብርሃንሽ ነገሥታትም ወደ መውጫሽ ጸዳል ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.
verses.fr: Porte tes yeux alentour, et regarde: Tous ils s''assemblent, ils viennent vers toi; Tes fils arrivent de loin, Et tes filles sont portées sur les bras.
verses.am: ዓይኖችሽን አንሥተሽ በዙሪያሽ ተመልከቺ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ ተሰብስበው ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፤ ወንዶች ልጆችሽ ከሩቅ ይመጣሉ፥ ሴቶች ልጆችሽንም በጫንቃ ላይ ይሸከሙአቸዋል።

verses.en: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.
verses.fr: Tu tressailliras alors et tu te réjouiras, Et ton coeur bondira et se dilatera, Quand les richesses de la mer se tourneront vers toi, Quand les trésors des nations viendront à toi.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የባሕሩ በረከት ወደ አንቺ ስለሚመለስ፥ የአሕዛብም ብልጥግና ወደ አንቺ ስለሚመጣ፥ አይተሽ ደስ ይልሻል፥ ልብሽም ይደነቃል ይሰፋማል።

verses.en: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu seras couverte d''une foule de chameaux, De dromadaires de Madian et d''Epha; Ils viendront tous de Séba; Ils porteront de l''or et de l''encens, Et publieront les louanges de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የግመሎች ብዛት፥ የምድያምና የጌፌር ግመሎች፥ ይሸፍኑሻል፤ ሁሉ ከሳባ ይመጣሉ፥ ወርቅንና ዕጣንን ያመጣሉ የእግዚአብሔርንም ምስጋና ያወራሉ።

verses.en: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
verses.fr: Les troupeaux de Kédar se réuniront tous chez toi; Les béliers de Nebajoth seront à ton service; Ils monteront sur mon autel et me seront agréables, Et je glorifierai la maison de ma gloire.
