verses.am: የቄዳር መንጎች ሁሉ ወደ አንቺ ይሰበሰባሉ የነባዮትም አውራ በጎች ያገለግሉሻል፤ እኔን ደስ ሊያሰኙ በመሠዊያዬ ላይ ይወጣሉ፥ የክብሬንም ቤት አከብራለሁ።

verses.en: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
verses.fr: Qui sont ceux-là qui volent comme des nuées, Comme des colombes vers leur colombier?
verses.am: ርግቦች ወደ ቤታቸው እንደሚበርሩ፥ እነዚህ እንደ ደመና የሚበርሩ እነማን ናቸው?

verses.en: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the Lord thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.
verses.fr: Car les îles espèrent en moi, Et les navires de Tarsis sont en tête, Pour ramener de loin tes enfants, Avec leur argent et leur or, A cause du nom de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, Du Saint d''Israël qui te glorifie.
verses.am: እርሱ አክብሮሻልና ለአምላክሽ ለእግዚአብሔር ስምና ለእስራኤል ቅዱስ ልጆችሽን ከሩቅ ከእነርሱ ጋርም ብራቸውንና ወርቃቸውን ያመጡ ዘንድ ደሴቶች የተርሴስ መርከቦችም አስቀድመው ይጠባበቁኛል።

verses.en: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.
verses.fr: Les fils de l''étranger rebâtiront tes murs, Et leurs rois seront tes serviteurs; Car je t''ai frappée dans ma colère, Mais dans ma miséricorde j''ai pitié de toi.
verses.am: በቍጣዬ ቀሥፌ በፍቅሬ ምሬሻለሁና መጻተኞች ቅጥርሽን ይሠራሉ፥ ነገሥታቶቻቸውም ያገለግሉሻል።

verses.en: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.
verses.fr: Tes portes seront toujours ouvertes, Elles ne seront fermées ni jour ni nuit, Afin de laisser entrer chez toi les trésors des nations, Et leurs rois avec leur suite.
verses.am: በሮችሽም ሁልጊዜ ይከፈታሉ፤ ሰዎች የአሕዛብን ብልጥግና የተማረኩትንም ነገሥታቶቻቸውን ወደ አንቺ ያመጡ ዘንድ ሌሊትና ቀን አይዘጉም።

verses.en: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
verses.fr: Car la nation et le royaume qui ne te serviront pas périront, Ces nations-là seront exterminées.
verses.am: ለአንቺም የማይገዛ ሕዝብና መንግሥት ይጠፋል፥ እነዚያ አሕዛብም ፈጽመው ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
verses.fr: La gloire du Liban viendra chez toi, Le cyprès, l''orme et le buis, tous ensemble, Pour orner le lieu de mon sanctuaire, Et je glorifierai la place où reposent mes pieds.
verses.am: የመቅደሴንም ስፍራ ያስጌጡ ዘንድ የሊባኖስ ክብር፥ ጥዱና አስታው ባርሰነቱም፥ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፥ የእግሬንም ስፍራ አከብራለሁ።

verses.en: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee; The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: Les fils de tes oppresseurs viendront s''humilier devant toi, Et tous ceux qui te méprisaient se prosterneront à tes pieds; Ils t''appelleront ville de l''Eternel, Sion du Saint d''Israël.
verses.am: የአስጨናቂዎችሽም ልጆች አንገታቸውን ደፍተው ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፥ የናቁሽም ሁሉ ወደ እግርሽ ጫማ ይሰግዳሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ከተማ፥ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ የሆንሽ ጽዮን ይሉሻል።

verses.en: Whereas thou has been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
verses.fr: Au lieu que tu étais délaissée et haïe, Et que personne ne te parcourait, Je ferai de toi un ornement pour toujours, Un sujet de joie de génération en génération.
verses.am: ከሰውም ማንም እስከማያልፍብሽ ድረስ የተተውሽና የተጠላሽ ነበርሽ፤ ነገር ግን የዘላለም ትምክሕትና የልጅ ልጅ ደስታ አደርግሻለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.fr: Tu suceras le lait des nations, Tu suceras la mamelle des rois; Et tu sauras que je suis l''Eternel, ton sauveur, Ton rédempteur, le puissant de Jacob.
verses.am: የአሕዛብንም ወተት ትጠጫለሽ የነገሥታትንም ጡት ትጠቢያለሽ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር የያዕቆብ ኃይል፥ መድኃኒትሽና ታዳጊሽ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቂያለሽ።

verses.en: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
verses.fr: Au lieu de l''airain je ferai venir de l''or, Au lieu du fer je ferai venir de l''argent, Au lieu du bois, de l''airain, Et au lieu des pierres, du fer; Je ferai régner sur toi la paix, Et dominer la justice.
verses.am: በናስ ፋንታ ወርቅን፥ በብረትም ፋንታ ብርን፥ በእንጨትም ፋንታ ናስን፥ በድንጋይም ፋንታ ብረትን አመጣለሁ። አለቆችሽንም ሰላም፥ የበላይ ገዢዎችሽንም ጽድቅ አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.en: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
verses.fr: On n''entendra plus parler de violence dans ton pays, Ni de ravage et de ruine dans ton territoire; Tu donneras à tes murs le nom de salut, Et à tes portes celui de gloire.
verses.am: ከዚያ በኋላ በምድርሽ ውስጥ ግፍ፥ በዳርቻሽም ውስጥ ጕስቍልናና ቅጥቃጤ አይሰማም፤ ቅጥርሽን መዳን በሮችሽንም ምስጋና ብለሽ ትጠሪያለሽ

verses.en: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the Lord shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
verses.fr: Ce ne sera plus le soleil qui te servira de lumière pendant le jour, Ni la lune qui t''éclairera de sa lueur; Mais l''Eternel sera ta lumière à toujours, Ton Dieu sera ta gloire.
verses.am: ከዚያ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር የዘላለም ብርሃንሽ፥ አምላክሽም ክብርሽ ይሆናልና ፀሐይ በቀን ብርሃን አይሆንልሽም፥ የጨረቃም ብርሃን በሌሊት አይበራልሽም።

verses.en: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the Lord shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
verses.fr: Ton soleil ne se couchera plus, Et ta lune ne s''obscurcira plus; Car l''Eternel sera ta lumière à toujours, Et les jours de ton deuil seront passés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የዘላለም ብርሃንሽ ይሆናልና፥ የልቅሶሽም ወራት ታልቃለችና ፀሐይሽ ከዚያ በኋላ አትጠልቅም ጨረቃሽም አይቋረጥም።

verses.en: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
verses.fr: Il n''y aura plus que des justes parmi ton peuple, Ils posséderont à toujours le pays; C''est le rejeton que j''ai planté, l''oeuvre de mes mains, Pour servir à ma gloire.
verses.am: ሕዝብሽም ሁሉ ጻድቃን ይሆናሉ፤ እኔም እከብር ዘንድ የአታክልቴን ቡቃያ፥ የእጄ ሥራ የምትሆን ምድሪቱንም ለዘላለም ይወርሳሉ።

verses.en: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the Lord will hasten it in his time.
verses.fr: Le plus petit deviendra un millier, Et le moindre une nation puissante. Moi, l''Eternel, je hâterai ces choses en leur temps.
verses.am: ታናሹ ለሺህ የሁሉም ታናሹ ለብርቱ ሕዝብ ይሆናል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር በዘመኑ ይህን አፋጥነዋለሁ።

verses.en: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
verses.fr: L''esprit du Seigneur, l''Eternel, est sur moi, Car l''Eternel m''a oint pour porter de bonnes nouvelles aux malheureux; Il m''a envoyé pour guérir ceux qui ont le coeur brisé, Pour proclamer aux captifs la liberté, Et aux prisonniers la délivrance;
verses.am: የጌታ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ ነው፥ ለድሆች የምሥራችን እሰብክ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ቀብቶኛልና፤ ልባቸው የተሰበረውን እጠግን ዘንድ፥ ለተማረኩትም ነጻነትን ለታሰሩትም መፈታትን እናገር ዘንድ ልኮኛል።

verses.en: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
verses.fr: Pour publier une année de grâce de l''Eternel, Et un jour de vengeance de notre Dieu; Pour consoler tous les affligés;
verses.am: የተወደደችውን የእግዚአብሔርን ዓመት አምላካችንም የሚበቀልበትን ቀን እናገር ዘንድ፥ የሚያለቅሱትንም ሁሉ አጽናና ዘንድ፤

verses.en: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, that he might be glorified.
verses.fr: Pour accorder aux affligés de Sion, Pour leur donner un diadème au lieu de la cendre, Une huile de joie au lieu du deuil, Un vêtement de louange au lieu d''un esprit abattu, Afin qu''on les appelle des térébinthes de la justice, Une plantation de l''Eternel, pour servir à sa gloire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለክብሩ የተከላቸው የጽድቅ ዛፎች እንዲባሉ ለጽዮን አልቃሾች አደርግላቸው ዘንድ፥ በአመድ ፋንታ አክሊልን፥ በልቅሶም ፋንታ የደስታን ዘይት፥ በኀዘንም መንፈስ ፋንታ የምስጋናን መጐናጸፊያ እሰጣቸው ዘንድ ልኮኛል።

verses.en: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
verses.fr: Ils rebâtiront sur d''anciennes ruines, Ils relèveront d''antiques décombres, Ils renouvelleront des villes ravagées, Dévastées depuis longtemps.
verses.am: ከጥንትም ጀምሮ ባድማ የነበሩትን ይሠራሉ ከቀድሞ የፈረሱትንም ያቆማሉ፤ ባድማ የነበሩትንና ከብዙ ትውልድ በፊት የፈረሱትን ከተሞች እንደ ገና ይሠራሉ።

verses.en: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
verses.fr: Des étrangers seront là et feront paître vos troupeaux, Des fils de l''étranger seront vos laboureurs et vos vignerons.
verses.am: መጻተኞችም ቆመው በጎቻችሁን ያሰማራሉ፥ ሌሎች ወገኖችም አራሾችና ወይም ጠባቂዎች ይሆኑላችኋል።

verses.en: But ye shall be named the Priests of the Lord: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
verses.fr: Mais vous, on vous appellera sacrificateurs de l''Eternel, On vous nommera serviteurs de notre Dieu; Vous mangerez les richesses des nations, Et vous vous glorifierez de leur gloire.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን የእግዚአብሔር ካህናት ትባላላችሁ፥ ሰዎቹም የአምላካችን አገልጋዮች ብለው ይጠሩአችኋል፤ የአሕዛብን ሀብት ትበላላችሁ፥ በክብራቸውም ትመካላችሁ።

verses.en: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
verses.fr: Au lieu de votre opprobre, vous aurez une portion double; Au lieu de l''ignominie, ils seront joyeux de leur part; Ils posséderont ainsi le double dans leur pays, Et leur joie sera éternelle.
verses.am: በእፍረታችሁ ፋንታ ሁለት እጥፍ ይሆንላችኋል፥ በውርደታችሁም ፋንታ ዕድል ፈንታችሁ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ ስለዚህ በምድራቸው ሁሉ እጥፍ ይገዛሉ፥ የዘላለምም ደስታ ይሆንላቸዋል።

verses.en: For I the Lord love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.fr: Car moi, l''Eternel, j''aime la justice, Je hais la rapine avec l''iniquité; Je leur donnerai fidèlement leur récompense, Et je traiterai avec eux une alliance éternelle.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን የምወድድ ስርቆትንና በደልን የምጠላ ነኝ፤ ፍዳቸውንም በእውነት እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the Lord hath blessed.
verses.fr: Leur race sera connue parmi les nations, Et leur postérité parmi les peuples; Tous ceux qui les verront reconnaîtront Qu''ils sont une race bénie de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ዘራቸውም በአሕዛብ መካከል፥ ልጆቻቸውም በወገኖች መካከል የታወቁ ይሆናሉ፤ ያያቸው ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር የባረካቸው ዘር እንደ ሆኑ ይገነዘባል።

verses.en: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
verses.fr: Je me réjouirai en l''Eternel, Mon âme sera ravie d''allégresse en mon Dieu; Car il m''a revêtu des vêtements du salut, Il m''a couvert du manteau de la délivrance, Comme le fiancé s''orne d''un diadème, Comme la fiancée se pare de ses joyaux.
verses.am: አክሊልን እንደ ለበሰ ሙሽራ፥ በጌጥ ሽልማትዋም እንዳጌጠች ሙሽራ፥ የማዳንን ልብስ አልብሶኛልና፥ የጽድቅንም መጐናጸፊያ ደርቦልኛልና በእግዚአብሔር እጅግ ደስ ይለኛል፥ ነፍሴም በአምላኬ ሐሤት ታደርጋለች።

verses.en: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord God will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
verses.fr: Car, comme la terre fait éclore son germe, Et comme un jardin fait pousser ses semences, Ainsi le Seigneur, l''Eternel, fera germer le salut et la louange, En présence de toutes les nations.
verses.am: ምድርም ቡቃያዋን እንደምታወጣ፥ ገነትም ዘሩን እንደሚያበቅል፥ እንዲሁ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ጽድቅንና ምስጋናን በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ፊት ያበቅላል።

verses.en: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.
verses.fr: Pour l''amour de Sion je ne me tairai point, Pour l''amour de Jérusalem je ne prendrai point de repos, Jusqu''à ce que son salut paraisse, comme l''aurore, Et sa délivrance, comme un flambeau qui s''allume.
verses.am: ስለ ጽዮን ዝም አልልም፥ ስለ ኢየሩሳሌምም ጸጥ አልልም፥ ጽድቅዋ እንደ ጸዳል መዳንዋም እንደሚበራ ፋና እስኪወጣ ድረስ።

verses.en: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the Lord shall name.
verses.fr: Alors les nations verront ton salut, Et tous les rois ta gloire; Et l''on t''appellera d''un nom nouveau, Que la bouche de l''Eternel déterminera.
verses.am: አሕዛብም ጽድቅሽን ነገሥታትም ሁሉ ክብርሽን ያያሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም አፍ በሚጠራበት በአዲሱ ስም ትጠሪያለሽ።

verses.en: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
verses.fr: Tu seras une couronne éclatante dans la main de l''Eternel, Un turban royal dans la main de ton Dieu.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር እጅ የክብር አክሊል፥ በአምላክሽም እጅ የመንግሥት ዘውድ ትሆኛለሽ።

verses.en: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the Lord delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
verses.fr: On ne te nommera plus délaissée, On ne nommera plus ta terre désolation; Mais on t''appellera mon plaisir en elle, Et l''on appellera ta terre épouse; Car l''Eternel met son plaisir en toi, Et ta terre aura un époux.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ። የተተወች አትባዪም፤ ምድርሽም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ። ውድማ አትባልም፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር በአንቺ ደስ ብሎታልና፥ ምድርሽም ባል ታገባለችና አንቺ። ደስታዬ የሚኖርባት ትባያለሽ ምድርሽም። ባል ያገባች ትባላለች።

verses.en: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.
verses.fr: Comme un jeune homme s''unit à une vierge, Ainsi tes fils s''uniront à toi; Et comme la fiancée fait la joie de son fiancé, Ainsi tu feras la joie de ton Dieu.
verses.am: ጕልማሳም ድንግሊቱን እንደሚያገባ፥ እንዲሁ ልጆችሽ ያገቡሻል፤ ሙሽራም በሙሽራይቱ ደስ እንደሚለው፥ እንዲሁ አምላክሽ በአንቺ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence,
verses.fr: Sur tes murs, Jérusalem, j''ai placé des gardes; Ils ne se tairont ni jour ni nuit. Vous qui la rappelez au souvenir de l''Eternel, Point de repos pour vous!
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ጕበኞችን በቅጥርሽ ላይ አቁሜአለሁ፤ ቀንና ሌሊት ከቶ ዝም አይሉም፤ እናንተ እግዚአብሔርን የምታሳስቡ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን እስኪያጸና በምድርም ላይ ምስጋና እስኪያደርጋት ድረስ አትረፉ ለእርሱም ዕረፍት አትስጡ።

verses.en: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
verses.fr: Et ne lui laissez aucun relâche, Jusqu''à ce qu''il rétablisse Jérusalem Et la rende glorieuse sur la terre.
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ጕበኞችን በቅጥርሽ ላይ አቁሜአለሁ፤ ቀንና ሌሊት ከቶ ዝም አይሉም፤ እናንተ እግዚአብሔርን የምታሳስቡ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን እስኪያጸና በምድርም ላይ ምስጋና እስኪያደርጋት ድረስ አትረፉ ለእርሱም ዕረፍት አትስጡ።

verses.en: The Lord hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
verses.fr: L''Eternel l''a juré par sa droite et par son bras puissant: Je ne donnerai plus ton blé pour nourriture à tes ennemis, Et les fils de l''étranger ne boiront plus ton vin, Produit de tes labeurs;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በእርግጥ ለጠላቶችሽ መብል ይሆን ዘንድ እህልሽን አልሰጥም፥ መጻተኞችም የደከምሽበትን ወይንሽን አይጠጡም፤

verses.en: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the Lord; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
verses.fr: Mais ceux qui auront amassé le blé le mangeront Et loueront l''Eternel, Et ceux qui auront récolté le vin le boiront, Dans les parvis de mon sanctuaire.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሰበሰቡት ይበሉታል እግዚአብሔርንም ያመሰግናሉ፥ ያከማቹትም በመቅደሴ አደባባይ ላይ ይጠጡታል ብሎ በቀኙና በኃይሉ ክንድ ምሎአል።

verses.en: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
verses.fr: Franchissez, franchissez les portes! Préparez un chemin pour le peuple! Frayez, frayez la route, ôtez les pierres! Elevez une bannière vers les peuples!
verses.am: እለፉ፥ በበሮች በኩል እለፉ፤ የሕዝቡንም መንገድ ጥረጉ፤ አዘጋጁ፥ ጐዳናውን አዘጋጁ፥ ድንጋዮቹንም አስወግዱ፤ ለአሕዛብም ዓለማ አንሡ።

verses.en: Behold, the Lord hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
verses.fr: Voici ce que l''Eternel proclame aux extrémités de la terre: Dites à la fille de Sion: Voici, ton sauveur arrive; Voici, le salaire est avec lui, Et les rétributions le précèdent.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለምድር ዳርቻ አዋጅ እንዲህ ብሎ ነግሮአል። ለጽዮን ልጅ። እነሆ፥ መድኃኒትሽ ይመጣል፤ እነሆ፥ ዋጋው ከእርሱ ጋር ሥራውም በፊቱ አለ በሉአት።

verses.en: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the Lord: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
verses.fr: On les appellera peuple saint, rachetés de l''Eternel; Et toi, on t''appellera recherchée, ville non délaissée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር። የተቤዣቸው፥ የተቀደሰ ሕዝብ ብለው ይጠሩአቸዋል፤ አንቺም። የተፈለገች ያልተተወችም ከተማ ትባያለሽ።

verses.en: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
verses.fr: Qui est celui-ci qui vient d''Edom, De Botsra, en vêtements rouges, En habits éclatants, Et se redressant avec fierté dans la plénitude de sa force? -C''est moi qui ai promis le salut, Qui ai le pouvoir de délivrer. -
verses.am: ይህ ከኤዶምያስ፥ ልብሱም የቀላ ከባሶራ የሚመጣ፥ አለባበሱ ያማረ፥ በጕልበቱ ጽናት የሚራመድ ማን ነው? በጽድቅ የምናገር ለማዳንም የምበረታ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
verses.fr: Pourquoi tes habits sont-ils rouges, Et tes vêtements comme les vêtements de celui qui foule dans la cuve? -
verses.am: ቀሚስህ ስለ ምን ቀላ? ልብስህስ በወይን መጥመቂያ እንደሚረግጥ ሰው ልብስ ስለ ምን መሰለ?

verses.en: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
verses.fr: J''ai été seul à fouler au pressoir, Et nul homme d''entre les peuples n''était avec moi; Je les ai foulés dans ma colère, Je les ai écrasés dans ma fureur; Leur sang a jailli sur mes vêtements, Et j''ai souillé tous mes habits.
verses.am: መጥመቂያውን ብቻዬን ረግጫለሁ፥ ከአሕዛብም አንድ ሰው ከእኔ ጋር አልነበረም፤ በቍጣዬ ረገጥኋቸው በመዓቴም ቀጠቀጥኋቸው፤ ደማቸውም በልብሴ ላይ ተረጭቶአል፥ ልብሴንም ሁሉ አስድፌአለሁ።

verses.en: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
verses.fr: Car un jour de vengeance était dans mon coeur, Et l''année de mes rachetés est venue.
verses.am: የምበቀልበት ቀን በልቤ ነውና፥ የምቤዥበትም ዓመት ደርሶአልና።

verses.en: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
verses.fr: Je regardais, et personne pour m''aider; J''étais étonné, et personne pour me soutenir; Alors mon bras m''a été en aide, Et ma fureur m''a servi d''appui.
verses.am: ተመለከትሁ፥ የሚረዳም አልተገኘም፤ የሚያግዝም አልነበረምና ተደነቅሁ፤ ስለዚህ የገዛ ክንዴ መድኃኒት አመጣልኝ፥ ቍጣዬም እርሱ አገዘኝ።

verses.en: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
verses.fr: J''ai foulé des peuples dans ma colère, Je les ai rendus ivres dans ma fureur, Et j''ai répandu leur sang sur la terre.
verses.am: በቍጣዬም አሕዛብን ረገጥሁ በመዓቴም ቀጠቀጥኋቸው፥ ደማቸውንም ወደ ምድር አፈሰስሁት።

verses.en: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the Lord, and the praises of the Lord, according to all that the Lord hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
verses.fr: Je publierai les grâces de l''Eternel, les louanges de l''Eternel, D''après tout ce que l''Eternel a fait pour nous; Je dirai sa grande bonté envers la maison d''Israël, Qu''il a traitée selon ses compassions et la richesse de son amour.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሰጠን ሁሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቸርነትና የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋና፥ እንደ ምሕረቱና እንደ ቸርነቱም ብዛት ለእስራኤል ቤት የሰጠውን ትልቅ በጎነት አሳስባለሁ።

verses.en: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
verses.fr: Il avait dit: Certainement ils sont mon peuple, Des enfants qui ne seront pas infidèles! Et il a été pour eux un sauveur.
verses.am: እርሱም። በእውነት ሕዝቤ፥ ሐሰትን የማያደርጉ ልጆች፥ ናቸው አለ፤ መድኃኒትም ሆነላቸው።

verses.en: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
verses.fr: Dans toutes leurs détresses ils n''ont pas été sans secours, Et l''ange qui est devant sa face les a sauvés; Il les a lui-même rachetés, dans son amour et sa miséricorde, Et constamment il les a soutenus et portés, aux anciens jours.
verses.am: በጭንቃቸው ሁሉ እርሱ ተጨነቀ፥ የፊቱም መልአክ አዳናቸው፤ በፍቅሩና በርኅራኄውም ተቤዣቸው፥ በቀደመውም ዘመን ሁሉ አንሥቶ ተሸከማቸው።

verses.en: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.
verses.fr: Mais ils ont été rebelles, ils ont attristé son esprit saint; Et il est devenu leur ennemi, il a combattu contre eux.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ዐመፁ ቅዱስ መንፈሱንም አስመረሩ፤ ስለዚህ ተመልሶ ጠላት ሆናቸው፥ እርሱም ተዋጋቸው።

verses.en: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?
verses.fr: Alors son peuple se souvint des anciens jours de Moïse: Où est celui qui les fit monter de la mer, Avec le berger de son troupeau? Où est celui qui mettait au milieu d''eux son esprit saint;
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ ብሎ የቀደመውን ዘመን አሰበ። የበጎቹን እረኛ ከባሕሩ ያወጣው ወዴት ነው ያለ? ቅዱስ መንፈሱንም በመካከላቸው ያኖረ ወዴት ነው ያለ?

verses.en: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
verses.fr: Qui dirigea la droite de Moïse, Par son bras glorieux; Qui fendit les eaux devant eux, Pour se faire un nom éternel;
verses.am: የከበረውንም ክንድ በሙሴ ቀኝ ያስሄደ፥ ለራሱም የዘላለምን ስም ያደርግ ዘንድ ውኃውን በፊታቸው የከፈለ፥

verses.en: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?
verses.fr: Qui les dirigea au travers des flots, Comme un coursier dans le désert, Sans qu''ils bronchassent?
verses.am: በምድረ በዳም እንደሚያልፍ ፈረስ፥ በቀላይ ውስጥ ያለ ዕንቅፋት ያሳለፋቸው ወዴት ነው ያለ?

verses.en: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the Lord caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
verses.fr: Comme la bête qui descend dans la vallée, L''esprit de l''Eternel les a menés au repos. C''est ainsi que tu as conduit ton peuple, Pour te faire un nom glorieux.
verses.am: ወደ ሸለቆ እንደሚወርዱ ከብቶች፥ እንዲሁ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ወደ ዕረፍት አመጣቸው፤ እንዲሁም ለራስህ የከበረ ስም ታደርግ ዘንድ ሕዝብን መራህ።

verses.en: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?
verses.fr: Regarde du ciel, et vois, De ta demeure sainte et glorieuse: Où sont ton zèle et ta puissance? Le frémissement de tes entrailles et tes compassions Ne se font plus sentir envers moi.
verses.am: ከሰማይ ተመልከት፥ ከቅዱስነትህና ከክብርህም ማደሪያ ጐብኝ፤ ቅንዓትህና ኃይልህስ ወዴት ነው? ለእኔም የሆነው የልብህ ናፍቆትና ርኅራኄህ ተከለከለ።

verses.en: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O Lord, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.
verses.fr: Tu es cependant notre père, Car Abraham ne nous connaît pas, Et Israël ignore qui nous sommes; C''est toi, Eternel, qui es notre père, Qui, dès l''éternité, t''appelles notre sauveur.
verses.am: አብርሃም ባያውቀን እስራኤልም ባይገነዘበን አንተ አባታችን ነህ፤ አቤቱ፥ አንተ አባታችን ነህ፥ ስምህም ከዘላለም ታዳጊያችን ነው።

verses.en: O Lord, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
verses.fr: Pourquoi, ô Eternel, nous fais-tu errer loin de tes voies, Et endurcis-tu notre coeur contre ta crainte? Reviens, pour l''amour de tes serviteurs, Des tribus de ton héritage!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከመንገድህ ለምን አሳትኸን? እንዳንፈራህም ልባችንን ለምን አጸናህብን? ስለ ባሪያዎችህ ስለ ርስትህ ነገዶች ተመለስ።

verses.en: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
verses.fr: Ton peuple saint n''a possédé le pays que peu de temps; Nos ennemis ont foulé ton sanctuaire.
verses.am: የተቀደሰው ሕዝብህ መቅደስህን ጥቂት ጊዜ ወረሱት፤ ጠላቶቻችንም ረግጠውታል።

verses.en: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.
verses.fr: Nous sommes depuis longtemps comme un peuple que tu ne gouvernes pas, Et qui n''est point appelé de ton nom...
verses.am: ከዘላለም እንዳልገዛኸን በስምህም እንዳልተጠራን ሆነናል።

verses.en: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
verses.fr: Oh! si tu déchirais les cieux, et si tu descendais, Les montagnes s''ébranleraient devant toi,
verses.am: ሰማዮችን ቀድደህ ምነው ብትወርድ! ተራሮችም ምነው ቢናወጡ!

verses.en: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
verses.fr: Comme s''allume un feu de bois sec, Comme s''évapore l''eau qui bouillonne; Tes ennemis connaîtraient ton nom, Et les nations trembleraient devant toi.
verses.am: እሳት ጭራሮውን እንደሚያቃጥል፥ እሳትም ውኃውን እንደሚያፈላ፥ ስምህ ለጠላቶችህ ይገለጥ ዘንድ፥ አሕዛብም በፊትህ ይንቀጠቀጡ ዘንድ።

verses.en: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
verses.fr: Lorsque tu fis des prodiges que nous n''attendions pas, Tu descendis, et les montagnes s''ébranlèrent devant toi.
verses.am: ያልተጠባበቅነውን የክብርህን ሥራ ባደረግህ ጊዜ፥ ወረድህ ተራሮችም በፊትህ ተንቀጠቀጡ።

verses.en: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
verses.fr: Jamais on n''a appris ni entendu dire, Et jamais l''oeil n''a vu qu''un autre dieu que toi Fît de telles choses pour ceux qui se confient en lui.
verses.am: ሰዎች ከጥንት ጀምሮ ለሚጠብቁህ ከምትሠራላቸው ከአንተ በቀር ሌላ አምላክን አልሰሙም በጆሮአቸውም አልተቀበሉም ዓይንም አላየችም።

verses.en: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
verses.fr: Tu vas au-devant de celui qui pratique avec joie la justice, De ceux qui marchent dans tes voies et se souviennent de toi. Mais tu as été irrité, parce que nous avons péché; Et nous en souffrons longtemps jusqu''à ce que nous soyons sauvés.
verses.am: ጽድቅን የሚያደርገውን በመንገዶችህም የሚያስቡህን ትገናኛቸዋለህ። እነሆ፥ እነተ ተቈጣህ እኛም ኃጢአት ሠራን፤ ስለዚህም ተሳሳትን።

verses.en: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
verses.fr: Nous sommes tous comme des impurs, Et toute notre justice est comme un vêtement souillé; Nous sommes tous flétris comme une feuille, Et nos crimes nous emportent comme le vent.
verses.am: ሁላችን እንደ ርኩስ ሰው ሆነናል፥ ጽድቃችንም ሁሉ እንደ መርገም ጨርቅ ነው፤ ሁላችንም እንደ ቅጠል ረግፈናል፥ በደላችንም እንደ ነፋስ ወስዶናል።

verses.en: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
verses.fr: Il n''y a personne qui invoque ton nom, Qui se réveille pour s''attacher à toi: Aussi nous as-tu caché ta face, Et nous laisses-tu périr par l''effet de nos crimes.
verses.am: ስምህንም የሚጠራ፥ አንተንም ሊይዝ የሚያስብ የለም፤ ፊትህንም ከእኛ ሰውረሃል፥ በኃጢአታችንም አጥፍተኸናል።

verses.en: But now, O Lord, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
verses.fr: Cependant, ô Eternel, tu es notre père; Nous sommes l''argile, et c''est toi qui nous as formés, Nous sommes tous l''ouvrage de tes mains.
verses.am: አሁን ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ አንተ አባታችን ነህ፤ እኛ ጭቃ ነን አንተም ሠሪያችን ነህ፥ እኛም ሁላችን የእጅህ ሥራ ነን።

verses.en: Be not wroth very sore, O Lord, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
verses.fr: Ne t''irrite pas à l''extrême, ô Eternel, Et ne te souviens pas à toujours du crime; Regarde donc, nous sommes tous ton peuple.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እጅግ አትቈጣ፥ ለዘላለምም ኃጢአትን አታስብ፤ እነሆ፥ እባክህ፥ ተመልከት፥ እኛ ሁላችን ሕዝብህ ነን።

verses.en: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.fr: Tes villes saintes sont un désert; Sion est un désert, Jérusalem une solitude.
verses.am: የተቀደሱ ከተሞችህ ምድረ በዳ ሆነዋል፤ ጽዮን ምድረ በዳ ኢየሩሳሌምም ውድማ ሆናለች።

verses.en: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
verses.fr: Notre maison sainte et glorieuse, Où nos pères célébraient tes louanges, Est devenue la proie des flammes; Tout ce que nous avions de précieux a été dévasté.
verses.am: አባቶቻችን አንተን ያመሰገኑበት የተቀደሰና የተዋበ ቤታችን በእሳት ተቃጥሎአል፥ ያማረውም ስፍራችን ሁሉ ፈርሶአል።

verses.en: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O Lord? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
verses.fr: Après cela, ô Eternel, te contiendras-tu? Est-ce que tu te tairas, et nous affligeras à l''excès?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በውኑ በዚህ ነገር ትታገሣለህን? ዝምስ ትላለህን? አጥብቀህስ ታስጨንቀናለህን?

verses.en: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
verses.fr: J''ai exaucé ceux qui ne demandaient rien, Je me suis laissé trouver par ceux qui ne me cherchaient pas; J''ai dit: Me voici, me voici! A une nation qui ne s''appelait pas de mon nom.
verses.am: ላልጠየቁኝ ተገለጥሁ፥ ላልፈለጉኝም ተገኘሁ፤ በስሜም ያልተጠራውን ሕዝብ። እነሆኝ፥ እነሆኝ አልሁት።

verses.en: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;
verses.fr: J''ai tendu mes mains tous les jours vers un peuple rebelle, Qui marche dans une voie mauvaise, Au gré de ses pensées;
verses.am: መልካም ባልሆነው መንገድ፥ አሳባቸውን እየተከተሉ፥ ወደሚሄዱ ወደ ዓመፀኛ ሕዝብ ቀኑን ሁሉ እጆቼን ዘረጋሁ።

verses.en: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;
verses.fr: Vers un peuple qui ne cesse de m''irriter en face, Sacrifiant dans les jardins, Et brûlant de l''encens sur les briques:
verses.am: ይህ ሕዝብ ዘወትር የሚያስቈጡኝ ናቸው፤ እነርሱ በአትክልት ውስጥ የሚሠዉ በጡብም ላይ የሚያጥኑ፥

verses.en: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
verses.fr: Qui fait des sépulcres sa demeure, Et passe la nuit dans les cavernes, Mangeant de la chair de porc, Et ayant dans ses vases des mets impurs;
verses.am: በመቃብርም መካከል የሚቀመጡ፥ በስውርም ስፍራ የሚያድሩ፥ የእሪያ ሥጋም የሚበሉ ናቸው። የረከሰው መረቅ በዕቃቸው ውስጥ አለ።

verses.en: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.
verses.fr: Qui dit: Retire-toi, Ne m''approche pas, car je suis saint!... De pareilles choses, c''est une fumée dans mes narines, C''est un feu qui brûle toujours.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ለራስህ ቁም፥ እኔ ከአንተ ይልቅ ቅዱስ ነኝና ወደ እኔ አትቅረብ ይላሉ፤ እነዚህ በአፍንጫዬ ዘንድ ጢስ ቀኑንም ሁሉ የምትነድድ እሳት ናቸው።

verses.en: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
verses.fr: Voici ce que j''ai résolu par devers moi: Loin de me taire, je leur ferai porter la peine, Oui, je leur ferai porter la peine
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በፊቴ ተጽፎአል። ኃጢአታችሁና የአባቶቻችሁን ኃጢአት በአንድ ላይ ወደ ብብታቸው ፍዳ አድርጌ አመልሳለሁ እንጂ ዝም አልልም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the Lord, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
verses.fr: De vos crimes, dit l''Eternel, et des crimes de vos pères, Qui ont brûlé de l''encens sur les montagnes, Et qui m''ont outragé sur les collines; Je leur mesurerai le salaire de leurs actions passées.
verses.am: በተራሮችም ላይ ስላጠኑ፥ በኮረብቶችም ላይ ስለ ሰደቡኝ፥ ስለዚህ አስቀድመው የሠሩትን ሥራቸውን በብብታቸው እሰፍራለሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Quand il se trouve du jus dans une grappe, On dit: Ne la détruis pas, Car il y a là une bénédiction! J''agirai de même, pour l''amour de mes serviteurs, Afin de ne pas tout détruire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወይን በዘለላው በተገኘች ጊዜ። በረከት በእርስዋ ላይ አለና አታጥፉት እንደሚባለው፥ ሁሉን እንዳላጠፉ ስለባሪያዎቼ እንዲሁ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
verses.fr: Je ferai sortir de Jacob une postérité, Et de Juda un héritier de mes montagnes; Mes élus posséderont le pays, Et mes serviteurs y habiteront.
verses.am: ከያዕቆብ ዘርን ከይሁዳም ተራሮቼን የሚወርሰውን አወጣለሁ፤ እኔም የመረጥኋቸው ይወርሱአታል፥ ባሪያዎቼም በዚያ ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
verses.fr: Le Saron servira de pâturage au menu bétail, Et la vallée d''Acor servira de gîte au gros bétail, Pour mon peuple qui m''aura cherché.
verses.am: ሳሮንም የበጎች ማሰማርያ፥ የአኮርም ሸለቆ የላሞች መመሰግያ ለፈልጉኝ ሕዝቤ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But ye are they that forsake the Lord, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
verses.fr: Mais vous, qui abandonnez l''Eternel, Qui oubliez ma montagne sainte, Qui dressez une table pour Gad, Et remplissez une coupe pour Meni,
verses.am: እናንተን ግን እግዚአብሔርን የተዋችሁትን፥ ቅዱሱንም ተራራዬን የረሳችሁትን፥ ጉድ ለተባለ ጣዖትም ማዕድ ያዘጋጃችሁትን፥ እድል ለተባለ ጣዖትም የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን የቀዳችሁትን፥

verses.en: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.
verses.fr: Je vous destine au glaive, Et vous fléchirez tous le genou pour être égorgés; Car j''ai appelé, et vous n''avez point répondu, J''ai parlé, et vous n''avez point écouté; Mais vous avez fait ce qui est mal à mes yeux, Et vous avez choisi ce qui me déplaît.
verses.am: እድላችሁን ለሰይፍ አደርገዋለሁ፥ ሁላችሁም ለመታረድ ትጐነበሳላችሁ፤ በፊቴም ክፉ ነገርን አደረጋችሁ፥ ያልወደድሁትንም መረጣችሁ እንጂ በጠራሁ ጊዜ አልመለሳችሁልኝምና፥ በተናገርሁም ጊዜ አልሰማችሁኝምና።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, mes serviteurs mangeront, et vous aurez faim; Voici, mes serviteurs boiront, et vous aurez soif; Voici, mes serviteurs se réjouiront, et vous serez confondus;
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ይበላሉ እናንተ ግን ትራባላችሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ይጠጣሉ እናንተ ግን ትጠማላችሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ደስ ይላቸዋል እናንተ ግን ታፍራላችሁ፤

verses.en: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.
verses.fr: Voici, mes serviteurs chanteront dans la joie de leur coeur; Mais vous, vous crierez dans la douleur de votre âme, Et vous vous lamenterez dans l''abattement de votre esprit.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ከልባቸው ደስታ የተነሣ ይዘምራሉ፥ እናንተ ግን ከልባችሁ ኀዘን የተነሣ ትጮኻላችሁ፥ መንፈሳችሁም ስለ ተሰበረ ወዮ ትላላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:
verses.fr: Vous laisserez votre nom en imprécation à mes élus; Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, vous fera mourir, Et il donnera à ses serviteurs un autre nom.
verses.am: ስማችሁንም ለተመረጡት ሕዝቤ እርግማን አድርጋችሁ ትተዋላችሁ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ይገድላችኋል፥ ባሪያዎቹንም በሌላ ስም ይጠራቸዋል።

verses.en: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.
verses.fr: Celui qui voudra être béni dans le pays Voudra l''être par le Dieu de vérité, Et celui qui jurera dans le pays Jurera par le Dieu de vérité; Car les anciennes souffrances seront oubliées, Elles seront cachées à mes yeux.
verses.am: እንዲሁም በምድር ላይ የተባረከ በእውነት አምላክ ይባረካል፥ በምድርም ላይ የማለ በእውነት አምላክ ይምላል፤ የቀድሞው ጭንቀት ተረስቶአልና፥ ከዓይኔም ተሰውሮአልና።

verses.en: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
verses.fr: Car je vais créer de nouveaux cieux Et une nouvelle terre; On ne se rappellera plus les choses passées, Elles ne reviendront plus à l''esprit.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አዲስ ሰማይና አዲስ ምድር እፈጥራለሁና፤ የቀደሙትም አይታሰቡም፥ ወደ ልብም አይገቡም።

verses.en: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
verses.fr: Réjouissez-vous plutôt et soyez à toujours dans l''allégresse, A cause de ce que je vais créer; Car je vais créer Jérusalem pour l''allégresse, Et son peuple pour la joie.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በፈጠርሁት ደስ ይበላችሁ ለዘላለምም ሐሤት አድርጉ፤ እነሆ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን ለሐሤት፥ ሕዝብዋንም ለደስታ እፈጥራለሁና።

verses.en: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
verses.fr: Je ferai de Jérusalem mon allégresse, Et de mon peuple ma joie; On n''y entendra plus Le bruit des pleurs et le bruit des cris.
verses.am: እኔም በኢየሩሳሌም ሐሤት አደርጋለሁ በሕዝቤም ደስ ይለኛል፤ ከዚያም ወዲያ የልቅሶ ድምፅና የዋይታ ድምፅ አይሰማባትም።

verses.en: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.
verses.fr: Il n''y aura plus ni enfants ni vieillards Qui n''accomplissent leurs jours; Car celui qui mourra à cent ans sera jeune, Et le pécheur âgé de cent ans sera maudit.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወዲያ ጥቂት ዘመን ብቻ የሚኖር ሕፃን፥ ወይም ዕድሜውን ያልፈጸመ ሽማግሌ አይገኝም፤ ጕልማሳው የመቶ ዓመት ሆኖት ይሞታልና፥ ኃጢአተኛውም የመቶ ዓመት ሆኖት የተረገመ ይሆናልና።

verses.en: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.fr: Ils bâtiront des maisons et les habiteront; Ils planteront des vignes et en mangeront le fruit.
verses.am: ቤቶችንም ይሠራሉ ይቀመጡባቸውማል፤ ወይኑንም ይተክላሉ ፍሬውንም ይበላሉ።

verses.en: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.fr: Ils ne bâtiront pas des maisons pour qu''un autre les habite, Ils ne planteront pas des vignes pour qu''un autre en mange le fruit; Car les jours de mon peuple seront comme les jours des arbres, Et mes élus jouiront de l''oeuvre de leurs mains.
verses.am: ሌላ እንዲቀመጥበት አይሠሩም፥ ሌላም እንዲበላው አይተከሉም፤ የሕዝቤ ዕድሜ እንደ ዛፍ ዕድሜ ይሆናልና፥ እኔም የመረጥኋቸው በእጃቸው ሥራ ረጅም ዘመን ደስ ይላቸዋልና።

verses.en: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the Lord, and their offspring with them.
verses.fr: Ils ne travailleront pas en vain, Et ils n''auront pas des enfants pour les voir périr; Car ils formeront une race bénie de l''Eternel, Et leurs enfants seront avec eux.
verses.am: እነርሱ ከነልጆቻቸው የእግዚአብሔር ቡሩካን ዘር ናቸውና በከንቱ አይደክሙም ለጥፋትም አይወልዱም።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
verses.fr: Avant qu''ils m''invoquent, je répondrai; Avant qu''ils aient cessé de parler, j''exaucerai.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ ሳይጠሩ አመልስላቸዋለሁ፥ ገናም ሲናገሩ እሰማለሁ።

verses.en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Le loup et l''agneau paîtront ensemble, Le lion, comme le boeuf, mangera de la paille, Et le serpent aura la poussière pour nourriture. Il ne se fera ni tort ni dommage Sur toute ma montagne sainte, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ተኵላና ጠቦት በአንድነት ይሰማራሉ፥ አንበሳም እንደ በሬ ገለባ ይበላል፥ የእባብም መብል ትቢያ ይሆናል። በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ ሁሉ አይጐዱም፥ አያጠፉምም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Le ciel est mon trône, Et la terre mon marchepied. Quelle maison pourriez-vous me bâtir, Et quel lieu me donneriez-vous pour demeure?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰማይ ዙፋኔ ነው፥ ምድርም የእግሬ መረገጫ ናት፤ የምትሠሩልኝ ቤት ምን ዓይነት ነው? የማርፍበትስ ስፍራ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: For all those things hath mine hand made, and all those things have been, saith the Lord: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.
verses.fr: Toutes ces choses, ma main les a faites, Et toutes ont reçu l''existence, dit l''Eternel. Voici sur qui je porterai mes regards: Sur celui qui souffre et qui a l''esprit abattu, Sur celui qui craint ma parole.
verses.am: እነዚህን ሁሉ እጄ ሠርታለችና እነዚህ ሁሉ የእኔ ናቸው ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነገር ግን ወደዚህ ወደ ትሑት፥ መንፈሱም ወደ ተሰበረ፥ በቃሌም ወደሚንቀጠቀጥ ሰው እመለከታለሁ።

verses.en: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine's blood; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.
verses.fr: Celui qui immole un boeuf est comme celui qui tuerait un homme, Celui qui sacrifie un agneau est comme celui qui romprait la nuque à un chien, Celui qui présente une offrande est comme celui qui répandrait du sang de porc, Celui qui brûle de l''encens est comme celui qui adorerait des idoles; Tous ceux-là se complaisent dans leurs voies, Et leur âme trouve du plaisir dans leurs abominations.
verses.am: በሬን የሚያርድልኝ ሰውን እንደሚገድል ነው፤ ጠቦትንም የሚሠዋ የውሻውን አንገት እንደሚሰብር ነው፤ የእህልን ቍርባን የሚያቀርብ የእርያን ደም እንደሚያቀርብ ነው፤ ዕጣንን የሚያጥን ጣዖትን እንደሚባርክ ነው። እነዚህ የገዛ መንገዳቸውን መረጡ፤ ነፍሳቸውም በርኵሰታቸው ደስ ይላታል፤

verses.en: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.
verses.fr: Moi aussi, je me complairai dans leur infortune, Et je ferai venir sur eux ce qui cause leur effroi, Parce que j''ai appelé, et qu''ils n''ont point répondu, Parce que j''ai parlé, et qu''ils n''ont point écouté; Mais ils ont fait ce qui est mal à mes yeux, Et ils ont choisi ce qui me déplaît.
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ የተሳለቀባቸውን እመርጣለሁ፥ የፈሩትንም ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁ፤ በፊቴ ክፉ ነገርን አደረጉ፥ ያልወደድሁትንም መረጡ እንጂ በጠራሁ ጊዜ አልመለሱልኝምና፥ በተናገርሁም ጊዜ አልሰሙኝምና።

verses.en: Hear the word of the Lord, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, said, Let the Lord be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.
verses.fr: Ecoutez la parole de l''Eternel, Vous qui craignez sa parole. Voici ce que disent vos frères, Qui vous haïssent et vous repoussent A cause de mon nom: Que l''Eternel montre sa gloire, Et que nous voyions votre joie! -Mais ils seront confondus.
verses.am: በቃሉ የምትንቀጠቀጡ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ። የጠሉአችሁ ስለ ስሜም ያባረሩአችሁ ወንድሞቻችሁ። ደስታችሁን እናይ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ይክበር ብለዋል፤ ነገር ግን ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the Lord that rendereth recompence to his enemies.
verses.fr: Une voix éclatante sort de la ville, Une voix sort du temple. C''est la voix de l''Eternel, Qui paie à ses ennemis leur salaire.
verses.am: የጩኸት ድምፅ ከከተማ፥ ድምፅም ከመቅደስ፥ በጠላቶቹ ላይ ፍዳን የሚያመጣ የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
verses.fr: Avant d''éprouver les douleurs, Elle a enfanté; Avant que les souffrances lui vinssent, Elle a donné naissance à un fils.
verses.am: ሳታምጥ ወለደች፤ ምጥም ሳያገኛት ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች።

verses.en: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.
verses.fr: Qui a jamais entendu pareille chose? Qui a jamais vu rien de semblable? Un pays peut-il naître en un jour? Une nation est-elle enfantée d''un seul coup? A peine en travail, Sion a enfanté ses fils!
verses.am: ከቶ እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ማን ሰምቶአል? እንዲህስ ያለ ነገር ማን አይቶአል? በውኑ አገር በአንድ ቀን ታምጣለችን? ወይስ በአንድ ጊዜ ሕዝብ ይወለዳልን? ጽዮን እንዳማጠች ወዲያው ልጆችዋን ወልዳለችና።

verses.en: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the Lord: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? saith thy God.
verses.fr: Ouvrirais-je le sein maternel, Pour ne pas laisser enfanter? dit l''Eternel; Moi, qui fais naître, Empêcherais-je d''enfanter? dit ton Dieu.
verses.am: በውኑ ወደ መውለድ የማደርስ እኔ አላስወልድምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ የማስወልድስ ማኅፀንን እኔ እዘጋለሁን? ይላል አምላክሽ።

verses.en: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:
verses.fr: Réjouissez-vous avec Jérusalem, Faites d''elle le sujet de votre allégresse, Vous tous qui l''aimez; Tressaillez avec elle de joie, Vous tous qui menez deuil sur elle;
verses.am: እናንተ የምትወድዱአት ሁሉ፥ ከኢየሩሳሌም ጋር ሐሤትን አድርጉ፥ ስለ እርስዋም ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ እናንተም የምታለቅሱላት ሁሉ፥ ከእርስዋ ጋር በደስታ ሐሤትን አድርጉ፥

verses.en: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.
verses.fr: Afin que vous soyez nourris et rassasiés Du lait de ses consolations, Afin que vous savouriez avec bonheur La plénitude de sa gloire.
verses.am: ትጠቡ ዘንድ ከማጽናናትዋም ጡት ትጠግቡ ዘንድ፤ እጅግ ጠጥታችሁ በክብርዋ ሙላት ደስ ይላችሁ ዘንድ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je dirigerai vers elle la paix comme un fleuve, Et la gloire des nations comme un torrent débordé, Et vous serez allaités; Vous serez portés sur les bras, Et caressés sur les genoux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ሰላምን እንደ ወንዝ፥ የአሕዛብንም ክብር እንደሚጐርፍ ፈሳሽ እመልስላታለሁ፤ ከዚያም ትጠባላችሁ፥ በጫንቃ ላይ ይሸከሙአችኋል በጕልበትም ላይ እያስቀመጡ ያቀማጥሉአችኋል።

verses.en: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Comme un homme que sa mère console, Ainsi je vous consolerai; Vous serez consolés dans Jérusalem.
verses.am: እናት ልጅዋን እንደምታጽናና እንዲሁ አጽናናችኋለሁ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ውስጥ ትጽናናላችሁ።

verses.en: And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the Lord shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.
verses.fr: Vous le verrez, et votre coeur sera dans la joie, Et vos os reprendront de la vigueur comme l''herbe; L''Eternel manifestera sa puissance envers ses serviteurs, Mais il fera sentir sa colère à ses ennemis.
verses.am: ታያላችሁ፥ ልባችሁም ሐሤት ታደርጋለች፥ አጥንታችሁም እንደ ለምለም ሣር ትበቅላለች፤ የእግዚአብሔርም እጅ ለሚፈሩት ትታወቃለች፥ በጠላቶቹም ላይ ይቈጣል።

verses.en: For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
verses.fr: Car voici, l''Eternel arrive dans un feu, Et ses chars sont comme un tourbillon; Il convertit sa colère en un brasier, Et ses menaces en flammes de feu.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር መዓቱን በቍጣ፥ ዘለፋውንም በእሳት ነበልባል ይመልስ ዘንድ ከእሳት ጋር ይመጣል፥ ሰረገሎቹም እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.
verses.fr: C''est par le feu que l''Eternel exerce ses jugements, C''est par son glaive qu''il châtie toute chair; Et ceux que tuera l''Eternel seront en grand nombre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ በእሳትና በሰይፉ ይፈርዳል፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ተወግተው የሞቱት ይበዛሉ።

verses.en: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ceux qui se sanctifient et se purifient dans les jardins, Au milieu desquels ils vont un à un, Qui mangent de la chair de porc, Des choses abominables et des souris, Tous ceux-là périront, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በመካከላቸው ያለውን አንዱን ተከትለው ወደ ገነቱ ይገቡ ዘንድ ሰውነታቸውን የሚቀድሱና የሚያነጹ፥ የእሪያንም ሥጋ አስጸያፊ ነገርንም አይጥንም የሚበሉ በአንድነት ይጠፋሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.
verses.fr: Je connais leurs oeuvres et leurs pensées. Le temps est venu de rassembler toutes les nations Et toutes les langues; Elles viendront et verront ma gloire.
verses.am: ሥራቸውንና አሳባቸውን አውቄአለሁና፤ አሕዛብንና ልሳናትን ሁሉ የምሰበስብበት ጊዜ ይደርሳል፥ እነርሱም ይመጣሉ ክብሬንም ያያሉ።

verses.en: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.
verses.fr: Je mettrai un signe parmi elles, Et j''enverrai leurs réchappés vers les nations, A Tarsis, à Pul et à Lud, qui tirent de l''arc, A Tubal et à Javan, Aux îles lointaines, Qui jamais n''ont entendu parler de moi, Et qui n''ont pas vu ma gloire; Et ils publieront ma gloire parmi les nations.
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም ምልክት አደርጋለሁ፥ ከእነርሱም የዳኑትን ዝናዬን ወዳልሰሙ፥ ክብሬንም ወዳላዩ ወደ አሕዛብ ወደ ተርሴስ ወደ ፉጥ ወደ ሉድ ወደ ሞሳሕ ወደ ቶቤል ወደ ያዋን በሩቅ ወዳሉ ደሴቶች እልካቸዋለሁ፥ በአሕዛብም መካከል ክብሬንም ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the Lord, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils amèneront tous vos frères du milieu de toutes les nations, En offrande à l''Eternel, Sur des chevaux, des chars et des litières, Sur des mulets et des dromadaires, A ma montagne sainte, A Jérusalem, dit l''Eternel, Comme les enfants d''Israël apportent leur offrande, Dans un vase pur, A la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ቍርባናቸውን በጥሩ ዕቃ አድርገው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደሚያመጡ፥ እንዲሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ቍርባን ይሆን ዘንድ ወንድሞቻችሁን ሁሉ፥ በፈረሶችና በሰረገሎች፥ በአልጋዎችና በበቅሎች በጠያር ግመሎችም ላይ አድርገው፥ ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ ወደ ተቀደሰው ተራራዬ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ያመጡአቸዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Et je prendrai aussi parmi eux Des sacrificateurs, des Lévites, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህናትና ሌዋውያን እንዲሆኑ ከእነርሱ እወስዳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.
verses.fr: Car, comme les nouveaux cieux Et la nouvelle terre que je vais créer Subsisteront devant moi, dit l''Eternel, Ainsi subsisteront votre postérité et votre nom.
verses.am: እኔ የምሠራቸው አዲስ ሰማይና አዲስ ምድር ከፊቴ ጸንተው እንደሚኖሩ፥ እንዲሁ ዘራችሁና ስማችሁ ጸንተው ይኖራሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: A chaque nouvelle lune et à chaque sabbat, Toute chair viendra se prosterner devant moi, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ በየመባቻውና በየሰንበቱ ሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ በፊቴ ይሰግድ ዘንድ ዘወትር ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
verses.fr: Et quand on sortira, on verra Les cadavres des hommes qui se sont rebellés contre moi; Car leur ver ne mourra point, et leur feu ne s''éteindra point; Et ils seront pour toute chair un objet d''horreur.
verses.am: ወጥተውም በእኔ ያመፁብኝን ሰዎች ሬሳቸውን ያያሉ፤ ትላቸው አይሞትምና፥ እሳታቸውም አይጠፋምና፤ ለሥጋ ለባሽም ሁሉ አስጸያፊ ነገር ይሆናሉ።
